average.statement: def average {K : ℕ} (g : Fin K → H) : H
average.complete_declaration:
def average {K : ℕ} (g : Fin K → H) : H :=
  (1 / (K : ℝ)) • ∑ i, g i

norm_sum_sq_of_orthogonal.statement:
theorem norm_sum_sq_of_orthogonal {K : ℕ} (g : Fin K → H)
    (hc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → inner ℝ (g i) (g j) = 0) :
    ‖∑ i, g i‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i, ‖g i‖ ^ 2
norm_sum_sq_of_orthogonal.complete_declaration:
theorem norm_sum_sq_of_orthogonal {K : ℕ} (g : Fin K → H)
    (hc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → inner ℝ (g i) (g j) = 0) :
    ‖∑ i, g i‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i, ‖g i‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hi (i j : Fin K) : inner ℝ (g i) (g j) =
      if i = j then ‖g i‖ ^ 2 else 0 := by
    split_ifs with hij
    · subst j; exact real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq _
    · exact hc i j hij
  rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  simp_rw [sum_inner, inner_sum, hi]
  simp

mean_sq_sum_of_orthogonal.statement:
theorem mean_sq_sum_of_orthogonal {K : ℕ} (g : Fin K → H)
    (hc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → inner ℝ (g i) (g j) = 0) :
    ‖average g‖ ^ 2 = (1 / (K : ℝ)) ^ 2 * ∑ i, ‖g i‖ ^ 2
mean_sq_sum_of_orthogonal.complete_declaration:
theorem mean_sq_sum_of_orthogonal {K : ℕ} (g : Fin K → H)
    (hc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → inner ℝ (g i) (g j) = 0) :
    ‖average g‖ ^ 2 = (1 / (K : ℝ)) ^ 2 * ∑ i, ‖g i‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [average, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs,
    norm_sum_sq_of_orthogonal g hc]

mean_sq_sum_of_orthogonal_le.statement:
theorem mean_sq_sum_of_orthogonal_le {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (g : Fin K → H) (V : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → inner ℝ (g i) (g j) = 0)
    (hV : ∀ i, ‖g i‖ ^ 2 ≤ V) : ‖average g‖ ^ 2 ≤ V / K
mean_sq_sum_of_orthogonal_le.complete_declaration:
theorem mean_sq_sum_of_orthogonal_le {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (g : Fin K → H) (V : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → inner ℝ (g i) (g j) = 0)
    (hV : ∀ i, ‖g i‖ ^ 2 ≤ V) : ‖average g‖ ^ 2 ≤ V / K := by
  have hsum : (∑ i, ‖g i‖ ^ 2) ≤ (K : ℝ) * V := by
    calc
      (∑ i, ‖g i‖ ^ 2) ≤ ∑ _ : Fin K, V := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ ↦ hV i)
      _ = (K : ℝ) * V := by simp
  rw [mean_sq_sum_of_orthogonal g hc]
  calc
    (1 / (K : ℝ)) ^ 2 * ∑ i, ‖g i‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (1 / (K : ℝ)) ^ 2 * ((K : ℝ) * V) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = V / K := by field_simp

mean_sum_of_orthogonal_le.statement:
theorem mean_sum_of_orthogonal_le {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (g : Fin K → H) (V : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → inner ℝ (g i) (g j) = 0)
    (hV : ∀ i, ‖g i‖ ^ 2 ≤ V) : ‖average g‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (V / K)
mean_sum_of_orthogonal_le.complete_declaration:
theorem mean_sum_of_orthogonal_le {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (g : Fin K → H) (V : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → inner ℝ (g i) (g j) = 0)
    (hV : ∀ i, ‖g i‖ ^ 2 ≤ V) : ‖average g‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (V / K) := by
  rw [← Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg (average g))]
  exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (mean_sq_sum_of_orthogonal_le hK g V hc hV)

norm_sum_smul_sq.statement:
theorem norm_sum_smul_sq {M : ℕ} (c : Fin M → ℝ) (g : Fin M → H) :
    ‖∑ i, c i • g i‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, (c i * c j) * inner ℝ (g i) (g j)
norm_sum_smul_sq.complete_declaration:
theorem norm_sum_smul_sq {M : ℕ} (c : Fin M → ℝ) (g : Fin M → H) :
    ‖∑ i, c i • g i‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, (c i * c j) * inner ℝ (g i) (g j) := by
  rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  simp_rw [sum_inner, inner_sum, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right]
  simp only [mul_assoc]

centered_sum_eq_zero.statement:
theorem centered_sum_eq_zero {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (g : Fin M → H) :
    (∑ i, (g i - average g)) = 0
centered_sum_eq_zero.complete_declaration:
theorem centered_sum_eq_zero {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (g : Fin M → H) :
    (∑ i, (g i - average g)) = 0 := by
  have hm : (M : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : M ≠ 0)
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
    ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ]
  unfold average
  rw [smul_smul, mul_one_div_cancel hm, one_smul, sub_self]

sum_cross_inner.statement:
private theorem sum_cross_inner {M : ℕ} (g : Fin M → H) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, inner ℝ (g i) (g j)) = ‖∑ i, g i‖ ^ 2
sum_cross_inner.complete_declaration:
private theorem sum_cross_inner {M : ℕ} (g : Fin M → H) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, inner ℝ (g i) (g j)) = ‖∑ i, g i‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  simp_rw [sum_inner, inner_sum]

equicorrelated_sum.statement:
theorem equicorrelated_sum {M : ℕ} (p r : ℝ) (g : Fin M → H) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, (if i = j then p else r) * inner ℝ (g i) (g j)) =
      (p - r) * (∑ i, ‖g i‖ ^ 2) + r * ‖∑ i, g i‖ ^ 2
equicorrelated_sum.complete_declaration:
theorem equicorrelated_sum {M : ℕ} (p r : ℝ) (g : Fin M → H) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, (if i = j then p else r) * inner ℝ (g i) (g j)) =
      (p - r) * (∑ i, ‖g i‖ ^ 2) + r * ‖∑ i, g i‖ ^ 2 := by
  classical
  have hs (i j : Fin M) :
      (if i = j then p else r) * inner ℝ (g i) (g j) =
        r * inner ℝ (g i) (g j) +
          (if i = j then (p - r) * inner ℝ (g i) (g j) else 0) := by
    split_ifs <;> ring
  simp_rw [hs, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have hd (i : Fin M) :
      (∑ j, if i = j then (p - r) * inner ℝ (g i) (g j) else 0) =
        (p - r) * ‖g i‖ ^ 2 := by simp [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  simp_rw [hd, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [sum_cross_inner]
  ring

inclusion.statement: def inclusion {M : ℕ} (batch : Ω → Finset (Fin M)) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin M) : ℝ
inclusion.complete_declaration:
def inclusion {M : ℕ} (batch : Ω → Finset (Fin M)) (ω : Ω) (i : Fin M) : ℝ :=
  if i ∈ batch ω then 1 else 0

BatchInclusionLaw.statement: structure BatchInclusionLaw {M : ℕ} (B : ℕ) (batch : Ω → Finset (Fin M)) : Prop
BatchInclusionLaw.complete_declaration:
structure BatchInclusionLaw {M : ℕ} (B : ℕ) (batch : Ω → Finset (Fin M)) : Prop where
  size : ∀ ω, (batch ω).card = B
  first : ∀ i, (∫ ω, inclusion batch ω i ∂P) = (B : ℝ) / M
  pair : ∀ i j, i ≠ j →
    (∫ ω, inclusion batch ω i * inclusion batch ω j ∂P) =
      (B : ℝ) * ((B : ℝ) - 1) / ((M : ℝ) * ((M : ℝ) - 1))

batchAverage.statement:
def batchAverage {M : ℕ} (B : ℕ) (batch : Ω → Finset (Fin M))
    (g : Fin M → H) (ω : Ω) : H

sum_inclusion.statement:
theorem sum_inclusion {M : ℕ} (batch : Ω → Finset (Fin M)) (ω : Ω) :
    (∑ i, inclusion batch ω i) = ((batch ω).card : ℝ)
sum_inclusion.complete_declaration:
theorem sum_inclusion {M : ℕ} (batch : Ω → Finset (Fin M)) (ω : Ω) :
    (∑ i, inclusion batch ω i) = ((batch ω).card : ℝ) := by
  classical
  simp [inclusion, ← Finset.sum_filter]

batchAverage_centered.statement:
theorem batchAverage_centered {M B : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B)
    (batch : Ω → Finset (Fin M)) (hbatch : BatchInclusionLaw P B batch)
    (g : Fin M → H) (ω : Ω) :
    batchAverage B batch (fun i ↦ g i - average g) ω =
      batchAverage B batch g ω - average g
batchAverage_centered.complete_declaration:
theorem batchAverage_centered {M B : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B)
    (batch : Ω → Finset (Fin M)) (hbatch : BatchInclusionLaw P B batch)
    (g : Fin M → H) (ω : Ω) :
    batchAverage B batch (fun i ↦ g i - average g) ω =
      batchAverage B batch g ω - average g := by
  have hb : (B : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : B ≠ 0)
  unfold batchAverage
  simp_rw [smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [← Finset.sum_smul, sum_inclusion batch ω, hbatch.size ω,
    smul_sub, smul_smul, one_div_mul_cancel hb, one_smul]

inclusion_product_moment.statement:
theorem inclusion_product_moment {M B : ℕ} (batch : Ω → Finset (Fin M))
    (hbatch : BatchInclusionLaw P B batch) (i j : Fin M) :
    (∫ ω, inclusion batch ω i * inclusion batch ω j ∂P) =
      if i = j then (B : ℝ) / M else
        (B : ℝ) * ((B : ℝ) - 1) / ((M : ℝ) * ((M : ℝ) - 1))
inclusion_product_moment.complete_declaration:
theorem inclusion_product_moment {M B : ℕ} (batch : Ω → Finset (Fin M))
    (hbatch : BatchInclusionLaw P B batch) (i j : Fin M) :
    (∫ ω, inclusion batch ω i * inclusion batch ω j ∂P) =
      if i = j then (B : ℝ) / M else
        (B : ℝ) * ((B : ℝ) - 1) / ((M : ℝ) * ((M : ℝ) - 1)) := by
  classical
  split_ifs with hij
  · subst j
    have hid (ω : Ω) : inclusion batch ω i * inclusion batch ω i =
        inclusion batch ω i := by
      unfold inclusion
      split_ifs <;> norm_num
    simp_rw [hid]
    exact hbatch.first i
  · exact hbatch.pair i j hij

batch_sum_second_moment.statement:
theorem batch_sum_second_moment {M B : ℕ} (batch : Ω → Finset (Fin M))
    (hbatch : BatchInclusionLaw P B batch) (g : Fin M → H) :
    (∫ ω, ‖∑ i, inclusion batch ω i • g i‖ ^ 2 ∂P) =
      ((B : ℝ) / M -
        (B : ℝ) * ((B : ℝ) - 1) / ((M : ℝ) * ((M : ℝ) - 1))) *
          (∑ i, ‖g i‖ ^ 2) +
      ((B : ℝ) * ((B : ℝ) - 1) / ((M : ℝ) * ((M : ℝ) - 1))) *
        ‖∑ i, g i‖ ^ 2
batch_sum_second_moment.complete_declaration:
theorem batch_sum_second_moment {M B : ℕ} (batch : Ω → Finset (Fin M))
    (hbatch : BatchInclusionLaw P B batch) (g : Fin M → H) :
    (∫ ω, ‖∑ i, inclusion batch ω i • g i‖ ^ 2 ∂P) =
      ((B : ℝ) / M -
        (B : ℝ) * ((B : ℝ) - 1) / ((M : ℝ) * ((M : ℝ) - 1))) *
          (∑ i, ‖g i‖ ^ 2) +
      ((B : ℝ) * ((B : ℝ) - 1) / ((M : ℝ) * ((M : ℝ) - 1))) *
        ‖∑ i, g i‖ ^ 2 := by
  simp_rw [norm_sum_smul_sq]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun _ _ ↦ Integrable.of_finite)]
  simp_rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun _ _ ↦ Integrable.of_finite)]
  simp_rw [integral_mul_const, inclusion_product_moment P batch hbatch]
  exact equicorrelated_sum _ _ g

without_replacement_variance.statement:
theorem without_replacement_variance {M B : ℕ} (hM : 1 < M) (hB : 0 < B)
    (batch : Ω → Finset (Fin M)) (hbatch : BatchInclusionLaw P B batch)
    (g : Fin M → H) (hzero : ∑ i, g i = 0) :
    (∫ ω, ‖batchAverage B batch g ω‖ ^ 2 ∂P) =
      ((M : ℝ) - B) / ((B : ℝ) * ((M : ℝ) - 1)) *
        ((1 / (M : ℝ)) * ∑ i, ‖g i‖ ^ 2)
without_replacement_variance.complete_declaration:
theorem without_replacement_variance {M B : ℕ} (hM : 1 < M) (hB : 0 < B)
    (batch : Ω → Finset (Fin M)) (hbatch : BatchInclusionLaw P B batch)
    (g : Fin M → H) (hzero : ∑ i, g i = 0) :
    (∫ ω, ‖batchAverage B batch g ω‖ ^ 2 ∂P) =
      ((M : ℝ) - B) / ((B : ℝ) * ((M : ℝ) - 1)) *
        ((1 / (M : ℝ)) * ∑ i, ‖g i‖ ^ 2) := by
  have hMc : (M : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : M ≠ 0)
  have hBc : (B : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : B ≠ 0)
  have hM1 : (M : ℝ) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    have hMc' : (1 : ℝ) < M := by exact_mod_cast hM
    linarith
  unfold batchAverage
  simp_rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
  rw [integral_const_mul, batch_sum_second_moment P batch hbatch g, hzero]
  simp only [norm_zero, zero_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), mul_zero, add_zero]
  field_simp [hMc, hBc, hM1]
  ring

minibatch_gradient_variance.statement:
theorem minibatch_gradient_variance {M B : ℕ} (hM : 1 < M) (hB : 0 < B)
    (batch : Ω → Finset (Fin M)) (hbatch : BatchInclusionLaw P B batch)
    (g : Fin M → H) :
    (∫ ω, ‖batchAverage B batch g ω - average g‖ ^ 2 ∂P) =
      ((M : ℝ) - B) / ((B : ℝ) * ((M : ℝ) - 1)) *
        ((1 / (M : ℝ)) * ∑ i, ‖g i - average g‖ ^ 2)
minibatch_gradient_variance.complete_declaration:
theorem minibatch_gradient_variance {M B : ℕ} (hM : 1 < M) (hB : 0 < B)
    (batch : Ω → Finset (Fin M)) (hbatch : BatchInclusionLaw P B batch)
    (g : Fin M → H) :
    (∫ ω, ‖batchAverage B batch g ω - average g‖ ^ 2 ∂P) =
      ((M : ℝ) - B) / ((B : ℝ) * ((M : ℝ) - 1)) *
        ((1 / (M : ℝ)) * ∑ i, ‖g i - average g‖ ^ 2) := by
  simpa only [batchAverage_centered P hB batch hbatch g] using
    without_replacement_variance P hM hB batch hbatch (fun i ↦ g i - average g)
      (centered_sum_eq_zero (by omega) g)

oracleVariance.statement: def oracleVariance (M B : ℕ) (V : ℝ) : ℝ
oracleVariance.complete_declaration:
def oracleVariance (M B : ℕ) (V : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((M : ℝ) - B) / ((B : ℝ) * ((M : ℝ) - 1)) * V

minibatch_oracle_variance_bound.statement:
theorem minibatch_oracle_variance_bound {M B : ℕ}
    (hM : 1 < M) (hB : 0 < B) (hBM : B ≤ M)
    (batch : Ω → Finset (Fin M)) (hbatch : BatchInclusionLaw P B batch)
    (g : Fin M → H) (V : ℝ)
    (hV : ((1 / (M : ℝ)) * ∑ i, ‖g i - average g‖ ^ 2) ≤ V) :
    (∫ ω, ‖batchAverage B batch g ω - average g‖ ^ 2 ∂P) ≤
      oracleVariance M B V
minibatch_oracle_variance_bound.complete_declaration:
theorem minibatch_oracle_variance_bound {M B : ℕ}
    (hM : 1 < M) (hB : 0 < B) (hBM : B ≤ M)
    (batch : Ω → Finset (Fin M)) (hbatch : BatchInclusionLaw P B batch)
    (g : Fin M → H) (V : ℝ)
    (hV : ((1 / (M : ℝ)) * ∑ i, ‖g i - average g‖ ^ 2) ≤ V) :
    (∫ ω, ‖batchAverage B batch g ω - average g‖ ^ 2 ∂P) ≤
      oracleVariance M B V := by
  rw [minibatch_gradient_variance P hM hB batch hbatch g]
  unfold oracleVariance
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hV
  have hMc : (1 : ℝ) < M := by exact_mod_cast hM
  have hBc : (0 : ℝ) < B := by exact_mod_cast hB
  have hBMc : (B : ℝ) ≤ M := by exact_mod_cast hBM
  exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hBMc)
    (mul_nonneg hBc.le (by linarith))

/-!
# Quantitative stability and discretization error for latent Euler algorithms

These results concern actual Euler updates on a real inner product space.  In the
paper's interacting algorithm that space can be the latent parameter / particle
cloud with its particle-normalized inner product.  Neither contraction nor an
error recurrence is included among the hypotheses.

The reference-path consistency hypothesis below is a *local defect bound*.  An
SDE application must establish it from the drift and Brownian regularity; this
file does not claim that such a bound follows from monotonicity alone.
-/

open scoped NNReal

namespace LatentDiffusion

variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]

/-- Added regularity assumption on the positive force, i.e. minus the SDE drift.
The constant `L` is nonnegative by its type. -/

/-- A step restriction stated without division, including degenerate spaces. -/

/-- The Euler update, with the entire additive noise increment supplied as `ξ`.
For IPLD it is `sqrt (2h)` times the appropriately scaled Gaussian cloud. -/

/-- The actual numerical trajectory, rather than an assumed error recurrence. -/

/-- Shared additive noise cancels, and strong monotonicity yields the sharp
quadratic one-step coefficient. -/

/-- A simpler squared contraction with a transparent step restriction. -/

/-- Norm contraction sufficient for robust coupling and numerical consistency. -/

/-- The familiar minimum step restriction implies the division-free one. -/

/-- A single update separates force approximation error from the reference's
local discretization defect. No stochastic independence is required. -/

/-- Finite-horizon robust numerical bound, including the exact geometric factor.
`G` is the implemented force; `F` is the reference force. The reference can be an
exact SDE skeleton once the stated local defect estimate has been established. -/

/-- Uniform numerical and model bias: `2 B / m + (2 D / m) sqrt h`.
The dimension and number of particles do not enter this algebraic estimate. -/

end LatentDiffusion

namespace LatentDiffusion

variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]

/-- Squared coupling error averaged over a finite probability space. -/

/-- Explicit finite probability weights. Normalization gives the expression its
usual expectation interpretation; the algebraic estimates only need positivity. -/

/-- Euler with a shared additive increment and an additional stochastic force
innovation `ζ`, multiplied by the step size. -/

/-- The zero cross moment needed from a centered innovation is stated on the
current Euler displacement. Conditional mean zero given the current states and
shared increment is a sufficient probabilistic condition for this assumption. -/

/-- Pythagorean identity after averaging: only the explicit cross moment is used. -/

/-- Centered stochastic force error has a mean-square floor of order `h`, rather
than the order-one floor for an arbitrary bounded force error. The result is for
actual coupled Euler recursions on any finite probability space. -/

end LatentDiffusion

namespace LatentDiffusion

open MeasureTheory

variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Primitive assumptions on exact integral reference segments. In an `L²`
realization `G` bounds the drift root mean square and `N sqrt t` bounds the
Brownian-increment root mean square. These are moment assumptions, not a local
numerical error or contraction assumption. `W` is the additive noise path. -/

/-- The local consistency bound is derived from the exact integral equation,
the drift moment bound, and the square-root noise increment bound. -/

/-- Nonasymptotic Euler error derived from primitive integral-path moment bounds,
with separate numerical bias `O(h G + N sqrt h)` and force-model bias `O(B)`.
The ambient space can be an `L²` Hilbert space, in which case this is an RMS

moment and lifted-force assumptions are separate obligations. -/

namespace LatentDiffusion

/-- Centered local force innovations in a Hilbert space. On `L²(Ω,P;E)`, the
orthogonality field is exactly a zero expected cross term, and the variance
field is a second-moment bound on the stochastic force innovation. -/

/-- Uniform second-moment stability for centered stochastic force errors in an
arbitrary real Hilbert space, including genuine `L²` probability spaces. -/

section ArbitraryProbability

open MeasureTheory

variable {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]

/-- Actual expectation interpretation of the Hilbert squared norm. `Lp` ensures
square integrability of every variable; no totalized nonintegrable expectation
is used as an error metric. -/

/-- Nonasymptotic mean-square stochastic-oracle bound on an arbitrary probability
space, permitting Gaussian innovations. `F` is the explicitly supplied force

ForceRegularity.statement: structure ForceRegularity (F : H → H) (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) : Prop
ForceRegularity.complete_declaration:
structure ForceRegularity (F : H → H) (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) : Prop where
  monotone : ∀ x y, m * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ (F x - F y) (x - y)
  lipschitz : ∀ x y, ‖F x - F y‖ ≤ (L : ℝ) * ‖x - y‖

StableStep.statement: structure StableStep (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (h : ℝ) : Prop
StableStep.complete_declaration:
structure StableStep (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (h : ℝ) : Prop where
  positive : 0 < h
  monotonicity_positive : 0 < m
  scaled_monotonicity : m * h ≤ 1
  scaled_lipschitz : h * (L : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ m

eulerStep.statement: def eulerStep (F : H → H) (h : ℝ) (x ξ : H) : H
eulerStep.complete_declaration: def eulerStep (F : H → H) (h : ℝ) (x ξ : H) : H := x - h • F x + ξ

eulerTrajectory.statement: def eulerTrajectory (F : H → H) (h : ℝ) (ξ : ℕ → H) (x₀ : H) : ℕ → H
eulerTrajectory.complete_declaration:
def eulerTrajectory (F : H → H) (h : ℝ) (ξ : ℕ → H) (x₀ : H) : ℕ → H
  | 0 => x₀
  | n + 1 => eulerStep F h (eulerTrajectory F h ξ x₀ n) (ξ n)

euler_sq_contraction.statement:
theorem euler_sq_contraction (F : H → H) (m h : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (x y ξ : H) :
    ‖eulerStep F h x ξ - eulerStep F h y ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (1 - 2 * m * h + (L : ℝ) ^ 2 * h ^ 2) * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2
euler_sq_contraction.complete_declaration:
theorem euler_sq_contraction (F : H → H) (m h : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (x y ξ : H) :
    ‖eulerStep F h x ξ - eulerStep F h y ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (1 - 2 * m * h + (L : ℝ) ^ 2 * h ^ 2) * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 := by
  simpa [eulerStep, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    using ULA.gradient_step_sq_bound x y (F x) (F y) m h L hh
      (hF.monotone x y) (hF.lipschitz x y)

euler_sq_contraction_stable.statement:
theorem euler_sq_contraction_stable (F : H → H) (m h : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (hs : StableStep m L h) (x y ξ : H) :
    ‖eulerStep F h x ξ - eulerStep F h y ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (1 - m * h) * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2
euler_sq_contraction_stable.complete_declaration:
theorem euler_sq_contraction_stable (F : H → H) (m h : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (hs : StableStep m L h) (x y ξ : H) :
    ‖eulerStep F h x ξ - eulerStep F h y ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (1 - m * h) * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hc : 1 - 2 * m * h + (L : ℝ) ^ 2 * h ^ 2 ≤ 1 - m * h := by
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs.scaled_lipschitz hs.positive.le]
  exact (euler_sq_contraction F m h L hF hs.positive.le x y ξ).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (sq_nonneg _))

euler_contraction.statement:
theorem euler_contraction (F : H → H) (m h : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (hs : StableStep m L h) (x y ξ : H) :
    ‖eulerStep F h x ξ - eulerStep F h y ξ‖ ≤
      (1 - m * h / 2) * ‖x - y‖
euler_contraction.complete_declaration:
theorem euler_contraction (F : H → H) (m h : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (hs : StableStep m L h) (x y ξ : H) :
    ‖eulerStep F h x ξ - eulerStep F h y ξ‖ ≤
      (1 - m * h / 2) * ‖x - y‖ := by
  have hsq := euler_sq_contraction_stable F m h L hF hs x y ξ
  have hq : 0 ≤ 1 - m * h / 2 := by linarith [hs.scaled_monotonicity]
  have hr : 0 ≤ (1 - m * h / 2) * ‖x - y‖ := mul_nonneg hq (norm_nonneg _)
  have hc : (1 - m * h) * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ((1 - m * h / 2) * ‖x - y‖) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (m * h * ‖x - y‖)]
  nlinarith [hsq.trans hc, norm_nonneg (eulerStep F h x ξ - eulerStep F h y ξ)]

stableStep_of_min.statement:
theorem stableStep_of_min (m h : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hL : 0 < (L : ℝ)) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hsmall : h ≤ min (1 / m) (m / (L : ℝ) ^ 2)) : StableStep m L h
stableStep_of_min.complete_declaration:
theorem stableStep_of_min (m h : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hL : 0 < (L : ℝ)) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hsmall : h ≤ min (1 / m) (m / (L : ℝ) ^ 2)) : StableStep m L h where
  positive := hh
  monotonicity_positive := hm
  scaled_monotonicity := by
    have ht := (le_div_iff₀ hm).mp (hsmall.trans (min_le_left _ _))
    nlinarith
  scaled_lipschitz :=
    (le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hL)).mp (hsmall.trans (min_le_right _ _))

euler_local_comparison.statement:
theorem euler_local_comparison (F G : H → H) (m h B R : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (hs : StableStep m L h)
    (x y yNext ξ : H) (hforce : ‖G x - F x‖ ≤ B)
    (hdefect : ‖yNext - eulerStep F h y ξ‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖eulerStep G h x ξ - yNext‖ ≤
      (1 - m * h / 2) * ‖x - y‖ + h * B + R
euler_local_comparison.complete_declaration:
theorem euler_local_comparison (F G : H → H) (m h B R : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (hs : StableStep m L h)
    (x y yNext ξ : H) (hforce : ‖G x - F x‖ ≤ B)
    (hdefect : ‖yNext - eulerStep F h y ξ‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖eulerStep G h x ξ - yNext‖ ≤
      (1 - m * h / 2) * ‖x - y‖ + h * B + R := by
  have hG : ‖eulerStep G h x ξ - eulerStep F h x ξ‖ ≤ h * B := by
    rw [show eulerStep G h x ξ - eulerStep F h x ξ = -h • (G x - F x) by
      unfold eulerStep; module]
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonpos (neg_nonpos.mpr hs.positive.le), neg_neg]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hforce hs.positive.le
  have hd : ‖eulerStep F h y ξ - yNext‖ ≤ R := by simpa [norm_sub_rev] using hdefect
  calc
    ‖eulerStep G h x ξ - yNext‖ ≤
        ‖eulerStep G h x ξ - eulerStep F h x ξ‖ +
          ‖eulerStep F h x ξ - eulerStep F h y ξ‖ +
          ‖eulerStep F h y ξ - yNext‖ := by
      calc
        _ = ‖(eulerStep G h x ξ - eulerStep F h x ξ) +
          (eulerStep F h x ξ - eulerStep F h y ξ) +
          (eulerStep F h y ξ - yNext)‖ := by congr 1; module
        _ ≤ _ := (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (norm_add_le _ _) (le_refl _))
    _ ≤ _ := by linarith [euler_contraction F m h L hF hs x y ξ]

trajectory_error_exact.statement:
theorem trajectory_error_exact (F G : H → H) (m h B D : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (hs : StableStep m L h)
    (ξ : ℕ → H) (x₀ : H) (y : ℕ → H)
    (hforce : ∀ n, ‖G (eulerTrajectory G h ξ x₀ n) - F (eulerTrajectory G h ξ x₀ n)‖ ≤ B)
    (hdefect : ∀ n, ‖y (n + 1) - eulerStep F h (y n) (ξ n)‖ ≤ D * h * Real.sqrt h)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ‖eulerTrajectory G h ξ x₀ n - y n‖ ≤
      (1 - m * h / 2) ^ n * ‖x₀ - y 0‖ +
        (h * B + D * h * Real.sqrt h) *
          (1 - (1 - m * h / 2) ^ n) / (1 - (1 - m * h / 2))
trajectory_error_exact.complete_declaration:
theorem trajectory_error_exact (F G : H → H) (m h B D : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (hs : StableStep m L h)
    (ξ : ℕ → H) (x₀ : H) (y : ℕ → H)
    (hforce : ∀ n, ‖G (eulerTrajectory G h ξ x₀ n) - F (eulerTrajectory G h ξ x₀ n)‖ ≤ B)
    (hdefect : ∀ n, ‖y (n + 1) - eulerStep F h (y n) (ξ n)‖ ≤ D * h * Real.sqrt h)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ‖eulerTrajectory G h ξ x₀ n - y n‖ ≤
      (1 - m * h / 2) ^ n * ‖x₀ - y 0‖ +
        (h * B + D * h * Real.sqrt h) *
          (1 - (1 - m * h / 2) ^ n) / (1 - (1 - m * h / 2)) := by
  have hq : 0 ≤ 1 - m * h / 2 := by linarith [hs.scaled_monotonicity]
  have hq1 : 1 - m * h / 2 < 1 := by nlinarith [hs.positive, hs.monotonicity_positive]
  apply ULA.affine_recurrence_exact (fun k ↦ ‖eulerTrajectory G h ξ x₀ k - y k‖)
    (1 - m * h / 2) (h * B + D * h * Real.sqrt h) hq hq1
    (fun k ↦ ?_) n
  simpa [eulerTrajectory, add_assoc] using euler_local_comparison F G m h B
    (D * h * Real.sqrt h) L hF hs (eulerTrajectory G h ξ x₀ k) (y k)
    (y (k + 1)) (ξ k) (hforce k) (hdefect k)

trajectory_error_bound.statement:
theorem trajectory_error_bound (F G : H → H) (m h B D : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (hs : StableStep m L h) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (ξ : ℕ → H) (x₀ : H) (y : ℕ → H)
    (hforce : ∀ n, ‖G (eulerTrajectory G h ξ x₀ n) - F (eulerTrajectory G h ξ x₀ n)‖ ≤ B)
    (hdefect : ∀ n, ‖y (n + 1) - eulerStep F h (y n) (ξ n)‖ ≤ D * h * Real.sqrt h)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ‖eulerTrajectory G h ξ x₀ n - y n‖ ≤
      (1 - m * h / 2) ^ n * ‖x₀ - y 0‖ +
        (2 / m) * (B + D * Real.sqrt h)
trajectory_error_bound.complete_declaration:
theorem trajectory_error_bound (F G : H → H) (m h B D : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (hs : StableStep m L h) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (ξ : ℕ → H) (x₀ : H) (y : ℕ → H)
    (hforce : ∀ n, ‖G (eulerTrajectory G h ξ x₀ n) - F (eulerTrajectory G h ξ x₀ n)‖ ≤ B)
    (hdefect : ∀ n, ‖y (n + 1) - eulerStep F h (y n) (ξ n)‖ ≤ D * h * Real.sqrt h)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ‖eulerTrajectory G h ξ x₀ n - y n‖ ≤
      (1 - m * h / 2) ^ n * ‖x₀ - y 0‖ +
        (2 / m) * (B + D * Real.sqrt h) := by
  have hq : 0 ≤ 1 - m * h / 2 := by linarith [hs.scaled_monotonicity]
  have hq1 : 1 - m * h / 2 < 1 := by nlinarith [hs.positive, hs.monotonicity_positive]
  have hr := ULA.affine_recurrence_bound (fun k ↦ ‖eulerTrajectory G h ξ x₀ k - y k‖)
    (1 - m * h / 2) (h * B + D * h * Real.sqrt h) hq hq1
    (by have hh := hs.positive.le; positivity) (fun k ↦ ?_) n
  · simpa only [eulerTrajectory] using (hr.trans_eq (by
      congr 1
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hs.positive, ne_of_gt hs.monotonicity_positive]
      ; ring))
  · simpa [eulerTrajectory, add_assoc] using euler_local_comparison F G m h B
      (D * h * Real.sqrt h) L hF hs (eulerTrajectory G h ξ x₀ k) (y k)
      (y (k + 1)) (ξ k) (hforce k) (hdefect k)

finiteMeanSq.statement: def finiteMeanSq {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (p : Ω → ℝ) (z : Ω → H) : ℝ
finiteMeanSq.complete_declaration:
def finiteMeanSq {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (p : Ω → ℝ) (z : Ω → H) : ℝ :=
  ∑ ω, p ω * ‖z ω‖ ^ 2

ProbabilityWeights.statement: structure ProbabilityWeights {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (p : Ω → ℝ) : Prop
ProbabilityWeights.complete_declaration:
structure ProbabilityWeights {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (p : Ω → ℝ) : Prop where
  nonnegative : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω
  total : ∑ ω, p ω = 1

noisyEulerTrajectory.statement:
def noisyEulerTrajectory {Ω : Type*} (F : H → H) (h : ℝ)
    (ξ ζ : ℕ → Ω → H) (x₀ : Ω → H) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : H

CenteredInnovationControl.statement:
structure CenteredInnovationControl {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (p : Ω → ℝ) (F : H → H) (h σ : ℝ) (ξ ζ : ℕ → Ω → H)
    (x₀ y₀ : Ω → H) : Prop
CenteredInnovationControl.complete_declaration:
structure CenteredInnovationControl {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (p : Ω → ℝ) (F : H → H) (h σ : ℝ) (ξ ζ : ℕ → Ω → H)
    (x₀ y₀ : Ω → H) : Prop where
  orthogonal : ∀ n, ∑ ω, p ω * inner ℝ
    (eulerStep F h (noisyEulerTrajectory F h ξ ζ x₀ n ω) (ξ n ω) -
      eulerStep F h (eulerTrajectory F h (fun k ↦ ξ k ω) (y₀ ω) n) (ξ n ω))
    (ζ n ω) = 0
  variance : ∀ n, finiteMeanSq p (ζ n) ≤ σ ^ 2

finiteMeanSq_orthogonal_add.statement:
theorem finiteMeanSq_orthogonal_add {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (p : Ω → ℝ) (a z : Ω → H) (h : ℝ)
    (horth : ∑ ω, p ω * inner ℝ (a ω) (z ω) = 0) :
    finiteMeanSq p (fun ω ↦ a ω + h • z ω) =
      finiteMeanSq p a + h ^ 2 * finiteMeanSq p z
finiteMeanSq_orthogonal_add.complete_declaration:
theorem finiteMeanSq_orthogonal_add {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (p : Ω → ℝ) (a z : Ω → H) (h : ℝ)
    (horth : ∑ ω, p ω * inner ℝ (a ω) (z ω) = 0) :
    finiteMeanSq p (fun ω ↦ a ω + h • z ω) =
      finiteMeanSq p a + h ^ 2 * finiteMeanSq p z := by
  have hp (ω : Ω) : p ω * ‖a ω + h • z ω‖ ^ 2 =
      p ω * ‖a ω‖ ^ 2 + (2 * h) * (p ω * inner ℝ (a ω) (z ω)) +
        h ^ 2 * (p ω * ‖z ω‖ ^ 2) := by
    rw [norm_add_sq_real, real_inner_smul_right, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    rw [mul_pow, sq_abs]
    ring
  simp_rw [finiteMeanSq, hp, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, horth]
  ring

centered_noise_mean_square_bound.statement:
theorem centered_noise_mean_square_bound {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (p : Ω → ℝ) (hp : ProbabilityWeights p)
    (F : H → H) (m h σ : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (hs : StableStep m L h)
    (ξ ζ : ℕ → Ω → H) (x₀ y₀ : Ω → H)
    (hc : CenteredInnovationControl p F h σ ξ ζ x₀ y₀) (n : ℕ) :
    finiteMeanSq p (fun ω ↦ noisyEulerTrajectory F h ξ ζ x₀ n ω -
      eulerTrajectory F h (fun k ↦ ξ k ω) (y₀ ω) n) ≤
        (1 - m * h) ^ n * finiteMeanSq p (fun ω ↦ x₀ ω - y₀ ω) +
          h * σ ^ 2 / m
centered_noise_mean_square_bound.complete_declaration:
theorem centered_noise_mean_square_bound {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (p : Ω → ℝ) (hp : ProbabilityWeights p)
    (F : H → H) (m h σ : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (hs : StableStep m L h)
    (ξ ζ : ℕ → Ω → H) (x₀ y₀ : Ω → H)
    (hc : CenteredInnovationControl p F h σ ξ ζ x₀ y₀) (n : ℕ) :
    finiteMeanSq p (fun ω ↦ noisyEulerTrajectory F h ξ ζ x₀ n ω -
      eulerTrajectory F h (fun k ↦ ξ k ω) (y₀ ω) n) ≤
        (1 - m * h) ^ n * finiteMeanSq p (fun ω ↦ x₀ ω - y₀ ω) +
          h * σ ^ 2 / m := by
  let X : ℕ → Ω → H := noisyEulerTrajectory F h ξ ζ x₀
  let Y : ℕ → Ω → H := fun k ω ↦ eulerTrajectory F h (fun j ↦ ξ j ω) (y₀ ω) k
  let A : ℕ → Ω → H := fun k ω ↦
    eulerStep F h (X k ω) (ξ k ω) - eulerStep F h (Y k ω) (ξ k ω)
  have hstep (k : ℕ) : finiteMeanSq p (fun ω ↦ X (k + 1) ω - Y (k + 1) ω) ≤
      (1 - m * h) * finiteMeanSq p (fun ω ↦ X k ω - Y k ω) + h ^ 2 * σ ^ 2 := by
    have hupdate : (fun ω ↦ X (k + 1) ω - Y (k + 1) ω) =
        (fun ω ↦ A k ω + h • ζ k ω) := by
      funext ω
      dsimp [X, Y, A, noisyEulerTrajectory, eulerTrajectory, eulerStep]
      module
    rw [hupdate, finiteMeanSq_orthogonal_add p (A k) (ζ k) h (hc.orthogonal k)]
    have hcontract : finiteMeanSq p (A k) ≤
        (1 - m * h) * finiteMeanSq p (fun ω ↦ X k ω - Y k ω) := by
      unfold finiteMeanSq
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro ω _
      have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (euler_sq_contraction_stable F m h L hF hs (X k ω) (Y k ω) (ξ k ω))
        (hp.nonnegative ω)
      simpa [A, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using ht
    exact add_le_add hcontract (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hc.variance k) (sq_nonneg h))
  have hq : 0 ≤ 1 - m * h := by linarith [hs.scaled_monotonicity]
  have hq1 : 1 - m * h < 1 := by nlinarith [hs.monotonicity_positive, hs.positive]
  have hr := ULA.affine_recurrence_bound
    (fun k ↦ finiteMeanSq p (fun ω ↦ X k ω - Y k ω))
    (1 - m * h) (h ^ 2 * σ ^ 2) hq hq1 (by positivity) hstep n
  have halgebra : h ^ 2 * σ ^ 2 / (1 - (1 - m * h)) = h * σ ^ 2 / m := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hs.monotonicity_positive, ne_of_gt hs.positive]
    ring
  rw [halgebra] at hr
  simpa [X, Y, noisyEulerTrajectory, eulerTrajectory] using hr

IntegralReference.statement:
structure IntegralReference (F : H → H) (h G N : ℝ) (y : ℕ → H)
    (ξ : ℕ → H) (Y W : ℕ → ℝ → H) : Prop
IntegralReference.complete_declaration:
structure IntegralReference (F : H → H) (h G N : ℝ) (y : ℕ → H)
    (ξ : ℕ → H) (Y W : ℕ → ℝ → H) : Prop where
  starts : ∀ n, Y n 0 = y n
  ends : ∀ n, Y n h = y (n + 1)
  noise_end : ∀ n, W n h = ξ n
  integrable : ∀ n, IntervalIntegrable (fun t ↦ F (Y n t)) volume 0 h
  drift_radius : ∀ n t, t ∈ Set.Icc 0 h → ‖F (Y n t)‖ ≤ G
  noise_growth : ∀ n t, t ∈ Set.Icc 0 h → ‖W n t‖ ≤ N * Real.sqrt t
  equation : ∀ n t, t ∈ Set.Icc 0 h →
    Y n t - Y n 0 = -(∫ s in 0..t, F (Y n s)) + W n t

integral_reference_local_defect.statement:
theorem integral_reference_local_defect (F : H → H) (m h G N : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    (y : ℕ → H) (ξ : ℕ → H) (Y W : ℕ → ℝ → H)
    (hr : IntegralReference F h G N y ξ Y W) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖y (n + 1) - eulerStep F h (y n) (ξ n)‖ ≤
      (L : ℝ) * (h ^ 2 * G / 2 + (2 / 3 : ℝ) * h * Real.sqrt h * N)
integral_reference_local_defect.complete_declaration:
theorem integral_reference_local_defect (F : H → H) (m h G N : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    (y : ℕ → H) (ξ : ℕ → H) (Y W : ℕ → ℝ → H)
    (hr : IntegralReference F h G N y ξ Y W) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖y (n + 1) - eulerStep F h (y n) (ξ n)‖ ≤
      (L : ℝ) * (h ^ 2 * G / 2 + (2 / 3 : ℝ) * h * Real.sqrt h * N) := by
  have hlip : LipschitzWith L F := LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul fun x z ↦ by
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hF.lipschitz x z
  have hid := ULA.localDefect_euler_identity F (Y n) (W n) h (hr.integrable n)
    (hr.equation n h ⟨hh, le_rfl⟩)
  have hn : y (n + 1) - eulerStep F h (y n) (ξ n) = -ULA.localDefect F (Y n) h := by
    rw [hr.starts n, hr.ends n, hr.noise_end n] at hid
    unfold eulerStep
    rw [hid]
    module
  rw [hn, norm_neg]
  exact ULA.localDefect_bound F (Y n) (W n) L h G N hh hlip
    (hr.drift_radius n) (hr.noise_growth n) (hr.equation n)

integral_reference_error_bound.statement:
theorem integral_reference_error_bound (F A : H → H) (m h B G N : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (hs : StableStep m L h)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hG : 0 ≤ G) (hN : 0 ≤ N)
    (y : ℕ → H) (ξ : ℕ → H) (Y W : ℕ → ℝ → H) (x₀ : H)
    (hr : IntegralReference F h G N y ξ Y W)
    (hforce : ∀ n, ‖A (eulerTrajectory A h ξ x₀ n) - F (eulerTrajectory A h ξ x₀ n)‖ ≤ B)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ‖eulerTrajectory A h ξ x₀ n - y n‖ ≤
      (1 - m * h / 2) ^ n * ‖x₀ - y 0‖ +
        2 * B / m + (L : ℝ) / m * (h * G + (4 / 3 : ℝ) * N * Real.sqrt h)
integral_reference_error_bound.complete_declaration:
theorem integral_reference_error_bound (F A : H → H) (m h B G N : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (hs : StableStep m L h)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hG : 0 ≤ G) (hN : 0 ≤ N)
    (y : ℕ → H) (ξ : ℕ → H) (Y W : ℕ → ℝ → H) (x₀ : H)
    (hr : IntegralReference F h G N y ξ Y W)
    (hforce : ∀ n, ‖A (eulerTrajectory A h ξ x₀ n) - F (eulerTrajectory A h ξ x₀ n)‖ ≤ B)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ‖eulerTrajectory A h ξ x₀ n - y n‖ ≤
      (1 - m * h / 2) ^ n * ‖x₀ - y 0‖ +
        2 * B / m + (L : ℝ) / m * (h * G + (4 / 3 : ℝ) * N * Real.sqrt h) := by
  let R : ℝ := (L : ℝ) * (h ^ 2 * G / 2 + (2 / 3 : ℝ) * h * Real.sqrt h * N)
  have hq : 0 ≤ 1 - m * h / 2 := by linarith [hs.scaled_monotonicity]
  have hq1 : 1 - m * h / 2 < 1 := by nlinarith [hs.positive, hs.monotonicity_positive]
  have hb : 0 ≤ h * B + R := by dsimp [R]; have hh := hs.positive.le; positivity
  have hstep (k : ℕ) : ‖eulerTrajectory A h ξ x₀ (k + 1) - y (k + 1)‖ ≤
      (1 - m * h / 2) * ‖eulerTrajectory A h ξ x₀ k - y k‖ + (h * B + R) := by
    simpa only [eulerTrajectory, add_assoc] using euler_local_comparison F A m h B R L
      hF hs (eulerTrajectory A h ξ x₀ k) (y k) (y (k + 1)) (ξ k) (hforce k)
      (integral_reference_local_defect F m h G N L hF hs.positive.le y ξ Y W hr k)
  have ht := ULA.affine_recurrence_bound (fun k ↦ ‖eulerTrajectory A h ξ x₀ k - y k‖)
    (1 - m * h / 2) (h * B + R) hq hq1 hb hstep n
  have halgebra : (h * B + R) / (1 - (1 - m * h / 2)) =
      2 * B / m + (L : ℝ) / m * (h * G + (4 / 3 : ℝ) * N * Real.sqrt h) := by
    dsimp [R]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hs.positive, ne_of_gt hs.monotonicity_positive]
    ring
  rw [halgebra] at ht
  simpa [eulerTrajectory, add_assoc] using ht

HilbertInnovationControl.statement:
structure HilbertInnovationControl (F : H → H) (h σ : ℝ)
    (ξ ζ : ℕ → H) (x₀ y₀ : H) : Prop
HilbertInnovationControl.complete_declaration:
structure HilbertInnovationControl (F : H → H) (h σ : ℝ)
    (ξ ζ : ℕ → H) (x₀ y₀ : H) : Prop where
  orthogonal : ∀ n, inner ℝ
    (eulerStep F h (eulerTrajectory F h (fun k ↦ ξ k + h • ζ k) x₀ n) (ξ n) -
      eulerStep F h (eulerTrajectory F h ξ y₀ n) (ξ n)) (ζ n) = 0
  variance : ∀ n, ‖ζ n‖ ^ 2 ≤ σ ^ 2

hilbert_innovation_sq_bound.statement:
theorem hilbert_innovation_sq_bound (F : H → H) (m h σ : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (hs : StableStep m L h)
    (ξ ζ : ℕ → H) (x₀ y₀ : H) (hc : HilbertInnovationControl F h σ ξ ζ x₀ y₀)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ‖eulerTrajectory F h (fun k ↦ ξ k + h • ζ k) x₀ n - eulerTrajectory F h ξ y₀ n‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (1 - m * h) ^ n * ‖x₀ - y₀‖ ^ 2 + h * σ ^ 2 / m
hilbert_innovation_sq_bound.complete_declaration:
theorem hilbert_innovation_sq_bound (F : H → H) (m h σ : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (hs : StableStep m L h)
    (ξ ζ : ℕ → H) (x₀ y₀ : H) (hc : HilbertInnovationControl F h σ ξ ζ x₀ y₀)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ‖eulerTrajectory F h (fun k ↦ ξ k + h • ζ k) x₀ n - eulerTrajectory F h ξ y₀ n‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (1 - m * h) ^ n * ‖x₀ - y₀‖ ^ 2 + h * σ ^ 2 / m := by
  let X : ℕ → H := eulerTrajectory F h (fun k ↦ ξ k + h • ζ k) x₀
  let Y : ℕ → H := eulerTrajectory F h ξ y₀
  have hstep (k : ℕ) : ‖X (k + 1) - Y (k + 1)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (1 - m * h) * ‖X k - Y k‖ ^ 2 + h ^ 2 * σ ^ 2 := by
    have hid : X (k + 1) - Y (k + 1) =
        (eulerStep F h (X k) (ξ k) - eulerStep F h (Y k) (ξ k)) + h • ζ k := by
      dsimp [X, Y, eulerTrajectory, eulerStep]
      module
    rw [hid, norm_add_sq_real, real_inner_smul_right, hc.orthogonal k,
      mul_zero, mul_zero, add_zero, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
    exact add_le_add (euler_sq_contraction_stable F m h L hF hs (X k) (Y k) (ξ k))
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hc.variance k) (sq_nonneg h))
  have hq : 0 ≤ 1 - m * h := by linarith [hs.scaled_monotonicity]
  have hq1 : 1 - m * h < 1 := by nlinarith [hs.monotonicity_positive, hs.positive]
  have ht := ULA.affine_recurrence_bound (fun k ↦ ‖X k - Y k‖ ^ 2)
    (1 - m * h) (h ^ 2 * σ ^ 2) hq hq1 (by positivity) hstep n
  have halgebra : h ^ 2 * σ ^ 2 / (1 - (1 - m * h)) = h * σ ^ 2 / m := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hs.monotonicity_positive, ne_of_gt hs.positive]
    ring
  rw [halgebra] at ht
  simpa [X, Y, eulerTrajectory] using ht

theorem l2_norm_sq_eq_expectation (X : Lp E 2 P) :

theorem l2_innovation_mean_square_bound
    (F : Lp E 2 P → Lp E 2 P) (m h σ : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (hs : StableStep m L h)
    (ξ ζ : ℕ → Lp E 2 P) (x₀ y₀ : Lp E 2 P)

      eulerTrajectory F h ξ y₀ n) ω‖ ^ 2 ∂P) ≤
        (1 - m * h) ^ n * (∫ ω, ‖(x₀ - y₀) ω‖ ^ 2 ∂P) + h * σ ^ 2 / m
l2_innovation_mean_square_bound.complete_declaration:
theorem l2_innovation_mean_square_bound
    (F : Lp E 2 P → Lp E 2 P) (m h σ : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (hs : StableStep m L h)
    (ξ ζ : ℕ → Lp E 2 P) (x₀ y₀ : Lp E 2 P)

        (1 - m * h) ^ n * (∫ ω, ‖(x₀ - y₀) ω‖ ^ 2 ∂P) + h * σ ^ 2 / m := by
  simpa only [← l2_norm_sq_eq_expectation] using
    hilbert_innovation_sq_bound F m h σ L hF hs ξ ζ x₀ y₀ hc n

theorem integral_density {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H]
    (q : Z → ℝ) (hq : Measurable q) (hpos : ∀ z, 0 ≤ q z) (f : Z → H) :
    (∫ z, f z ∂(volume.withDensity (fun z ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (q z)))) =
      ∫ z, q z • f z
integral_density.complete_declaration:
theorem integral_density {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H]
    (q : Z → ℝ) (hq : Measurable q) (hpos : ∀ z, 0 ≤ q z) (f : Z → H) :
    (∫ z, f z ∂(volume.withDensity (fun z ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (q z)))) =
      ∫ z, q z • f z := by
  rw [integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul hq.ennreal_ofReal
    (ae_of_all _ fun _ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)]
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hpos _)]

theorem gibbs_variational_lower_bound (Q : ProbabilityMeasure Z) (q V : Z → ℝ)
    (hq : Measurable q) (hpos : ∀ z, 0 < q z)
    (hlaw : (Q : Measure Z) = volume.withDensity (fun z ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (q z)))
    (hweight : Integrable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-V z)) volume)
    (hZ : 0 < ∫ z, Real.exp (-V z))
    (hlog : Integrable (fun z ↦ Real.log (q z)) (Q : Measure Z))
    (hV : Integrable V (Q : Measure Z)) :
    -(Real.log (∫ z, Real.exp (-V z))) ≤
      (∫ z, Real.log (q z) ∂(Q : Measure Z)) + ∫ z, V z ∂(Q : Measure Z)
gibbs_variational_lower_bound.complete_declaration:
theorem gibbs_variational_lower_bound (Q : ProbabilityMeasure Z) (q V : Z → ℝ)
    (hq : Measurable q) (hpos : ∀ z, 0 < q z)
    (hlaw : (Q : Measure Z) = volume.withDensity (fun z ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (q z)))
    (hweight : Integrable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-V z)) volume)
    (hZ : 0 < ∫ z, Real.exp (-V z))
    (hlog : Integrable (fun z ↦ Real.log (q z)) (Q : Measure Z))
    (hV : Integrable V (Q : Measure Z)) :
    -(Real.log (∫ z, Real.exp (-V z))) ≤
      (∫ z, Real.log (q z) ∂(Q : Measure Z)) + ∫ z, V z ∂(Q : Measure Z) := by
  let Z0 := ∫ z, Real.exp (-V z)
  let r : Z → ℝ := fun z ↦ (Real.exp (-V z)/Z0)/q z
  have hprod : (fun z ↦ q z * r z) = fun z ↦ Real.exp (-V z)/Z0 := by
    funext z
    dsimp only [r]
    field_simp [(hpos z).ne']
  have hr : Integrable r (Q : Measure Z) := by
    rw [hlaw, integrable_withDensity_iff_integrable_smul' hq.ennreal_ofReal
      (ae_of_all _ fun _ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)]
    simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hpos _).le, smul_eq_mul, hprod] using
      hweight.div_const Z0
  have hrint : (∫ z, r z ∂(Q : Measure Z)) = 1 := by
    rw [hlaw, integral_density q hq (fun z ↦ (hpos z).le)]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, hprod]
    rw [integral_div]
    exact div_self hZ.ne'
  have hpoint (z : Z) : 1-r z ≤ Real.log (q z)+V z+Real.log Z0 := by
    have hz : 0 < Real.exp (-V z)/Z0 := div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) hZ
    have hh := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hz (hpos z))
    rw [Real.log_div hz.ne' (hpos z).ne', Real.log_div (Real.exp_ne_zero _) hZ.ne',
      Real.log_exp] at hh
    dsimp only [r]
    linarith
  have hbound := integral_mono ((integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).sub hr)
    ((hlog.add hV).add (integrable_const (Real.log Z0))) hpoint
  have ha := integral_add' (hlog.add hV) (integrable_const (Real.log Z0))
  have hb := integral_add' hlog hV
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at ha hb
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply] at hbound
  rw [integral_sub (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)) hr, hrint,
    ha, hb] at hbound
  simp only [integral_const, Measure.real, measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one, one_smul] at hbound
  dsimp only [Z0] at hbound
  linarith

theorem energy_lower_bound
    (hweight : ∀ i p, Integrable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-R.potential i p z)) volume)
    (hZ : ∀ i p, 0 < ∫ z, Real.exp (-R.potential i p z))
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    -evidence R (parameterInterpolate a b s) ≤ R.freeEnergy s
energy_lower_bound.complete_declaration:
theorem energy_lower_bound
    (hweight : ∀ i p, Integrable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-R.potential i p z)) volume)
    (hZ : ∀ i p, 0 < ∫ z, Real.exp (-R.potential i p z))
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    -evidence R (parameterInterpolate a b s) ≤ R.freeEnergy s := by
  have hi (i : Fin M) :
      -(Real.log (∫ z, Real.exp (-R.potential i (parameterInterpolate a b s) z))) ≤
        RegularTransport.freeEnergy (R.displacement i) (R.potential i) a b s := by
    let _ := (R.law i).property
    let Q : ProbabilityMeasure Z := ⟨(R.displacement i).law s, inferInstance⟩
    exact gibbs_variational_lower_bound Q ((R.displacement i).density s)
      (R.potential i (parameterInterpolate a b s))
      ((R.displacement i).measurable_density s hs)
      ((R.displacement i).positive_density s hs)
      ((R.displacement i).density_law s hs) (hweight i _) (hZ i _)
      (log_integrable R i s hs) (potential_integrable R i s hs)
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) ↦ hi i)
    (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg M))
  simpa only [evidence, DatasetRegularity.freeEnergy, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, mul_neg] using hh

    (hZ : ∀ i, 0 < ∫ z, Real.exp (-R.potential i b z))
    (hpost : ∀ i z, (R.displacement i).density 1 z =

posterior_energy.complete_declaration:
theorem posterior_energy
    (hZ : ∀ i, 0 < ∫ z, Real.exp (-R.potential i b z))
    (hpost : ∀ i z, (R.displacement i).density 1 z =
      Real.exp (-R.potential i b z)/(∫ w, Real.exp (-R.potential i b w))) :
    R.freeEnergy 1 = -evidence R b := by
  have hi (i : Fin M) :
      RegularTransport.freeEnergy (R.displacement i) (R.potential i) a b 1 =
        -Real.log (∫ z, Real.exp (-R.potential i b z)) := by
    let _ := (R.law i).property
    have hs : (1 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 1 := by constructor <;> norm_num
    have hlog := log_integrable R i 1 hs
    have hpot := potential_integrable R i 1 hs
    simp only [parameterInterpolate, sub_self, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add] at hpot
    unfold RegularTransport.freeEnergy RegularDisplacement.entropy
    simp only [parameterInterpolate, sub_self, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add]
    rw [← integral_add hlog hpot]
    have hp : (fun z ↦ Real.log ((R.displacement i).density 1 z)+R.potential i b z) =
        fun _ ↦ -Real.log (∫ z, Real.exp (-R.potential i b z)) := by
      funext z
      rw [hpost, Real.log_div (Real.exp_ne_zero _) (hZ i).ne', Real.log_exp]
      ring
    rw [hp]
    simp
  simp only [DatasetRegularity.freeEnergy, hi, evidence, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, mul_neg]

theorem posterior_minimal
    (hweight : ∀ i p, Integrable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-R.potential i p z)) volume)
    (hZ : ∀ i p, 0 < ∫ z, Real.exp (-R.potential i p z))
    (hmax : ∀ p, evidence R p ≤ evidence R b)

structure ClassicalFlow (M d : ℕ) (rho : ℝ) (astar : A)
    (U : Fin M → A → Z → ℝ)
ClassicalFlow.complete_declaration:
structure ClassicalFlow (M d : ℕ) (rho : ℝ) (astar : A)
    (U : Fin M → A → Z → ℝ) where
  parameter : ℝ → A
  parameterDerivative : ℝ → A
  density : Fin M → ℝ → Z → ℝ
  densityDerivative : Fin M → ℝ → Z → ℝ
  targetDensity : Fin M → Z → ℝ
  transport : (t : ℝ) → DatasetRegularity (Z := Z) M d (parameter t) astar rho
  potential_eq : ∀ t, (transport t).potential = U
  density_eq : ∀ t i, ((transport t).displacement i).density 0 = density i t
  target_density_eq : ∀ t i, ((transport t).displacement i).density 1 = targetDensity i
  parameter_differentiable : ∀ t, HasDerivAt parameter (parameterDerivative t) t
  potential_parameter_differentiable : ∀ i z a, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun b ↦ U i b z) a
  positive : ∀ i t z, 0 < density i t z
  density_C1 : ∀ i t, ContDiff ℝ 1 (density i t)
  potential_C1 : ∀ i t, ContDiff ℝ 1 (U i (parameter t))
  parameter_gradient : ∀ t i z, HasGradientAt (fun a ↦ U i a z)
    (((transport t).potential_gradient i z).fst) (parameter t)
  latent_gradient : ∀ t i z, HasGradientAt (U i (parameter t))
    (((transport t).potential_gradient i z).snd) z
  parameter_gradient_integrable : ∀ t i,
    Integrable (fun z ↦ density i t z • gradient (fun a ↦ U i a z) (parameter t)) volume
  domination : ∀ t i, LocalEnergyDomination volume (density i) (densityDerivative i)
    (fun u ↦ U i (parameter u))
    (fun u z ↦ fderiv ℝ (fun a ↦ U i a z) (parameter u) (parameterDerivative u)) t
  parameter_equation : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → parameterDerivative t =
    -averagedParameterForce volume (fun i ↦ density i t) U (parameter t)
  density_equation : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ i, ∀ᵐ z ∂volume, densityDerivative i t z =
    fluxDivergence (fokkerPlanckFlux (density i t) (U i (parameter t))) z
  integrable_tails : ∀ t i, NoBoundaryFlux
    (fokkerPlanckFlux (density i t) (U i (parameter t)))
    (fun z ↦ chemicalPotential (density i t) (U i (parameter t)) z + 1)

initial_energy.statement: theorem initial_energy (t : ℝ) : (S.transport t).freeEnergy 0 = S.energy t
initial_energy.complete_declaration:
theorem initial_energy (t : ℝ) : (S.transport t).freeEnergy 0 = S.energy t := by
  unfold DatasetRegularity.freeEnergy energy normalizedDensityEnergy
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  let D := (S.transport t).displacement i
  have hden := D.initial_density_law
  rw [S.density_eq t i] at hden
  have hq := (S.density_C1 i t).continuous.measurable
  have hpos := fun z ↦ (S.positive i t z).le
  have hlog : Integrable (fun z ↦ Real.log (S.density i t z))
      ((S.transport t).law i : Measure Z) := by
    simpa only [D, interpolate_zero, id_eq, S.density_eq t i] using
      D.integrable_log 0 (by constructor <;> norm_num)
  have hU : Integrable (U i (S.parameter t)) ((S.transport t).law i : Measure Z) := by
    simpa only [S.potential_eq t] using (S.transport t).potential_integrable_initial i
  unfold RegularTransport.freeEnergy RegularDisplacement.entropy
  simp only [RegularDisplacement.law_zero, parameterInterpolate, sub_zero, one_smul,
    zero_smul, add_zero,
    S.potential_eq t, S.density_eq t i]
  rw [← integral_add hlog hU, hden, integral_density _ hq hpos]
  rfl

terminal_energy.complete_declaration:
theorem terminal_energy (t : ℝ) : (S.transport t).freeEnergy 1 = S.targetEnergy := by
  borelize Z
  unfold DatasetRegularity.freeEnergy targetEnergy normalizedDensityEnergy
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  let D := (S.transport t).displacement i
  have hs : (1 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 1 := by constructor <;> norm_num
  have hlaw : D.law 1 = volume.withDensity (fun z ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (S.targetDensity i z)) := by
    simpa only [D, RegularDisplacement.law, S.target_density_eq t i] using D.density_law 1 hs
  have hq : Measurable (S.targetDensity i) := by
    simpa only [D, S.target_density_eq t i] using D.measurable_density 1 hs
  have hpos : ∀ z, 0 ≤ S.targetDensity i z := by
    intro z
    simpa only [D, S.target_density_eq t i] using (D.positive_density 1 hs z).le
  have hlog : Integrable (fun z ↦ Real.log (S.targetDensity i z)) (D.law 1) := by
    have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z ↦ Real.log (S.targetDensity i z)) (D.law 1) :=
      (Real.measurable_log.comp hq).aestronglyMeasurable
    apply (integrable_map_measure hm (interpolate_measurable _ D.measurable_transport 1).aemeasurable).mpr
    simpa only [D, interpolate_one, Function.comp_def, S.target_density_eq t i,
      measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace] using D.integrable_log 1 hs
  have hU : Integrable (U i astar) (D.law 1) := by
    apply (integrable_map_measure
      (by simpa only [S.potential_eq t] using ((S.transport t).potential_measurable i astar).aestronglyMeasurable)
      (interpolate_measurable _ D.measurable_transport 1).aemeasurable).mpr
    simpa only [D, interpolate_one, Function.comp_def, S.potential_eq t,
      measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace] using (S.transport t).potential_integrable_final i
  unfold RegularTransport.freeEnergy RegularDisplacement.entropy
  simp only [parameterInterpolate, sub_self, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add,
    S.potential_eq t, S.target_density_eq t i]
  rw [← integral_add hlog hU, hlaw, integral_density _ hq hpos]
  rfl

theorem terminal_law (t : ℝ) (i : Fin M) :

parameterForce_eq.complete_declaration:
theorem parameterForce_eq (t : ℝ) : (S.transport t).parameterForce =
    averagedParameterForce volume (fun i ↦ S.density i t) U (S.parameter t) := by
  unfold DatasetRegularity.parameterForce averagedParameterForce
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have hg : (fun z ↦ ((S.transport t).potential_gradient i z).fst) =
      fun z ↦ gradient (fun a ↦ U i a z) (S.parameter t) := by
    funext z
    exact (S.parameter_gradient t i z).unique
      (S.potential_parameter_differentiable i z (S.parameter t)).hasGradientAt
  rw [hg, ((S.transport t).displacement i).initial_density_law,
    S.density_eq t i, integral_density _ (S.density_C1 i t).continuous.measurable
      (fun z ↦ (S.positive i t z).le)]
  rfl

latentScore_eq.statement:
theorem latentScore_eq (t : ℝ) (i : Fin M) (z : Z) :
    (S.transport t).latentScore i z =
      gradient (chemicalPotential (S.density i t) (U i (S.parameter t))) z
latentScore_eq.complete_declaration:
theorem latentScore_eq (t : ℝ) (i : Fin M) (z : Z) :
    (S.transport t).latentScore i z =
      gradient (chemicalPotential (S.density i t) (U i (S.parameter t))) z := by
  have hg := (S.latent_gradient t i z).unique
    ((S.potential_C1 i t).differentiable (by norm_num) z).hasGradientAt
  have hlog : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y ↦ Real.log (S.density i t y)) z :=
    ((S.density_C1 i t).differentiable (by norm_num) z).log (S.positive i t z).ne'
  simp only [DatasetRegularity.latentScore, S.density_eq t i, hg]
  have hder := hlog.hasFDerivAt.add
    ((S.potential_C1 i t).differentiable (by norm_num) z).hasFDerivAt
  change _ = (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ Z).symm
    (fderiv ℝ (fun x ↦ Real.log (S.density i t x) + U i (S.parameter t) x) z)
  change _ = (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ Z).symm
    (fderiv ℝ ((fun x ↦ Real.log (S.density i t x)) + U i (S.parameter t)) z)
  rw [hder.fderiv, map_add]
  exact add_comm _ _

fisher_eq.statement: theorem fisher_eq (t : ℝ) : (S.transport t).fisherInformation = S.fisher t
fisher_eq.complete_declaration:
theorem fisher_eq (t : ℝ) : (S.transport t).fisherInformation = S.fisher t := by
  unfold DatasetRegularity.fisherInformation fisher normalizedSlopeSquared
  rw [S.parameterForce_eq]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp_rw [S.latentScore_eq]
  rw [((S.transport t).displacement i).initial_density_law, S.density_eq t i,
    integral_density _ (S.density_C1 i t).continuous.measurable
      (fun z ↦ (S.positive i t z).le)]
  rfl

deBruijn.statement: theorem deBruijn (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : HasDerivAt S.energy (-S.fisher t) t
deBruijn.complete_declaration:
theorem deBruijn (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : HasDerivAt S.energy (-S.fisher t) t :=
  (normalized_product_deBruijn S.density S.densityDerivative U S.parameter
    S.parameterDerivative t (S.domination t) S.parameter_differentiable
    S.potential_parameter_differentiable (fun i ↦ S.positive i t)
    (fun i ↦ S.density_C1 i t) (fun i ↦ S.potential_C1 i t)
    (S.parameter_gradient_integrable t) (S.parameter_equation t ht)
    (S.density_equation t ht) (S.integrable_tails t)).2

extendedLSI.statement:
theorem extendedLSI (hM : 0 < M) (hrho : 0 < rho) (t : ℝ) :
    2*rho*(S.energy t-(S.transport t).freeEnergy 1) ≤ S.fisher t
extendedLSI.complete_declaration:
theorem extendedLSI (hM : 0 < M) (hrho : 0 < rho) (t : ℝ) :
    2*rho*(S.energy t-(S.transport t).freeEnergy 1) ≤ S.fisher t := by
  simpa only [S.initial_energy, S.fisher_eq] using
    (S.transport t).extendedLSI hM hrho

energy_decay.statement:
theorem energy_decay (hM : 0 < M) (hrho : 0 < rho) (T : ℝ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    S.energy t-S.targetEnergy ≤ (S.energy 0-S.targetEnergy)*Real.exp (-2*rho*t)
energy_decay.complete_declaration:
theorem energy_decay (hM : 0 < M) (hrho : 0 < rho) (T : ℝ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    S.energy t-S.targetEnergy ≤ (S.energy 0-S.targetEnergy)*Real.exp (-2*rho*t) := by
  have hd (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) := (S.deBruijn u hu).sub_const S.targetEnergy
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun u ↦ S.energy u-S.targetEnergy) (Icc 0 T) :=
    fun u hu ↦ (hd u hu.1).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hg := le_gronwallBound_of_liminf_deriv_right_le (K := -2*rho) (ε := 0) hc
    (fun u hu c hc ↦ (hd u hu.1).hasDerivWithinAt.liminf_right_slope_le hc)
    (le_refl (S.energy 0-S.targetEnergy))
    (fun u hu ↦ by
      have hi := S.extendedLSI hM hrho u
      rw [S.terminal_energy u] at hi
      linarith) t ht
  simpa only [gronwallBound_ε0, sub_zero] using hg

target_minimal.statement:
theorem target_minimal
    (hweight : ∀ i a, Integrable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-U i a z)) volume)
    (hZ : ∀ i a, 0 < ∫ z, Real.exp (-U i a z))
    (hmax : ∀ a, S.evidence a ≤ S.evidence astar)
    (hpost : ∀ i z, S.targetDensity i z =
      Real.exp (-U i astar z)/(∫ w, Real.exp (-U i astar w))) (t : ℝ) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (S.transport t).freeEnergy 1 ≤ (S.transport t).freeEnergy s
target_minimal.complete_declaration:
theorem target_minimal
    (hweight : ∀ i a, Integrable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-U i a z)) volume)
    (hZ : ∀ i a, 0 < ∫ z, Real.exp (-U i a z))
    (hmax : ∀ a, S.evidence a ≤ S.evidence astar)
    (hpost : ∀ i z, S.targetDensity i z =
      Real.exp (-U i astar z)/(∫ w, Real.exp (-U i astar w))) (t : ℝ) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (S.transport t).freeEnergy 1 ≤ (S.transport t).freeEnergy s := by
  apply RegularDataset.posterior_minimal (S.transport t)
  · simpa only [S.potential_eq t] using hweight
  · simpa only [S.potential_eq t] using hZ
  · simpa only [RegularDataset.evidence, evidence, S.potential_eq t] using hmax
  · simpa only [S.target_density_eq t, S.potential_eq t] using hpost

theorem distance_control (hM : 0 < M) (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (hweight : ∀ i a, Integrable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-U i a z)) volume)
    (hZ : ∀ i a, 0 < ∫ z, Real.exp (-U i a z))
    (hmax : ∀ a, S.evidence a ≤ S.evidence astar)
    (hpost : ∀ i z, S.targetDensity i z =
      Real.exp (-U i astar z)/(∫ w, Real.exp (-U i astar w))) (t : ℝ) :
    rho/2*(S.transport t).distanceSq ≤ S.energy t-S.targetEnergy
distance_control.complete_declaration:
theorem distance_control (hM : 0 < M) (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (hweight : ∀ i a, Integrable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-U i a z)) volume)
    (hZ : ∀ i a, 0 < ∫ z, Real.exp (-U i a z))
    (hmax : ∀ a, S.evidence a ≤ S.evidence astar)
    (hpost : ∀ i z, S.targetDensity i z =
      Real.exp (-U i astar z)/(∫ w, Real.exp (-U i astar w))) (t : ℝ) :
    rho/2*(S.transport t).distanceSq ≤ S.energy t-S.targetEnergy := by
  have h := (S.transport t).talagrand_final hM hrho.le
    (S.target_minimal hweight hZ hmax hpost t)
  simpa only [S.initial_energy, S.terminal_energy] using h

full_product_exponential_convergence.statement:
theorem full_product_exponential_convergence (hM : 0 < M) (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (hweight : ∀ i a, Integrable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-U i a z)) volume)
    (hZ : ∀ i a, 0 < ∫ z, Real.exp (-U i a z))
    (hmax : ∀ a, S.evidence a ≤ S.evidence astar)
    (hpost : ∀ i z, S.targetDensity i z =
      Real.exp (-U i astar z)/(∫ w, Real.exp (-U i astar w)))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    Real.sqrt (S.transport t).distanceSq ≤ Real.sqrt (2*(S.energy t-S.targetEnergy)/rho) ∧
    Real.sqrt (2*(S.energy t-S.targetEnergy)/rho) ≤
      Real.sqrt (2*(S.energy 0-S.targetEnergy)/rho)*Real.exp (-rho*t)
full_product_exponential_convergence.complete_declaration:
theorem full_product_exponential_convergence (hM : 0 < M) (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (hweight : ∀ i a, Integrable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-U i a z)) volume)
    (hZ : ∀ i a, 0 < ∫ z, Real.exp (-U i a z))
    (hmax : ∀ a, S.evidence a ≤ S.evidence astar)
    (hpost : ∀ i z, S.targetDensity i z =
      Real.exp (-U i astar z)/(∫ w, Real.exp (-U i astar w)))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    Real.sqrt (S.transport t).distanceSq ≤ Real.sqrt (2*(S.energy t-S.targetEnergy)/rho) ∧
    Real.sqrt (2*(S.energy t-S.targetEnergy)/rho) ≤
      Real.sqrt (2*(S.energy 0-S.targetEnergy)/rho)*Real.exp (-rho*t) := by
  have hctrl := S.distance_control hM hrho hweight hZ hmax hpost t
  have hgap : 0 ≤ S.energy t-S.targetEnergy :=
    (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (S.transport t).distanceSq_nonneg).trans hctrl
  have hgap0 : 0 ≤ S.energy 0-S.targetEnergy :=
    (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (S.transport 0).distanceSq_nonneg).trans
      (S.distance_control hM hrho hweight hZ hmax hpost 0)
  constructor
  · apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hrho).mpr
    nlinarith
  · have hd := S.energy_decay hM hrho t t ⟨ht, le_rfl⟩
    have hx : 0 ≤ 2*(S.energy 0-S.targetEnergy)/rho := by positivity
    have hy : 0 ≤ 2*(S.energy t-S.targetEnergy)/rho := by positivity
    have hsquare : (Real.sqrt (2*(S.energy 0-S.targetEnergy)/rho)*Real.exp (-rho*t))^2 =
        (2*(S.energy 0-S.targetEnergy)/rho)*Real.exp (-2*rho*t) := by
      rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hx, pow_two, ← Real.exp_add]
      congr 2
      ring
    have hdec := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (show 0 ≤ 2/rho by positivity)
    have hdec' : 2*(S.energy t-S.targetEnergy)/rho ≤
        (2*(S.energy 0-S.targetEnergy)/rho)*Real.exp (-2*rho*t) := by
      convert hdec using 1 <;> ring
    have hn : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2*(S.energy 0-S.targetEnergy)/rho)*Real.exp (-rho*t) := by
      positivity
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hy, Real.sqrt_nonneg (2*(S.energy t-S.targetEnergy)/rho)]

theorem parameter_exponential_convergence (hM : 0 < M) (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (hweight : ∀ i a, Integrable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-U i a z)) volume)
    (hZ : ∀ i a, 0 < ∫ z, Real.exp (-U i a z))
    (hmax : ∀ a, S.evidence a ≤ S.evidence astar)
    (hpost : ∀ i z, S.targetDensity i z =
      Real.exp (-U i astar z)/(∫ w, Real.exp (-U i astar w)))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ‖S.parameter t-astar‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (2*(S.energy 0-S.targetEnergy)/rho)*Real.exp (-rho*t)
parameter_exponential_convergence.complete_declaration:
theorem parameter_exponential_convergence (hM : 0 < M) (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (hweight : ∀ i a, Integrable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-U i a z)) volume)
    (hZ : ∀ i a, 0 < ∫ z, Real.exp (-U i a z))
    (hmax : ∀ a, S.evidence a ≤ S.evidence astar)
    (hpost : ∀ i z, S.targetDensity i z =
      Real.exp (-U i astar z)/(∫ w, Real.exp (-U i astar w)))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ‖S.parameter t-astar‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (2*(S.energy 0-S.targetEnergy)/rho)*Real.exp (-rho*t) := by
  have hp : ‖S.parameter t-astar‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (S.transport t).distanceSq := by
    apply (Real.le_sqrt (norm_nonneg _) (S.transport t).distanceSq_nonneg).mpr
    unfold DatasetRegularity.distanceSq
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (by positivity)
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦ sq_nonneg _))
  have hd := S.full_product_exponential_convergence hM hrho hweight hZ hmax hpost t ht
  exact hp.trans (hd.1.trans hd.2)

existsUnique_optimizer_and_flow_converge.statement:
theorem existsUnique_optimizer_and_flow_convergence {dθ dz : ℕ}
    (U : Fin M → IPLA.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (hM : 0 < M)
    (rho : ℝ) (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn univ rho (U i)) :
    let V := fun i a z ↦ U i (IPLA.pair a z)
    let ell := fun a ↦ (M : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, Real.log (∫ z, Real.exp (-V i a z))
    ∃! astar : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dθ),
      (∀ a, ell a ≤ ell astar) ∧
      ∀ S : ClassicalFlow M dz rho astar V,
        (∀ i z, S.targetDensity i z = Real.exp (-V i astar z)/
          (∫ w, Real.exp (-V i astar w))) →
        ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ‖S.parameter t-astar‖ ≤
          Real.sqrt (2*(S.energy 0-S.targetEnergy)/rho)*Real.exp (-rho*t)

theorem existsUnique_optimizer_and_flow_convergence {dθ dz : ℕ}

    let ell := fun a ↦ (M : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, Real.log (∫ z, Real.exp (-V i a z))
    ∃! astar : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dθ),

      ∀ S : ClassicalFlow M dz rho astar V,
        (∀ i z, S.targetDensity i z = Real.exp (-V i astar z)/
          (∫ w, Real.exp (-V i astar w))) →
        ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ‖S.parameter t-astar‖ ≤
          Real.sqrt (2*(S.energy 0-S.targetEnergy)/rho)*Real.exp (-rho*t) := by
  dsimp only

  · intro S hpost t ht
    exact S.parameter_exponential_convergence hM hrho

      (fun i a ↦ IPLA.marginalIntegral_pos (U i) rho hrho (hdiff i) (hsc i) a)
      hmax hpost t ht
  · intro b hb
    apply hu b
    intro a
    have h := hb.1 a
    change ell a ≤ ell b at h
    rw [he, he] at h

  apply data.bound_integrable.mono' data.gradient_measurable
  filter_upwards [data.derivative_bound] with z hz
  simpa only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)] using
    hz a (mem_of_mem_nhds data.neighborhood_mem)

normalizer_hasFDerivAt.statement:
theorem normalizer_hasFDerivAt
    (ν : Measure Z) (U : A → Z → ℝ) (a : A)
    (data : LocalNormalizerRegularity ν U a) :
    HasFDerivAt (normalizer ν U)
      (-(InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ A) (unnormalizedScore ν U a)) a
normalizer_hasFDerivAt.complete_declaration:
theorem normalizer_hasFDerivAt
    (ν : Measure Z) (U : A → Z → ℝ) (a : A)
    (data : LocalNormalizerRegularity ν U a) :
    HasFDerivAt (normalizer ν U)
      (-(InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ A) (unnormalizedScore ν U a)) a := by
  let D : A → Z → A →L[ℝ] ℝ := fun b z ↦
    -(InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ A)
      (Real.exp (-U b z) • gradient (fun c ↦ U c z) b)
  have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (D a) ν := by
    exact ((InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ A).continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable
      data.gradient_measurable).neg
  have hd : HasFDerivAt (normalizer ν U) (∫ z, D a z ∂ν) a := by
    apply hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
      (F := fun b z ↦ Real.exp (-U b z)) (F' := D) data.neighborhood_mem
      data.measurable data.density_integrable hmeas
    · filter_upwards [data.derivative_bound] with z hz b hb
      simpa only [D, norm_neg, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map, norm_smul,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)] using hz b hb
    · exact data.bound_integrable
    · filter_upwards [data.differentiable] with z hz b hb
      have h := (hz b hb).hasFDerivAt.neg.exp
      convert h using 1
      simp [D, gradient]
  have heq : (∫ z, D a z ∂ν) =
      -(InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ A) (unnormalizedScore ν U a) := by
    rw [show (fun z ↦ D a z) = (fun z ↦
      -((InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ A).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap
        (Real.exp (-U a z) • gradient (fun b ↦ U b z) a))) from rfl]
    rw [integral_neg, ContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm
      (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ A).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap
        data.weighted_gradient_integrable]
    rfl
  rwa [heq] at hd

posterior_isProbability.statement:
theorem posterior_isProbability
    (ν : Measure Z) (U : A → Z → ℝ) (a : A)
    (hint : Integrable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-U a z)) ν)
    (hZ : 0 < normalizer ν U a) : IsProbabilityMeasure (posterior ν U a)
posterior_isProbability.complete_declaration:
theorem posterior_isProbability
    (ν : Measure Z) (U : A → Z → ℝ) (a : A)
    (hint : Integrable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-U a z)) ν)
    (hZ : 0 < normalizer ν U a) : IsProbabilityMeasure (posterior ν U a) :=
  Density.posteriorMeasure_isProbability ν _ _ (fun _ ↦ (Real.exp_pos _).le) hZ hint rfl

posterior_gradient_integrable.statement:
theorem posterior_gradient_integrable
    (ν : Measure Z) (U : A → Z → ℝ) (a : A)
    (data : LocalNormalizerRegularity ν U a)
    (hmeas : Measurable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-U a z)))
    (hZ : 0 < normalizer ν U a) :
    Integrable (fun z ↦ gradient (fun b ↦ U b z) a) (posterior ν U a)
posterior_gradient_integrable.complete_declaration:
theorem posterior_gradient_integrable
    (ν : Measure Z) (U : A → Z → ℝ) (a : A)
    (data : LocalNormalizerRegularity ν U a)
    (hmeas : Measurable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-U a z)))
    (hZ : 0 < normalizer ν U a) :
    Integrable (fun z ↦ gradient (fun b ↦ U b z) a) (posterior ν U a) := by
  unfold posterior Density.posteriorMeasure Density.densityMeasure
  rw [integrable_withDensity_iff_integrable_smul' (hmeas.div_const _).ennreal_ofReal
    (ae_of_all _ fun _ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)]
  simp_rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (div_nonneg (Real.exp_nonneg _) hZ.le),
    div_eq_inv_mul, mul_smul]
  exact data.weighted_gradient_integrable.smul ((normalizer ν U a)⁻¹)

posteriorScore_eq.statement:
theorem posteriorScore_eq
    (ν : Measure Z) (U : A → Z → ℝ) (a : A)
    (hmeas : Measurable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-U a z)))
    (hZ : 0 < normalizer ν U a) :
    posteriorScore ν U a = (normalizer ν U a)⁻¹ • unnormalizedScore ν U a
posteriorScore_eq.complete_declaration:
theorem posteriorScore_eq
    (ν : Measure Z) (U : A → Z → ℝ) (a : A)
    (hmeas : Measurable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-U a z)))
    (hZ : 0 < normalizer ν U a) :
    posteriorScore ν U a = (normalizer ν U a)⁻¹ • unnormalizedScore ν U a := by
  unfold posteriorScore posterior Density.posteriorMeasure Density.densityMeasure
  rw [integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul (hmeas.div_const _).ennreal_ofReal
    (ae_of_all _ fun _ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)]
  simp_rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (div_nonneg (Real.exp_nonneg _) hZ.le),
    div_eq_inv_mul, mul_smul]
  rw [integral_smul]
  rfl

log_normalizer_hasFDerivAt.statement:
theorem log_normalizer_hasFDerivAt
    (ν : Measure Z) (U : A → Z → ℝ) (a : A)
    (data : LocalNormalizerRegularity ν U a)
    (hmeas : Measurable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-U a z)))
    (hZ : 0 < normalizer ν U a) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun b ↦ Real.log (normalizer ν U b))
      (-(InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ A) (posteriorScore ν U a)) a
log_normalizer_hasFDerivAt.complete_declaration:
theorem log_normalizer_hasFDerivAt
    (ν : Measure Z) (U : A → Z → ℝ) (a : A)
    (data : LocalNormalizerRegularity ν U a)
    (hmeas : Measurable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-U a z)))
    (hZ : 0 < normalizer ν U a) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun b ↦ Real.log (normalizer ν U b))
      (-(InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ A) (posteriorScore ν U a)) a := by
  have h := (normalizer_hasFDerivAt ν U a data).log hZ.ne'
  rw [posteriorScore_eq ν U a hmeas hZ]
  simpa only [map_smul, smul_neg] using h

logEvidence.statement: def logEvidence {M : ℕ} (ν : Measure Z) (U : Fin M → A → Z → ℝ) (a : A) : ℝ
logEvidence.complete_declaration:
def logEvidence {M : ℕ} (ν : Measure Z) (U : Fin M → A → Z → ℝ) (a : A) : ℝ :=
  (M : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, Real.log (normalizer ν (U i) a)

averagedPosteriorScore.statement:
def averagedPosteriorScore {M : ℕ} (ν : Measure Z) (U : Fin M → A → Z → ℝ)
    (a : A) : A
averagedPosteriorScore.complete_declaration:
def averagedPosteriorScore {M : ℕ} (ν : Measure Z) (U : Fin M → A → Z → ℝ)
    (a : A) : A := (M : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, posteriorScore ν (U i) a

logEvidence_hasFDerivAt.statement:
theorem logEvidence_hasFDerivAt {M : ℕ}
    (ν : Measure Z) (U : Fin M → A → Z → ℝ) (a : A)
    (data : ∀ i, LocalNormalizerRegularity ν (U i) a)
    (hmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-U i a z)))
    (hZ : ∀ i, 0 < normalizer ν (U i) a) :
    HasFDerivAt (logEvidence ν U)
      (-(InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ A) (averagedPosteriorScore ν U a)) a
logEvidence_hasFDerivAt.complete_declaration:
theorem logEvidence_hasFDerivAt {M : ℕ}
    (ν : Measure Z) (U : Fin M → A → Z → ℝ) (a : A)
    (data : ∀ i, LocalNormalizerRegularity ν (U i) a)
    (hmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-U i a z)))
    (hZ : ∀ i, 0 < normalizer ν (U i) a) :
    HasFDerivAt (logEvidence ν U)
      (-(InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ A) (averagedPosteriorScore ν U a)) a := by
  have h := (HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun i _ ↦
    log_normalizer_hasFDerivAt ν (U i) a (data i) (hmeas i) (hZ i))).const_mul ((M : ℝ)⁻¹)
  convert h using 1
  · rfl
  · simp only [averagedPosteriorScore, map_smul, map_sum,
      Finset.sum_neg_distrib, smul_neg]

averaged_posterior_parameter_gradient_eq.statement:
theorem averaged_posterior_parameter_gradient_eq_zero {M : ℕ}
    (ν : Measure Z) (U : Fin M → A → Z → ℝ) (a : A)
    (data : ∀ i, LocalNormalizerRegularity ν (U i) a)
    (hmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-U i a z)))
    (hZ : ∀ i, 0 < normalizer ν (U i) a)
    (hmax : IsLocalMax (logEvidence ν U) a) :
    averagedPosteriorScore ν U a = 0
averaged_posterior_parameter_gradient_eq.complete_declaration:
theorem averaged_posterior_parameter_gradient_eq_zero {M : ℕ}
    (ν : Measure Z) (U : Fin M → A → Z → ℝ) (a : A)
    (data : ∀ i, LocalNormalizerRegularity ν (U i) a)
    (hmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-U i a z)))
    (hZ : ∀ i, 0 < normalizer ν (U i) a)
    (hmax : IsLocalMax (logEvidence ν U) a) :
    averagedPosteriorScore ν U a = 0 := by
  have hz := hmax.hasFDerivAt_eq_zero (logEvidence_hasFDerivAt ν U a data hmeas hZ)
  apply (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ A).injective
  simpa only [map_zero, neg_eq_zero] using hz

sum_posterior_parameter_gradient_eq_zero.statement:
theorem sum_posterior_parameter_gradient_eq_zero {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (ν : Measure Z) (U : Fin M → A → Z → ℝ) (a : A)
    (data : ∀ i, LocalNormalizerRegularity ν (U i) a)
    (hmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-U i a z)))
    (hZ : ∀ i, 0 < normalizer ν (U i) a)
    (hmax : IsLocalMax (logEvidence ν U) a) :
    ∑ i, (∫ z, gradient (fun b ↦ U i b z) a ∂posterior ν (U i) a) = 0
sum_posterior_parameter_gradient_eq_zero.complete_declaration:
theorem sum_posterior_parameter_gradient_eq_zero {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (ν : Measure Z) (U : Fin M → A → Z → ℝ) (a : A)
    (data : ∀ i, LocalNormalizerRegularity ν (U i) a)
    (hmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-U i a z)))
    (hZ : ∀ i, 0 < normalizer ν (U i) a)
    (hmax : IsLocalMax (logEvidence ν U) a) :
    ∑ i, (∫ z, gradient (fun b ↦ U i b z) a ∂posterior ν (U i) a) = 0 := by
  have h := averaged_posterior_parameter_gradient_eq_zero ν U a data hmeas hZ hmax
  exact (smul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left (inv_ne_zero (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hM.ne'))
