import LatentDiffusion.RegularEvidence
import LatentDiffusion.RegularStochastic

set_option linter.style.header false
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false

/-! # Posterior evidence scores in the actual scaled particle cloud

The parameter slice of a joint potential has precisely the parameter block of
its joint gradient. Actual posterior initialization transfers the evidence
first-order condition to the score random variables used by the numerical
theorem. Neither zero empirical means nor an optimizer force identity is an
extra hypothesis of the final theorem.
-/

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal

namespace LatentDiffusion.RegularEvidenceScores

open RegularStochastic

variable {K dθ dz : ℕ}





/-- Taking a parameter gradient of an actual joint potential is exactly
projection of its joint gradient onto the parameter coordinates. -/




variable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]

/-- Deterministic L² parameter output gives the claimed pointwise parameter
value almost everywhere, as needed to identify each actual particle law. -/

/-- An initialized particle's actual score mean is the insertion of its
posterior parameter-gradient mean into the cloud parameter block. -/

/-- Evidence optimality proves the exact centering condition used by the
full-batch theorem for an actual posterior-initialized cloud. -/

end LatentDiffusion.RegularEvidenceScores

pair.statement: def pair (a : Parameter dθ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz)) : Cloud.Joint dθ dz
pair.complete_declaration:
def pair (a : Parameter dθ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz)) : Cloud.Joint dθ dz :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 (Sum.elim a z)

pair_head.statement:
@[simp] theorem pair_head (a : Parameter dθ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz))
    (j : Fin dθ) : pair a z (Sum.inl j) = a j
pair_head.complete_declaration:
@[simp] theorem pair_head (a : Parameter dθ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz))
    (j : Fin dθ) : pair a z (Sum.inl j) = a j := rfl

pair_tail.statement:
@[simp] theorem pair_tail (a : Parameter dθ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz))
    (j : Fin dz) : pair a z (Sum.inr j) = z j
pair_tail.complete_declaration:
@[simp] theorem pair_tail (a : Parameter dθ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz))
    (j : Fin dz) : pair a z (Sum.inr j) = z j := rfl

pair_hasFDerivAt.statement:
theorem pair_hasFDerivAt (a : Parameter dθ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz)) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun b ↦ pair b z) (headInsert (J := Fin dz)) a
pair_hasFDerivAt.complete_declaration:
theorem pair_hasFDerivAt (a : Parameter dθ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz)) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun b ↦ pair b z) (headInsert (J := Fin dz)) a := by
  have h := ((headInsert (d := dθ) (J := Fin dz)).hasFDerivAt (x := a)).add_const
    (pair (0 : Parameter dθ) z)
  convert h using 1
  funext b
  ext j
  cases j <;> simp [pair, headInsert]

parameter_gradient_pair.statement:
theorem parameter_gradient_pair
    (U : Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (a : Parameter dθ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz)) (hU : DifferentiableAt ℝ U (pair a z)) :
    gradient (fun b ↦ U (pair b z)) a = headExtract (gradient U (pair a z))
parameter_gradient_pair.complete_declaration:
theorem parameter_gradient_pair
    (U : Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (a : Parameter dθ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz)) (hU : DifferentiableAt ℝ U (pair a z)) :
    gradient (fun b ↦ U (pair b z)) a = headExtract (gradient U (pair a z)) := by
  apply ext_inner_right ℝ
  intro b
  rw [inner_gradient_left]
  have hd := hU.hasFDerivAt.comp a (pair_hasFDerivAt a z)
  change fderiv ℝ (U ∘ (fun b ↦ pair b z)) a b = _
  rw [hd.fderiv]
  change fderiv ℝ U (pair a z) (headInsert b) = _
  rw [← inner_gradient_left]
  simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type, headInsert_apply, headExtract_apply,
    Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, inner_zero_right, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]

physicalParticleCLM.statement:
def physicalParticleCLM (i : Fin K) :
    Cloud.State K dθ dz →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz)

joint_eq_pair.statement:
theorem joint_eq_pair (i : Fin K) (x : Cloud.State K dθ dz) (a : Parameter dθ)
    (ha : IPLA.parameterCLM x = a) :
    Cloud.joint i x = pair a (physicalParticleCLM i x)
joint_eq_pair.complete_declaration:
theorem joint_eq_pair (i : Fin K) (x : Cloud.State K dθ dz) (a : Parameter dθ)
    (ha : IPLA.parameterCLM x = a) :
    Cloud.joint i x = pair a (physicalParticleCLM i x) := by
  ext j
  cases j with
  | inl j => exact congrArg (fun b ↦ b j) ha
  | inr j => rfl

latentPotential.statement:
def latentPotential (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (i : Fin K)
    (a : Parameter dθ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz)) : ℝ
latentPotential.complete_declaration:
def latentPotential (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (i : Fin K)
    (a : Parameter dθ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz)) : ℝ := U i (pair a z)

parameter_ae_of_output.statement:
theorem parameter_ae_of_output (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) (a : Parameter dθ)
    (hX : parameterOutput P X = constantL2 P a) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, IPLA.parameterCLM (X ω) = a
parameter_ae_of_output.complete_declaration:
theorem parameter_ae_of_output (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) (a : Parameter dθ)
    (hX : parameterOutput P X = constantL2 P a) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, IPLA.parameterCLM (X ω) = a := by
  have hp := (@IPLA.parameterCLM K dθ dz).coeFn_compLpL X
  change (parameterOutput P X : Ω → Parameter dθ) =ᵐ[P]
    (fun ω ↦ IPLA.parameterCLM (X ω)) at hp
  rw [hX] at hp
  filter_upwards [hp, constantL2_coe P a] with ω hω hc
  exact hω.symm.trans hc

score_mean_eq_posterior.statement:
theorem score_mean_eq_posterior
    (ν : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz)))
    (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i)))
    (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) (a : Parameter dθ)
    (hX : parameterOutput P X = constantL2 P a) (i : Fin K)
    (hlaw : P.map (fun ω ↦ physicalParticleCLM i (X ω)) =
      RegularEvidence.posterior ν (latentPotential U i) a)
    (hint : Integrable (fun z ↦ gradient (fun b ↦ latentPotential U i b z) a)
      (RegularEvidence.posterior ν (latentPotential U i) a)) :
    (∫ ω, scoreLp P U L hLip X i ω ∂P) =
      headInsert (J := Fin K × Fin dz)
        (∫ z, gradient (fun b ↦ latentPotential U i b z) a
          ∂RegularEvidence.posterior ν (latentPotential U i) a)
score_mean_eq_posterior.complete_declaration:
theorem score_mean_eq_posterior
    (ν : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz)))
    (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i)))
    (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) (a : Parameter dθ)
    (hX : parameterOutput P X = constantL2 P a) (i : Fin K)
    (hlaw : P.map (fun ω ↦ physicalParticleCLM i (X ω)) =
      RegularEvidence.posterior ν (latentPotential U i) a)
    (hint : Integrable (fun z ↦ gradient (fun b ↦ latentPotential U i b z) a)
      (RegularEvidence.posterior ν (latentPotential U i) a)) :
    (∫ ω, scoreLp P U L hLip X i ω ∂P) =
      headInsert (J := Fin K × Fin dz)
        (∫ z, gradient (fun b ↦ latentPotential U i b z) a
          ∂RegularEvidence.posterior ν (latentPotential U i) a) := by
  let f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz) → Parameter dθ :=
    fun z ↦ gradient (fun b ↦ latentPotential U i b z) a
  have hm : AEMeasurable (fun ω ↦ physicalParticleCLM i (X ω)) P :=
    (physicalParticleCLM i).continuous.measurable.comp_aemeasurable
      (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable X).aemeasurable
  have hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f (P.map (fun ω ↦ physicalParticleCLM i (X ω))) := by
    rw [hlaw]
    exact hint.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hi : Integrable (fun ω ↦ f (physicalParticleCLM i (X ω))) P := by
    apply (integrable_map_measure hf hm).mp
    rwa [hlaw]
  have heq : (fun ω ↦ scoreLp P U L hLip X i ω) =ᵐ[P]
      (fun ω ↦ headInsert (J := Fin K × Fin dz) (f (physicalParticleCLM i (X ω)))) := by
    filter_upwards [PBGSO.liftMap_coe P (parameterScore U i)
      (parameterScore_lipschitz U L hLip i) X, parameter_ae_of_output P X a hX]
      with ω hs hp
    change scoreLp P U L hLip X i ω = _ at hs
    rw [hs]
    unfold parameterScore
    rw [joint_eq_pair i (X ω) a hp]
    rw [← parameter_gradient_pair (U i) a _ (hdiff i _)]
    rfl
  rw [integral_congr_ae heq,
    ContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm (headInsert (J := Fin K × Fin dz)) hi]
  congr 1
  have hh := integral_map hm hf
  rw [hlaw] at hh
  exact hh.symm

sum_score_means_eq_zero_of_evidence_maxi.statement:
theorem sum_score_means_eq_zero_of_evidence_maximum
    (hK : 0 < K) (ν : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz)))
    (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i)))
    (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) (a : Parameter dθ)
    (hX : parameterOutput P X = constantL2 P a)
    (hlaw : ∀ i, P.map (fun ω ↦ physicalParticleCLM i (X ω)) =
      RegularEvidence.posterior ν (latentPotential U i) a)
    (data : ∀ i, RegularEvidence.LocalNormalizerRegularity ν (latentPotential U i) a)
    (hmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-latentPotential U i a z)))
    (hZ : ∀ i, 0 < RegularEvidence.normalizer ν (latentPotential U i) a)
    (hmax : IsLocalMax (RegularEvidence.logEvidence ν (latentPotential U)) a) :
    ∑ i, (∫ ω, scoreLp P U L hLip X i ω ∂P) = 0
sum_score_means_eq_zero_of_evidence_maxi.complete_declaration:
theorem sum_score_means_eq_zero_of_evidence_maximum
    (hK : 0 < K) (ν : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz)))
    (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i)))
    (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) (a : Parameter dθ)
    (hX : parameterOutput P X = constantL2 P a)
    (hlaw : ∀ i, P.map (fun ω ↦ physicalParticleCLM i (X ω)) =
      RegularEvidence.posterior ν (latentPotential U i) a)
    (data : ∀ i, RegularEvidence.LocalNormalizerRegularity ν (latentPotential U i) a)
    (hmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-latentPotential U i a z)))
    (hZ : ∀ i, 0 < RegularEvidence.normalizer ν (latentPotential U i) a)
    (hmax : IsLocalMax (RegularEvidence.logEvidence ν (latentPotential U)) a) :
    ∑ i, (∫ ω, scoreLp P U L hLip X i ω ∂P) = 0 := by
  have hm := RegularEvidence.sum_posterior_parameter_gradient_eq_zero hK ν
    (latentPotential U) a data hmeas hZ hmax
  have heach (i : Fin K) := score_mean_eq_posterior P ν U L hdiff hLip X a hX i
    (hlaw i) (RegularEvidence.posterior_gradient_integrable ν _ a (data i) (hmeas i) (hZ i))
  simp_rw [heach]
  rw [← map_sum, hm, map_zero]

/-!
# Density free-energy differentiation and the Fokker–Planck equation

The density energy is the actual integral `∫ q (log q + U)`. Its time
derivative follows from pointwise time derivatives and local domination.
The weak Fokker–Planck equation is tested against the chemical potential;
the free-energy dissipation identity is a theorem, never a regularity field.

The classical version below derives the weak identity from the pointwise PDE
and ordinary Lebesgue integration by parts. Its tail assumptions are absolute
integrability of the three products in that integration-by-parts theorem.
-/

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter Set
open scoped Topology

namespace LatentDiffusion.RegularFlowCalculus

/-- Pointwise differentiation of the density energy when both its density and
its potential depend on time. -/

/-- Sufficient local analytic hypotheses for differentiation of the actual
density free energy. These are domination, positivity and pointwise regularity,
and contain no assertion about the derivative of an integral. -/

/-- Domination together with the pointwise potential derivative. The
parameter-path constructor below derives this final field by the chain rule. -/

/-- Dominated differentiation computes the density free-energy derivative. -/

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E]

/-- The chemical potential, which is the density first variation up to an
irrelevant constant on probability-preserving directions. -/

/-- Admissible-test weak Fokker–Planck equation `qdot = div(q ∇(log q+U))`.
All C¹ tests for which both displayed integrands are integrable are allowed.
This is a solution equation, independent of any free-energy calculation. -/

omit [MeasurableSpace E] in

/-- The de Bruijn identity for a regular solution of the weak density equation.
Only pointwise derivatives, domination and the weak PDE are inputs. In
particular, neither an energy derivative nor an energy inequality is assumed. -/

section ClassicalEquation

variable [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [BorelSpace E]

Fréchet derivative. No trace/divergence identification is assumed. -/

The three products are exactly those in the ordinary Lebesgue theorem;

omit [CompleteSpace E] in

omit [CompleteSpace E] in

/-- Lebesgue integration by parts gives the divergence weak equation from
classical spatial derivatives and explicit tail integrability. -/

/-- The transport integration-by-parts identity under the actual density law.
It is derived from Lebesgue integration by parts and the pointwise derivative
of `log q`. This is the entropy-score pairing used by displacement calculus. -/

/-- Both actual law integrals in the transport score identity are absolutely
integrable; the identity does not exploit the total integral's default value. -/

/-- Classical Fokker–Planck flux. Its negative divided by `q` is the
continuity-equation velocity `-∇(log q+U)`. -/

/-- A pointwise Fokker–Planck equation has its expected weak identity whenever
the ordinary integration-by-parts products are integrable. -/

/-- The first variation in a genuine continuity-equation direction. The
velocity field is arbitrary; its pairing with the score is a conclusion of
integration by parts, rather than an assumed Wasserstein derivative. -/

/-- Actual energy differentiation in any classical continuity-equation
direction. This is the integral first-variation formula needed to represent
the source gradient on its normalized product tangent space. -/

/-- The full density de Bruijn identity is proved from the classical PDE.
All added assumptions are local differentiability/domination, spatial C¹
regularity, absolute integrability and the pointwise solution equation. -/

end ClassicalEquation

/-- Parameter time derivatives used in the energy integral are derived by the

/-- Riesz pairing with the source's normalized product gradient. There is no

omit [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]

/-- Source gradient representation for the actual density energy and every
admissible parameter/transport tangent. Parameter differentiation comes from
the chain rule and integration; law differentiation comes from the actual
continuity equation and proved spatial integration by parts.

This simultaneously fixes the normalization: the parameter gradient is the
average force, while each law gradient is `∇(log q_i + U_i)`. -/

/-- The squared norm of the source gradient in its normalized product metric,
written using the actual density integrals. -/

omit [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [BorelSpace E] in
/-- The actual normalized product-gradient norm is nonnegative. -/

/-- Source de Bruijn identity for the full normalized parameter/law system.
The parameter ODE is `pdot=-average ∫q∇_parameter U`; each law satisfies its
classical Fokker–Planck PDE. Integrability of the Fisher integrands is proved
from the spatial tail conditions, alongside the energy derivative.

No entropy derivative, entropy dissipation or convergence bound is assumed. -/

end NormalizedProduct

energy_integrand_hasDerivAt.statement:
theorem energy_integrand_hasDerivAt
    {q U : ℝ → ℝ} {qd Ud t : ℝ}
    (hq : HasDerivAt q qd t) (hU : HasDerivAt U Ud t) (hpos : 0 < q t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ q s * (Real.log (q s) + U s))
      (qd * (Real.log (q t) + U t + 1) + q t * Ud) t
energy_integrand_hasDerivAt.complete_declaration:
theorem energy_integrand_hasDerivAt
    {q U : ℝ → ℝ} {qd Ud t : ℝ}
    (hq : HasDerivAt q qd t) (hU : HasDerivAt U Ud t) (hpos : 0 < q t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ q s * (Real.log (q s) + U s))
      (qd * (Real.log (q t) + U t + 1) + q t * Ud) t := by
  have hc : q t * (qd / q t) = qd := by
    rw [mul_comm, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hpos.ne']
  convert hq.mul ((hq.log hpos.ne').add hU) using 1
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, mul_add, mul_one, hc]
  ring

LocalEnergyDomination.statement:
structure LocalEnergyDomination {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (ν : Measure X) (q qdot U Udot : ℝ → X → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
LocalEnergyDomination.complete_declaration:
structure LocalEnergyDomination {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (ν : Measure X) (q qdot U Udot : ℝ → X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) where
  neighborhood : Set ℝ
  neighborhood_mem : neighborhood ∈ 𝓝 t
  bound : X → ℝ
  measurable : ∀ᶠ u in 𝓝 t,
    AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ q u x * (Real.log (q u x) + U u x)) ν
  integrable : Integrable (fun x ↦ q t x * (Real.log (q t x) + U t x)) ν
  derivative_measurable : AEStronglyMeasurable
    (fun x ↦ qdot t x * (Real.log (q t x) + U t x + 1) + q t x * Udot t x) ν
  derivative_bound : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, ∀ u ∈ neighborhood,
    ‖qdot u x * (Real.log (q u x) + U u x + 1) + q u x * Udot u x‖ ≤ bound x
  bound_integrable : Integrable bound ν
  positive : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, ∀ u ∈ neighborhood, 0 < q u x
  density_derivative : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, ∀ u ∈ neighborhood,
    HasDerivAt (fun v ↦ q v x) (qdot u x) u

LocalEnergyRegularity.statement:
structure LocalEnergyRegularity {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (ν : Measure X) (q qdot U Udot : ℝ → X → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    extends LocalEnergyDomination ν q qdot U Udot t
LocalEnergyRegularity.complete_declaration:
structure LocalEnergyRegularity {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (ν : Measure X) (q qdot U Udot : ℝ → X → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    extends LocalEnergyDomination ν q qdot U Udot t where
  potential_derivative : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, ∀ u ∈ neighborhood,
    HasDerivAt (fun v ↦ U v x) (Udot u x) u

LocalEnergyRegularity.hasDerivAt_energy.statement:
theorem LocalEnergyRegularity.hasDerivAt_energy
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {ν : Measure X}
    {q qdot U Udot : ℝ → X → ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (data : LocalEnergyRegularity ν q qdot U Udot t) :
    Integrable
      (fun x ↦ qdot t x * (Real.log (q t x) + U t x + 1) + q t x * Udot t x) ν ∧
    HasDerivAt (fun u ↦ SourceCalculus.densityFreeEnergy ν (q u) (U u))
      (∫ x, qdot t x * (Real.log (q t x) + U t x + 1) + q t x * Udot t x ∂ν) t
LocalEnergyRegularity.hasDerivAt_energy.complete_declaration:
theorem LocalEnergyRegularity.hasDerivAt_energy
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {ν : Measure X}
    {q qdot U Udot : ℝ → X → ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (data : LocalEnergyRegularity ν q qdot U Udot t) :
    Integrable
      (fun x ↦ qdot t x * (Real.log (q t x) + U t x + 1) + q t x * Udot t x) ν ∧
    HasDerivAt (fun u ↦ SourceCalculus.densityFreeEnergy ν (q u) (U u))
      (∫ x, qdot t x * (Real.log (q t x) + U t x + 1) + q t x * Udot t x ∂ν) t := by
  apply hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le data.neighborhood_mem
    data.measurable data.integrable data.derivative_measurable
    data.derivative_bound data.bound_integrable
  filter_upwards [data.positive, data.density_derivative, data.potential_derivative]
    with x hx hq hU u hu
  exact energy_integrand_hasDerivAt (hq u hu) (hU u hu) (hx u hu)

chemicalPotential.statement: def chemicalPotential (q U : E → ℝ) : E → ℝ
chemicalPotential.complete_declaration: def chemicalPotential (q U : E → ℝ) : E → ℝ := fun x ↦ Real.log (q x) + U x

WeakFokkerPlanck.statement: def WeakFokkerPlanck (ν : Measure E) (q qdot U : E → ℝ) : Prop
WeakFokkerPlanck.complete_declaration:
def WeakFokkerPlanck (ν : Measure E) (q qdot U : E → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ →
    Integrable (fun x ↦ qdot x * ψ x) ν →
    Integrable (fun x ↦ q x * inner ℝ (gradient (chemicalPotential q U) x)
      (gradient ψ x)) ν →
    (∫ x, qdot x * ψ x ∂ν) =
      -(∫ x, q x * inner ℝ (gradient (chemicalPotential q U) x)
        (gradient ψ x) ∂ν)

gradient_add_one.statement:
theorem gradient_add_one (f : E → ℝ) (x : E) :
    gradient (fun y ↦ f y + 1) x = gradient f x
gradient_add_one.complete_declaration:
theorem gradient_add_one (f : E → ℝ) (x : E) :
    gradient (fun y ↦ f y + 1) x = gradient f x := by
  simp [gradient, fderiv_add_const]

deBruijn_of_regular_weak_equation.statement:
theorem deBruijn_of_regular_weak_equation
    (ν : Measure E) (q qdot U Udot : ℝ → E → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (data : LocalEnergyRegularity ν q qdot U Udot t)
    (hpos : ∀ x, 0 < q t x) (hq : ContDiff ℝ 1 (q t))
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ 1 (U t))
    (hpotential : Integrable (fun x ↦ q t x * Udot t x) ν)
    (hfisher : Integrable
      (fun x ↦ q t x * ‖gradient (chemicalPotential (q t) (U t)) x‖ ^ 2) ν)
    (hweak : WeakFokkerPlanck ν (q t) (qdot t) (U t)) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u ↦ SourceCalculus.densityFreeEnergy ν (q u) (U u))
      (-(∫ x, q t x * ‖gradient (chemicalPotential (q t) (U t)) x‖ ^ 2 ∂ν) +
        ∫ x, q t x * Udot t x ∂ν) t
deBruijn_of_regular_weak_equation.complete_declaration:
theorem deBruijn_of_regular_weak_equation
    (ν : Measure E) (q qdot U Udot : ℝ → E → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (data : LocalEnergyRegularity ν q qdot U Udot t)
    (hpos : ∀ x, 0 < q t x) (hq : ContDiff ℝ 1 (q t))
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ 1 (U t))
    (hpotential : Integrable (fun x ↦ q t x * Udot t x) ν)
    (hfisher : Integrable
      (fun x ↦ q t x * ‖gradient (chemicalPotential (q t) (U t)) x‖ ^ 2) ν)
    (hweak : WeakFokkerPlanck ν (q t) (qdot t) (U t)) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u ↦ SourceCalculus.densityFreeEnergy ν (q u) (U u))
      (-(∫ x, q t x * ‖gradient (chemicalPotential (q t) (U t)) x‖ ^ 2 ∂ν) +
        ∫ x, q t x * Udot t x ∂ν) t := by
  have hW : ContDiff ℝ 1 (chemicalPotential (q t) (U t)) :=
    (hq.log (fun x ↦ (hpos x).ne')).add hU
  let ψ : E → ℝ := fun x ↦ chemicalPotential (q t) (U t) x + 1
  have hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ := hW.add contDiff_const
  have hd := data.hasDerivAt_energy
  have hint : Integrable (fun x ↦ qdot t x * ψ x) ν := by
    convert hd.1.sub hpotential using 1
    ext x
    simp [ψ, chemicalPotential]
  have hgrad : ∀ x, gradient ψ x = gradient (chemicalPotential (q t) (U t)) x :=
    gradient_add_one _
  have hflux : Integrable
      (fun x ↦ q t x * inner ℝ (gradient (chemicalPotential (q t) (U t)) x)
        (gradient ψ x)) ν := by
    simpa only [hgrad, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] using hfisher
  have hw := hweak ψ hψ hint hflux
  simp only [hgrad, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at hw
  have hsplit : (∫ x, qdot t x * (Real.log (q t x) + U t x + 1) +
      q t x * Udot t x ∂ν) =
      -(∫ x, q t x * ‖gradient (chemicalPotential (q t) (U t)) x‖ ^ 2 ∂ν) +
        ∫ x, q t x * Udot t x ∂ν := by
    change (∫ x, qdot t x * ψ x + q t x * Udot t x ∂ν) = _
    rw [integral_add hint hpotential]
    exact congrArg (fun v : ℝ ↦ v + ∫ x, q t x * Udot t x ∂ν) hw
  rw [hsplit] at hd
  exact hd.2

fluxComponent.statement: def fluxComponent (V : E → E) (i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E)) : E → ℝ
fluxComponent.complete_declaration:
def fluxComponent (V : E → E) (i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E)) : E → ℝ :=
  fun x ↦ inner ℝ (V x) (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E i)

fluxDivergence.statement: def fluxDivergence (V : E → E) (x : E) : ℝ

fluxComponent_neg.statement:
theorem fluxComponent_neg (V : E → E) (i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E)) :
    fluxComponent (fun y ↦ -V y) i = -fluxComponent V i
fluxComponent_neg.complete_declaration:
theorem fluxComponent_neg (V : E → E) (i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E)) :
    fluxComponent (fun y ↦ -V y) i = -fluxComponent V i := by
  funext x
  exact inner_neg_left (V x) (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E i)

fluxDivergence_neg.statement:
theorem fluxDivergence_neg (V : E → E) (x : E) :
    fluxDivergence (fun y ↦ -V y) x = -fluxDivergence V x
fluxDivergence_neg.complete_declaration:
theorem fluxDivergence_neg (V : E → E) (x : E) :
    fluxDivergence (fun y ↦ -V y) x = -fluxDivergence V x := by
  simp only [fluxDivergence, fluxComponent_neg, fderiv_neg, neg_apply,
    Finset.sum_neg_distrib]

fluxDivergence_eq_trace.statement:
theorem fluxDivergence_eq_trace (V : E → E) (A : E →L[ℝ] E) (x : E)
    (hV : HasFDerivAt V A x) :
    fluxDivergence V x = LinearMap.trace ℝ E A.toLinearMap
fluxDivergence_eq_trace.complete_declaration:
theorem fluxDivergence_eq_trace (V : E → E) (A : E →L[ℝ] E) (x : E)
    (hV : HasFDerivAt V A x) :
    fluxDivergence V x = LinearMap.trace ℝ E A.toLinearMap := by
  rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_sum_inner A.toLinearMap (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E)]
  unfold fluxDivergence
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hd : HasFDerivAt (fluxComponent V i)
      ((innerSL ℝ (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E i)).comp A) x := by
    convert (innerSL ℝ (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E i)).hasFDerivAt.comp x hV using 1
    funext y
    exact real_inner_comm _ _
  rw [hd.fderiv]
  rfl

NoBoundaryFlux.statement: structure NoBoundaryFlux (V : E → E) (ψ : E → ℝ) : Prop
NoBoundaryFlux.complete_declaration:
structure NoBoundaryFlux (V : E → E) (ψ : E → ℝ) : Prop where
  flux_differentiable : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (fluxComponent V i)
  derivative_flux_integrable : ∀ i, Integrable
    (fun x ↦ fderiv ℝ (fluxComponent V i) x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E i) * ψ x)
    volume
  derivative_test_integrable : ∀ i, Integrable
    (fun x ↦ fluxComponent V i x * fderiv ℝ ψ x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E i))
    volume
  product_integrable : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x ↦ fluxComponent V i x * ψ x) volume

NoBoundaryFlux.neg.statement:
theorem NoBoundaryFlux.neg {V : E → E} {ψ : E → ℝ}
    (htail : NoBoundaryFlux V ψ) : NoBoundaryFlux (fun y ↦ -V y) ψ
NoBoundaryFlux.neg.complete_declaration:
theorem NoBoundaryFlux.neg {V : E → E} {ψ : E → ℝ}
    (htail : NoBoundaryFlux V ψ) : NoBoundaryFlux (fun y ↦ -V y) ψ where
  flux_differentiable i := by
    simpa only [fluxComponent_neg] using (htail.flux_differentiable i).neg
  derivative_flux_integrable i := by
    convert (htail.derivative_flux_integrable i).neg using 1
    ext x
    simp only [fluxComponent_neg, fderiv_neg, neg_apply, Pi.neg_apply, neg_mul]
  derivative_test_integrable i := by
    convert (htail.derivative_test_integrable i).neg using 1
    ext x
    simp only [fluxComponent_neg, Pi.neg_apply, neg_mul]
  product_integrable i := by
    convert (htail.product_integrable i).neg using 1
    ext x
    simp only [fluxComponent_neg, Pi.neg_apply, neg_mul]

NoBoundaryFlux.integrable_flux_gradient.statement:
theorem NoBoundaryFlux.integrable_flux_gradient
    {V : E → E} {ψ : E → ℝ} (htail : NoBoundaryFlux V ψ) :
    Integrable (fun x ↦ inner ℝ (V x) (gradient ψ x)) volume
NoBoundaryFlux.integrable_flux_gradient.complete_declaration:
theorem NoBoundaryFlux.integrable_flux_gradient
    {V : E → E} {ψ : E → ℝ} (htail : NoBoundaryFlux V ψ) :
    Integrable (fun x ↦ inner ℝ (V x) (gradient ψ x)) volume := by
  have hpoint (x : E) :
      inner ℝ (V x) (gradient ψ x) =
      ∑ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E),
        fluxComponent V i x * fderiv ℝ ψ x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E i) := by
    simpa only [fluxComponent, ← inner_gradient_left,
      real_inner_comm (gradient ψ x)] using
      ((stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E).sum_inner_mul_inner (V x) (gradient ψ x)).symm
  simp_rw [hpoint]
  exact integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ ↦ htail.derivative_test_integrable i)

NoBoundaryFlux.integrable_divergence_mul.statement:
theorem NoBoundaryFlux.integrable_divergence_mul
    {V : E → E} {ψ : E → ℝ} (htail : NoBoundaryFlux V ψ) :
    Integrable (fun x ↦ fluxDivergence V x * ψ x) volume
NoBoundaryFlux.integrable_divergence_mul.complete_declaration:
theorem NoBoundaryFlux.integrable_divergence_mul
    {V : E → E} {ψ : E → ℝ} (htail : NoBoundaryFlux V ψ) :
    Integrable (fun x ↦ fluxDivergence V x * ψ x) volume := by
  simp_rw [fluxDivergence, Finset.sum_mul]
  exact integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ ↦ htail.derivative_flux_integrable i)

integral_divergence_mul.statement:
theorem integral_divergence_mul
    (V : E → E) (ψ : E → ℝ) (hψ : Differentiable ℝ ψ)
    (htail : NoBoundaryFlux V ψ) :
    (∫ x, fluxDivergence V x * ψ x ∂volume) =
      -(∫ x, inner ℝ (V x) (gradient ψ x) ∂volume)
integral_divergence_mul.complete_declaration:
theorem integral_divergence_mul
    (V : E → E) (ψ : E → ℝ) (hψ : Differentiable ℝ ψ)
    (htail : NoBoundaryFlux V ψ) :
    (∫ x, fluxDivergence V x * ψ x ∂volume) =
      -(∫ x, inner ℝ (V x) (gradient ψ x) ∂volume) := by
  have hpoint (x : E) :
      inner ℝ (V x) (gradient ψ x) =
      ∑ i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E),
        fluxComponent V i x * fderiv ℝ ψ x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E i) := by
    simpa only [fluxComponent, ← inner_gradient_left,
      real_inner_comm (gradient ψ x)] using
      ((stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E).sum_inner_mul_inner (V x) (gradient ψ x)).symm
  simp_rw [fluxDivergence, Finset.sum_mul, hpoint]
  rw [integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ ↦ htail.derivative_flux_integrable i),
    integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ ↦ htail.derivative_test_integrable i),
    ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hip := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable
    (htail.derivative_flux_integrable i) (htail.derivative_test_integrable i)
    (htail.product_integrable i) (fun x _ ↦ htail.flux_differentiable i x)
    (fun x _ ↦ hψ x)
  linarith

transport_score_pairing.statement:
theorem transport_score_pairing
    (q : E → ℝ) (V : E → E) (hq : ContDiff ℝ 1 q) (hpos : ∀ x, 0 < q x)
    (htail : NoBoundaryFlux V q) :
    (∫ x, fluxDivergence V x ∂(volume.withDensity (fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (q x)))) =
      -(∫ x, inner ℝ (V x) (gradient (fun y ↦ Real.log (q y)) x)
        ∂(volume.withDensity (fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (q x))))
transport_score_pairing.complete_declaration:
theorem transport_score_pairing
    (q : E → ℝ) (V : E → E) (hq : ContDiff ℝ 1 q) (hpos : ∀ x, 0 < q x)
    (htail : NoBoundaryFlux V q) :
    (∫ x, fluxDivergence V x ∂(volume.withDensity (fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (q x)))) =
      -(∫ x, inner ℝ (V x) (gradient (fun y ↦ Real.log (q y)) x)
        ∂(volume.withDensity (fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (q x)))) := by
  have hconvert (f : E → ℝ) :
      (∫ x, f x ∂(volume.withDensity (fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (q x)))) =
      ∫ x, q x * f x ∂volume := by
    rw [integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul hq.continuous.measurable.ennreal_ofReal
      (ae_of_all _ fun _ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)]
    simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hpos _).le, smul_eq_mul]
  have hpoint (x : E) : q x * inner ℝ (V x)
      (gradient (fun y ↦ Real.log (q y)) x) = inner ℝ (V x) (gradient q x) := by
    have hscore : gradient (fun y ↦ Real.log (q y)) x = (q x)⁻¹ • gradient q x := by

        map_smul]
    rw [hscore, inner_smul_right, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (hpos x).ne', one_mul]
  rw [hconvert, hconvert]
  simp_rw [hpoint, mul_comm (q _)]
  exact integral_divergence_mul V q (hq.differentiable (by norm_num)) htail

theorem classical_fokkerPlanck_test
    (q qdot U ψ : E → ℝ) (hψ : Differentiable ℝ ψ)

      qdot x = -fluxDivergence (fun y ↦ q y • v y) x)
    (htail : NoBoundaryFlux (fun y ↦ q y • v y)
      (fun x ↦ chemicalPotential q U x + 1)) :

theorem continuity_density_variation
    (q qdot U : E → ℝ) (v : E → E)
    (hW : Differentiable ℝ (chemicalPotential q U))
    (hcontinuity : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume,
      qdot x = -fluxDivergence (fun y ↦ q y • v y) x)
    (htail : NoBoundaryFlux (fun y ↦ q y • v y)

      ∫ x, q x * inner ℝ (v x) (gradient (chemicalPotential q U) x) ∂volume := by
  have hgrad : ∀ x, gradient (fun y ↦ chemicalPotential q U y + 1) x =

  have hip := integral_divergence_mul (fun y ↦ q y • v y)
    (fun x ↦ chemicalPotential q U x + 1) (hW.add_const 1) htail
  simp only [hgrad, inner_smul_left, RCLike.conj_to_real] at hip

      rw [← integral_neg]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hcontinuity] with x hx

theorem energy_derivative_of_regular_continuity
    (q qdot U Udot : ℝ → E → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (v : E → E)
    (data : LocalEnergyRegularity volume q qdot U Udot t)
    (hpos : ∀ x, 0 < q t x) (hq : ContDiff ℝ 1 (q t))
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ 1 (U t))
    (hpotential : Integrable (fun x ↦ q t x * Udot t x) volume)
    (hcontinuity : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume,
      qdot t x = -fluxDivergence (fun y ↦ q t y • v y) x)
    (htail : NoBoundaryFlux (fun y ↦ q t y • v y)
      (fun x ↦ chemicalPotential (q t) (U t) x + 1)) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u ↦ SourceCalculus.densityFreeEnergy volume (q u) (U u))
      ((∫ x, q t x * inner ℝ (v x)
        (gradient (chemicalPotential (q t) (U t)) x) ∂volume) +
        ∫ x, q t x * Udot t x ∂volume) t

theorem energy_derivative_of_regular_continuity
    (q qdot U Udot : ℝ → E → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (v : E → E)
    (data : LocalEnergyRegularity volume q qdot U Udot t)
    (hpos : ∀ x, 0 < q t x) (hq : ContDiff ℝ 1 (q t))
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ 1 (U t))
    (hpotential : Integrable (fun x ↦ q t x * Udot t x) volume)
    (hcontinuity : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume,
      qdot t x = -fluxDivergence (fun y ↦ q t y • v y) x)
    (htail : NoBoundaryFlux (fun y ↦ q t y • v y)
      (fun x ↦ chemicalPotential (q t) (U t) x + 1)) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u ↦ SourceCalculus.densityFreeEnergy volume (q u) (U u))
      ((∫ x, q t x * inner ℝ (v x)
        (gradient (chemicalPotential (q t) (U t)) x) ∂volume) +
        ∫ x, q t x * Udot t x ∂volume) t := by
  have hW : ContDiff ℝ 1 (chemicalPotential (q t) (U t)) :=
    (hq.log (fun x ↦ (hpos x).ne')).add hU
  have hv := continuity_density_variation (q t) (qdot t) (U t) v
    (hW.differentiable (by norm_num)) hcontinuity htail
  have hd := data.hasDerivAt_energy
  have hint : Integrable
      (fun x ↦ qdot t x * (Real.log (q t x) + U t x + 1)) volume := by
    convert hd.1.sub hpotential using 1
    ext x
    simp
  have heq : (∫ x, qdot t x * (Real.log (q t x) + U t x + 1) +
      q t x * Udot t x ∂volume) =
      (∫ x, q t x * inner ℝ (v x)
        (gradient (chemicalPotential (q t) (U t)) x) ∂volume) +
        ∫ x, q t x * Udot t x ∂volume := by
    rw [integral_add hint hpotential]
    exact congrArg (fun r : ℝ ↦ r + ∫ x, q t x * Udot t x ∂volume) hv
  rw [heq] at hd
  exact hd.2

theorem deBruijn_of_regular_classical_equation
    (q qdot U Udot : ℝ → E → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (data : LocalEnergyRegularity volume q qdot U Udot t)
    (hpos : ∀ x, 0 < q t x) (hq : ContDiff ℝ 1 (q t))
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ 1 (U t))
    (hpotential : Integrable (fun x ↦ q t x * Udot t x) volume)
    (hpde : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, qdot t x =
      fluxDivergence (fokkerPlanckFlux (q t) (U t)) x)
    (htail : NoBoundaryFlux (fokkerPlanckFlux (q t) (U t))
      (fun x ↦ chemicalPotential (q t) (U t) x + 1)) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u ↦ SourceCalculus.densityFreeEnergy volume (q u) (U u))
      (-(∫ x, q t x * ‖gradient (chemicalPotential (q t) (U t)) x‖ ^ 2 ∂volume) +
        ∫ x, q t x * Udot t x ∂volume) t := by
  have hW : ContDiff ℝ 1 (chemicalPotential (q t) (U t)) :=
    (hq.log (fun x ↦ (hpos x).ne')).add hU

  have hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ := hW.add contDiff_const
  have hgrad : ∀ x, gradient ψ x = gradient (chemicalPotential (q t) (U t)) x :=
    gradient_add_one _

    (hψ.differentiable (by norm_num)) hpde htail

  have hint : Integrable (fun x ↦ qdot t x * ψ x) volume := by
    convert hd.1.sub hpotential using 1
    ext x
    simp [ψ, chemicalPotential]
  have hsplit : (∫ x, qdot t x * (Real.log (q t x) + U t x + 1) +
      q t x * Udot t x ∂volume) =
      -(∫ x, q t x * ‖gradient (chemicalPotential (q t) (U t)) x‖ ^ 2 ∂volume) +
        ∫ x, q t x * Udot t x ∂volume := by
    change (∫ x, qdot t x * ψ x + q t x * Udot t x ∂volume) = _
    rw [integral_add hint hpotential]
    exact congrArg (fun v : ℝ ↦ v + ∫ x, q t x * Udot t x ∂volume) hw
  rw [hsplit] at hd
  exact hd.2

    (hU : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (U i (p t)))
    (hgrad : ∀ i, Integrable
      (fun x ↦ q i t x • gradient (fun b ↦ U i b x) (p t)) volume)
    (hode : pdot t = -averagedParameterForce volume (fun i ↦ q i t) U (p t))
    (hpde : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, qdot i t x =

    (∀ i, Integrable

    HasDerivAt (fun u ↦ normalizedDensityEnergy volume (fun i ↦ q i u) U (p u))

normalized_product_deBruijn.complete_declaration:
theorem normalized_product_deBruijn
    (q qdot : Fin M → ℝ → E → ℝ) (U : Fin M → A → E → ℝ)
    (p pdot : ℝ → A) (t : ℝ)
    (data : ∀ i, LocalEnergyDomination volume (q i) (qdot i) (fun u ↦ U i (p u))
      (fun u x ↦ fderiv ℝ (fun a ↦ U i a x) (p u) (pdot u)) t)
    (hp : ∀ u, HasDerivAt p (pdot u) u)
    (hparam : ∀ i x a, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun b ↦ U i b x) a)
    (hpos : ∀ i x, 0 < q i t x) (hq : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (q i t))
    (hU : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (U i (p t)))
    (hgrad : ∀ i, Integrable
      (fun x ↦ q i t x • gradient (fun b ↦ U i b x) (p t)) volume)
    (hode : pdot t = -averagedParameterForce volume (fun i ↦ q i t) U (p t))
    (hpde : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, qdot i t x =
      fluxDivergence (fokkerPlanckFlux (q i t) (U i (p t))) x)
    (htail : ∀ i, NoBoundaryFlux (fokkerPlanckFlux (q i t) (U i (p t)))
      (fun x ↦ chemicalPotential (q i t) (U i (p t)) x + 1)) :
    (∀ i, Integrable
      (fun x ↦ q i t x * ‖gradient (chemicalPotential (q i t) (U i (p t))) x‖ ^ 2)
      volume) ∧
    HasDerivAt (fun u ↦ normalizedDensityEnergy volume (fun i ↦ q i u) U (p u))
      (-normalizedSlopeSquared volume (fun i ↦ q i t) U (p t)) t := by
  let v : Fin M → E → E := fun i x ↦
    -gradient (chemicalPotential (q i t) (U i (p t))) x
  have hvel (i : Fin M) : (fun y ↦ q i t y • v i y) =
      (fun y ↦ -fokkerPlanckFlux (q i t) (U i (p t)) y) := by
    funext y
    simp only [v, fokkerPlanckFlux, smul_neg]
  have hcont : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂volume,
      qdot i t x = -fluxDivergence (fun y ↦ q i t y • v i y) x := by
    intro i
    filter_upwards [hpde i] with x hx
    rw [hvel i, fluxDivergence_neg, neg_neg, hx]
  have htailv : ∀ i, NoBoundaryFlux (fun y ↦ q i t y • v i y)
      (fun x ↦ chemicalPotential (q i t) (U i (p t)) x + 1) := by
    intro i
    rw [hvel i]

    data hp hparam hpos hq hU hgrad hcont htailv

      inner_neg_left, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, mul_neg, integral_neg,
      Finset.sum_neg_distrib, mul_neg, neg_add_rev]
    ring
  rw [hrate] at hd
  refine ⟨?_, hd⟩
  intro i
  have h := (htail i).integrable_flux_gradient
  simpa only [fokkerPlanckFlux, gradient_add_one, inner_smul_left,
    RCLike.conj_to_real, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] using h

RegularDensityDynamics.statement: structure RegularDensityDynamics (M : ℕ) (U : Fin M → A → Z → ℝ)
RegularDensityDynamics.complete_declaration:
structure RegularDensityDynamics (M : ℕ) (U : Fin M → A → Z → ℝ) where
  parameter : ℝ → A
  parameterDerivative : ℝ → A
  density : Fin M → ℝ → Z → ℝ
  densityDerivative : Fin M → ℝ → Z → ℝ
  parameter_differentiable : ∀ t, HasDerivAt parameter (parameterDerivative t) t
  potential_parameter_differentiable : ∀ i z a, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun b ↦ U i b z) a
  positive : ∀ i t z, 0 < density i t z
  density_C1 : ∀ i t, ContDiff ℝ 1 (density i t)
  potential_C1 : ∀ i t, ContDiff ℝ 1 (U i (parameter t))
  parameter_gradient_integrable : ∀ t i,
    Integrable (fun z ↦ density i t z • gradient (fun a ↦ U i a z) (parameter t)) volume
  domination : ∀ t i, LocalEnergyDomination volume (density i) (densityDerivative i)
    (fun u ↦ U i (parameter u))
    (fun u z ↦ fderiv ℝ (fun a ↦ U i a z) (parameter u) (parameterDerivative u)) t
  parameter_equation : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → parameterDerivative t =
    -averagedParameterForce volume (fun i ↦ density i t) U (parameter t)
  density_equation : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ i, ∀ᵐ z ∂volume, densityDerivative i t z =
    fluxDivergence (fokkerPlanckFlux (density i t) (U i (parameter t))) z
  integrable_tails : ∀ t i, NoBoundaryFlux
    (fokkerPlanckFlux (density i t) (U i (parameter t)))
    (fun z ↦ chemicalPotential (density i t) (U i (parameter t)) z + 1)

def energy (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  normalizedDensityEnergy volume (fun i ↦ S.density i t) U (S.parameter t)

def fisher (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=

score.statement: def score (t : ℝ) (i : Fin M) : Z → Z
score.complete_declaration:
def score (t : ℝ) (i : Fin M) : Z → Z :=

deBruijn.statement: theorem deBruijn (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : HasDerivAt S.energy (-S.fisher t) t
deBruijn.complete_declaration:
theorem deBruijn (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : HasDerivAt S.energy (-S.fisher t) t :=
  (normalized_product_deBruijn S.density S.densityDerivative U S.parameter
    S.parameterDerivative t (S.domination t) S.parameter_differentiable
    S.potential_parameter_differentiable (fun i ↦ S.positive i t)
    (fun i ↦ S.density_C1 i t) (fun i ↦ S.potential_C1 i t)
    (S.parameter_gradient_integrable t) (S.parameter_equation t ht)
    (S.density_equation t ht) (S.integrable_tails t)).2

fisher_integrable.statement:
theorem fisher_integrable (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (i : Fin M) :
    Integrable (fun z ↦ S.density i t z * ‖S.score t i z‖ ^ 2) volume
fisher_integrable.complete_declaration:
theorem fisher_integrable (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (i : Fin M) :
    Integrable (fun z ↦ S.density i t z * ‖S.score t i z‖ ^ 2) volume :=
  (normalized_product_deBruijn S.density S.densityDerivative U S.parameter
    S.parameterDerivative t (S.domination t) S.parameter_differentiable
    S.potential_parameter_differentiable (fun i ↦ S.positive i t)
    (fun i ↦ S.density_C1 i t) (fun i ↦ S.potential_C1 i t)
    (S.parameter_gradient_integrable t) (S.parameter_equation t ht)
    (S.density_equation t ht) (S.integrable_tails t)).1 i

theorem fisher_nonneg (t : ℝ) : 0 ≤ S.fisher t :=

score_measurable.complete_declaration:
theorem score_measurable (t : ℝ) (i : Fin M) : Measurable (S.score t i) := by
  have hW : ContDiff ℝ 1 (chemicalPotential (S.density i t) (U i (S.parameter t))) :=
    ((S.density_C1 i t).log (fun z ↦ (S.positive i t z).ne')).add (S.potential_C1 i t)
  exact ((InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ Z).symm.continuous.comp
    (hW.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num))).measurable

structure CharacteristicRealization

theorem kinetic_energy_eq_fisher (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :

theorem exists_minimizer_talagrand [CompleteSpace X]
    (Fstar rho : ℝ) (hrho : 0 < rho) (hstar : ∀ x, Fstar ≤ D.energy x)
    (hxLSI : ∀ x, 2 * rho * (D.energy x-Fstar) ≤
      normalizedSlopeSquared volume (fun i ↦ (D.chart i).density x) U (D.parameter x)) :
    ∃ xstar, Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ R.state n) atTop (𝓝 xstar) ∧
      D.energy xstar = Fstar ∧ (∀ x, D.energy xstar ≤ D.energy x) ∧
      ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → rho * dist (R.state t) xstar ^ 2 ≤
        2 * (D.energy (R.state t)-Fstar)

    (hxLSI : ∀ x, 2 * rho * (D.energy x-Fstar) ≤
      normalizedSlopeSquared volume (fun i ↦ (D.chart i).density x) U (D.parameter x)) :
    ∃ xstar, Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ R.state n) atTop (𝓝 xstar) ∧
      D.energy xstar = Fstar ∧ (∀ x, D.energy xstar ≤ D.energy x) ∧

        2 * (D.energy (R.state t)-Fstar) := by

  · exact (D.continuous_energy.comp_continuousOn R.state_continuous).sub continuousOn_const
  · intro t ht

    funext u
    rw [energy_eq Q R u]
  · intro t ht
    exact S.fisher_nonneg t
  · intro t ht
    have h := hxLSI (R.state t)
    rwa [domain_fisher_eq Q R t] at h
  · intro s t hs ht r hr
    exact distance_right_slope Q R s t ht r hr

expected parameter force. -/


/-- Every actual mean-field solution has deterministic parameter trajectories;
this follows from the equation rather than being imposed on the solution. -/

/-- Actual nonstationary mean-field solutions driven by the same Brownian
input contract exponentially. Joint strong convexity supplies the energy
inequality, and deterministic parameters are the only subspace condition. -/

/-- Equal state laws give equal actual posterior score means. -/

/-- At a zero total posterior score, the computed mean-field drift is exactly
the frozen posterior drift. Individual per-datum score means need not vanish. -/

/-- A constructed stationary posterior reference is also an actual mean-field
solution. Posterior optimality cancels the expected optimizer drift. -/

/-- The actual mean-field optimizer converges to the posterior evidence
optimizer. The initial coupling and parameter are arbitrary; no convergence
estimate is assumed. -/

end LatentDiffusion.RegularMeanField

averageCLM.statement: def averageCLM : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P →L[ℝ] Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P
averageCLM.complete_declaration:
def averageCLM : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P →L[ℝ] Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P :=
  (Lp.constL 2 P ℝ).comp
    (headInsert.comp (headExtract.comp (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P))) +
      tailMask.compLpL 2 P

averageCLM_coe.statement:
theorem averageCLM_coe (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) :
    averageCLM P X =ᵐ[P] fun ω =>
      headInsert (headExtract (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P X)) + tailMask (X ω)
averageCLM_coe.complete_declaration:
theorem averageCLM_coe (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) :
    averageCLM P X =ᵐ[P] fun ω =>
      headInsert (headExtract (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P X)) + tailMask (X ω) := by
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_add
    (Lp.const 2 P (headInsert (headExtract (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P X))))
    (tailMask.compLpL 2 P X),
    Lp.coeFn_const (μ := P) (p := 2)
      (c := headInsert (J := Fin K × Fin dz) (headExtract (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P X))),
    tailMask.coeFn_compLpL (p := 2) (μ := P) X] with ω ha hc ht
  change ((Lp.const 2 P (headInsert (J := Fin K × Fin dz)
    (headExtract (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P X))) : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) +
      tailMask.compLpL 2 P X) ω = _
  rw [ha]
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, hc, ht, Function.const_apply]

averageCLM_norm_le.statement:
theorem averageCLM_norm_le (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) :
    ‖averageCLM P X‖ ≤ 2 * ‖X‖
averageCLM_norm_le.complete_declaration:
theorem averageCLM_norm_le (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) :
    ‖averageCLM P X‖ ≤ 2 * ‖X‖ := by
  have hc : ‖Lp.const 2 P (headInsert (J := Fin K × Fin dz)
      (headExtract (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P X)))‖ ≤ ‖X‖ := by
    have hc0 : ‖Lp.const 2 P (headInsert (J := Fin K × Fin dz)
        (headExtract (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P X)))‖ ≤
        ‖headInsert (J := Fin K × Fin dz) (headExtract (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P X))‖ := by
      simpa using Lp.norm_const_le 2 P (headInsert (J := Fin K × Fin dz)
        (headExtract (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P X)))
    exact hc0.trans ((headInsert_norm _).le.trans
      ((headExtract_norm_le _).trans (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM_norm_le P X)))
  let C : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P →L[ℝ] Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P :=
    (tailMask (d := dθ) (J := Fin K × Fin dz)).compLpL 2 P
  have hn : ‖C‖ ≤ 1 := (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compLpL_le _).trans tailMask_opNorm_le
  have ht : ‖C X‖ ≤ ‖X‖ := (C.le_opNorm X).trans (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) hn)
  change ‖(Lp.const 2 P (headInsert (J := Fin K × Fin dz)
    (headExtract (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P X))) : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) + C X‖ ≤ _
  exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (by linarith)

averageCLM_lipschitz.statement:
theorem averageCLM_lipschitz : LipschitzWith 2
    (averageCLM (K := K) (dθ := dθ) (dz := dz) P)
averageCLM_lipschitz.complete_declaration:
theorem averageCLM_lipschitz : LipschitzWith 2
    (averageCLM (K := K) (dθ := dθ) (dz := dz) P) := by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro X Y
  simpa only [dist_eq_norm, ← map_sub, NNReal.coe_ofNat] using averageCLM_norm_le P (X-Y)

force.statement:
def force {F : Cloud.State K dθ dz → Cloud.State K dθ dz} {m : ℝ} {L : ℝ≥0}
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P)

force_lipschitz.complete_declaration:
theorem force_lipschitz {F : Cloud.State K dθ dz → Cloud.State K dθ dz}
    {m : ℝ} {L : ℝ≥0} (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) :
    LipschitzWith (2*L) (force P hF) :=

exists_meanField.statement:
theorem exists_meanField
    (hK : 0 < K) (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i)))
    (initial : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P)
    (B : (Fin K × Fin dz) → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (B i) P) :
    ∃ Y : ℝ → Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P, Continuous Y ∧ Y 0 = initial ∧
      ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - Y 0 =
        -(∫ r in 0..t, force P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) (Y r)) +
          physicalNoise P B hB t
exists_meanField.complete_declaration:
theorem exists_meanField
    (hK : 0 < K) (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i)))
    (initial : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P)
    (B : (Fin K × Fin dz) → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (B i) P) :
    ∃ Y : ℝ → Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P, Continuous Y ∧ Y 0 = initial ∧
      ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - Y 0 =
        -(∫ r in 0..t, force P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) (Y r)) +
          physicalNoise P B hB t := by
  have hc : Continuous (physicalNoise (dθ := dθ) P B hB) := by
    let C : Lp (Latent K dz) 2 P →L[ℝ] Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P := tailInsert.compLpL 2 P
    have hs : Continuous (fun _ : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (K : ℝ))⁻¹) := continuous_const
    exact hs.smul (C.continuous.comp (ULA.brownianLangevinNoise_continuous P B hB 0))
  exact exists_global_integral _ (2*L) (force_lipschitz P _) initial _ hc (physicalNoise_zero P B hB)

actual_centered_residual.statement:
theorem actual_centered_residual
    (hK : 0 < K) (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i)))
    (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) :
    particleForce P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip X -
      force P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) X =
    ProximalLangevin.lpCenterCLM P
      (MiniBatchVariance.average (scoreLp P U L hLip X))
actual_centered_residual.complete_declaration:
theorem actual_centered_residual
    (hK : 0 < K) (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i)))
    (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) :
    particleForce P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip X -
      force P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) X =
    ProximalLangevin.lpCenterCLM P
      (MiniBatchVariance.average (scoreLp P U L hLip X)) := by
  let hF := Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip
  let Z := liftedForce P hF X
  have hres := lifted_meanForce_residual P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip X
  change Z - frozenForce P hF X = _ at hres
  rw [← hres]
  change Z - averageCLM P Z = (Z - frozenForce P hF X) -
    Lp.const 2 P (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P (Z - frozenForce P hF X))
  have he : ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P (Z - frozenForce P hF X) =
      headInsert (headExtract (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P Z)) := by
    rw [map_sub]
    have ht := ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM_compLp P tailMask Z
    change ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P (tailMask.compLpL 2 P Z) = _ at ht
    change ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P Z -
      ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P (tailMask.compLpL 2 P Z) = _
    rw [ht]
    ext j
    cases j <;> simp
  rw [he]
  change Z - (Lp.const 2 P (headInsert (J := Fin K × Fin dz)
    (headExtract (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P Z))) + tailMask.compLpL 2 P Z) =
    (Z-tailMask.compLpL 2 P Z)-Lp.const 2 P (headInsert (J := Fin K × Fin dz)
      (headExtract (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P Z)))
  abel

theorem center_average {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] (g : Fin K → Lp E 2 P) :

theorem center_average {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] (g : Fin K → Lp E 2 P) :

meanField_residual_bound.statement:
theorem meanField_residual_bound
    (hK : 0 < K) (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i)))
    (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) (V : ℝ)
    (hind : iIndepFun (fun i ω => scoreLp P U L hLip X i ω) P)
    (hvar : ∀ i, ‖scoreLp P U L hLip X i -
      constantL2 P (∫ ω, scoreLp P U L hLip X i ω ∂P)‖^2 ≤ V) :
    ‖particleForce P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip X -
      force P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) X‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (V/K)
meanField_residual_bound.complete_declaration:
theorem meanField_residual_bound
    (hK : 0 < K) (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i)))
    (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) (V : ℝ)
    (hind : iIndepFun (fun i ω => scoreLp P U L hLip X i ω) P)
    (hvar : ∀ i, ‖scoreLp P U L hLip X i -
      constantL2 P (∫ ω, scoreLp P U L hLip X i ω ∂P)‖^2 ≤ V) :
    ‖particleForce P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip X -
      force P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) X‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (V/K) := by
  rw [actual_centered_residual P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip, center_average]
  let g := scoreLp P U L hLip X
  let z (i : Fin K) := g i - constantL2 P (∫ ω, g i ω ∂P)
  have horth (i j : Fin K) (hij : i ≠ j) : inner ℝ (z i) (z j) = 0 := by
    rw [L2.inner_def]
    have hmean (i : Fin K) : (∫ ω, (g i ω - ∫ w, g i w ∂P) ∂P) = 0 := by
      rw [integral_sub ((Lp.memLp (g i)).integrable (by norm_num)) (integrable_const _)]
      simp
    have he := ((hind.indepFun hij).comp
      (show Measurable (fun x : Cloud.State K dθ dz => x - ∫ ω, g i ω ∂P) by fun_prop)
      (show Measurable (fun x : Cloud.State K dθ dz => x - ∫ ω, g j ω ∂P) by fun_prop)).integral_bilin
        (((Lp.memLp (g i)).integrable (by norm_num)).sub (integrable_const _))
        (((Lp.memLp (g j)).integrable (by norm_num)).sub (integrable_const _)) (innerSL ℝ)
    change (∫ ω, inner ℝ (g i ω - ∫ w, g i w ∂P) (g j ω - ∫ w, g j w ∂P) ∂P) =
      inner ℝ (∫ ω, g i ω - ∫ w, g i w ∂P ∂P) (∫ ω, g j ω - ∫ w, g j w ∂P ∂P) at he
    rw [hmean i, hmean j, inner_zero_left] at he
    apply (integral_congr_ae ?_).trans he
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (g i) (constantL2 P (∫ ω, g i ω ∂P)),
      Lp.coeFn_sub (g j) (constantL2 P (∫ ω, g j ω ∂P)),
      constantL2_coe P (∫ ω, g i ω ∂P), constantL2_coe P (∫ ω, g j ω ∂P)] with ω hi hj hci hcj
    simp only [z, hi, hj, hci, hcj, Pi.sub_apply]
  exact MiniBatchVariance.mean_sum_of_orthogonal_le hK z V horth hvar

exists_spatial_comparison.statement:
theorem exists_spatial_comparison
    (hK : 0 < K) (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hm : 0 < m) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i)))
    (Y : ℝ → Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) (hY : Continuous Y)
    (B : ℝ → Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0=0)
    (hYe : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t-Y 0 =
      -(∫ r in 0..t, force P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) (Y r))+B t)
    (V : ℝ) (_hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hind : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → iIndepFun (fun i ω => scoreLp P U L hLip (Y t) i ω) P)
    (hvar : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ i, ‖scoreLp P U L hLip (Y t) i -
      constantL2 P (∫ ω, scoreLp P U L hLip (Y t) i ω ∂P)‖^2 ≤ V) :
    ∃ X : ℝ → Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P, Continuous X ∧ X 0=Y 0 ∧
      (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → X t-X 0 =
        -(∫ r in 0..t, particleForce P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip (X r))+B t) ∧
      ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ‖X t-Y t‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (V/K)/m*(1-Real.exp (-m*t))
exists_spatial_comparison.complete_declaration:
theorem exists_spatial_comparison
    (hK : 0 < K) (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hm : 0 < m) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i)))
    (Y : ℝ → Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) (hY : Continuous Y)
    (B : ℝ → Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0=0)
    (hYe : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t-Y 0 =
      -(∫ r in 0..t, force P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) (Y r))+B t)
    (V : ℝ) (_hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hind : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → iIndepFun (fun i ω => scoreLp P U L hLip (Y t) i ω) P)
    (hvar : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ i, ‖scoreLp P U L hLip (Y t) i -
      constantL2 P (∫ ω, scoreLp P U L hLip (Y t) i ω ∂P)‖^2 ≤ V) :
    ∃ X : ℝ → Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P, Continuous X ∧ X 0=Y 0 ∧
      (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → X t-X 0 =
        -(∫ r in 0..t, particleForce P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip (X r))+B t) ∧
      ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ‖X t-Y t‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (V/K)/m*(1-Real.exp (-m*t)) := by
  let hF := Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip
  let F := particleForce P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip
  have hlip : LipschitzWith L F := LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    (fun X Z => by simpa only [dist_eq_norm, F, particleForce] using (liftedForce_regular P hF).lipschitz X Z)
  obtain ⟨X,hX,hX0,hXe⟩ := exists_global_integral F L hlip (Y 0) B hB hB0
  refine ⟨X,hX,hX0,hXe,?_⟩
  intro t ht
  let f := fun r => F (Y r)-force P hF (Y r)
  have hf : Continuous f := (hlip.continuous.comp hY).sub ((force_lipschitz P hF).continuous.comp hY)
  have hforced (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 t) : Y r-Y 0 =
      -(∫ s in 0..r, F (Y s))+(∫ s in 0..r, f s)+B r := by
    have hiF := (hlip.continuous.comp hY).intervalIntegrable (μ := volume) 0 r
    have hiM := ((force_lipschitz P hF).continuous.comp hY).intervalIntegrable (μ := volume) 0 r
    rw [show (∫ s in 0..r, f s) = (∫ s in 0..r, F (Y s))-
      (∫ s in 0..r, force P hF (Y s)) from intervalIntegral.integral_sub hiF hiM]
    have he := hYe r hr.1
    change Y r-Y 0 = -(∫ s in 0..r, force P hF (Y s))+B r at he
    rw [he]
    abel
  have hbound := PBGSO.forced_additive_integral_contraction F L hlip
    (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ _) m (Real.sqrt (V/K)) hm (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    (fun x y => by simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, real_inner_comm, F, particleForce] using
      (liftedForce_regular P hF).monotone x y)
    X Y B f hX hY hf t (fun r hr => hXe r hr.1) hforced
    (fun r hr => by
      simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply] using
        meanField_residual_bound P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip (Y r) V (hind r hr.1) (hvar r hr.1))
    hX0 t ⟨ht,le_rfl⟩
  exact hbound

theorem force_radius_of_state_radius {F : Cloud.State K dθ dz → Cloud.State K dθ dz}
    {m : ℝ} {L : ℝ≥0} (hF : ForceRegularity F m L)
    (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) (R : ℝ) (hR : ‖X‖ ≤ R) :

      -(∫ r in 0..t, particleForce P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip (X r))+physicalNoise P B hB t)
    (hMoment : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ‖X t‖ ≤ R) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖eulerTrajectory (particleForce P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) h
      (fun k => physicalNoise P B hB ((k : ℝ)*h+h)-physicalNoise P B hB ((k : ℝ)*h)) (X 0) n-
      X ((n : ℝ)*h)‖ ≤
      (L : ℝ)/m * (h*(‖particleForce P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip 0‖+(L : ℝ)*R)+
        (4/3 : ℝ)*Real.sqrt (2*(dz : ℝ))*Real.sqrt h) := by
  let hF := Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip
  let F := particleForce P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip
  let G := ‖F 0‖+(L : ℝ)*R
  let y := fun n : ℕ => X ((n : ℝ)*h)
  let ξ : ℕ → Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P := fun n => physicalNoise P B hB ((n : ℝ)*h+h)-physicalNoise P B hB ((n : ℝ)*h)
  let Y : ℕ → ℝ → Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P := fun n t => X ((n : ℝ)*h+t)
  let W : ℕ → ℝ → Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P := fun n t => physicalNoise P B hB ((n : ℝ)*h+t)-physicalNoise P B hB ((n : ℝ)*h)
  have hlip : LipschitzWith L F := LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    (fun x z => by simpa only [dist_eq_norm, F, particleForce] using (liftedForce_regular P hF).lipschitz x z)
  have hr : IntegralReference F h G (physicalNoiseScale K dz) y ξ Y W :=
    { starts := by intro n; simp [Y,y]
      ends := by intro n; dsimp [Y,y]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
      noise_end := by intro n; rfl
      integrable := fun n => (hlip.continuous.comp
        (hX.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id))).intervalIntegrable 0 h
      drift_radius := by
        intro n t ht
        exact force_radius_of_state_radius P hF _ R
          (hMoment _ (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hs.positive.le) ht.1))
      noise_growth := fun n t ht => physicalNoise_increment_bound P B hB _ _
        (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hs.positive.le) ht.1
      equation := by
        intro n t ht
        have he := PBGSO.MethodSegments.integral_shift X (fun r => -F (X r)) (physicalNoise P B hB)
          (hlip.continuous.comp hX).neg
          (fun r hr => by simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_neg] using hXe r hr)
          ((n : ℝ)*h) t (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hs.positive.le) ht.1
        simpa only [Y, W, intervalIntegral.integral_neg, add_zero] using he }
  have he := integral_reference_error_bound F F m h 0 G (physicalNoiseScale K dz) L
    (liftedForce_regular P hF) hs le_rfl (by dsimp [G]; positivity)
    (by unfold physicalNoiseScale; positivity) y ξ Y W (X 0) hr (by intro k; simp) n
  simpa [y, ξ, G, physicalNoiseScale_eq hK] using he

theorem inner_average_pointwise (a : Parameter dθ) (z x : Cloud.State K dθ dz) :

inner_average_eq.statement:
theorem inner_average_eq (Z X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) (a : Parameter dθ)
    (hX : parameterOutput P X = constantL2 P a) :
    inner ℝ (averageCLM P Z) X = inner ℝ Z X
inner_average_eq.complete_declaration:
theorem inner_average_eq (Z X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) (a : Parameter dθ)
    (hX : parameterOutput P X = constantL2 P a) :
    inner ℝ (averageCLM P Z) X = inner ℝ Z X := by
  let c := headExtract (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P Z)
  have hhead : headExtract.compLpL 2 P X = constantL2 P a := by
    exact hX
  have hiZ : Integrable (fun ω => headExtract (Z ω)) P :=
    headExtract.integrable_comp ((Lp.memLp Z).integrable (by norm_num))
  have hi : Integrable (fun ω => c-headExtract (Z ω)) P := (integrable_const _).sub hiZ
  have hcross : (∫ ω, inner ℝ (c-headExtract (Z ω)) a ∂P) = 0 := by
    simp_rw [real_inner_comm a]
    rw [integral_inner hi a, integral_sub (integrable_const _) hiZ]
    have he := headExtract.integral_comp_comm ((Lp.memLp Z).integrable (by norm_num))
    rw [he]
    simp [c, ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM_apply]
  have hicross : Integrable (fun ω => inner ℝ (c-headExtract (Z ω)) a) P := by
    have hh := (innerSL ℝ a).integrable_comp hi
    change Integrable (fun ω => inner ℝ a (c-headExtract (Z ω))) P at hh
    apply hh.congr
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => (real_inner_comm a _).symm)
  rw [L2.inner_def, L2.inner_def]
  have he : (∫ ω, inner ℝ ((averageCLM P Z) ω) (X ω) ∂P) =
      ∫ ω, inner ℝ (Z ω) (X ω) + inner ℝ (c-headExtract (Z ω)) a ∂P := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [averageCLM_coe P Z, (@IPLA.parameterCLM K dθ dz).coeFn_compLpL X,
      constantL2_coe P a] with ω hav hp hc
    have hpa : headExtract (X ω) = a := by
      change (parameterOutput P X) ω = _ at hp
      rw [hX, hc] at hp
      exact hp.symm
    rw [hav, inner_average_pointwise, hpa]
  rw [he, integral_add (L2.integrable_inner Z X) hicross, hcross, add_zero]

force_monotone_on_deterministic.statement:
theorem force_monotone_on_deterministic
    {F : Cloud.State K dθ dz → Cloud.State K dθ dz} {m : ℝ} {L : ℝ≥0}
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (X Y : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P)
    (a b : Parameter dθ) (hX : parameterOutput P X = constantL2 P a)
    (hY : parameterOutput P Y = constantL2 P b) :
    m*‖X-Y‖^2 ≤ inner ℝ (force P hF X-force P hF Y) (X-Y)
force_monotone_on_deterministic.complete_declaration:
theorem force_monotone_on_deterministic
    {F : Cloud.State K dθ dz → Cloud.State K dθ dz} {m : ℝ} {L : ℝ≥0}
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (X Y : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P)
    (a b : Parameter dθ) (hX : parameterOutput P X = constantL2 P a)
    (hY : parameterOutput P Y = constantL2 P b) :
    m*‖X-Y‖^2 ≤ inner ℝ (force P hF X-force P hF Y) (X-Y) := by
  have hxy : parameterOutput P (X-Y) = constantL2 P (a-b) := by
    rw [map_sub,hX,hY]
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (constantL2 P a) (constantL2 P b),
      constantL2_coe P a,constantL2_coe P b,constantL2_coe P (a-b)] with ω hs ha hb hab
    simp only [hs,ha,hb,hab,Pi.sub_apply]
  change m*‖X-Y‖^2 ≤ inner ℝ
    (averageCLM P (liftedForce P hF X)-averageCLM P (liftedForce P hF Y)) (X-Y)
  rw [← map_sub,inner_average_eq P _ (X-Y) (a-b) hxy]
  exact (liftedForce_regular P hF).monotone X Y

theorem force_parameter
    {F : Cloud.State K dθ dz → Cloud.State K dθ dz} {m : ℝ} {L : ℝ≥0}
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) :
    parameterOutput P (force P hF X) = constantL2 P
      (headExtract (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P (liftedForce P hF X)))
force_parameter.complete_declaration:
theorem force_parameter
    {F : Cloud.State K dθ dz → Cloud.State K dθ dz} {m : ℝ} {L : ℝ≥0}
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) :
    parameterOutput P (force P hF X) = constantL2 P
      (headExtract (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P (liftedForce P hF X))) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(@IPLA.parameterCLM K dθ dz).coeFn_compLpL (force P hF X),
    averageCLM_coe P (liftedForce P hF X),
    constantL2_coe P (headExtract (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P (liftedForce P hF X)))]
      with ω hp hav hc
  change (parameterOutput P (force P hF X)) ω = _ at hp
  rw [hp,hc]
  change IPLA.parameterCLM ((averageCLM P (liftedForce P hF X)) ω) = _
  rw [hav]
  ext j
  simp

constantL2_eq_const.complete_declaration:
theorem constantL2_eq_const {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (x : E) :
    constantL2 P x = Lp.const 2 P x := by
  apply Lp.ext

theorem meanField_parameter_deterministic
    {F : Cloud.State K dθ dz → Cloud.State K dθ dz} {m : ℝ} {L : ℝ≥0}
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L)
    (Y : ℝ → Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) (hY : Continuous Y)
    (B : ℝ → Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P)
    (hB : ∀ t, parameterOutput P (B t)=0)
    (hYe : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t-Y 0 = -(∫ r in 0..t, force P hF (Y r))+B t)
    (a₀ : Parameter dθ) (ha₀ : parameterOutput P (Y 0)=constantL2 P a₀)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    parameterOutput P (Y t)=constantL2 P
      (a₀-∫ r in 0..t, headExtract (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P (liftedForce P hF (Y r))))
meanField_parameter_deterministic.complete_declaration:
theorem meanField_parameter_deterministic
    {F : Cloud.State K dθ dz → Cloud.State K dθ dz} {m : ℝ} {L : ℝ≥0}
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L)
    (Y : ℝ → Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) (hY : Continuous Y)
    (B : ℝ → Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P)
    (hB : ∀ t, parameterOutput P (B t)=0)
    (hYe : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t-Y 0 = -(∫ r in 0..t, force P hF (Y r))+B t)
    (a₀ : Parameter dθ) (ha₀ : parameterOutput P (Y 0)=constantL2 P a₀)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    parameterOutput P (Y t)=constantL2 P
      (a₀-∫ r in 0..t, headExtract (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P (liftedForce P hF (Y r)))) := by
  let A := fun r => headExtract (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P (liftedForce P hF (Y r)))
  have hfLip : LipschitzWith L (liftedForce P hF) := LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    (fun X Z => by simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using (liftedForce_regular P hF).lipschitz X Z)
  have hA : Continuous A := headExtract.continuous.comp
    ((ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P).continuous.comp (hfLip.continuous.comp hY))
  let C := parameterOutput (K := K) (dθ := dθ) (dz := dz) P
  have hi := C.intervalIntegral_comp_comm (μ := volume)
    (((force_lipschitz P hF).continuous.comp hY).intervalIntegrable 0 t)
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hi
  have hiConst := (Lp.constL 2 P ℝ : Parameter dθ →L[ℝ] Lp (Parameter dθ) 2 P).intervalIntegral_comp_comm
    (μ := volume) (hA.intervalIntegrable 0 t)
  have he := congrArg C (hYe t ht)
  simp only [map_sub,map_add,map_neg,← hi,C,force_parameter,hB,add_zero,ha₀,
    constantL2_eq_const] at he
  have hi' : (∫ r in 0..t, Lp.const 2 P (A r)) = Lp.const 2 P (∫ r in 0..t, A r) := by
    simpa only [Lp.constL_apply] using hiConst
  change parameterOutput P (Y t)-Lp.const 2 P a₀ = -(∫ r in 0..t, Lp.const 2 P (A r)) at he
  rw [hi'] at he
  rw [constantL2_eq_const]
  change parameterOutput P (Y t) = Lp.const 2 P (a₀-∫ r in 0..t, A r)
  have hc : Lp.const 2 P (a₀-∫ r in 0..t, A r) =
      Lp.const 2 P a₀-Lp.const 2 P (∫ r in 0..t, A r) :=
    (Lp.constL 2 P ℝ).map_sub _ _
  rw [hc]
  calc
    _ = -Lp.const 2 P (∫ r in 0..t, A r)+Lp.const 2 P a₀ := sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp he
    _ = _ := by abel

meanField_contraction.statement:
theorem meanField_contraction
    {F : Cloud.State K dθ dz → Cloud.State K dθ dz} {m : ℝ} {L : ℝ≥0}
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L)
    (Y Z B : ℝ → Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) (hY : Continuous Y) (hZ : Continuous Z)
    (hYe : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t-Y 0 = -(∫ r in 0..t, force P hF (Y r))+B t)
    (hZe : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Z t-Z 0 = -(∫ r in 0..t, force P hF (Z r))+B t)
    (a b : ℝ → Parameter dθ)
    (hpa : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → parameterOutput P (Y t)=constantL2 P (a t))
    (hpb : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → parameterOutput P (Z t)=constantL2 P (b t))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ‖Y t-Z t‖ ≤ Real.exp (-m*t)*‖Y 0-Z 0‖
meanField_contraction.complete_declaration:
theorem meanField_contraction
    {F : Cloud.State K dθ dz → Cloud.State K dθ dz} {m : ℝ} {L : ℝ≥0}
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L)
    (Y Z B : ℝ → Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) (hY : Continuous Y) (hZ : Continuous Z)
    (hYe : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t-Y 0 = -(∫ r in 0..t, force P hF (Y r))+B t)
    (hZe : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Z t-Z 0 = -(∫ r in 0..t, force P hF (Z r))+B t)
    (a b : ℝ → Parameter dθ)
    (hpa : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → parameterOutput P (Y t)=constantL2 P (a t))
    (hpb : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → parameterOutput P (Z t)=constantL2 P (b t))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ‖Y t-Z t‖ ≤ Real.exp (-m*t)*‖Y 0-Z 0‖ := by
  let e := fun r => ‖Y r-Z r‖^2
  let e' := fun r => -2*inner ℝ (Y r-Z r) (force P hF (Y r)-force P hF (Z r))
  have hc : ContinuousOn e (Icc 0 t) := ((hY.sub hZ).norm.pow 2).continuousOn
  have hd : ∀ r ∈ Ico 0 t, HasDerivWithinAt e (e' r) (Ici r) r := by
    intro r hr
    have hdiff := KineticLangevin.integral_difference_hasDerivWithinAt
      (force P hF) (2*L) (force_lipschitz P hF) Y Z B hY hZ t
      (fun s hs => hYe s hs.1) (fun s hs => hZe s hs.1) r hr
    simpa only [e,e',inner_neg_right,mul_neg,neg_mul] using hdiff.norm_sq
  have hm : ∀ r ∈ Ico 0 t, e' r ≤ -2*m*e r := by
    intro r hr
    have h := force_monotone_on_deterministic P hF (Y r) (Z r) (a r) (b r) (hpa r hr.1) (hpb r hr.1)
    rw [real_inner_comm] at h
    dsimp [e,e']
    nlinarith
  have he := PBGSO.energy_decay hc hd hm t ⟨ht,le_rfl⟩
  have heexp : Real.exp (-m*t)^2=Real.exp (-2*m*t) := by
    rw [pow_two,← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp
  rw [mul_pow,heexp]
  simpa only [e,mul_comm] using he

theorem liftMap_expectation_eq_of_law {E A : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup A] [NormedSpace ℝ A] [CompleteSpace A]
    (f : E → A) {C : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzWith C f)
    (X Y : Lp E 2 P) (hlaw : P.map X=P.map Y) :
    (∫ ω, PBGSO.liftMap P f hf X ω ∂P) = ∫ ω, PBGSO.liftMap P f hf Y ω ∂P
liftMap_expectation_eq_of_law.complete_declaration:
theorem liftMap_expectation_eq_of_law {E A : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup A] [NormedSpace ℝ A] [CompleteSpace A]
    (f : E → A) {C : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzWith C f)
    (X Y : Lp E 2 P) (hlaw : P.map X=P.map Y) :
    (∫ ω, PBGSO.liftMap P f hf X ω ∂P) = ∫ ω, PBGSO.liftMap P f hf Y ω ∂P := by
  rw [integral_congr_ae (PBGSO.liftMap_coe P f hf X),
    integral_congr_ae (PBGSO.liftMap_coe P f hf Y)]
  have hx := integral_map (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable X).aemeasurable hf.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hy := integral_map (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable Y).aemeasurable hf.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [← hx,← hy,hlaw]

force_eq_frozen_of_score_mean_zero.statement:
theorem force_eq_frozen_of_score_mean_zero
    (hK : 0 < K) (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i)))
    (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P)
    (hopt : ∑ i, (∫ ω, scoreLp P U L hLip X i ω ∂P)=0) :
    force P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) X =
      frozenForce P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) X
force_eq_frozen_of_score_mean_zero.complete_declaration:
theorem force_eq_frozen_of_score_mean_zero
    (hK : 0 < K) (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i)))
    (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P)
    (hopt : ∑ i, (∫ ω, scoreLp P U L hLip X i ω ∂P)=0) :
    force P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) X =
      frozenForce P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) X := by
  let hF := Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip
  let Z := liftedForce P hF X
  let E := ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM (E := Cloud.State K dθ dz) P
  have heZ : E (Z-frozenForce P hF X) = headInsert (headExtract (E Z)) := by
    rw [map_sub]
    have ht := ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM_compLp P tailMask Z
    change E (tailMask.compLpL 2 P Z)=tailMask (E Z) at ht
    change E Z-E (tailMask.compLpL 2 P Z)=_
    rw [ht]
    ext j
    cases j <;> simp
  have hzero : E (MiniBatchVariance.average (scoreLp P U L hLip X))=0 := by
    rw [MiniBatchVariance.average,map_smul,map_sum]
    change (1/(K : ℝ)) • (∑ i, ∫ ω, scoreLp P U L hLip X i ω ∂P)=0
    rw [hopt,smul_zero]
  have he := congrArg E (lifted_meanForce_residual P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip X)
  change E (Z-frozenForce P hF X)=_ at he
  rw [heZ,hzero] at he
  have hp : headExtract (E Z)=0 := by
    have hh := congrArg (headExtract (d := dθ) (J := Fin K × Fin dz)) he
    ext j
    have hj := congrArg (fun x : Parameter dθ => x j) hh
    simpa using hj
  change Lp.const 2 P (headInsert (J := Fin K × Fin dz) (headExtract (E Z)))+
      tailMask.compLpL 2 P Z = tailMask.compLpL 2 P Z
  rw [hp,map_zero]
  simp

theorem frozen_is_meanField
    (hK : 0 < K) (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i)))
    (B : (Fin K × Fin dz) → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (B i) P)
    (S : FrozenPosteriorSolution P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) B hB)
    (hopt : ∑ i, (∫ ω, scoreLp P U L hLip (S.path 0) i ω ∂P)=0) :
    ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → S.path t-S.path 0 =
      -(∫ r in 0..t, force P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) (S.path r))+
        physicalNoise P B hB t
frozen_is_meanField.complete_declaration:
theorem frozen_is_meanField
    (hK : 0 < K) (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i)))
    (B : (Fin K × Fin dz) → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (B i) P)
    (S : FrozenPosteriorSolution P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) B hB)
    (hopt : ∑ i, (∫ ω, scoreLp P U L hLip (S.path 0) i ω ∂P)=0) :
    ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → S.path t-S.path 0 =
      -(∫ r in 0..t, force P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) (S.path r))+
        physicalNoise P B hB t := by
  intro t ht
  have hp (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
      force P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) (S.path r) =
        frozenForce P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) (S.path r) := by
    apply force_eq_frozen_of_score_mean_zero P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip
    have hs (i : Fin K) : (∫ ω, scoreLp P U L hLip (S.path r) i ω ∂P) =
        ∫ ω, scoreLp P U L hLip (S.path 0) i ω ∂P :=
      liftMap_expectation_eq_of_law P (parameterScore U i) (parameterScore_lipschitz U L hLip i)
        _ _ (S.stationary_law r hr)
    simp_rw [hs]
    exact hopt
  rw [show (∫ r in 0..t, force P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) (S.path r)) =
    ∫ r in 0..t, frozenForce P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) (S.path r) by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro r hr
      rw [uIcc_of_le ht] at hr
      exact hp r hr.1]
  exact S.equation t ht

meanField_optimizer_convergence.statement:
theorem meanField_optimizer_convergence
    (hK : 0 < K) (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i)))
    (B : (Fin K × Fin dz) → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (B i) P)
    (S : FrozenPosteriorSolution P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) B hB)
    (hopt : ∑ i, (∫ ω, scoreLp P U L hLip (S.path 0) i ω ∂P)=0)
    (astar : Parameter dθ) (hstar : parameterOutput P (S.path 0)=constantL2 P astar)
    (Y : ℝ → Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) (hY : Continuous Y)
    (hYe : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t-Y 0 =
      -(∫ r in 0..t, force P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) (Y r))+
        physicalNoise P B hB t)
    (a₀ : Parameter dθ) (ha₀ : parameterOutput P (Y 0)=constantL2 P a₀)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ‖parameterOutput P (Y t)-constantL2 P astar‖ ≤ Real.exp (-m*t)*‖Y 0-S.path 0‖
meanField_optimizer_convergence.complete_declaration:
theorem meanField_optimizer_convergence
    (hK : 0 < K) (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i)))
    (B : (Fin K × Fin dz) → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (B i) P)
    (S : FrozenPosteriorSolution P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) B hB)
    (hopt : ∑ i, (∫ ω, scoreLp P U L hLip (S.path 0) i ω ∂P)=0)
    (astar : Parameter dθ) (hstar : parameterOutput P (S.path 0)=constantL2 P astar)
    (Y : ℝ → Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) (hY : Continuous Y)
    (hYe : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t-Y 0 =
      -(∫ r in 0..t, force P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) (Y r))+
        physicalNoise P B hB t)
    (a₀ : Parameter dθ) (ha₀ : parameterOutput P (Y 0)=constantL2 P a₀)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ‖parameterOutput P (Y t)-constantL2 P astar‖ ≤ Real.exp (-m*t)*‖Y 0-S.path 0‖ := by
  let hF := Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip
  let a := fun t => a₀-∫ r in 0..t, headExtract (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P (liftedForce P hF (Y r)))
  have hpa := meanField_parameter_deterministic P hF Y hY (physicalNoise P B hB)
    (parameterOutput_noise_zero P B hB) hYe a₀ ha₀
  have hpb (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) : parameterOutput P (S.path r)=constantL2 P astar :=
    (S.parameter_constant P r hr).trans hstar
  have he := meanField_contraction P hF Y S.path (physicalNoise P B hB) hY S.continuous
    hYe (frozen_is_meanField P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip B hB S hopt) a (fun _ => astar) hpa hpb t ht
  rw [← hpb t ht,← map_sub]
  exact ((parameterOutput P).le_opNorm _).trans
    ((mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (parameterOutput_norm_le P)).trans he)
