import UnadjustedLangevin.Coupling
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Slope
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.IntervalIntegral.FundThmCalculus

set_option linter.style.header false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter Set
open scoped Topology ENNReal

namespace LatentDiffusion.RegularMetricFlow

variable {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
  [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
  (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]

/-- A regular optimal-transport realization to a fixed target. Minimality is
over genuine measure couplings, not a distance or convergence bound. In a
characteristic-flow application the anchor is T_t(Y_t), where T_t is a regular
optimal transport map from the current law to the fixed target. -/



/-- Gluing the actual characteristic variables to an optimal target anchor
proves the distance comparison. No Wasserstein triangle bound is assumed. -/


/-- Corrected source metric-speed lemma, in the stronger upper-Dini form.
The ordinary distance derivative need not exist at a crossing time. -/

/-- Integrating the characteristic velocity gives the source's integrated
metric-speed control for actual probability laws. -/

end LatentDiffusion.RegularMetricFlow

OptimalAnchor.statement: structure OptimalAnchor (Y : Lp E 2 P) (target : Measure E)
OptimalAnchor.complete_declaration:
structure OptimalAnchor (Y : Lp E 2 P) (target : Measure E) where
  value : Lp E 2 P
  law : P.map value = target
  minimal : ∀ c : ULA.Coupling (P.map Y) target,
    ENNReal.ofReal ‖Y - value‖ ≤ ULA.couplingCost c.joint

distanceTo.statement: def distanceTo (Y : ℝ → Lp E 2 P) (target : Measure E) (t : ℝ) : ℝ
distanceTo.complete_declaration:
def distanceTo (Y : ℝ → Lp E 2 P) (target : Measure E) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ULA.wasserstein2Real (P.map (Y t)) target

OptimalAnchor.distance_eq.complete_declaration:
theorem OptimalAnchor.distance_eq {Y : Lp E 2 P} {target : Measure E}
    (D : OptimalAnchor P Y target) :
    ULA.wasserstein2Real (P.map Y) target = ‖Y - D.value‖ := by
  have upper := ULA.wasserstein2_le_Lp_cost P Y D.value
  rw [D.law] at upper
  have lower : ENNReal.ofReal ‖Y - D.value‖ ≤ ULA.wasserstein2 (P.map Y) target := by
    exact le_iInf D.minimal
  have heq := le_antisymm upper lower
  exact (congrArg ENNReal.toReal heq).trans (ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (norm_nonneg _))

distance_increment_le.statement:
theorem distance_increment_le (Y : ℝ → Lp E 2 P) (target : Measure E)
    (anchor : ∀ t, OptimalAnchor P (Y t) target) (s t : ℝ) :
    distanceTo P Y target s - distanceTo P Y target t ≤ ‖Y s - Y t‖
distance_increment_le.complete_declaration:
theorem distance_increment_le (Y : ℝ → Lp E 2 P) (target : Measure E)
    (anchor : ∀ t, OptimalAnchor P (Y t) target) (s t : ℝ) :
    distanceTo P Y target s - distanceTo P Y target t ≤ ‖Y s - Y t‖ := by
  have upper := ULA.wasserstein2_le_Lp_cost_real P (Y s) (anchor t).value
  rw [(anchor t).law] at upper
  have tri : ‖Y s - (anchor t).value‖ ≤ ‖Y s - Y t‖ + ‖Y t - (anchor t).value‖ := by
    calc
      _ = ‖(Y s - Y t) + (Y t - (anchor t).value)‖ := by congr 1; abel
      _ ≤ _ := norm_add_le _ _
  have heq := (anchor t).distance_eq
  change distanceTo P Y target t = _ at heq
  change distanceTo P Y target s ≤ _ at upper
  linarith

distance_abs_increment_le.statement:
theorem distance_abs_increment_le (Y : ℝ → Lp E 2 P) (target : Measure E)
    (anchor : ∀ t, OptimalAnchor P (Y t) target) (s t : ℝ) :
    |distanceTo P Y target s - distanceTo P Y target t| ≤ ‖Y s - Y t‖
distance_abs_increment_le.complete_declaration:
theorem distance_abs_increment_le (Y : ℝ → Lp E 2 P) (target : Measure E)
    (anchor : ∀ t, OptimalAnchor P (Y t) target) (s t : ℝ) :
    |distanceTo P Y target s - distanceTo P Y target t| ≤ ‖Y s - Y t‖ := by
  refine abs_le.mpr ⟨?_, distance_increment_le P Y target anchor s t⟩
  have h := distance_increment_le P Y target anchor t s
  rw [norm_sub_rev] at h
  linarith

distance_right_slope.statement:
theorem distance_right_slope (Y : ℝ → Lp E 2 P) (target : Measure E)
    (anchor : ∀ t, OptimalAnchor P (Y t) target) (t : ℝ) (v : Lp E 2 P)
    (hY : HasDerivWithinAt Y v (Ici t) t) (r : ℝ) (hr : ‖v‖ < r) :
    ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] t, slope (distanceTo P Y target) t s < r
distance_right_slope.complete_declaration:
theorem distance_right_slope (Y : ℝ → Lp E 2 P) (target : Measure E)
    (anchor : ∀ t, OptimalAnchor P (Y t) target) (t : ℝ) (v : Lp E 2 P)
    (hY : HasDerivWithinAt Y v (Ici t) t) (r : ℝ) (hr : ‖v‖ < r) :
    ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] t, slope (distanceTo P Y target) t s < r := by
  have h := (hY.mono Ioi_subset_Ici_self).limsup_norm_slope_le hr
  filter_upwards [h, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs hst
  have hinc := distance_increment_le P Y target anchor s t
  rw [slope_def_field]
  have hpos : 0 < s - t := sub_pos.mpr hst
  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hpos] at hs
  have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinc (inv_nonneg.mpr hpos.le)
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hpos, div_eq_inv_mul] using hscaled.trans_lt hs

distance_integral_bound.statement:
theorem distance_integral_bound (Y v : ℝ → Lp E 2 P) (target : Measure E)
    (anchor : ∀ t, OptimalAnchor P (Y t) target) (s t : ℝ) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (hY : ∀ u ∈ uIcc s t, HasDerivAt Y (v u) u)
    (hv : IntervalIntegrable v volume s t) :
    |distanceTo P Y target t - distanceTo P Y target s| ≤ ∫ u in s..t, ‖v u‖
distance_integral_bound.complete_declaration:
theorem distance_integral_bound (Y v : ℝ → Lp E 2 P) (target : Measure E)
    (anchor : ∀ t, OptimalAnchor P (Y t) target) (s t : ℝ) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (hY : ∀ u ∈ uIcc s t, HasDerivAt Y (v u) u)
    (hv : IntervalIntegrable v volume s t) :
    |distanceTo P Y target t - distanceTo P Y target s| ≤ ∫ u in s..t, ‖v u‖ := by
  apply (distance_abs_increment_le P Y target anchor t s).trans
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hY hv]
  exact intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_integral_norm hst

import LatentDiffusion.RegularVariational
import LatentDiffusion.Marginal

set_option linter.style.header false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped ENNReal

namespace LatentDiffusion.RegularModel

variable {dθ dz M : ℕ}




/-- The source density model is constructed from the original potentials.
Normalization and existence of the posterior are consequences of A3. -/


/-- Actual heterogeneous posterior normalization and evidence identification
are constructed, rather than supplied as an abstract family interpretation. -/

/-- Every posterior lies in the source P₂ domain, derived from joint strong
convexity and not added as an independent moment hypothesis. -/

/-- The source optimizer theorem on its actual P₂ and finite-KL domain, using
the literal density integral and posteriors constructed from the potentials. -/

end LatentDiffusion.RegularModel

latentInsert.statement: def latentInsert : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz) →L[ℝ] IPLA.Joint dθ dz

slice_differentiable.statement:
theorem slice_differentiable (U : IPLA.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (hU : Differentiable ℝ U) (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dθ)) :
    Differentiable ℝ (fun z ↦ U (IPLA.pair a z))
slice_differentiable.complete_declaration:
theorem slice_differentiable (U : IPLA.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (hU : Differentiable ℝ U) (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dθ)) :
    Differentiable ℝ (fun z ↦ U (IPLA.pair a z)) := by
  have hp : (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz) ↦ IPLA.pair a z) =
      fun z ↦ IPLA.pair a 0 + latentInsert z := by
    funext z
    ext j
    cases j <;> simp [IPLA.pair, latentInsert]
  rw [show (fun z ↦ U (IPLA.pair a z)) = U ∘ (fun z ↦ IPLA.pair a z) from rfl, hp]
  exact hU.comp (latentInsert.differentiable.const_add (IPLA.pair a 0))

slice_strongConvex.statement:
theorem slice_strongConvex (U : IPLA.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (m : ℝ)
    (hU : StrongConvexOn univ m U) (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dθ)) :
    StrongConvexOn univ m (fun z ↦ U (IPLA.pair a z))
slice_strongConvex.complete_declaration:
theorem slice_strongConvex (U : IPLA.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (m : ℝ)
    (hU : StrongConvexOn univ m U) (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dθ)) :
    StrongConvexOn univ m (fun z ↦ U (IPLA.pair a z)) := by
  refine ⟨convex_univ, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy r s hr hs hrs
  have h := hU.2 (mem_univ (IPLA.pair a x)) (mem_univ (IPLA.pair a y)) hr hs hrs
  have ha : r • a + s • a = a := by rw [← add_smul, hrs, one_smul]
  rw [← IPLA.pair_affine, ha, IPLA.pair_sub] at h
  dsimp only at h
  rw [IPLA.norm_pair_sq] at h
  simpa only [sub_self, norm_zero, zero_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), zero_add] using h

densityModel.statement:
def densityModel (U : Fin M → IPLA.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (m : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn univ m (U i)) :
    RegularVariational.DensityModel (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dθ))
      (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz)) M volume
densityModel.complete_declaration:
def densityModel (U : Fin M → IPLA.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (m : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn univ m (U i)) :
    RegularVariational.DensityModel (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dθ))
      (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz)) M volume where
  density a i z := Real.exp (-U i (IPLA.pair a z))
  measurable a i := (Real.continuous_exp.comp
    ((slice_differentiable (U i) (hdiff i) a).continuous.neg)).measurable
  positive _ _ _ := Real.exp_pos _
  integrable a i := IPLA.integrable_marginal_weight (U i) m hm (hdiff i) (hsc i) a
  mass_positive a i := IPLA.marginalIntegral_pos (U i) m hm (hdiff i) (hsc i) a

densityModel_logEvidence.statement:
theorem densityModel_logEvidence (U : Fin M → IPLA.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (m : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn univ m (U i)) (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dθ)) :
    (densityModel U m hm hdiff hsc).family.logEvidence a = -averageMarginalPotential U a
densityModel_logEvidence.complete_declaration:
theorem densityModel_logEvidence (U : Fin M → IPLA.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (m : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn univ m (U i)) (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dθ)) :
    (densityModel U m hm hdiff hsc).family.logEvidence a = -averageMarginalPotential U a := by
  simp only [RegularVariational.DensityModel.family, densityModel,
    RegularVariational.DensityModel.mass, averageMarginalPotential,
    IPLA.marginalPotential, IPLA.marginalIntegral, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, mul_neg, neg_neg]

existsUnique_variationalOptimizer.statement:
theorem existsUnique_variationalOptimizer (U : Fin M → IPLA.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (hM : 0 < M) (m : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn univ m (U i)) :
    ∃! p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dθ) ×
        (Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz))),
      (densityModel U m hm hdiff hsc).family.IsGlobalMin p.1 p.2
existsUnique_variationalOptimizer.complete_declaration:
theorem existsUnique_variationalOptimizer (U : Fin M → IPLA.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (hM : 0 < M) (m : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn univ m (U i)) :
    ∃! p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dθ) ×
        (Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz))),
      (densityModel U m hm hdiff hsc).family.IsGlobalMin p.1 p.2 :=
  LatentDiffusion.existsUnique_variationalOptimizer U hM m hm hdiff hsc
    (densityModel U m hm hdiff hsc).family (densityModel_logEvidence U m hm hdiff hsc)

posterior_memLp.statement:
theorem posterior_memLp (U : Fin M → IPLA.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (m : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn univ m (U i)) (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dθ)) (i : Fin M) :
    MemLp (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz) ↦ z) 2
      ((densityModel U m hm hdiff hsc).posterior a i : Measure _)
posterior_memLp.complete_declaration:
theorem posterior_memLp (U : Fin M → IPLA.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (m : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn univ m (U i)) (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dθ)) (i : Fin M) :
    MemLp (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz) ↦ z) 2
      ((densityModel U m hm hdiff hsc).posterior a i : Measure _) := by
  let V : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz) → ℝ := fun z ↦ U i (IPLA.pair a z)
  have hdiffV := slice_differentiable (U i) (hdiff i) a
  have hscV := slice_strongConvex (U i) m (hsc i) a
  have hid : ((densityModel U m hm hdiff hsc).posterior a i : Measure _) = ULA.gibbsMeasure V := by
    simp only [RegularVariational.DensityModel.posterior, densityModel,
      RegularVariational.DensityModel.mass, Density.posteriorMeasure, Density.densityMeasure,
      ULA.gibbsMeasure, ULA.gibbsPartition, ULA.gibbsWeight]
    rw [← withDensity_smul _ (show Measurable (ULA.gibbsWeight V) from
      (Real.continuous_exp.comp hdiffV.continuous.neg).measurable.ennreal_ofReal)]
    apply withDensity_congr_ae
    refine ae_of_all _ fun z ↦ ?_
    have hZ : 0 < ∫ z, Real.exp (-U i (IPLA.pair a z)) :=
      IPLA.marginalIntegral_pos (U i) m hm (hdiff i) (hsc i) a
    change ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-U i (IPLA.pair a z)) / ∫ z, Real.exp (-U i (IPLA.pair a z))) = _
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos hZ]
    have hmass := ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal
      (IPLA.integrable_marginal_weight (U i) m hm (hdiff i) (hsc i) a)
      (ae_of_all _ fun z ↦ (Real.exp_pos _).le)
    rw [hmass]
    simp only [V, ULA.gibbsWeight, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
  rw [hid]
  exact ULA.memLp_id_gibbsMeasure V m hm hdiffV hscV

existsUnique_p2_literalOptimizer.statement:
theorem existsUnique_p2_literalOptimizer (U : Fin M → IPLA.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (hM : 0 < M) (m : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn univ m (U i)) :
    let D := densityModel U m hm hdiff hsc
    ∃! p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dθ) ×
        (Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz))),
      D.family.Admissible p.1 p.2 ∧
      (∀ i, MemLp (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz) ↦ z) 2 (p.2 i : Measure _)) ∧
      ∀ b q, D.family.Admissible b q →
        (∀ i, MemLp (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz) ↦ z) 2 (q i : Measure _)) →
        D.literalEnergy p.1 p.2 ≤ D.literalEnergy b q
existsUnique_p2_literalOptimizer.complete_declaration:
theorem existsUnique_p2_literalOptimizer (U : Fin M → IPLA.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (hM : 0 < M) (m : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn univ m (U i)) :
    let D := densityModel U m hm hdiff hsc
    ∃! p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dθ) ×
        (Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz))),
      D.family.Admissible p.1 p.2 ∧
      (∀ i, MemLp (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz) ↦ z) 2 (p.2 i : Measure _)) ∧
      ∀ b q, D.family.Admissible b q →
        (∀ i, MemLp (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz) ↦ z) 2 (q i : Measure _)) →
        D.literalEnergy p.1 p.2 ≤ D.literalEnergy b q := by
  let D := densityModel U m hm hdiff hsc
  let domain := fun q : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz)) ↦
    ∀ i, MemLp (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz) ↦ z) 2 (q i : Measure _)
  have hpost : ∀ a, domain (D.posterior a) := fun a i ↦ posterior_memLp U m hm hdiff hsc a i
  have heq (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dθ) ×
      (Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz)))) :
      (D.family.Admissible p.1 p.2 ∧ domain p.2 ∧
        ∀ b q, D.family.Admissible b q → domain q →
          D.literalEnergy p.1 p.2 ≤ D.literalEnergy b q) ↔
      D.family.IsGlobalMin p.1 p.2 :=
    (D.literal_minimizers_on_iff hM domain hpost p.1 p.2).trans
      (D.family.global_minimizers_iff hM p.1 p.2).symm
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hu⟩ := existsUnique_variationalOptimizer U hM m hm hdiff hsc
  exact ⟨p, (heq p).mpr hp, fun q hq ↦ hu q ((heq q).mp hq)⟩

lift.statement: def lift (a : P) (Y : ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m)) : LiftSpace (P := P) (Z := Z) Q
lift.complete_declaration:
def lift (a : P) (Y : ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m)) : LiftSpace (P := P) (Z := Z) Q :=

lift_sub.statement:
theorem lift_sub (a b : P) (Y W : ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m)) :
    lift Q a Y - lift Q b W = lift Q (a - b) (fun m ↦ Y m - W m)
lift_sub.complete_declaration:
theorem lift_sub (a b : P) (Y W : ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m)) :
    lift Q a Y - lift Q b W = lift Q (a - b) (fun m ↦ Y m - W m) := by
  apply WithLp.ofLp_injective 2
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · apply WithLp.ofLp_injective 2
    funext m
    change Real.sqrt (M : ℝ)⁻¹ • Y m - Real.sqrt (M : ℝ)⁻¹ • W m =
      Real.sqrt (M : ℝ)⁻¹ • (Y m - W m)
    rw [smul_sub]

lift_norm_sq.statement:
theorem lift_norm_sq (a : P) (Y : ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m)) :

lift_norm_sq.complete_declaration:
theorem lift_norm_sq (a : P) (Y : ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m)) :
    ‖lift Q a Y‖ ^ 2 = ‖a‖ ^ 2 + (M : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ m, ‖Y m‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [WithLp.prod_norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
  change ‖a‖ ^ 2 + ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun m ↦ Real.sqrt (M : ℝ)⁻¹ • Y m) :
    PiLp 2 (fun m ↦ Lp Z 2 (Q m)))‖ ^ 2 = _
  rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
  simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs,
    Real.sq_sqrt (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg M))]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]

distance_eq_anchor_norm.statement:
theorem distance_eq_anchor_norm
    (a : ℝ → P) (Y : ℝ → ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m)) (astar : P)
    (target : Fin M → Measure Z)
    (anchor : ∀ t m, RegularMetricFlow.OptimalAnchor (Q m) (Y t m) (target m))

distance_eq_anchor_norm.complete_declaration:
theorem distance_eq_anchor_norm
    (a : ℝ → P) (Y : ℝ → ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m)) (astar : P)
    (target : Fin M → Measure Z)
    (anchor : ∀ t m, RegularMetricFlow.OptimalAnchor (Q m) (Y t m) (target m))
    (t : ℝ) :
    distance Q a Y astar target t =
      ‖lift Q (a t) (Y t) - lift Q astar (fun m ↦ (anchor t m).value)‖ := by
  rw [lift_sub, ← Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), lift_norm_sq]
  unfold distance
  congr 2
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro m _

theorem distance_le_anchor_norm

distance_increment_le.statement:
theorem distance_increment_le
    (a : ℝ → P) (Y : ℝ → ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m)) (astar : P)
    (target : Fin M → Measure Z)
    (anchor : ∀ t m, RegularMetricFlow.OptimalAnchor (Q m) (Y t m) (target m))
    (s t : ℝ) :
    distance Q a Y astar target s - distance Q a Y astar target t ≤
      ‖lift Q (a s) (Y s) - lift Q (a t) (Y t)‖
distance_increment_le.complete_declaration:
theorem distance_increment_le
    (a : ℝ → P) (Y : ℝ → ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m)) (astar : P)
    (target : Fin M → Measure Z)
    (anchor : ∀ t m, RegularMetricFlow.OptimalAnchor (Q m) (Y t m) (target m))
    (s t : ℝ) :
    distance Q a Y astar target s - distance Q a Y astar target t ≤
      ‖lift Q (a s) (Y s) - lift Q (a t) (Y t)‖ := by
  have hs := distance_le_anchor_norm Q a Y astar target anchor s t
  have ht := distance_eq_anchor_norm Q a Y astar target anchor t
  have htri : ‖lift Q (a s) (Y s) - lift Q astar (fun m ↦ (anchor t m).value)‖ ≤
      ‖lift Q (a s) (Y s) - lift Q (a t) (Y t)‖+
        ‖lift Q (a t) (Y t) - lift Q astar (fun m ↦ (anchor t m).value)‖ := by
    calc
      _ = ‖(lift Q (a s) (Y s) - lift Q (a t) (Y t))+
          (lift Q (a t) (Y t) - lift Q astar (fun m ↦ (anchor t m).value))‖ := by
        congr 1
        abel
      _ ≤ _ := norm_add_le _ _
  linarith

distance_abs_increment_le.statement:
theorem distance_abs_increment_le
    (a : ℝ → P) (Y : ℝ → ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m)) (astar : P)

    (anchor : ∀ t m, RegularMetricFlow.OptimalAnchor (Q m) (Y t m) (target m))

      ‖lift Q (a s) (Y s) - lift Q (a t) (Y t)‖
distance_abs_increment_le.complete_declaration:
theorem distance_abs_increment_le
    (a : ℝ → P) (Y : ℝ → ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m)) (astar : P)
    (target : Fin M → Measure Z)
    (anchor : ∀ t m, RegularMetricFlow.OptimalAnchor (Q m) (Y t m) (target m))
    (s t : ℝ) :
    |distance Q a Y astar target s - distance Q a Y astar target t| ≤
      ‖lift Q (a s) (Y s) - lift Q (a t) (Y t)‖ := by
  refine abs_le.mpr ⟨?_, distance_increment_le Q a Y astar target anchor s t⟩
  have h := distance_increment_le Q a Y astar target anchor t s
  rw [norm_sub_rev] at h
  linarith

lift_hasDerivAt.statement:
theorem lift_hasDerivAt
    (a : ℝ → P) (Y : ℝ → ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m)) (t : ℝ)
    (adot : P) (v : ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m))
    (ha : HasDerivAt a adot t) (hY : ∀ m, HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ Y s m) (v m) t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ lift Q (a s) (Y s)) (lift Q adot v) t
lift_hasDerivAt.complete_declaration:
theorem lift_hasDerivAt
    (a : ℝ → P) (Y : ℝ → ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m)) (t : ℝ)
    (adot : P) (v : ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m))
    (ha : HasDerivAt a adot t) (hY : ∀ m, HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ Y s m) (v m) t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ lift Q (a s) (Y s)) (lift Q adot v) t := by
  have hpi : HasDerivAt
      (fun s m ↦ Real.sqrt (M : ℝ)⁻¹ • Y s m)
      (fun m ↦ Real.sqrt (M : ℝ)⁻¹ • v m) t :=
    hasDerivAt_pi.mpr (fun m ↦ by
      convert (hY m).const_smul (Real.sqrt (M : ℝ)⁻¹) using 1)
  have hl := (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (fun m ↦ Lp Z 2 (Q m))).symm
    |>.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hpi
  have hj := (WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ P
    (PiLp 2 (fun m ↦ Lp Z 2 (Q m)))).symm.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (ha.prodMk hl)
  exact hj

distance_right_slope.statement:
theorem distance_right_slope
    (a : ℝ → P) (Y : ℝ → ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m)) (astar : P)
    (target : Fin M → Measure Z)
    (anchor : ∀ t m, RegularMetricFlow.OptimalAnchor (Q m) (Y t m) (target m))
    (t : ℝ) (adot : P) (v : ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m))
    (ha : HasDerivAt a adot t) (hY : ∀ m, HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ Y s m) (v m) t)
    (r : ℝ) (hr : Real.sqrt (‖adot‖ ^ 2 + (M : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ m, ‖v m‖ ^ 2) < r) :
    ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] t, slope (distance Q a Y astar target) t s < r
distance_right_slope.complete_declaration:
theorem distance_right_slope
    (a : ℝ → P) (Y : ℝ → ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m)) (astar : P)
    (target : Fin M → Measure Z)
    (anchor : ∀ t m, RegularMetricFlow.OptimalAnchor (Q m) (Y t m) (target m))
    (t : ℝ) (adot : P) (v : ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m))
    (ha : HasDerivAt a adot t) (hY : ∀ m, HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ Y s m) (v m) t)
    (r : ℝ) (hr : Real.sqrt (‖adot‖ ^ 2 + (M : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ m, ‖v m‖ ^ 2) < r) :
    ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] t, slope (distance Q a Y astar target) t s < r := by
  have hnorm : ‖lift Q adot v‖ =
      Real.sqrt (‖adot‖ ^ 2 + (M : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ m, ‖v m‖ ^ 2) := by
    rw [← lift_norm_sq Q adot v, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]
  have h : HasDerivWithinAt (fun s ↦ lift Q (a s) (Y s)) (lift Q adot v) (Ici t) t :=
    (lift_hasDerivAt Q a Y t adot v ha hY).hasDerivWithinAt
  have hs := (h.mono Ioi_subset_Ici_self).limsup_norm_slope_le (hnorm ▸ hr)
  filter_upwards [hs, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs hst
  have hi := distance_increment_le Q a Y astar target anchor s t
  rw [slope_def_field]
  have hpos : 0 < s - t := sub_pos.mpr hst
  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hpos] at hs
  have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi (inv_nonneg.mpr hpos.le)
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hpos, div_eq_inv_mul]
    using hscaled.trans_lt hs

distance_integral_bound.statement:
theorem distance_integral_bound
    (a adot : ℝ → P) (Y v : ℝ → ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m)) (astar : P)
    (target : Fin M → Measure Z)
    (anchor : ∀ t m, RegularMetricFlow.OptimalAnchor (Q m) (Y t m) (target m))
    (s t : ℝ) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (ha : ∀ u ∈ uIcc s t, HasDerivAt a (adot u) u)
    (hY : ∀ u ∈ uIcc s t, ∀ m, HasDerivAt (fun r ↦ Y r m) (v u m) u)
    (hv : IntervalIntegrable (fun u ↦ lift Q (adot u) (v u)) volume s t) :
    |distance Q a Y astar target t - distance Q a Y astar target s| ≤
      ∫ u in s..t, Real.sqrt (‖adot u‖ ^ 2 + (M : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ m, ‖v u m‖ ^ 2)
distance_integral_bound.complete_declaration:
theorem distance_integral_bound
    (a adot : ℝ → P) (Y v : ℝ → ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m)) (astar : P)
    (target : Fin M → Measure Z)
    (anchor : ∀ t m, RegularMetricFlow.OptimalAnchor (Q m) (Y t m) (target m))
    (s t : ℝ) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (ha : ∀ u ∈ uIcc s t, HasDerivAt a (adot u) u)
    (hY : ∀ u ∈ uIcc s t, ∀ m, HasDerivAt (fun r ↦ Y r m) (v u m) u)
    (hv : IntervalIntegrable (fun u ↦ lift Q (adot u) (v u)) volume s t) :
    |distance Q a Y astar target t - distance Q a Y astar target s| ≤
      ∫ u in s..t, Real.sqrt (‖adot u‖ ^ 2 + (M : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ m, ‖v u m‖ ^ 2) := by
  have hderiv : ∀ u ∈ uIcc s t,
      HasDerivAt (fun r ↦ lift Q (a r) (Y r)) (lift Q (adot u) (v u)) u :=
    fun u hu ↦ lift_hasDerivAt Q a Y u (adot u) (v u) (ha u hu) (hY u hu)
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖lift Q (a t) (Y t) - lift Q (a s) (Y s)‖ :=
      distance_abs_increment_le Q a Y astar target anchor t s
    _ = ‖∫ u in s..t, lift Q (adot u) (v u)‖ := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hderiv hv]
    _ ≤ ∫ u in s..t, ‖lift Q (adot u) (v u)‖ :=
      intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_integral_norm hst
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      funext u
      rw [← lift_norm_sq Q (adot u) (v u), Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]

distance_derivative_le.statement:
theorem distance_derivative_le
    (a : ℝ → P) (Y : ℝ → ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m)) (astar : P)
    (target : Fin M → Measure Z)
    (anchor : ∀ t m, RegularMetricFlow.OptimalAnchor (Q m) (Y t m) (target m))
    (t : ℝ) (adot : P) (v : ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m))
    (ha : HasDerivAt a adot t) (hY : ∀ m, HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ Y s m) (v m) t)
    (derivative : ℝ)
    (hd : HasDerivWithinAt (distance Q a Y astar target) derivative (Ici t) t) :
    derivative ≤ Real.sqrt (‖adot‖ ^ 2 + (M : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ m, ‖v m‖ ^ 2)
distance_derivative_le.complete_declaration:
theorem distance_derivative_le
    (a : ℝ → P) (Y : ℝ → ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m)) (astar : P)
    (target : Fin M → Measure Z)
    (anchor : ∀ t m, RegularMetricFlow.OptimalAnchor (Q m) (Y t m) (target m))
    (t : ℝ) (adot : P) (v : ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m))
    (ha : HasDerivAt a adot t) (hY : ∀ m, HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ Y s m) (v m) t)
    (derivative : ℝ)
    (hd : HasDerivWithinAt (distance Q a Y astar target) derivative (Ici t) t) :
    derivative ≤ Real.sqrt (‖adot‖ ^ 2 + (M : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ m, ‖v m‖ ^ 2) := by
  apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
  intro ε hε
  have hb := distance_right_slope Q a Y astar target anchor t adot v ha hY
    (Real.sqrt (‖adot‖ ^ 2 + (M : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ m, ‖v m‖ ^ 2) + ε) (by linarith)
  have hlim : Tendsto (slope (distance Q a Y astar target) t) (𝓝[>] t) (𝓝 derivative) :=
    (hasDerivWithinAt_iff_tendsto_slope' (by simp : t ∉ Ioi t)).mp
      (hd.mono Ioi_subset_Ici_self)
  exact le_of_tendsto hlim (hb.mono fun _ h ↦ h.le)

theorem velocity_norm_sq
    (Y v : ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m)) (field : Fin M → Z → Z)
    (hmeas : ∀ m, Measurable (field m))
    (hvelocity : ∀ m, (v m : Ω m → Z) =ᵐ[Q m]

theorem velocity_norm_sq
    (Y v : ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m)) (field : Fin M → Z → Z)

    (hvelocity : ∀ m, (v m : Ω m → Z) =ᵐ[Q m]

    (Y v : ∀ m, Lp Z 2 (Q m)) (field : Fin M → Z → Z) (force adot : P)

theorem full_batch_optimizer_rms

    (U : Fin (M*N) → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m h : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i))) (hs : StableStep m L h)
    (initial : Lp (Latent (M*N) dz) 2 P)
    (hinitial : P.map initial = ULA.gibbsMeasure
      (frozenPotential U (optimizerParameter hMN U m hm hdiff hsc)))
    (hposterior : ∀ i, P.map (fun ω => physicalParticleCLM i
        ((packLp P (optimizerParameter hMN U m hm hdiff hsc) initial) ω)) =
      RegularEvidence.posterior volume (latentPotential U i) (optimizerParameter hMN U m hm hdiff hsc))
    (data : ∀ i, RegularEvidence.LocalNormalizerRegularity volume (latentPotential U i)
      (optimizerParameter hMN U m hm hdiff hsc))
    (hindScores : iIndepFun (fun i ω => scoreLp P U L hLip
      (packLp P (optimizerParameter hMN U m hm hdiff hsc) initial) i ω) P)
    (B : (Fin (M*N) × Fin dz) → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (B i) P)
    (hscalar : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → iIndepFun (fun p : ℕ × (Fin (M*N) × Fin dz) => fun ω =>
      ULA.Hilbert.brownianEulerNoise P B hB s p.1 ω p.2) P)
    (hind : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → IndepFun initial
      (fun ω n => ULA.Hilbert.brownianEulerNoise P B hB s n ω) P)
    (x₀ : Lp (Cloud.State (M*N) dθ dz) 2 P) (n : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt (∫ ω, ‖IPLA.parameterCLM
      (eulerTrajectory (Cloud.meanForce U) h
        (fun k => noiseIncrement P B hB h k ω) (x₀ ω) n)-
      optimizerParameter hMN U m hm hdiff hsc‖^2 ∂P) ≤
      (1-m*h/2)^n * ‖x₀-packLp P (optimizerParameter hMN U m hm hdiff hsc) initial‖ +
      (2/m) * Real.sqrt ((1/((M*N : ℕ) : ℝ))^2 *
        scoreVarianceBudget P U L hLip (packLp P (optimizerParameter hMN U m hm hdiff hsc) initial)) +
      (L : ℝ)/m * (h*Real.sqrt ((L : ℝ)*(dz : ℝ))+
        (4/3 : ℝ)*Real.sqrt (2*(dz : ℝ))*Real.sqrt h)

theorem full_batch_optimizer_rms
    {M N : ℕ} (hMN : 0 < M*N)
    (U : Fin (M*N) → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m h : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i))) (hs : StableStep m L h)
    (initial : Lp (Latent (M*N) dz) 2 P)
    (hinitial : P.map initial = ULA.gibbsMeasure
      (frozenPotential U (optimizerParameter hMN U m hm hdiff hsc)))
    (hposterior : ∀ i, P.map (fun ω => physicalParticleCLM i
        ((packLp P (optimizerParameter hMN U m hm hdiff hsc) initial) ω)) =
      RegularEvidence.posterior volume (latentPotential U i) (optimizerParameter hMN U m hm hdiff hsc))
    (data : ∀ i, RegularEvidence.LocalNormalizerRegularity volume (latentPotential U i)
      (optimizerParameter hMN U m hm hdiff hsc))
    (hindScores : iIndepFun (fun i ω => scoreLp P U L hLip
      (packLp P (optimizerParameter hMN U m hm hdiff hsc) initial) i ω) P)
    (B : (Fin (M*N) × Fin dz) → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (B i) P)
    (hscalar : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → iIndepFun (fun p : ℕ × (Fin (M*N) × Fin dz) => fun ω =>
      ULA.Hilbert.brownianEulerNoise P B hB s p.1 ω p.2) P)
    (hind : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → IndepFun initial
      (fun ω n => ULA.Hilbert.brownianEulerNoise P B hB s n ω) P)
    (x₀ : Lp (Cloud.State (M*N) dθ dz) 2 P) (n : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt (∫ ω, ‖IPLA.parameterCLM
      (eulerTrajectory (Cloud.meanForce U) h
        (fun k => noiseIncrement P B hB h k ω) (x₀ ω) n)-
      optimizerParameter hMN U m hm hdiff hsc‖^2 ∂P) ≤
      (1-m*h/2)^n * ‖x₀-packLp P (optimizerParameter hMN U m hm hdiff hsc) initial‖ +
      (2/m) * Real.sqrt ((1/((M*N : ℕ) : ℝ))^2 *
        scoreVarianceBudget P U L hLip (packLp P (optimizerParameter hMN U m hm hdiff hsc) initial)) +
      (L : ℝ)/m * (h*Real.sqrt ((L : ℝ)*(dz : ℝ))+
        (4/3 : ℝ)*Real.sqrt (2*(dz : ℝ))*Real.sqrt h) := by
  let a := optimizerParameter hMN U m hm hdiff hsc
  let S := sourceReference P hMN U m L hm hdiff hsc hLip a initial hinitial B hB hscalar hind
  have hS0 : S.path 0=packLp P a initial :=
    sourceReference_initial P hMN U m L hm hdiff hsc hLip a initial hinitial B hB hscalar hind
  have hmeas (i : Fin (M*N)) : Measurable (fun z => Real.exp (-latentPotential U i a z)) :=
    (Real.continuous_exp.comp ((RegularModel.slice_differentiable (U i) (hdiff i) a).continuous.neg)).measurable
  have hZ (i : Fin (M*N)) : 0 < RegularEvidence.normalizer volume (latentPotential U i) a :=
    IPLA.marginalIntegral_pos (U i) m hm (hdiff i) (hsc i) a
  have hopt := sum_score_means_eq_zero_of_evidence_maximum P hMN volume U L hdiff hLip
    (packLp P a initial) a (parameterOutput_packLp P a initial) hposterior data hmeas hZ
      (optimizer_maximizes_evidence hMN U m hm hdiff hsc)
  have hb := full_batch_parameter_bound P hMN U m h L hdiff hsc hLip hs B hB S
    (by rw [hS0]; exact hindScores) (by rw [hS0]; exact hopt) x₀ a
    (by rw [hS0]; exact parameterOutput_packLp P a initial) n
  rw [hS0,physicalNoiseScale_eq hMN] at hb
  have hG := initial_frozen_drift_bound P hMN U m L hm hdiff hsc hLip a initial hinitial
  have htime := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (add_le_add_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hG hs.positive.le)
      ((4/3 : ℝ)*Real.sqrt (2*(dz : ℝ))*Real.sqrt h)) (div_nonneg L.coe_nonneg hm.le)
  let ξ := noiseIncrement (dθ := dθ) P B hB h
  let F := particleForce P hMN U m L hdiff hsc hLip
  change ‖parameterOutput P (eulerTrajectory F h ξ x₀ n)-constantL2 P a‖ ≤ _ at hb
  have hrms := parameterOutput_rms P (eulerTrajectory F h ξ x₀ n) a
  have hpath := lifted_eulerTrajectory_coe P
    (Cloud.meanForce_regular hMN U m L hdiff hsc hLip) h ξ x₀ n
  have hlhs : Real.sqrt (∫ ω, ‖IPLA.parameterCLM
      (eulerTrajectory (Cloud.meanForce U) h (fun k => ξ k ω) (x₀ ω) n)-a‖^2 ∂P) =
      ‖parameterOutput P (eulerTrajectory F h ξ x₀ n)-constantL2 P a‖ := by
    rw [hrms]
    congr 1
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hpath] with ω hω
    change (eulerTrajectory F h ξ x₀ n) ω = _ at hω
    rw [hω]
  rw [hlhs]
  dsimp only [ξ, F, noiseIncrement, a] at *
  linarith only [hb, htime]

theorem empiricalProductDistanceSq_le {M N : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hN : 0 < N)
    (x y : Cloud.State (M * N) dθ dz) :
    empiricalProductDistanceSq x y ≤ ‖x - y‖ ^ 2
empiricalProductDistanceSq_le.complete_declaration:
theorem empiricalProductDistanceSq_le {M N : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hN : 0 < N)
    (x y : Cloud.State (M * N) dθ dz) :
    empiricalProductDistanceSq x y ≤ ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hpair (i : Fin M) := PBGSO.empiricalCloud_wasserstein_sq_le N hN
    (fun j => physicalParticleCLM (finProdFinEquiv (i, j)) x)
    (fun j => physicalParticleCLM (finProdFinEquiv (i, j)) y)
  have hs := (finProdFinEquiv (m := M) (n := N)).sum_comp
    (fun k => ‖physicalParticleCLM k x - physicalParticleCLM k y‖ ^ 2)
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type] at hs
  calc
    empiricalProductDistanceSq x y ≤
      ‖IPLA.parameterCLM x - IPLA.parameterCLM y‖ ^ 2 + (M : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ i : Fin M, (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ j : Fin N,
          ‖physicalParticleCLM (finProdFinEquiv (i, j)) x -
            physicalParticleCLM (finProdFinEquiv (i, j)) y‖ ^ 2 := by
      unfold empiricalProductDistanceSq
      exact add_le_add (le_refl _) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (Finset.sum_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hpair i))
        (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg M)))
    _ = ‖IPLA.parameterCLM x - IPLA.parameterCLM y‖ ^ 2 + ((M * N : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ k, ‖physicalParticleCLM k x - physicalParticleCLM k y‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hs, Nat.cast_mul, mul_inv_rev]
      ring
    _ = _ := normalized_physical_energy (Nat.mul_pos hM hN) x y

theorem empiricalProductDistanceSq_measurable {M N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    Measurable (fun p : Cloud.State (M * N) dθ dz × Cloud.State (M * N) dθ dz =>

  let : NeZero N := ⟨hN.ne'⟩
  unfold empiricalProductDistanceSq
  apply Measurable.add
  · fun_prop
  · apply Measurable.const_mul
    apply Finset.measurable_sum
    intro i _
    apply Measurable.pow_const
    let cloud : (Cloud.State (M * N) dθ dz × Cloud.State (M * N) dθ dz) →
        (Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz)) × (Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz)) :=
      fun p => ((fun j => physicalParticleCLM (finProdFinEquiv (i, j)) p.1),
        (fun j => physicalParticleCLM (finProdFinEquiv (i, j)) p.2))
    have hc : Measurable cloud := by
      apply Measurable.prodMk
      · exact Measurable.of_eval fun j =>
          (physicalParticleCLM (finProdFinEquiv (i, j))).continuous.measurable.comp measurable_fst
      · exact Measurable.of_eval fun j =>
          (physicalParticleCLM (finProdFinEquiv (i, j))).continuous.measurable.comp measurable_snd
    have hm : Measurable (fun z : (Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz)) ×
        (Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz)) =>
        (ULA.wasserstein2 (PBGSO.Model.empiricalLaw N z.1) (PBGSO.Model.empiricalLaw N z.2)).toReal) :=
      ENNReal.measurable_toReal.comp
        (PBGSO.EmpiricalTransportMeasurable.empirical_wasserstein_measurable
          (H := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin dz)) N)
    convert hm.comp hc using 1
    funext p

theorem empiricalProduct_rms_le_l2 {M N : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hN : 0 < N)
    (X Y : Lp (Cloud.State (M * N) dθ dz) 2 P) :
    Real.sqrt (∫ ω, empiricalProductDistanceSq (X ω) (Y ω) ∂P) ≤ ‖X - Y‖
empiricalProduct_rms_le_l2.complete_declaration:
theorem empiricalProduct_rms_le_l2 {M N : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hN : 0 < N)
    (X Y : Lp (Cloud.State (M * N) dθ dz) 2 P) :
    Real.sqrt (∫ ω, empiricalProductDistanceSq (X ω) (Y ω) ∂P) ≤ ‖X - Y‖ := by
  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => empiricalProductDistanceSq (X ω) (Y ω)) P :=
    ((empiricalProductDistanceSq_measurable (dθ := dθ) (dz := dz) hN).comp_aemeasurable
      ((Lp.aestronglyMeasurable X).aemeasurable.prodMk (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable Y).aemeasurable)).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hnorm : Integrable (fun ω => ‖X ω - Y ω‖ ^ 2) P :=
    ((Lp.memLp X).sub (Lp.memLp Y)).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)
  have hi : Integrable (fun ω => empiricalProductDistanceSq (X ω) (Y ω)) P := by
    apply hnorm.mono' hm
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (empiricalProductDistanceSq_nonneg (X ω) (Y ω))]
      exact empiricalProductDistanceSq_le hM hN (X ω) (Y ω)
  have hb := integral_mono_ae hi hnorm
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => empiricalProductDistanceSq_le hM hN (X ω) (Y ω))
  have he : (∫ ω, ‖X ω - Y ω‖ ^ 2 ∂P) = ‖X - Y‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [l2_norm_sq_eq_expectation]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub X Y] with ω hω
    simp only [hω, Pi.sub_apply]
  rw [he] at hb
  exact (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hb).trans_eq (Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _))

      (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ i, P.map (fun ω => physicalParticleCLM i (S.path t ω)) =
        RegularEvidence.posterior volume (latentPotential U i)
          (optimizerParameter hK U m hm hdiff hsc)) ∧
      ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ‖Y t - S.path t‖ ≤
        Real.exp (-m * t) * ‖Y 0 - packLp P (optimizerParameter hK U m hm hdiff hsc) initial‖ := by
  let a := optimizerParameter hK U m hm hdiff hsc
  let S := sourceReference P hK U m L hm hdiff hsc hLip a initial hinitial B hB hscalar hind
  have hS0 : S.path 0 = packLp P a initial :=
    sourceReference_initial P hK U m L hm hdiff hsc hLip a initial hinitial B hB hscalar hind
  have hmeas (i : Fin K) : Measurable (fun z => Real.exp (-latentPotential U i a z)) :=
    (Real.continuous_exp.comp
      ((RegularModel.slice_differentiable (U i) (hdiff i) a).continuous.neg)).measurable
  have hZ (i : Fin K) : 0 < RegularEvidence.normalizer volume (latentPotential U i) a :=
    IPLA.marginalIntegral_pos (U i) m hm (hdiff i) (hsc i) a
  have hopt := sum_score_means_eq_zero_of_evidence_maximum P hK volume U L hdiff hLip
    (packLp P a initial) a (parameterOutput_packLp P a initial) hposterior data hmeas hZ
      (optimizer_maximizes_evidence hK U m hm hdiff hsc)
  let hF := Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip
  let aPath := fun t => a₀ - ∫ r in 0..t,
    headExtract (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM P (liftedForce P hF (Y r)))
  have hpa := RegularMeanField.meanField_parameter_deterministic P hF Y hY
    (physicalNoise P B hB) (parameterOutput_noise_zero P B hB) hYe a₀ ha₀
  have hpb (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : parameterOutput P (S.path t) = constantL2 P a := by
    rw [S.parameter_constant P t ht, hS0]
    exact parameterOutput_packLp P a initial
  refine ⟨S, hS0, hpb, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t ht i
    have hlaw := physicalParticle_law_eq_of_state_law P i (S.path t) (S.path 0)
      (S.stationary_law t ht)
    rw [hS0] at hlaw
    exact hlaw.trans (hposterior i)

    have hSe := RegularMeanField.frozen_is_meanField P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip B hB S
      (by rw [hS0]; exact hopt)
    have he := RegularMeanField.meanField_contraction P hF Y S.path (physicalNoise P B hB)
      hY S.continuous hYe hSe aPath (fun _ => a) hpa hpb t ht
    simpa only [hS0] using he

headInsert_norm.statement:
@[simp] theorem headInsert_norm {d : ℕ} {J : Type*} [Fintype J] (a : Parameter d) :

headInsert_norm.complete_declaration:
@[simp] theorem headInsert_norm {d : ℕ} {J : Type*} [Fintype J] (a : Parameter d) :
    ‖headInsert (J := J) a‖ = ‖a‖ := by
  have h : ‖headInsert (J := J) a‖ ^ 2 = ‖a‖ ^ 2 := by
    simp [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (headInsert (J := J) a), norm_nonneg a]

parameterScore_lipschitz.statement:
theorem parameterScore_lipschitz (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (L : ℝ≥0) (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i))) (i : Fin K) :
    LipschitzWith (L * ‖Cloud.jointCLM (dθ := dθ) (dx := dz) i‖₊)
      (parameterScore U i)
parameterScore_lipschitz.complete_declaration:
theorem parameterScore_lipschitz (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (L : ℝ≥0) (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i))) (i : Fin K) :
    LipschitzWith (L * ‖Cloud.jointCLM (dθ := dθ) (dx := dz) i‖₊)
      (parameterScore U i) := by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro x y
  simp only [dist_eq_norm]
  rw [parameterScore, parameterScore, ← map_sub, headInsert_norm, ← map_sub]
  apply (headExtract_norm_le _).trans
  apply ((hLip i).norm_sub_le _ _).trans
  have hj := (Cloud.jointCLM (dθ := dθ) (dx := dz) i).le_opNorm (x-y)
  simpa only [NNReal.coe_mul, coe_nnnorm, ContinuousLinearMap.map_sub,
    Cloud.jointCLM_apply, mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hj L.coe_nonneg

theorem meanForce_residual (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i)) (x : Cloud.State K dθ dz) :
    Cloud.meanForce U x - tailMask (Cloud.meanForce U x) =
      MiniBatchVariance.average (fun i => parameterScore U i x)
meanForce_residual.complete_declaration:
theorem meanForce_residual (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i)) (x : Cloud.State K dθ dz) :
    Cloud.meanForce U x - tailMask (Cloud.meanForce U x) =
      MiniBatchVariance.average (fun i => parameterScore U i x) := by
  ext j
  cases j with
  | inl j =>
    simp [MiniBatchVariance.average, parameterScore, Cloud.meanForce,
      Cloud.gradient_potential_parameter hdiff]
  | inr j => simp [MiniBatchVariance.average, parameterScore]

frozenForce.complete_declaration:
def frozenForce {F : Cloud.State K dθ dz → Cloud.State K dθ dz} {m : ℝ} {L : ℝ≥0}
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) :
    Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P :=
  tailMask.compLpL 2 P (liftedForce P hF X)

frozenForce_lipschitz.complete_declaration:
theorem frozenForce_lipschitz {F : Cloud.State K dθ dz → Cloud.State K dθ dz}
    {m : ℝ} {L : ℝ≥0} (hF : ForceRegularity F m L) :
    LipschitzWith L (frozenForce P hF) := by
  let C : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P →L[ℝ] Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P :=
    (tailMask (d := dθ) (J := Fin K × Fin dz)).compLpL 2 P
  have hc : ‖C‖ ≤ 1 :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compLpL_le _).trans tailMask_opNorm_le
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro X Y
  simp only [dist_eq_norm]
  change ‖C (liftedForce P hF X) - C (liftedForce P hF Y)‖ ≤
    (L : ℝ) * ‖X-Y‖
  rw [← C.map_sub]
  exact (C.le_opNorm _).trans
    ((mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) hc).trans
      ((liftedForce_regular P hF).lipschitz X Y))

    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i))) (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P)
    (i : Fin K) : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P :=
  PBGSO.liftMap P (parameterScore U i) (parameterScore_lipschitz U L hLip i) X

    (hK : 0 < K) (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))

    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i)))
    (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) :
    particleForce P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip X -
      frozenForce P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) X =
        MiniBatchVariance.average (scoreLp P U L hLip X)
lifted_meanForce_residual.complete_declaration:
theorem lifted_meanForce_residual
    (hK : 0 < K) (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i)))
    (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) :
    particleForce P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip X -
      frozenForce P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) X =
        MiniBatchVariance.average (scoreLp P U L hLip X) := by
  let hF := Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip
  let f := scoreLp P U L hLip X
  have hs : (∑ i, f i) =ᵐ[P] fun ω => ∑ i, parameterScore U i (X ω) := by
    have hsum := Lp.coeFn_finsetSum Finset.univ f
    filter_upwards [hsum, ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i =>
      PBGSO.liftMap_coe P (parameterScore U i) (parameterScore_lipschitz U L hLip i) X)]
      with ω hw hi
    rw [hw]
    simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hi i)
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (particleForce P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip X)
    (frozenForce P hF X), liftedForce_coe P hF X,
    tailMask.coeFn_compLpL (p := 2) (μ := P) (liftedForce P hF X),
    Lp.coeFn_smul (1 / (K : ℝ)) (∑ i, f i), hs] with ω hsub hf ht ha hs
  change (particleForce P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip X) ω = _ at hf
  change (frozenForce P hF X) ω = _ at ht
  change _ = ((1 / (K : ℝ)) • (∑ i, f i)) ω
  rw [hsub, ha]
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply]
  rw [ht]
  change _ - tailMask ((liftedForce P hF X) ω) = _
  rw [hf, show (liftedForce P hF X) ω = Cloud.meanForce U (X ω) from hf, hs]
  exact meanForce_residual U hdiff (X ω)

liftMap_norm_eq_of_law.statement:
theorem liftMap_norm_eq_of_law {E A : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup A] [InnerProductSpace ℝ A] [CompleteSpace A]
    (f : E → A) {C : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzWith C f)
    (X Y : Lp E 2 P) (hlaw : P.map X = P.map Y) :
    ‖PBGSO.liftMap P f hf X‖ = ‖PBGSO.liftMap P f hf Y‖
liftMap_norm_eq_of_law.complete_declaration:
theorem liftMap_norm_eq_of_law {E A : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup A] [InnerProductSpace ℝ A] [CompleteSpace A]
    (f : E → A) {C : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzWith C f)
    (X Y : Lp E 2 P) (hlaw : P.map X = P.map Y) :
    ‖PBGSO.liftMap P f hf X‖ = ‖PBGSO.liftMap P f hf Y‖ := by
  have he (Z : Lp E 2 P) : ‖PBGSO.liftMap P f hf Z‖ ^ 2 =
      ∫ z, ‖f z‖ ^ 2 ∂P.map Z := by
    rw [l2_norm_sq_eq_expectation]
    have hm := integral_map (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable Z).aemeasurable
      (show AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => ‖f z‖ ^ 2) (P.map Z) from
        (hf.continuous.norm.pow 2).aestronglyMeasurable)
    rw [hm]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [PBGSO.liftMap_coe P f hf Z] with ω hω
    rw [hω]
  have h := (he X).trans ((congrArg (fun μ => ∫ z, ‖f z‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) hlaw).trans (he Y).symm)
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (PBGSO.liftMap P f hf X), norm_nonneg (PBGSO.liftMap P f hf Y)]

independent_average_norm_sq.statement:
theorem independent_average_norm_sq {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (g : Fin K → Lp E 2 P)
    (hind : iIndepFun (fun i ω => g i ω) P)
    (hopt : ∑ i, (∫ ω, g i ω ∂P) = 0) :
    ‖MiniBatchVariance.average g‖ ^ 2 = (1 / (K : ℝ)) ^ 2 *
      ∑ i, ‖g i - constantL2 P (∫ ω, g i ω ∂P)‖ ^ 2
independent_average_norm_sq.complete_declaration:
theorem independent_average_norm_sq {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (g : Fin K → Lp E 2 P)
    (hind : iIndepFun (fun i ω => g i ω) P)
    (hopt : ∑ i, (∫ ω, g i ω ∂P) = 0) :
    ‖MiniBatchVariance.average g‖ ^ 2 = (1 / (K : ℝ)) ^ 2 *
      ∑ i, ‖g i - constantL2 P (∫ ω, g i ω ∂P)‖ ^ 2 := by
  let c (i : Fin K) := ∫ ω, g i ω ∂P
  let z (i : Fin K) := g i - constantL2 P (c i)
  have hzcoe (i : Fin K) : z i =ᵐ[P] fun ω => g i ω - c i := by
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (g i) (constantL2 P (c i)), constantL2_coe P (c i)]
      with ω hsub hc
    simp only [z, hsub, hc, Pi.sub_apply]
  have hmean (i : Fin K) : (∫ ω, (g i ω - c i) ∂P) = 0 := by
    rw [integral_sub ((Lp.memLp (g i)).integrable (by norm_num)) (integrable_const _)]
    simp [c]
  have hzorth (i j : Fin K) (hij : i ≠ j) : inner ℝ (z i) (z j) = 0 := by
    rw [L2.inner_def]
    have he := ((hind.indepFun hij).comp
      (show Measurable (fun x : E => x - c i) by fun_prop)
      (show Measurable (fun x : E => x - c j) by fun_prop)).integral_bilin
        (((Lp.memLp (g i)).integrable (by norm_num)).sub (integrable_const _))
        (((Lp.memLp (g j)).integrable (by norm_num)).sub (integrable_const _)) (innerSL ℝ)
    change (∫ ω, inner ℝ (g i ω - c i) (g j ω - c j) ∂P) =
      inner ℝ (∫ ω, g i ω - c i ∂P) (∫ ω, g j ω - c j ∂P) at he
    rw [hmean i, hmean j, inner_zero_left] at he
    apply (integral_congr_ae ?_).trans he
    filter_upwards [hzcoe i, hzcoe j] with ω hi hj
    rw [hi, hj]
  have hcSum : ∑ i, constantL2 P (c i) = 0 := by
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i => constantL2 P (c i)),
      ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => constantL2_coe P (c i)), Lp.coeFn_zero E 2 P]
      with ω hs hc hz
    rw [hs, hz]
    simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
    simpa only [hc, Pi.zero_apply, c] using hopt
  have hsum : ∑ i, z i = ∑ i, g i := by
    simp only [z, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hcSum, sub_zero]
  rw [← MiniBatchVariance.mean_sq_sum_of_orthogonal z hzorth]
  congr 1
  exact congrArg (fun q => ‖(1 / (K : ℝ)) • q‖) hsum.symm

theorem physicalNoise_increment_bound
    (B : (Fin K × Fin dz) → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (B i) P)
    (a t : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ‖physicalNoise (dθ := dθ) P B hB (a+t) - physicalNoise P B hB a‖ ≤
      physicalNoiseScale K dz * Real.sqrt t
physicalNoise_increment_bound.complete_declaration:
theorem physicalNoise_increment_bound
    (B : (Fin K × Fin dz) → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (B i) P)
    (a t : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ‖physicalNoise (dθ := dθ) P B hB (a+t) - physicalNoise P B hB a‖ ≤
      physicalNoiseScale K dz * Real.sqrt t := by
  let C : Lp (Latent K dz) 2 P →L[ℝ] Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P :=
    tailInsert.compLpL 2 P
  have hc : ‖C‖ ≤ 1 := (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compLpL_le _).trans tailInsert_opNorm_le
  change ‖(Real.sqrt (K : ℝ))⁻¹ • C (ULA.brownianLangevinNoise P B hB 0 (a+t)) -
    (Real.sqrt (K : ℝ))⁻¹ • C (ULA.brownianLangevinNoise P B hB 0 a)‖ ≤ _
  rw [← smul_sub, ← C.map_sub, PBGSO.MethodSegments.brownianNoise_increment,
    norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))]
  have hn := ULA.brownianLangevinNoise_norm P B hB a t ha ht
  have hn' := (C.le_opNorm (ULA.brownianLangevinNoise P B hB a t)).trans
    (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) hc)
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hn'.trans hn.le)
    (inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg (K : ℝ)))
  simpa [physicalNoiseScale, Fintype.card_prod, mul_assoc] using h

l2_norm_eq_of_law.statement:
theorem l2_norm_eq_of_law {E A : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup A] [InnerProductSpace ℝ A] [CompleteSpace A]
    (f : E → A) (hf : Continuous f) (X Y : Lp E 2 P) (X' Y' : Lp A 2 P)
    (hX : X' =ᵐ[P] fun ω => f (X ω)) (hY : Y' =ᵐ[P] fun ω => f (Y ω))
    (hlaw : P.map X = P.map Y) : ‖X'‖ = ‖Y'‖
l2_norm_eq_of_law.complete_declaration:
theorem l2_norm_eq_of_law {E A : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup A] [InnerProductSpace ℝ A] [CompleteSpace A]
    (f : E → A) (hf : Continuous f) (X Y : Lp E 2 P) (X' Y' : Lp A 2 P)
    (hX : X' =ᵐ[P] fun ω => f (X ω)) (hY : Y' =ᵐ[P] fun ω => f (Y ω))
    (hlaw : P.map X = P.map Y) : ‖X'‖ = ‖Y'‖ := by
  have he (Z : Lp E 2 P) (Z' : Lp A 2 P) (hZ : Z' =ᵐ[P] fun ω => f (Z ω)) :
      ‖Z'‖ ^ 2 = ∫ z, ‖f z‖ ^ 2 ∂P.map Z := by
    rw [l2_norm_sq_eq_expectation]
    have hm := integral_map (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable Z).aemeasurable
      (show AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => ‖f z‖ ^ 2) (P.map Z) from
        (hf.norm.pow 2).aestronglyMeasurable)
    rw [hm]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hZ] with ω hω
    rw [hω]
  have h := (he X X' hX).trans
    ((congrArg (fun μ => ∫ z, ‖f z‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) hlaw).trans (he Y Y' hY).symm)
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg X', norm_nonneg Y']

theorem residual_coe {F : Cloud.State K dθ dz → Cloud.State K dθ dz}

theorem frozenForce_norm_eq_of_law {F : Cloud.State K dθ dz → Cloud.State K dθ dz}

theorem parameterOutput_noise_zero

structure FrozenPosteriorSolution
    {F : Cloud.State K dθ dz → Cloud.State K dθ dz} {m : ℝ} {L : ℝ≥0}
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L)
    (B : (Fin K × Fin dz) → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (B i) P) where
  path : ℝ → Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P
  continuous : Continuous path
  equation : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → path t - path 0 =

FrozenPosteriorSolution.parameter_consta.statement:
theorem FrozenPosteriorSolution.parameter_constant
    (S : FrozenPosteriorSolution P hF B hB) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    parameterOutput P (S.path t) = parameterOutput P (S.path 0)
FrozenPosteriorSolution.parameter_consta.complete_declaration:
theorem FrozenPosteriorSolution.parameter_constant
    (S : FrozenPosteriorSolution P hF B hB) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    parameterOutput P (S.path t) = parameterOutput P (S.path 0) := by
  let C := parameterOutput (K := K) (dθ := dθ) (dz := dz) P
  have hi := C.intervalIntegral_comp_comm (μ := volume)
    (((frozenForce_lipschitz P hF).continuous.comp S.continuous).intervalIntegrable 0 t)
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hi
  have hi0 : C (∫ r in 0..t, frozenForce P hF (S.path r)) = 0 := by
    rw [← hi]
    simp only [C, parameterOutput_frozen_zero, intervalIntegral.integral_zero]
  have he := congrArg C (S.equation t ht)
  simp only [map_sub, map_add, map_neg, hi0, neg_zero,
    C, parameterOutput_noise_zero, add_zero] at he
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp he

FrozenPosteriorSolution.integralReferenc.statement:
theorem FrozenPosteriorSolution.integralReference
    (S : FrozenPosteriorSolution P hF B hB) (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 ≤ h) :
    IntegralReference (frozenForce P hF) h ‖frozenForce P hF (S.path 0)‖
      (physicalNoiseScale K dz)
      (fun n => S.path ((n : ℝ) * h))
      (fun n => physicalNoise P B hB ((n : ℝ)*h+h) - physicalNoise P B hB ((n : ℝ)*h))
      (fun n t => S.path ((n : ℝ)*h+t))
      (fun n t => physicalNoise P B hB ((n : ℝ)*h+t) - physicalNoise P B hB ((n : ℝ)*h))
FrozenPosteriorSolution.integralReferenc.complete_declaration:
theorem FrozenPosteriorSolution.integralReference
    (S : FrozenPosteriorSolution P hF B hB) (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 ≤ h) :
    IntegralReference (frozenForce P hF) h ‖frozenForce P hF (S.path 0)‖
      (physicalNoiseScale K dz)
      (fun n => S.path ((n : ℝ) * h))
      (fun n => physicalNoise P B hB ((n : ℝ)*h+h) - physicalNoise P B hB ((n : ℝ)*h))
      (fun n t => S.path ((n : ℝ)*h+t))
      (fun n t => physicalNoise P B hB ((n : ℝ)*h+t) - physicalNoise P B hB ((n : ℝ)*h)) where
  starts n := by simp
  ends n := by congr 1; push_cast; ring
  noise_end n := rfl
  integrable n := ((frozenForce_lipschitz P hF).continuous.comp
    (S.continuous.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id))).intervalIntegrable 0 h
  drift_radius n t ht := (frozenForce_norm_eq_of_law P hF _ _
    (S.stationary_law ((n : ℝ)*h+t) (by positivity [ht.1]))).le
  noise_growth n t ht := physicalNoise_increment_bound P B hB _ _ (by positivity) ht.1
  equation n t ht := by
    have he := PBGSO.MethodSegments.integral_shift S.path
      (fun r => -frozenForce P hF (S.path r)) (physicalNoise P B hB)
      ((frozenForce_lipschitz P hF).continuous.comp S.continuous).neg
      (fun r hr => by simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_neg] using S.equation r hr)
      ((n : ℝ)*h) t (by positivity) ht.1
    simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_neg, add_zero] using he

def scoreVarianceBudget (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i)))
    (X : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i, ‖scoreLp P U L hLip X i -
    constantL2 P (∫ ω, scoreLp P U L hLip X i ω ∂P)‖ ^ 2

full_batch_parameter_bound.statement:
theorem full_batch_parameter_bound
    (hK : 0 < K) (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m h : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i))) (hs : StableStep m L h)
    (B : (Fin K × Fin dz) → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (B i) P)
    (S : FrozenPosteriorSolution P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) B hB)
    (hind : iIndepFun (fun i ω => scoreLp P U L hLip (S.path 0) i ω) P)
    (hopt : ∑ i, (∫ ω, scoreLp P U L hLip (S.path 0) i ω ∂P) = 0)
    (x₀ : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) (astar : Parameter dθ)
    (hstar : parameterOutput P (S.path 0) = constantL2 P astar) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖parameterOutput P
      (eulerTrajectory (particleForce P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) h
        (fun k => physicalNoise P B hB ((k : ℝ)*h+h) - physicalNoise P B hB ((k : ℝ)*h)) x₀ n) -
      constantL2 P astar‖ ≤
      (1 - m*h/2)^n * ‖x₀ - S.path 0‖ +
      (2/m) * Real.sqrt ((1/(K : ℝ))^2 * scoreVarianceBudget P U L hLip (S.path 0)) +
      (L : ℝ)/m * (h * ‖frozenForce P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip)
        (S.path 0)‖ + (4/3 : ℝ)*physicalNoiseScale K dz*Real.sqrt h)
full_batch_parameter_bound.complete_declaration:
theorem full_batch_parameter_bound
    (hK : 0 < K) (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m h : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i))) (hs : StableStep m L h)
    (B : (Fin K × Fin dz) → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (B i) P)
    (S : FrozenPosteriorSolution P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) B hB)
    (hind : iIndepFun (fun i ω => scoreLp P U L hLip (S.path 0) i ω) P)
    (hopt : ∑ i, (∫ ω, scoreLp P U L hLip (S.path 0) i ω ∂P) = 0)
    (x₀ : Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P) (astar : Parameter dθ)
    (hstar : parameterOutput P (S.path 0) = constantL2 P astar) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖parameterOutput P
      (eulerTrajectory (particleForce P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) h
        (fun k => physicalNoise P B hB ((k : ℝ)*h+h) - physicalNoise P B hB ((k : ℝ)*h)) x₀ n) -
      constantL2 P astar‖ ≤
      (1 - m*h/2)^n * ‖x₀ - S.path 0‖ +
      (2/m) * Real.sqrt ((1/(K : ℝ))^2 * scoreVarianceBudget P U L hLip (S.path 0)) +
      (L : ℝ)/m * (h * ‖frozenForce P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip)
        (S.path 0)‖ + (4/3 : ℝ)*physicalNoiseScale K dz*Real.sqrt h) := by
  let hF := Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip
  let F := particleForce P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip
  let R := frozenForce P hF
  let b := Real.sqrt ((1/(K : ℝ))^2 * scoreVarianceBudget P U L hLip (S.path 0))
  have hres (k : ℕ) : ‖F (S.path ((k : ℝ)*h)) - R (S.path ((k : ℝ)*h))‖ ≤ b := by
    change ‖liftedForce P hF (S.path ((k : ℝ)*h)) - frozenForce P hF (S.path ((k : ℝ)*h))‖ ≤ b
    rw [residual_norm_eq_of_law P hF _ _ (S.stationary_law _ (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hs.positive.le))]
    change ‖particleForce P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip (S.path 0) -
      frozenForce P hF (S.path 0)‖ ≤ b
    rw [lifted_meanForce_residual P hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip]
    have hv := independent_average_norm_sq P (scoreLp P U L hLip (S.path 0)) hind hopt
    change ‖MiniBatchVariance.average (scoreLp P U L hLip (S.path 0))‖ ≤ Real.sqrt _
    unfold scoreVarianceBudget
    rw [← hv, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]
  have he := equilibrium_reference_error F R m h b ‖R (S.path 0)‖ (physicalNoiseScale K dz)
    L (liftedForce_regular P hF) (frozenForce_lipschitz P hF) hs (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    (norm_nonneg _) (by unfold physicalNoiseScale; positivity)
    _ _ _ _ x₀ (S.integralReference P h hs.positive.le) hres n
  have ht : parameterOutput P (S.path ((n : ℝ)*h)) = constantL2 P astar :=
    (S.parameter_constant P _ (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hs.positive.le)).trans hstar
  rw [← ht, ← map_sub]
  have hc := (parameterOutput P).le_opNorm
    (eulerTrajectory F h
      (fun k => physicalNoise P B hB ((k : ℝ)*h+h) - physicalNoise P B hB ((k : ℝ)*h)) x₀ n -
        S.path ((n : ℝ)*h))
  apply (hc.trans (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (parameterOutput_norm_le P))).trans
  simpa [b, R, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using he

pack.statement: def pack (astar : Parameter dθ) (z : Latent K dz) : Cloud.State K dθ dz
pack.complete_declaration:
def pack (astar : Parameter dθ) (z : Latent K dz) : Cloud.State K dθ dz :=
  headInsert astar + (Real.sqrt (K : ℝ))⁻¹ • tailInsert z

packLp.statement:
def packLp (astar : Parameter dθ) (Z : Lp (Latent K dz) 2 P) :
    Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P

packLp_coe.statement:
theorem packLp_coe (astar : Parameter dθ) (Z : Lp (Latent K dz) 2 P) :
    packLp P astar Z =ᵐ[P] fun ω => pack astar (Z ω)
packLp_coe.complete_declaration:
theorem packLp_coe (astar : Parameter dθ) (Z : Lp (Latent K dz) 2 P) :
    packLp P astar Z =ᵐ[P] fun ω => pack astar (Z ω) := by
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_add (constantL2 P (headInsert astar))
    ((Real.sqrt (K : ℝ))⁻¹ • tailInsert.compLpL 2 P Z),
    constantL2_coe P (headInsert (J := Fin K × Fin dz) astar),
    Lp.coeFn_smul (Real.sqrt (K : ℝ))⁻¹ (tailInsert.compLpL 2 P Z),
    (tailInsert (dθ := dθ)).coeFn_compLpL (p := 2) (μ := P) Z] with ω ha hc hs ht
  change _ = headInsert astar + (Real.sqrt (K : ℝ))⁻¹ • tailInsert (Z ω)
  unfold packLp
  rw [ha]
  simp only [Pi.add_apply]
  rw [hc, hs]
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply]
  rw [ht]

packLp_continuous.statement: theorem packLp_continuous (astar : Parameter dθ) : Continuous (packLp (K := K) (dz := dz) P astar)
packLp_continuous.complete_declaration:
theorem packLp_continuous (astar : Parameter dθ) : Continuous (packLp (K := K) (dz := dz) P astar) := by
  unfold packLp
  fun_prop

packLp_law_eq.statement:
theorem packLp_law_eq (astar : Parameter dθ) (Z T : Lp (Latent K dz) 2 P)
    (h : P.map Z = P.map T) : P.map (packLp P astar Z) = P.map (packLp P astar T)
packLp_law_eq.complete_declaration:
theorem packLp_law_eq (astar : Parameter dθ) (Z T : Lp (Latent K dz) 2 P)
    (h : P.map Z = P.map T) : P.map (packLp P astar Z) = P.map (packLp P astar T) := by
  rw [Measure.map_congr (packLp_coe P astar Z), Measure.map_congr (packLp_coe P astar T)]
  have hm : Measurable (pack (K := K) (dz := dz) astar) := by
    have hc : Continuous (pack (K := K) (dz := dz) astar) := by unfold pack; fun_prop
    exact hc.measurable
  change P.map (pack astar ∘ Z) = P.map (pack astar ∘ T)
  rw [← Measure.map_map hm (Lp.stronglyMeasurable Z).measurable,
    ← Measure.map_map hm (Lp.stronglyMeasurable T).measurable, h]

frozenForce_packLp.statement:
theorem frozenForce_packLp {F : Cloud.State K dθ dz → Cloud.State K dθ dz}
    {m : ℝ} {L : ℝ≥0} (hF : ForceRegularity F m L)
    (V : Latent K dz → ℝ) (A : ℝ≥0) (hV : LipschitzWith A (gradient V))
    (astar : Parameter dθ)
    (hforce : ∀ z, tailMask (F (pack astar z)) =
      (Real.sqrt (K : ℝ))⁻¹ • tailInsert (gradient V z)) (Z : Lp (Latent K dz) 2 P) :
    frozenForce P hF (packLp P astar Z) =
      (Real.sqrt (K : ℝ))⁻¹ • tailInsert.compLpL 2 P (ULA.lpDrift P (gradient V) hV Z)
frozenForce_packLp.complete_declaration:
theorem frozenForce_packLp {F : Cloud.State K dθ dz → Cloud.State K dθ dz}
    {m : ℝ} {L : ℝ≥0} (hF : ForceRegularity F m L)
    (V : Latent K dz → ℝ) (A : ℝ≥0) (hV : LipschitzWith A (gradient V))
    (astar : Parameter dθ)
    (hforce : ∀ z, tailMask (F (pack astar z)) =
      (Real.sqrt (K : ℝ))⁻¹ • tailInsert (gradient V z)) (Z : Lp (Latent K dz) 2 P) :
    frozenForce P hF (packLp P astar Z) =
      (Real.sqrt (K : ℝ))⁻¹ • tailInsert.compLpL 2 P (ULA.lpDrift P (gradient V) hV Z) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [frozenForce_coe P hF (packLp P astar Z), packLp_coe P astar Z,
    Lp.coeFn_smul (Real.sqrt (K : ℝ))⁻¹
      (tailInsert.compLpL 2 P (ULA.lpDrift P (gradient V) hV Z)),
    (tailInsert (dθ := dθ)).coeFn_compLpL (p := 2) (μ := P)
      (ULA.lpDrift P (gradient V) hV Z), ULA.lpDrift_coe P (gradient V) hV Z]
      with ω hr hp hs ht hv
  rw [hr, hp, hs]
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply]
  rw [ht, hv, hforce]

FrozenPosteriorSolution.of_latent_gibbs.statement:
def FrozenPosteriorSolution.of_latent_gibbs
    {F : Cloud.State K dθ dz → Cloud.State K dθ dz} {m : ℝ} {L : ℝ≥0}
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L)
    (V : Latent K dz → ℝ) (a : ℝ) (A : ℝ≥0) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hdiff : Differentiable ℝ V) (hsc : StrongConvexOn Set.univ a V)
    (hV : LipschitzWith A (gradient V)) (astar : Parameter dθ)
    (hforce : ∀ z, tailMask (F (pack astar z)) =
      (Real.sqrt (K : ℝ))⁻¹ • tailInsert (gradient V z))
    (B : (Fin K × Fin dz) → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (B i) P)
    (Z : ℝ → Lp (Latent K dz) 2 P) (hZ : Continuous Z)
    (hZe : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Z t - Z 0 =
      -(∫ r in 0..t, ULA.lpDrift P (gradient V) hV (Z r)) + ULA.brownianLangevinNoise P B hB 0 t)
    (hinitial : P.map (Z 0) = ULA.gibbsMeasure V)
    (hscalar : ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → iIndepFun (fun p : ℕ × (Fin K × Fin dz) => fun ω =>
      ULA.Hilbert.brownianEulerNoise P B hB h p.1 ω p.2) P)
    (hind : ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → IndepFun (Z 0)
      (fun ω n => ULA.Hilbert.brownianEulerNoise P B hB h n ω) P) :
    FrozenPosteriorSolution P hF B hB
FrozenPosteriorSolution.of_latent_gibbs.complete_declaration:
def FrozenPosteriorSolution.of_latent_gibbs
    {F : Cloud.State K dθ dz → Cloud.State K dθ dz} {m : ℝ} {L : ℝ≥0}
    (hF : ForceRegularity F m L)
    (V : Latent K dz → ℝ) (a : ℝ) (A : ℝ≥0) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hdiff : Differentiable ℝ V) (hsc : StrongConvexOn Set.univ a V)
    (hV : LipschitzWith A (gradient V)) (astar : Parameter dθ)
    (hforce : ∀ z, tailMask (F (pack astar z)) =
      (Real.sqrt (K : ℝ))⁻¹ • tailInsert (gradient V z))
    (B : (Fin K × Fin dz) → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (B i) P)
    (Z : ℝ → Lp (Latent K dz) 2 P) (hZ : Continuous Z)
    (hZe : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Z t - Z 0 =
      -(∫ r in 0..t, ULA.lpDrift P (gradient V) hV (Z r)) + ULA.brownianLangevinNoise P B hB 0 t)
    (hinitial : P.map (Z 0) = ULA.gibbsMeasure V)
    (hscalar : ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → iIndepFun (fun p : ℕ × (Fin K × Fin dz) => fun ω =>
      ULA.Hilbert.brownianEulerNoise P B hB h p.1 ω p.2) P)
    (hind : ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → IndepFun (Z 0)
      (fun ω n => ULA.Hilbert.brownianEulerNoise P B hB h n ω) P) :
    FrozenPosteriorSolution P hF B hB where
  path t := packLp P astar (Z t)
  continuous := (packLp_continuous P astar).comp hZ
  equation t ht := by
    let C : Lp (Latent K dz) 2 P →L[ℝ] Lp (Cloud.State K dθ dz) 2 P :=
      (Real.sqrt (K : ℝ))⁻¹ • tailInsert.compLpL 2 P
    have hC (r : ℝ) : C (ULA.lpDrift P (gradient V) hV (Z r)) =
      frozenForce P hF (packLp P astar (Z r)) :=
      (frozenForce_packLp P hF V A hV astar hforce (Z r)).symm
    have hi := C.intervalIntegral_comp_comm (μ := volume)
      (((ULA.lpDrift_lipschitz P (gradient V) hV).continuous.comp hZ).intervalIntegrable 0 t)
    simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hi
    have he := congrArg C (hZe t ht)
    simp only [map_sub, map_add, map_neg, ← hi, hC] at he
    simpa only [packLp, C, smul_apply, physicalNoise,
      add_sub_add_left_eq_sub] using he
  stationary_law t ht := by
    apply packLp_law_eq P astar
    rw [hinitial]
    exact ULA.lp_langevin_gibbs_stationary P V a A ha hdiff hsc hV (Z 0) hinitial
      B hB hscalar hind Z hZ t ht (fun s hs => hZe s hs.1)

physicalNoiseScale_eq.statement: theorem physicalNoiseScale_eq (hK : 0 < K) : physicalNoiseScale K dz = Real.sqrt (2 * (dz : ℝ))
physicalNoiseScale_eq.complete_declaration:
theorem physicalNoiseScale_eq (hK : 0 < K) : physicalNoiseScale K dz = Real.sqrt (2 * (dz : ℝ)) := by
  have hK0 : (Real.sqrt (K : ℝ)) ≠ 0 := Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hK)
  unfold physicalNoiseScale
  rw [show (2 * ((K * dz : ℕ) : ℝ)) = (K : ℝ) * (2 * (dz : ℝ)) by push_cast; ring,
    Real.sqrt_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg K)]
  rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hK0, one_mul]

theorem gradient_frozenPotential
    (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (astar : Parameter dθ) (z : Latent K dz) :
    gradient (frozenPotential U astar) z =
      (Real.sqrt (K : ℝ))⁻¹ • tailExtract (gradient (Cloud.potential U) (pack astar z))
gradient_frozenPotential.complete_declaration:
theorem gradient_frozenPotential
    (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (astar : Parameter dθ) (z : Latent K dz) :
    gradient (frozenPotential U astar) z =
      (Real.sqrt (K : ℝ))⁻¹ • tailExtract (gradient (Cloud.potential U) (pack astar z)) := by
  let C : Latent K dz →L[ℝ] Cloud.State K dθ dz := (Real.sqrt (K : ℝ))⁻¹ • tailInsert
  have hp : HasFDerivAt (pack astar) C z := by
    change HasFDerivAt (fun z => headInsert astar + C z) C z
    exact HasFDerivAt.const_add _ C.hasFDerivAt
  have hd := ((Cloud.potential_differentiable hdiff) (pack astar z)).hasFDerivAt.comp z hp
  ext j
  have h := inner_gradient_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := frozenPotential U astar) (x := z)
    (y := EuclideanSpace.single j 1)
  rw [show fderiv ℝ (frozenPotential U astar) z =
    (fderiv ℝ (Cloud.potential U) (pack astar z)).comp C from hd.fderiv] at h
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, C, smul_apply, tailInsert_single,
    map_smul, ← inner_gradient_left,
    EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, one_mul, conj_trivial] at h
  simpa only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, tailExtract_apply] using h

frozenPotential_force_identity.statement:
theorem frozenPotential_force_identity (hK : 0 < K)
    (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (astar : Parameter dθ) (z : Latent K dz) :

frozenPotential_force_identity.complete_declaration:
theorem frozenPotential_force_identity (hK : 0 < K)
    (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (astar : Parameter dθ) (z : Latent K dz) :
    tailMask (Cloud.meanForce U (pack astar z)) =
      (Real.sqrt (K : ℝ))⁻¹ • tailInsert (gradient (frozenPotential U astar) z) := by
  have hK0 : (K : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hK)
  have hs : ((Real.sqrt (K : ℝ))⁻¹)^2 = (K : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    rw [inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg K)]
  rw [gradient_frozenPotential U hdiff astar z]
  ext j
  cases j with
  | inl j => simp
  | inr j =>
    simp only [tailMask_tail, Cloud.meanForce, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      tailInsert_tail, map_smul, tailExtract_apply]
    nlinarith [congrArg (fun a : ℝ => a * gradient (Cloud.potential U) (pack astar z) (Sum.inr j)) hs]

frozenPotential_strongConvex.statement:
theorem frozenPotential_strongConvex (hK : 0 < K)
    (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (m : ℝ)
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i)) (astar : Parameter dθ) :
    StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (frozenPotential U astar)
frozenPotential_strongConvex.complete_declaration:
theorem frozenPotential_strongConvex (hK : 0 < K)
    (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (m : ℝ)
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i)) (astar : Parameter dθ) :
    StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (frozenPotential U astar) := by
  have hK0 : (K : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hK)
  refine ⟨convex_univ, ?_⟩
  intro z hz w hw a b ha hb hab
  have hc := (Cloud.potential_strongConvex hsc).2 (Set.mem_univ (pack astar z))
    (Set.mem_univ (pack astar w)) ha hb hab
  rw [← pack_affine astar z w a b hab, pack_norm_sub] at hc
  dsimp only at hc ⊢
  rw [mul_pow, inv_sqrt_sq] at hc
  have he : ((K : ℝ)*m/2) * ((K : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖z-w‖^2) =
      (m/2)*‖z-w‖^2 := by field_simp
  simpa only [frozenPotential, smul_eq_mul, he] using hc

frozenPotential_gradient_lipschitz.statement:
theorem frozenPotential_gradient_lipschitz (hK : 0 < K)
    (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i))) (astar : Parameter dθ) :
    LipschitzWith L (gradient (frozenPotential U astar))
frozenPotential_gradient_lipschitz.complete_declaration:
theorem frozenPotential_gradient_lipschitz (hK : 0 < K)
    (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i))) (astar : Parameter dθ) :
    LipschitzWith L (gradient (frozenPotential U astar)) := by
  have hK0 : (K : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hK)
  let s := (Real.sqrt (K : ℝ))⁻¹
  have hs : 0 ≤ s := inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro z w
  simp only [dist_eq_norm, gradient_frozenPotential U hdiff, ← smul_sub, ← map_sub,
    norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg (K : ℝ)))]
  calc
    s * ‖tailExtract (gradient (Cloud.potential U) (pack astar z) -
        gradient (Cloud.potential U) (pack astar w))‖ ≤
      s * ‖gradient (Cloud.potential U) (pack astar z) -
        gradient (Cloud.potential U) (pack astar w)‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (tailExtract_norm_le _) hs
    _ ≤ s * (((K : ℝ)*(L : ℝ)) * ‖pack astar z - pack astar w‖) := by
      have ht := (Cloud.potential_gradient_lipschitz hdiff hLip).norm_sub_le (pack astar z) (pack astar w)
      simpa only [NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_natCast] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht hs
    _ = (L : ℝ) * ‖z-w‖ := by
      rw [pack_norm_sub]
      change s * ((K : ℝ)*(L : ℝ)*(s*‖z-w‖)) = _
      calc
        _ = (s^2*(K : ℝ)) * (L : ℝ) * ‖z-w‖ := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [show s^2 = (K : ℝ)⁻¹ from inv_sqrt_sq K, inv_mul_cancel₀ hK0, one_mul]

exists_global_integral.statement:
theorem exists_global_integral {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H]
    [CompleteSpace H] (g : H → H) (C : ℝ≥0) (hg : LipschitzWith C g)
    (initial : H) (W : ℝ → H) (hW : Continuous W) (hW0 : W 0 = 0) :
    ∃ Y : ℝ → H, Continuous Y ∧ Y 0 = initial ∧
      ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - Y 0 = -(∫ r in 0..t, g (Y r)) + W t
exists_global_integral.complete_declaration:
theorem exists_global_integral {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H]
    [CompleteSpace H] (g : H → H) (C : ℝ≥0) (hg : LipschitzWith C g)
    (initial : H) (W : ℝ → H) (hW : Continuous W) (hW0 : W 0 = 0) :
    ∃ Y : ℝ → H, Continuous Y ∧ Y 0 = initial ∧
      ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - Y 0 = -(∫ r in 0..t, g (Y r)) + W t := by
  classical
  let flow := fun n : ℕ => Classical.choose
    (ULA.exists_langevin_integral g C hg initial W hW hW0 ((n : ℝ)+1) (by positivity))
  have hs (n : ℕ) : Continuous (flow n) ∧ flow n 0 = initial ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 ((n : ℝ)+1), flow n t - initial =
        -(∫ r in 0..t, g (flow n r)) + W t :=
    Classical.choose_spec (ULA.exists_langevin_integral g C hg initial W hW hW0 ((n : ℝ)+1) (by positivity))
  have coherent (m n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
      (hm : r ≤ (m : ℝ)+1) (hn : r ≤ (n : ℝ)+1) : flow m r = flow n r := by
    exact ULA.langevin_integral_unique g C hg initial W (flow m) (flow n)
      (hs m).1 (hs n).1 r hr
      (fun t ht => (hs m).2.2 t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans hm⟩)
      (fun t ht => (hs n).2.2 t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans hn⟩) ⟨hr, le_rfl⟩
  let Y := fun t : ℝ => flow (Nat.ceil (max 0 t)) (max 0 t)
  have agree (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hr : max 0 r ≤ (n : ℝ)+1) : Y r = flow n (max 0 r) := by
    apply coherent _ n _ (le_max_left _ _)
    · exact (Nat.le_ceil _).trans (by linarith)
    · exact hr
  have hc : Continuous Y := by
    apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
    intro t
    let n := Nat.ceil (max 0 t)
    have ht : max 0 t < (n : ℝ)+1 := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_ceil _) (by linarith)
    have hc : Continuous (fun r : ℝ => max 0 r) := continuous_const.max continuous_id
    have hev : ∀ᶠ r in nhds t, max 0 r < (n : ℝ)+1 :=
      hc.continuousAt.eventually (gt_mem_nhds ht)
    apply ((hs n).1.comp hc).continuousAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq
    exact hev.mono fun r hr => agree n r hr.le
  have hz : Y 0 = initial := by
    have he : Y 0 = flow 0 0 := by simpa only [max_self] using agree 0 0 (by norm_num)
    exact he.trans (hs 0).2.1
  refine ⟨Y, hc, hz, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  let n := Nat.ceil t
  have hnt : t ≤ (n : ℝ)+1 := (Nat.le_ceil t).trans (by linarith)
  have he (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 t) : Y r = flow n r := by
    simpa only [max_eq_right hr.1] using agree n r (by rw [max_eq_right hr.1]; exact hr.2.trans hnt)
  have hi : (∫ r in 0..t, g (Y r)) = ∫ r in 0..t, g (flow n r) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro r hr
    rw [uIcc_of_le ht] at hr
    change g (Y r) = g (flow n r)
    rw [he r hr]
  rw [he t ⟨ht, le_rfl⟩, hz, hi]
  exact (hs n).2.2 t ⟨ht, hnt⟩

def latentFlow (V : Latent K dz → ℝ) (A : ℝ≥0) (hV : LipschitzWith A (gradient V))
    (initial : Lp (Latent K dz) 2 P)
    (B : (Fin K × Fin dz) → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (B i) P) : ℝ → Lp (Latent K dz) 2 P
latentFlow.complete_declaration:
def latentFlow (V : Latent K dz → ℝ) (A : ℝ≥0) (hV : LipschitzWith A (gradient V))
    (initial : Lp (Latent K dz) 2 P)
    (B : (Fin K × Fin dz) → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (B i) P) : ℝ → Lp (Latent K dz) 2 P :=
  Classical.choose (exists_global_integral (ULA.lpDrift P (gradient V) hV) A
    (ULA.lpDrift_lipschitz P (gradient V) hV) initial (ULA.brownianLangevinNoise P B hB 0)
    (ULA.brownianLangevinNoise_continuous P B hB 0) (ULA.brownianLangevinNoise_zero P B hB 0))

latentFlow_spec.statement:
theorem latentFlow_spec (V : Latent K dz → ℝ) (A : ℝ≥0) (hV : LipschitzWith A (gradient V))
    (initial : Lp (Latent K dz) 2 P)
    (B : (Fin K × Fin dz) → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (B i) P) :
    Continuous (latentFlow P V A hV initial B hB) ∧
      latentFlow P V A hV initial B hB 0 = initial ∧
      ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → latentFlow P V A hV initial B hB t - latentFlow P V A hV initial B hB 0 =
        -(∫ r in 0..t, ULA.lpDrift P (gradient V) hV (latentFlow P V A hV initial B hB r)) +
          ULA.brownianLangevinNoise P B hB 0 t
latentFlow_spec.complete_declaration:
theorem latentFlow_spec (V : Latent K dz → ℝ) (A : ℝ≥0) (hV : LipschitzWith A (gradient V))
    (initial : Lp (Latent K dz) 2 P)
    (B : (Fin K × Fin dz) → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (B i) P) :
    Continuous (latentFlow P V A hV initial B hB) ∧
      latentFlow P V A hV initial B hB 0 = initial ∧
      ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → latentFlow P V A hV initial B hB t - latentFlow P V A hV initial B hB 0 =
        -(∫ r in 0..t, ULA.lpDrift P (gradient V) hV (latentFlow P V A hV initial B hB r)) +
          ULA.brownianLangevinNoise P B hB 0 t :=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_global_integral (ULA.lpDrift P (gradient V) hV) A
    (ULA.lpDrift_lipschitz P (gradient V) hV) initial (ULA.brownianLangevinNoise P B hB 0)
    (ULA.brownianLangevinNoise_continuous P B hB 0) (ULA.brownianLangevinNoise_zero P B hB 0))

def sourceReference
    (hK : 0 < K) (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hm : 0 < m) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i))) (astar : Parameter dθ)
    (initial : Lp (Latent K dz) 2 P)
    (hinitial : P.map initial = ULA.gibbsMeasure (frozenPotential U astar))
    (B : (Fin K × Fin dz) → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (B i) P)
    (hscalar : ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → iIndepFun (fun p : ℕ × (Fin K × Fin dz) => fun ω =>
      ULA.Hilbert.brownianEulerNoise P B hB h p.1 ω p.2) P)
    (hind : ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → IndepFun initial
      (fun ω n => ULA.Hilbert.brownianEulerNoise P B hB h n ω) P) :
    FrozenPosteriorSolution P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) B hB
