def sourceReference
    (hK : 0 < K) (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hm : 0 < m) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i))) (astar : Parameter dθ)
    (initial : Lp (Latent K dz) 2 P)
    (hinitial : P.map initial = ULA.gibbsMeasure (frozenPotential U astar))
    (B : (Fin K × Fin dz) → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (B i) P)
    (hscalar : ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → iIndepFun (fun p : ℕ × (Fin K × Fin dz) => fun ω =>
      ULA.Hilbert.brownianEulerNoise P B hB h p.1 ω p.2) P)
    (hind : ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → IndepFun initial
      (fun ω n => ULA.Hilbert.brownianEulerNoise P B hB h n ω) P) :
    FrozenPosteriorSolution P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) B hB := by
  let V := frozenPotential U astar
  let hv := frozenPotential_gradient_lipschitz hK U L hdiff hLip astar
  let Z := latentFlow P V L hv initial B hB
  have hs := latentFlow_spec P V L hv initial B hB
  have hzero : Z 0 = initial := hs.2.1
  exact FrozenPosteriorSolution.of_latent_gibbs P
    (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip) V m L hm
    (frozenPotential_differentiable U hdiff astar) (frozenPotential_strongConvex hK U m hsc astar)
    hv astar (frozenPotential_force_identity hK U hdiff astar) B hB Z hs.1 hs.2.2
    (by rw [hzero]; exact hinitial) hscalar (by rw [hzero]; exact hind)

theorem sourceReference_initial
    (hK : 0 < K) (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hm : 0 < m) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i))) (astar : Parameter dθ)
    (initial : Lp (Latent K dz) 2 P)
    (hinitial : P.map initial = ULA.gibbsMeasure (frozenPotential U astar))
    (B : (Fin K × Fin dz) → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (B i) P)
    (hscalar : ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → iIndepFun (fun p : ℕ × (Fin K × Fin dz) => fun ω =>
      ULA.Hilbert.brownianEulerNoise P B hB h p.1 ω p.2) P)
    (hind : ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → IndepFun initial
      (fun ω n => ULA.Hilbert.brownianEulerNoise P B hB h n ω) P) :
    (sourceReference P hK U m L hm hdiff hsc hLip astar initial hinitial B hB hscalar hind).path 0 =
      packLp P astar initial := by
  change packLp P astar (latentFlow P (frozenPotential U astar) L
    (frozenPotential_gradient_lipschitz hK U L hdiff hLip astar) initial B hB 0) = _
  rw [(latentFlow_spec P _ _ _ initial B hB).2.1]

theorem initial_frozen_drift_bound
    (hK : 0 < K) (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hm : 0 < m) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i))) (astar : Parameter dθ)
    (initial : Lp (Latent K dz) 2 P)
    (hinitial : P.map initial = ULA.gibbsMeasure (frozenPotential U astar)) :
    ‖frozenForce P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip)
      (packLp P astar initial)‖ ≤ Real.sqrt ((L : ℝ) * (dz : ℝ))
initial_frozen_drift_bound.complete_declaration:
theorem initial_frozen_drift_bound
    (hK : 0 < K) (U : Fin K → Cloud.Joint dθ dz → ℝ)
    (m : ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hm : 0 < m) (hdiff : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i))
    (hsc : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn Set.univ m (U i))
    (hLip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i))) (astar : Parameter dθ)
    (initial : Lp (Latent K dz) 2 P)
    (hinitial : P.map initial = ULA.gibbsMeasure (frozenPotential U astar)) :
    ‖frozenForce P (Cloud.meanForce_regular hK U m L hdiff hsc hLip)
      (packLp P astar initial)‖ ≤ Real.sqrt ((L : ℝ) * (dz : ℝ)) := by
  let hv := frozenPotential_gradient_lipschitz hK U L hdiff hLip astar
  rw [frozenForce_packLp P _ (frozenPotential U astar) L hv astar
    (frozenPotential_force_identity hK U hdiff astar)]
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))]
  have hc : ‖(tailInsert (K := K) (dθ := dθ) (dz := dz)).compLpL 2 P‖ ≤ 1 :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_compLpL_le _).trans tailInsert_opNorm_le
  have hn := ((tailInsert (K := K) (dθ := dθ) (dz := dz)).compLpL 2 P).le_opNorm
    (ULA.lpDrift P (gradient (frozenPotential U astar)) hv initial)
  have hg := ULA.lpDrift_norm_le_of_strongConvex_gibbs_law P (frozenPotential U astar) m L hm
    (frozenPotential_differentiable U hdiff astar) (frozenPotential_strongConvex hK U m hsc astar)
    hv initial hinitial
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (hn.trans ((mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) hc).trans hg))
    (inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg (K : ℝ)))
  have hK0 : Real.sqrt (K : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hK)
  have he : (Real.sqrt (K : ℝ))⁻¹ * Real.sqrt ((L : ℝ) * (Module.finrank ℝ (Latent K dz) : ℝ)) =
      Real.sqrt ((L : ℝ) * (dz : ℝ)) := by
    rw [show ((L : ℝ) * (Module.finrank ℝ (Latent K dz) : ℝ)) =
      (K : ℝ) * ((L : ℝ) * (dz : ℝ)) by simp [Latent]; ring,
      Real.sqrt_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg K), ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hK0, one_mul]
  exact h.trans_eq he

import LatentDiffusion.SourceResults
import LatentDiffusion.RegularMetricFlow
import Mathlib.Analysis.ODE.Gronwall
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Sqrt

set_option linter.style.header false

/-! # From extended LSI to finite flow length and Talagrand

The implication uses the actual flow's energy dissipation and upper-right
metric-speed estimate. It requires no geodesic convexity hypothesis. Those
two flow identities are supplied by the separate density/PDE and coupling
theorems when this real-analysis result is specialized to the source model.
-/

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter Set
open scoped Topology

namespace LatentDiffusion.RegularTalagrand


/-- At zero energy the nonnegative dissipating energy stays zero to the right,
so its square root has right derivative zero even though sqrt is singular. -/

/-- Extended LSI controls the square-root energy's dissipation by the metric
speed. The zero-energy case is handled by the preceding right-constancy proof. -/

/-- Adding a differentiable scalar correction to an upper-right slope bound
preserves the bound. The result is stronger than the liminf input to Grönwall. -/

/-- Finite remaining flow length: the product of sqrt(2 rho) with any distance
increment is paid for by the drop of twice the square-root energy. -/



/-- Extended LSI implies the corrected Talagrand conclusion by the full
flow-length argument on a complete metric energy domain. No minimizer or
geodesic convexity is an input: a minimizing limit is constructed.

In the latent-density application, dissipation is supplied by
`normalized_product_deBruijn` and upper slopes by the characteristic/coupling
theorem. Lower semicontinuity is supplied by the dominated density chart. -/

theorem energy_nonincreasing

theorem sqrt_energy_hasDerivWithinAt
    (E I : ℝ → ℝ) (hcont : ContinuousOn E (Ici 0))
    (hderiv : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivWithinAt E (-I t) (Ici t) t)
    (hE : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → 0 ≤ E t) (hI : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → 0 ≤ I t)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun u ↦ Real.sqrt (E u))
      (if E t = 0 then 0 else -I t / (2 * Real.sqrt (E t))) (Ici t) t ∧
      (E t = 0 → I t = 0)
sqrt_energy_hasDerivWithinAt.complete_declaration:
theorem sqrt_energy_hasDerivWithinAt
    (E I : ℝ → ℝ) (hcont : ContinuousOn E (Ici 0))
    (hderiv : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivWithinAt E (-I t) (Ici t) t)
    (hE : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → 0 ≤ E t) (hI : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → 0 ≤ I t)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun u ↦ Real.sqrt (E u))
      (if E t = 0 then 0 else -I t / (2 * Real.sqrt (E t))) (Ici t) t ∧
      (E t = 0 → I t = 0) := by
  by_cases hz : E t = 0
  · have heq (u : ℝ) (hu : u ∈ Ici t) : E u = 0 := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · simpa only [hz] using energy_nonincreasing E I hcont hderiv hI t u ht hu
      · exact hE u (ht.trans hu)
    have hd0 : HasDerivWithinAt E 0 (Ici t) t :=
      (hasDerivWithinAt_const t (Ici t) (0 : ℝ)).congr heq hz
    have hzI : I t = 0 := by
      have ha := (hderiv t ht).derivWithin (uniqueDiffWithinAt_Ici t)
      have hb := hd0.derivWithin (uniqueDiffWithinAt_Ici t)
      linarith
    constructor
    · simp only [hz, ↓reduceIte]
      apply (hasDerivWithinAt_const t (Ici t) (0 : ℝ)).congr
      · intro u hu
        simp [heq u hu]
      · simp [hz]
    · exact fun _ ↦ hzI
  · exact ⟨by simpa only [hz, ↓reduceIte] using (hderiv t ht).sqrt hz,
      fun h ↦ (hz h).elim⟩

theorem sqrt_energy_speed_bound
    {E I rho : ℝ} (hrho : 0 < rho) (hE : 0 ≤ E) (hI : 0 ≤ I)
    (hlsi : 2 * rho * E ≤ I) (hzero : E = 0 → I = 0) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * rho) * Real.sqrt I +
      2 * (if E = 0 then 0 else -I / (2 * Real.sqrt E)) ≤ 0
sqrt_energy_speed_bound.complete_declaration:
theorem sqrt_energy_speed_bound
    {E I rho : ℝ} (hrho : 0 < rho) (hE : 0 ≤ E) (hI : 0 ≤ I)
    (hlsi : 2 * rho * E ≤ I) (hzero : E = 0 → I = 0) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * rho) * Real.sqrt I +
      2 * (if E = 0 then 0 else -I / (2 * Real.sqrt E)) ≤ 0 := by
  by_cases hz : E = 0
  · simp [hz, hzero hz]
  · have hEp : 0 < E := lt_of_le_of_ne hE (Ne.symm hz)
    have hsE : 0 < Real.sqrt E := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hEp
    have hroot : Real.sqrt (2 * rho) * Real.sqrt E ≤ Real.sqrt I := by
      rw [← Real.sqrt_mul (by linarith : 0 ≤ 2 * rho)]
      exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hlsi
    have hmult := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hroot (Real.sqrt_nonneg I)
    rw [mul_assoc, Real.mul_self_sqrt hI] at hmult
    simp only [hz, ↓reduceIte]
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ hsE).mp
    have hcancel : (2 * (-I / (2 * Real.sqrt E))) * Real.sqrt E = -I := by
      field_simp
    rw [add_mul, hcancel, zero_mul]
    nlinarith [hmult]

upper_slope_add.statement:
theorem upper_slope_add
    (D G : ℝ → ℝ) (t L g : ℝ)
    (hD : ∀ r, L < r → ∀ᶠ u in 𝓝[>] t, slope D t u < r)
    (hG : HasDerivWithinAt G g (Ici t) t) :
    ∀ r, L + g < r → ∀ᶠ u in 𝓝[>] t, slope (fun s ↦ D s + G s) t u < r
upper_slope_add.complete_declaration:
theorem upper_slope_add
    (D G : ℝ → ℝ) (t L g : ℝ)
    (hD : ∀ r, L < r → ∀ᶠ u in 𝓝[>] t, slope D t u < r)
    (hG : HasDerivWithinAt G g (Ici t) t) :
    ∀ r, L + g < r → ∀ᶠ u in 𝓝[>] t, slope (fun s ↦ D s + G s) t u < r := by
  intro r hr
  let ε := (r - (L + g)) / 2
  have hε : 0 < ε := by dsimp [ε]; linarith
  have hlim : Tendsto (slope G t) (𝓝[>] t) (𝓝 g) :=
    (hasDerivWithinAt_iff_tendsto_slope' (by simp : t ∉ Ioi t)).mp
      (hG.mono Ioi_subset_Ici_self)
  filter_upwards [hD (L + ε) (by linarith),
    hlim.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds (show g < g + ε by linarith)),
    self_mem_nhdsWithin] with u huD huG htu
  have heq : slope (fun s ↦ D s + G s) t u = slope D t u + slope G t u := by
    simp only [slope_def_field]
    ring
  rw [heq]
  dsimp [ε] at huD huG
  linarith

distance_energy_drop.statement:
theorem distance_energy_drop
    (D E I : ℝ → ℝ) (rho : ℝ) (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (hDcont : ContinuousOn D (Ici 0)) (hEcont : ContinuousOn E (Ici 0))
    (hderiv : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivWithinAt E (-I t) (Ici t) t)
    (hE : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → 0 ≤ E t) (hI : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → 0 ≤ I t)
    (hlsi : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → 2 * rho * E t ≤ I t)
    (hspeed : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ r, Real.sqrt (I t) < r →
      ∀ᶠ u in 𝓝[>] t, slope D t u < r)
    (s t : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * rho) * (D t - D s) ≤
      2 * (Real.sqrt (E s) - Real.sqrt (E t))
distance_energy_drop.complete_declaration:
theorem distance_energy_drop
    (D E I : ℝ → ℝ) (rho : ℝ) (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (hDcont : ContinuousOn D (Ici 0)) (hEcont : ContinuousOn E (Ici 0))
    (hderiv : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivWithinAt E (-I t) (Ici t) t)
    (hE : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → 0 ≤ E t) (hI : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → 0 ≤ I t)
    (hlsi : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → 2 * rho * E t ≤ I t)
    (hspeed : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ r, Real.sqrt (I t) < r →
      ∀ᶠ u in 𝓝[>] t, slope D t u < r)
    (s t : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * rho) * (D t - D s) ≤
      2 * (Real.sqrt (E s) - Real.sqrt (E t)) := by
  let A := Real.sqrt (2 * rho)
  have hA : 0 < A := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun u ↦ 2 * Real.sqrt (E u)
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun u ↦ A * D u + G u
  let J : ℝ → ℝ := fun u ↦
    A * Real.sqrt (I u) + 2 * (if E u = 0 then 0 else -I u / (2 * Real.sqrt (E u)))
  have hFcont : ContinuousOn F (Ici 0) :=
    (continuousOn_const.mul hDcont).add
      (continuousOn_const.mul (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn hEcont))
  have hFspeed : ∀ u, 0 ≤ u → ∀ r, J u < r →
      ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[>] u, slope F u z < r := by
    intro u hu r hr
    have hscaled : ∀ c, A * Real.sqrt (I u) < c →
        ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[>] u, slope (fun y ↦ A * D y) u z < c := by
      intro c hc
      have hc' : Real.sqrt (I u) < c / A := (lt_div_iff₀ hA).mpr (by nlinarith)
      filter_upwards [hspeed u hu (c / A) hc'] with z hz
      have hscale : slope (fun y ↦ A * D y) u z = A * slope D u z := by
        simp only [slope_def_field]
        ring
      rw [hscale]
      have hh := (lt_div_iff₀ hA).mp hz
      nlinarith
    exact upper_slope_add (fun y ↦ A * D y) G u (A * Real.sqrt (I u)) _ hscaled
      ((sqrt_energy_hasDerivWithinAt E I hEcont hderiv hE hI u hu).1.const_mul 2) r hr
  have hJ : ∀ u, 0 ≤ u → J u ≤ 0 := by
    intro u hu
    exact sqrt_energy_speed_bound hrho (hE u hu) (hI u hu) (hlsi u hu)
      (sqrt_energy_hasDerivWithinAt E I hEcont hderiv hE hI u hu).2
  have hout := le_gronwallBound_of_liminf_deriv_right_le
    (f := F) (f' := J) (δ := F s) (K := 0) (ε := 0)
    (hFcont.mono (fun u hu ↦ hs.trans hu.1))
    (fun u hu r hr ↦ by
      simpa only [slope_def_field, div_eq_inv_mul] using
        (hFspeed u (hs.trans hu.1) r hr).frequently)
    (le_refl _) (fun u hu ↦ by simpa using hJ u (hs.trans hu.1))
    t (show t ∈ Icc s t from ⟨hst, le_rfl⟩)
  simp only [gronwallBound_K0, zero_mul, add_zero] at hout
  dsimp [F, G, A] at hout
  linarith

theorem energy_decay
    (E I : ℝ → ℝ) (rho : ℝ) (_hrho : 0 < rho)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn E (Ici 0))
    (hderiv : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivWithinAt E (-I t) (Ici t) t)
    (hlsi : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → 2 * rho * E t ≤ I t)

theorem energy_decay
    (E I : ℝ → ℝ) (rho : ℝ) (_hrho : 0 < rho)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn E (Ici 0))
    (hderiv : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivWithinAt E (-I t) (Ici t) t)
    (hlsi : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → 2 * rho * E t ≤ I t)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    E t ≤ E 0 * Real.exp (-2 * rho * t) := by
  have h := le_gronwallBound_of_liminf_deriv_right_le
    (f := E) (f' := fun u ↦ -I u) (δ := E 0) (K := -2 * rho) (ε := 0)

theorem energy_nat_tendsto_zero
    (E I : ℝ → ℝ) (rho : ℝ) (hrho : 0 < rho)

    (hderiv : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivWithinAt E (-I t) (Ici t) t)

energy_nat_tendsto_zero.complete_declaration:
theorem energy_nat_tendsto_zero
    (E I : ℝ → ℝ) (rho : ℝ) (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn E (Ici 0))
    (hderiv : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivWithinAt E (-I t) (Ici t) t)

    (hlsi : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → 2 * rho * E t ≤ I t) :

metric_flow_talagrand.statement:
theorem metric_flow_talagrand
    {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X]
    (F : X → ℝ) (Fstar : ℝ) (x : ℝ → X) (I : ℝ → ℝ) (rho : ℝ)
    (hrho : 0 < rho) (hF : LowerSemicontinuous F) (hstar : ∀ y, Fstar ≤ F y)
    (hx : ContinuousOn x (Ici 0))
    (henergy : ContinuousOn (fun t ↦ F (x t) - Fstar) (Ici 0))
    (hderiv : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivWithinAt (fun u ↦ F (x u) - Fstar)
      (-I t) (Ici t) t)
    (hI : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → 0 ≤ I t)
    (hlsi : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → 2 * rho * (F (x t) - Fstar) ≤ I t)
    (hspeed : ∀ s t, 0 ≤ s → 0 ≤ t → ∀ r, Real.sqrt (I t) < r →
      ∀ᶠ u in 𝓝[>] t, slope (fun v ↦ dist (x s) (x v)) t u < r) :
    ∃ xstar, Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ x n) atTop (𝓝 xstar) ∧
      F xstar = Fstar ∧ (∀ y, F xstar ≤ F y) ∧
      ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → rho * dist (x t) xstar ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (F (x t) - Fstar)
metric_flow_talagrand.complete_declaration:
theorem metric_flow_talagrand
    {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X]
    (F : X → ℝ) (Fstar : ℝ) (x : ℝ → X) (I : ℝ → ℝ) (rho : ℝ)
    (hrho : 0 < rho) (hF : LowerSemicontinuous F) (hstar : ∀ y, Fstar ≤ F y)
    (hx : ContinuousOn x (Ici 0))
    (henergy : ContinuousOn (fun t ↦ F (x t) - Fstar) (Ici 0))
    (hderiv : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivWithinAt (fun u ↦ F (x u) - Fstar)
      (-I t) (Ici t) t)
    (hI : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → 0 ≤ I t)
    (hlsi : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → 2 * rho * (F (x t) - Fstar) ≤ I t)
    (hspeed : ∀ s t, 0 ≤ s → 0 ≤ t → ∀ r, Real.sqrt (I t) < r →
      ∀ᶠ u in 𝓝[>] t, slope (fun v ↦ dist (x s) (x v)) t u < r) :
    ∃ xstar, Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ x n) atTop (𝓝 xstar) ∧
      F xstar = Fstar ∧ (∀ y, F xstar ≤ F y) ∧
      ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → rho * dist (x t) xstar ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (F (x t) - Fstar) := by
  let E : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦ F (x t) - Fstar
  have hE (t : ℝ) (_ht : 0 ≤ t) : 0 ≤ E t := sub_nonneg.mpr (hstar (x t))
  have hdrop (s t : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t) :
      Real.sqrt (2 * rho) * dist (x s) (x t) ≤
        2 * (Real.sqrt (E s) - Real.sqrt (E t)) := by
    have h := distance_energy_drop (fun u ↦ dist (x s) (x u)) E I rho hrho
      ((continuous_const.dist continuous_id).comp_continuousOn hx)
      henergy hderiv hE hI hlsi
      (fun u hu ↦ hspeed s u hs hu) s t hs hst
    simpa only [dist_self, sub_zero] using h
  have hEn : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ E n) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    energy_nat_tendsto_zero E I rho hrho henergy hderiv hE hlsi
  have hroot : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ 2 * Real.sqrt (E n)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.sqrt_zero, mul_zero] using
      (Real.continuous_sqrt.tendsto 0 |>.comp hEn).const_mul 2
  have hA : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * rho) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have hCauchy : CauchySeq (fun n : ℕ ↦ x n) := by
    apply Metric.cauchySeq_iff.mpr
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp
      (hroot.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds (mul_pos hA hε)))
    refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
    intro m hm n hn
    rcases le_total m n with hmn | hnm
    · have hd := hdrop m n (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by exact_mod_cast hmn)
      have hsmall := hN m hm
      have hnonneg := Real.sqrt_nonneg (E n)
      nlinarith
    · have hd := hdrop n m (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by exact_mod_cast hnm)
      have hsmall := hN n hn
      have hnonneg := Real.sqrt_nonneg (E m)
      rw [dist_comm (x (n : ℝ)) (x (m : ℝ))] at hd
      nlinarith
  have hvalues : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ F (x n)) atTop (𝓝 Fstar) := by
    convert hEn.add_const Fstar using 1
    · funext n
      dsimp [E]
      ring
    · simp
  obtain ⟨xstar, hlimit, hminvalue, hmin⟩ :=
    SourceResults.cauchy_minimizing_sequence F Fstar hF hstar
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ x n) hCauchy hvalues
  refine ⟨xstar, hlimit, hminvalue, hmin, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  have hdlim : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ Real.sqrt (2 * rho) * dist (x t) (x n))
      atTop (𝓝 (Real.sqrt (2 * rho) * dist (x t) xstar)) :=
    (((continuous_const.dist continuous_id).continuousAt.tendsto).comp hlimit).const_mul _
  have heroot : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ 2 * (Real.sqrt (E t) - Real.sqrt (E n)))
      atTop (𝓝 (2 * Real.sqrt (E t))) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.sqrt_zero, sub_zero] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds.sub (Real.continuous_sqrt.tendsto 0 |>.comp hEn)).const_mul 2
  have hdbound : Real.sqrt (2 * rho) * dist (x t) xstar ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (E t) := by
    apply le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto hdlim heroot
    filter_upwards [tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop t)] with n hn
    exact hdrop t n ht hn
  have hsq : (Real.sqrt (2 * rho) * dist (x t) xstar) ^ 2 ≤
      (2 * Real.sqrt (E t)) ^ 2 := by
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hdbound 2
  rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith : 0 ≤ 2 * rho), mul_pow,
    Real.sq_sqrt (hE t ht)] at hsq
  dsimp [E] at hsq
  nlinarith

# Regular displacement transport for the latent free energy

pushforward by a measurable interpolation, positive densities, positive
eigenvalues of its Jacobian, the density/Jacobian change of variables formula,

spectralJacobian.statement: def spectralJacobian {d : ℕ} (eigenvalue : Fin d → ℝ) (s : ℝ) : ℝ
spectralJacobian.complete_declaration:
def spectralJacobian {d : ℕ} (eigenvalue : Fin d → ℝ) (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∏ i, ((1 - s) + s * eigenvalue i)

spectralJacobian_pos.statement:
theorem spectralJacobian_pos {d : ℕ} (eigenvalue : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < eigenvalue i) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    0 < spectralJacobian eigenvalue s
spectralJacobian_pos.complete_declaration:
theorem spectralJacobian_pos {d : ℕ} (eigenvalue : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < eigenvalue i) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    0 < spectralJacobian eigenvalue s := by
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro i _
  by_cases h : s = 0
  · simp [h]
  · have hsp : 0 < s := lt_of_le_of_ne hs.1 (Ne.symm h)
    exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (sub_nonneg.mpr hs.2) (mul_pos hsp (hpos i))

spectralJacobian_zero.statement:
@[simp] theorem spectralJacobian_zero {d : ℕ} (eigenvalue : Fin d → ℝ) :
    spectralJacobian eigenvalue 0 = 1
spectralJacobian_zero.complete_declaration:
@[simp] theorem spectralJacobian_zero {d : ℕ} (eigenvalue : Fin d → ℝ) :
    spectralJacobian eigenvalue 0 = 1 := by simp [spectralJacobian]

spectralJacobian_one.statement:
@[simp] theorem spectralJacobian_one {d : ℕ} (eigenvalue : Fin d → ℝ) :
    spectralJacobian eigenvalue 1 = ∏ i, eigenvalue i
spectralJacobian_one.complete_declaration:
@[simp] theorem spectralJacobian_one {d : ℕ} (eigenvalue : Fin d → ℝ) :
    spectralJacobian eigenvalue 1 = ∏ i, eigenvalue i := by simp [spectralJacobian]

log_spectralJacobian_ge.statement:
theorem log_spectralJacobian_ge {d : ℕ} (eigenvalue : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < eigenvalue i) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    s * Real.log (spectralJacobian eigenvalue 1) ≤
      Real.log (spectralJacobian eigenvalue s)
log_spectralJacobian_ge.complete_declaration:
theorem log_spectralJacobian_ge {d : ℕ} (eigenvalue : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < eigenvalue i) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    s * Real.log (spectralJacobian eigenvalue 1) ≤
      Real.log (spectralJacobian eigenvalue s) := by
  have he (i : Fin d) :
      s * Real.log (eigenvalue i) ≤ Real.log ((1 - s) + s * eigenvalue i) := by
    have h := (StrictConcaveOn.concaveOn strictConcaveOn_log_Ioi).2
      (show (1 : ℝ) ∈ Ioi 0 by norm_num) (hpos i)
      (sub_nonneg.mpr hs.2) hs.1 (by ring : (1 - s) + s = 1)
    simpa [smul_eq_mul] using h
  rw [spectralJacobian_one, Real.log_prod (fun i _ ↦ (hpos i).ne')]
  unfold spectralJacobian
  rw [Real.log_prod (fun i _ ↦ ?_)]
  · rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ ↦ he i
  · have h := spectralJacobian_pos (d := 1) (fun _ ↦ eigenvalue i) (fun _ ↦ hpos i) s hs
    simpa [spectralJacobian] using h.ne'

interpolate.statement: def interpolate (T : Z → Z) (s : ℝ) (z : Z) : Z
interpolate.complete_declaration: def interpolate (T : Z → Z) (s : ℝ) (z : Z) : Z := (1 - s) • z + s • T z

interpolate_zero.statement: @[simp] theorem interpolate_zero (T : Z → Z) : interpolate T 0 = id
interpolate_zero.complete_declaration:
@[simp] theorem interpolate_zero (T : Z → Z) : interpolate T 0 = id := by
  funext z
  simp [interpolate]

interpolate_one.statement: @[simp] theorem interpolate_one (T : Z → Z) : interpolate T 1 = T
interpolate_one.complete_declaration:
@[simp] theorem interpolate_one (T : Z → Z) : interpolate T 1 = T := by
  funext z
  simp [interpolate]

interpolate_measurable.statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem interpolate_measurable (T : Z → Z) (hT : Measurable T) (s : ℝ) :
    Measurable (interpolate T s)
interpolate_measurable.complete_declaration:
@[fun_prop] theorem interpolate_measurable (T : Z → Z) (hT : Measurable T) (s : ℝ) :
    Measurable (interpolate T s) := by unfold interpolate; fun_prop

RegularDisplacement.statement: structure RegularDisplacement (ν μ : Measure Z) (d : ℕ)
RegularDisplacement.complete_declaration:
structure RegularDisplacement (ν μ : Measure Z) (d : ℕ) where
  transport : Z → Z
  measurable_transport : Measurable transport
  density : ℝ → Z → ℝ
  measurable_density : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, Measurable (density s)
  positive_density : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ z, 0 < density s z
  density_law : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
    μ.map (interpolate transport s) = ν.withDensity (fun z ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (density s z))
  eigenvalue : Z → Fin d → ℝ
  positive_eigenvalue : ∀ z i, 0 < eigenvalue z i
  jacobian : Z → Z →L[ℝ] Z
  derivative_transport : ∀ z, HasFDerivAt transport (jacobian z) z
  spectral_basis : Z → OrthonormalBasis (Fin d) ℝ Z
  jacobian_eigenvector : ∀ z i,
    jacobian z (spectral_basis z i) = eigenvalue z i • spectral_basis z i
  density_jacobian : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ z,
    density s (interpolate transport s z) =
      density 0 z / spectralJacobian (eigenvalue z) s
  integrable_log : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
    Integrable (fun z ↦ Real.log (density s (interpolate transport s z))) μ

det_jacobian.statement:
theorem det_jacobian (z : Z) :
    (D.jacobian z).toLinearMap.det = spectralJacobian (D.eigenvalue z) 1
det_jacobian.complete_declaration:
theorem det_jacobian (z : Z) :
    (D.jacobian z).toLinearMap.det = spectralJacobian (D.eigenvalue z) 1 := by
  rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (D.spectral_basis z).toBasis]
  have hmatrix : LinearMap.toMatrix (D.spectral_basis z).toBasis
      (D.spectral_basis z).toBasis (D.jacobian z).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.diagonal (D.eigenvalue z) := by
    ext i j
    rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis,
      D.jacobian_eigenvector, map_smul]
    by_cases h : i = j
    · subst j
      simp
    · simp [h]
  rw [hmatrix, Matrix.det_diagonal, spectralJacobian_one]

trace_jacobian.statement:
theorem trace_jacobian (z : Z) :
    LinearMap.trace ℝ Z (D.jacobian z).toLinearMap = ∑ i, D.eigenvalue z i
trace_jacobian.complete_declaration:
theorem trace_jacobian (z : Z) :
    LinearMap.trace ℝ Z (D.jacobian z).toLinearMap = ∑ i, D.eigenvalue z i := by
  rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace ℝ (D.spectral_basis z).toBasis]
  unfold Matrix.trace Matrix.diag
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
  simp [D.jacobian_eigenvector]

law.complete_declaration: def law (s : ℝ) : Measure Z := μ.map (interpolate D.transport s)

law_zero.complete_declaration: @[simp] theorem law_zero : D.law 0 = μ := by simp [law]

law_one.complete_declaration: @[simp] theorem law_one : D.law 1 = μ.map D.transport := by simp [law]

law_probability.statement:
instance law_probability [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (s : ℝ) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (D.law s)
law_probability.complete_declaration:
instance law_probability [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (s : ℝ) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (D.law s) :=
  (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff
    (interpolate_measurable _ D.measurable_transport s).aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance

log_density_interpolate_le.statement:
theorem log_density_interpolate_le (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (z : Z) :
    Real.log (D.density s (interpolate D.transport s z)) ≤
      (1 - s) * Real.log (D.density 0 z) +
        s * Real.log (D.density 1 (D.transport z))
log_density_interpolate_le.complete_declaration:
theorem log_density_interpolate_le (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (z : Z) :
    Real.log (D.density s (interpolate D.transport s z)) ≤
      (1 - s) * Real.log (D.density 0 z) +
        s * Real.log (D.density 1 (D.transport z)) := by
  have hj := spectralJacobian_pos (D.eigenvalue z) (D.positive_eigenvalue z) s hs
  have hj1 := spectralJacobian_pos (D.eigenvalue z) (D.positive_eigenvalue z) 1
    (by constructor <;> norm_num)
  have h0 := D.positive_density 0 (by constructor <;> norm_num) z
  have hmass := D.density_jacobian s hs z
  have hmass1 := D.density_jacobian 1 (by constructor <;> norm_num) z
  simp only [interpolate_one] at hmass1
  rw [hmass, hmass1, Real.log_div h0.ne' hj.ne', Real.log_div h0.ne' hj1.ne']
  have hdet := log_spectralJacobian_ge (D.eigenvalue z) (D.positive_eigenvalue z) s hs
  nlinarith

entropy.complete_declaration: def entropy (s : ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ z, Real.log (D.density s z) ∂D.law s

entropy_eq_pullback.statement:
theorem entropy_eq_pullback (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    D.entropy s = ∫ z, Real.log (D.density s (interpolate D.transport s z)) ∂μ
entropy_eq_pullback.complete_declaration:
theorem entropy_eq_pullback (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    D.entropy s = ∫ z, Real.log (D.density s (interpolate D.transport s z)) ∂μ := by
  exact integral_map (interpolate_measurable _ D.measurable_transport s).aemeasurable
    ((Real.measurable_log.comp (D.measurable_density s hs)).aestronglyMeasurable)

entropy_displacement_convex.statement:
theorem entropy_displacement_convex (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    D.entropy s ≤ (1 - s) * D.entropy 0 + s * D.entropy 1
entropy_displacement_convex.complete_declaration:
theorem entropy_displacement_convex (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    D.entropy s ≤ (1 - s) * D.entropy 0 + s * D.entropy 1 := by
  rw [D.entropy_eq_pullback s hs,
    D.entropy_eq_pullback 0 (by constructor <;> norm_num),
    D.entropy_eq_pullback 1 (by constructor <;> norm_num)]
  simp only [interpolate_zero, id_eq, interpolate_one]
  have h0 := D.integrable_log 0 (by constructor <;> norm_num)
  have h1 := D.integrable_log 1 (by constructor <;> norm_num)
  simp only [interpolate_zero, id_eq, interpolate_one] at h0 h1
  rw [← integral_const_mul, ← integral_const_mul, ← integral_add (h0.const_mul _) (h1.const_mul _)]
  exact integral_mono (D.integrable_log s hs) ((h0.const_mul _).add (h1.const_mul _))
    (D.log_density_interpolate_le s hs)

parameterInterpolate.statement: def parameterInterpolate (p₀ p₁ : P) (s : ℝ) : P
parameterInterpolate.complete_declaration: def parameterInterpolate (p₀ p₁ : P) (s : ℝ) : P := (1 - s) • p₀ + s • p₁

freeEnergy.statement:
def freeEnergy (D : RegularDisplacement ν μ d) (U : P → Z → ℝ)

secondCost_sq_eq_integral.statement:
theorem secondCost_sq_eq_integral {Ω H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    (Q : Measure Ω) (X : Ω → H) (hX : MemLp X 2 Q) :
    (eLpNorm X 2 Q).toReal ^ 2 = ∫ ω, ‖X ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q
secondCost_sq_eq_integral.complete_declaration:
theorem secondCost_sq_eq_integral {Ω H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    (Q : Measure Ω) (X : Ω → H) (hX : MemLp X 2 Q) :
    (eLpNorm X 2 Q).toReal ^ 2 = ∫ ω, ‖X ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q := by
  have h := ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral Q (hX.toLp X)
  rw [Lp.norm_toLp] at h
  exact h.trans (integral_congr_ae (hX.coeFn_toLp.fun_comp fun v ↦ ‖v‖ ^ 2))

potential_displacement_strongConvex.statement:
theorem potential_displacement_strongConvex
    (D : RegularDisplacement ν μ d) (U : P → Z → ℝ) (p₀ p₁ : P) (rho : ℝ)
    (hU : StrongConvexOn univ rho (fun w : PBGSO.ProductTransport.Joint P Z ↦ U w.fst w.snd))
    (hmeas : ∀ p, Measurable (U p))
    (hint : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      Integrable (fun z ↦ U (parameterInterpolate p₀ p₁ s) (interpolate D.transport s z)) μ)
    (hcost : MemLp (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (∫ z, U (parameterInterpolate p₀ p₁ s) z ∂D.law s) ≤
      (1 - s) * (∫ z, U p₀ z ∂μ) + s * (∫ z, U p₁ (D.transport z) ∂μ) -
        rho / 2 * s * (1 - s) *
          (‖p₀ - p₁‖ ^ 2 + (eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ).toReal ^ 2)
potential_displacement_strongConvex.complete_declaration:
theorem potential_displacement_strongConvex
    (D : RegularDisplacement ν μ d) (U : P → Z → ℝ) (p₀ p₁ : P) (rho : ℝ)
    (hU : StrongConvexOn univ rho (fun w : PBGSO.ProductTransport.Joint P Z ↦ U w.fst w.snd))
    (hmeas : ∀ p, Measurable (U p))
    (hint : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      Integrable (fun z ↦ U (parameterInterpolate p₀ p₁ s) (interpolate D.transport s z)) μ)
    (hcost : MemLp (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (∫ z, U (parameterInterpolate p₀ p₁ s) z ∂D.law s) ≤
      (1 - s) * (∫ z, U p₀ z ∂μ) + s * (∫ z, U p₁ (D.transport z) ∂μ) -
        rho / 2 * s * (1 - s) *
          (‖p₀ - p₁‖ ^ 2 + (eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ).toReal ^ 2) := by
  have hpoint (z : Z) :
      U (parameterInterpolate p₀ p₁ s) (interpolate D.transport s z) ≤
        (1 - s) * U p₀ z + s * U p₁ (D.transport z) -
          rho / 2 * s * (1 - s) * (‖p₀ - p₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖z - D.transport z‖ ^ 2) := by
    have h := hU.2 (mem_univ (PBGSO.ProductTransport.embed p₀ z))
      (mem_univ (PBGSO.ProductTransport.embed p₁ (D.transport z)))
      (sub_nonneg.mpr hs.2) hs.1 (by ring : (1 - s) + s = 1)
    change U ((1 - s) • p₀ + s • p₁) ((1 - s) • z + s • D.transport z) ≤
      (1 - s) * U p₀ z + s * U p₁ (D.transport z) -
        (1 - s) * s * (rho / 2 *
          ‖PBGSO.ProductTransport.embed p₀ z -
            PBGSO.ProductTransport.embed p₁ (D.transport z)‖ ^ 2) at h
    rw [WithLp.prod_norm_sq_eq_of_L2] at h
    change U ((1 - s) • p₀ + s • p₁) ((1 - s) • z + s • D.transport z) ≤
      (1 - s) * U p₀ z + s * U p₁ (D.transport z) -
        (1 - s) * s * (rho / 2 * (‖p₀ - p₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖z - D.transport z‖ ^ 2)) at h
    convert h using 1 <;> first | rfl | ring
  have h0 := hint 0 (by constructor <;> norm_num)
  have h1 := hint 1 (by constructor <;> norm_num)
  simp only [parameterInterpolate, sub_zero, one_smul, zero_smul, add_zero,
    interpolate_zero, id_eq, sub_self, zero_add, interpolate_one] at h0 h1
  have hc := hcost.integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)
  have hsum : Integrable (fun z ↦ ‖p₀ - p₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖z - D.transport z‖ ^ 2) μ :=
    (integrable_const _).add hc
  have hrhs : Integrable (fun z ↦ (1 - s) * U p₀ z + s * U p₁ (D.transport z) -
      rho / 2 * s * (1 - s) * (‖p₀ - p₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖z - D.transport z‖ ^ 2)) μ :=
    ((h0.const_mul _).add (h1.const_mul _)).sub (hsum.const_mul _)
  have hbound := integral_mono (hint s hs) hrhs hpoint
  have hmap : (∫ z, U (parameterInterpolate p₀ p₁ s) z ∂D.law s) =
      ∫ z, U (parameterInterpolate p₀ p₁ s) (interpolate D.transport s z) ∂μ :=
    integral_map (interpolate_measurable _ D.measurable_transport s).aemeasurable
      (hmeas _).aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [hmap]
  convert hbound using 1
  symm
  change (∫ z, (((fun z : Z ↦ (1 - s) * U p₀ z) +
    (fun z : Z ↦ s * U p₁ (D.transport z)) -
    (fun z : Z ↦ rho / 2 * s * (1 - s) *
      (‖p₀ - p₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖z - D.transport z‖ ^ 2))) : Z → ℝ) z ∂μ) = _
  rw [integral_sub' ((h0.const_mul (1 - s)).add (h1.const_mul s))
      (hsum.const_mul (rho / 2 * s * (1 - s))),
    integral_add' (h0.const_mul (1 - s)) (h1.const_mul s), integral_const_mul,
    integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, integral_add (integrable_const _) hc,
    integral_const, ← secondCost_sq_eq_integral μ _ hcost]
  simp

freeEnergy_displacement_strongConvex_cos.statement:
theorem freeEnergy_displacement_strongConvex_cost
    (D : RegularDisplacement ν μ d) (U : P → Z → ℝ) (p₀ p₁ : P) (rho : ℝ)
    (hU : StrongConvexOn univ rho (fun w : PBGSO.ProductTransport.Joint P Z ↦ U w.fst w.snd))
    (hmeas : ∀ p, Measurable (U p))
    (hint : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      Integrable (fun z ↦ U (parameterInterpolate p₀ p₁ s) (interpolate D.transport s z)) μ)
    (hcost : MemLp (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    freeEnergy D U p₀ p₁ s ≤
      (1 - s) * freeEnergy D U p₀ p₁ 0 + s * freeEnergy D U p₀ p₁ 1 -
        rho / 2 * s * (1 - s) *
          (‖p₀ - p₁‖ ^ 2 + (eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ).toReal ^ 2)
freeEnergy_displacement_strongConvex_cos.complete_declaration:
theorem freeEnergy_displacement_strongConvex_cost
    (D : RegularDisplacement ν μ d) (U : P → Z → ℝ) (p₀ p₁ : P) (rho : ℝ)
    (hU : StrongConvexOn univ rho (fun w : PBGSO.ProductTransport.Joint P Z ↦ U w.fst w.snd))
    (hmeas : ∀ p, Measurable (U p))
    (hint : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      Integrable (fun z ↦ U (parameterInterpolate p₀ p₁ s) (interpolate D.transport s z)) μ)
    (hcost : MemLp (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    freeEnergy D U p₀ p₁ s ≤
      (1 - s) * freeEnergy D U p₀ p₁ 0 + s * freeEnergy D U p₀ p₁ 1 -
        rho / 2 * s * (1 - s) *
          (‖p₀ - p₁‖ ^ 2 + (eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ).toReal ^ 2) := by
  have he := D.entropy_displacement_convex s hs
  have hp := potential_displacement_strongConvex D U p₀ p₁ rho hU hmeas hint hcost s hs
  have hmap : (∫ z, U p₁ z ∂D.law 1) = ∫ z, U p₁ (D.transport z) ∂μ := by
    rw [D.law_one]
    exact integral_map D.measurable_transport.aemeasurable (hmeas p₁).aestronglyMeasurable
  simp only [freeEnergy, parameterInterpolate, sub_zero, one_smul, zero_smul, add_zero,
    sub_self, zero_add, D.law_zero, hmap]
  unfold parameterInterpolate at hp
  linarith

wasserstein_sq_le_displacement_cost.statement:
theorem wasserstein_sq_le_displacement_cost
    (D : RegularDisplacement ν μ d) (hcost : MemLp (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ) :

theorem freeEnergy_displacement_strongConvex
    (D : RegularDisplacement ν μ d) (U : P → Z → ℝ) (p₀ p₁ : P) (rho : ℝ)
    (hrho : 0 ≤ rho)
    (hU : StrongConvexOn univ rho (fun w : PBGSO.ProductTransport.Joint P Z ↦ U w.fst w.snd))
    (hmeas : ∀ p, Measurable (U p))
    (hint : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      Integrable (fun z ↦ U (parameterInterpolate p₀ p₁ s) (interpolate D.transport s z)) μ)
    (hcost : MemLp (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    freeEnergy D U p₀ p₁ s ≤
      (1 - s) * freeEnergy D U p₀ p₁ 0 + s * freeEnergy D U p₀ p₁ 1 -
        rho / 2 * s * (1 - s) *
          (‖p₀ - p₁‖ ^ 2 + ULA.wasserstein2Real μ (D.law 1) ^ 2)

    (hmin : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      freeEnergy D U p₀ p₁ 0 ≤ freeEnergy D U p₀ p₁ s) :
    rho / 2 * (‖p₀ - p₁‖ ^ 2 + ULA.wasserstein2Real μ (D.law 1) ^ 2) ≤

theorem talagrand_product

    (hrho : 0 ≤ rho)
    (hU : StrongConvexOn univ rho (fun w : PBGSO.ProductTransport.Joint P Z ↦ U w.fst w.snd))
    (hmeas : ∀ p, Measurable (U p))
    (hint : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,

strongConvex_tangent.statement:
theorem strongConvex_tangent (U : H → ℝ) (rho : ℝ)
    (hU : StrongConvexOn univ rho U) (x y : H) (A : H →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hA : HasFDerivAt U A x) :
    U x + A (y - x) + rho / 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 ≤ U y
strongConvex_tangent.complete_declaration:
theorem strongConvex_tangent (U : H → ℝ) (rho : ℝ)
    (hU : StrongConvexOn univ rho U) (x y : H) (A : H →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hA : HasFDerivAt U A x) :
    U x + A (y - x) + rho / 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 ≤ U y := by
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun s ↦ U (x + s • (y - x))
  have hl : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ ↦ x + s • (y - x)) (y - x) 0 := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const (y - x)).const_add x
  have hd : HasDerivAt f (A (y - x)) 0 := by
    have hA' : HasFDerivAt U A (x + (0 : ℝ) • (y - x)) := by simpa using hA
    convert hA'.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℝ) hl using 1
    rfl
  have hconv (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
      f s ≤ (1 - s) * f 0 + s * U y - rho / 2 * s * (1 - s) * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 := by
    have h := hU.2 (mem_univ x) (mem_univ y) (sub_nonneg.mpr hs.2) hs.1
      (by ring : (1 - s) + s=1)
    have he : x + s • (y - x) = (1 - s) • x + s • y := by module
    simpa [f, he, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using h
  have ht := SourceResults.geodesic_convexity_first_order f (U y) (A (y - x)) rho ‖x - y‖
    hd.hasDerivWithinAt hconv
  simp only [f, zero_smul, add_zero] at ht
  linarith

theorem integral_inner_le_secondCost {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] (Q : Measure Ω) (A B : Ω → H)
    (hA : MemLp A 2 Q) (hB : MemLp B 2 Q) :

wasserstein_triangle.statement:
theorem wasserstein_triangle (T : OptimalMap μ ν) (S : OptimalMap ν η) :
    ULA.wasserstein2 μ η ≤ ULA.wasserstein2 μ ν + ULA.wasserstein2 ν η
wasserstein_triangle.complete_declaration:
theorem wasserstein_triangle (T : OptimalMap μ ν) (S : OptimalMap ν η) :
    ULA.wasserstein2 μ η ≤ ULA.wasserstein2 μ ν + ULA.wasserstein2 ν η := by
  have hm : μ.map (S.transport ∘ T.transport) = η := by
    rw [← Measure.map_map S.measurable_transport T.measurable_transport, T.pushes, S.pushes]
  have hb := ULA.wasserstein2_le_random_cost μ id (S.transport ∘ T.transport) measurable_id
    (S.measurable_transport.comp T.measurable_transport)
  simp only [Measure.map_id, hm] at hb
  apply hb.trans
  rw [T.wasserstein_eq_cost, S.wasserstein_eq_cost]
  calc
    eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - (S.transport ∘ T.transport) z) 2 μ =
      eLpNorm ((fun z ↦ z - T.transport z) +
        (fun z ↦ T.transport z - S.transport (T.transport z))) 2 μ := by
      congr 1
      funext z
      simp
    _ ≤ eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - T.transport z) 2 μ +
      eLpNorm (fun z ↦ T.transport z - S.transport (T.transport z)) 2 μ :=
      eLpNorm_add_le (by norm_num)
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      have hmap := eLpNorm_map_measure
        (μ := μ) (p := 2) (g := fun z ↦ z - S.transport z)
        ((measurable_id.sub S.measurable_transport).aestronglyMeasurable)
        T.measurable_transport.aemeasurable
      simpa only [T.pushes, Function.comp_def] using hmap.symm

theorem wassersteinReal_triangle (T : OptimalMap μ ν) (S : OptimalMap ν η) :
    ULA.wasserstein2Real μ η ≤ ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν + ULA.wasserstein2Real ν η
wassersteinReal_triangle.complete_declaration:
theorem wassersteinReal_triangle (T : OptimalMap μ ν) (S : OptimalMap ν η) :
    ULA.wasserstein2Real μ η ≤ ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν + ULA.wasserstein2Real ν η := by
  have hfin := ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨T.wasserstein_ne_top, S.wasserstein_ne_top⟩
  have h := ENNReal.toReal_mono hfin (T.wasserstein_triangle S)
  simpa only [ULA.wasserstein2Real, ENNReal.toReal_add T.wasserstein_ne_top S.wasserstein_ne_top]
    using h

    (hU0 : Integrable (U p₀) μ)

      rho / 2 * (‖p₀ - p₁‖ ^ 2 + (eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ).toReal ^ 2) ≤

    (hG : ∀ z, HasGradientAt (fun w : Joint (P := P) (Z := Z) ↦ U w.fst w.snd)
      (G z) (PBGSO.ProductTransport.embed p₀ z))
    (hG2 : MemLp G 2 μ) (hc : MemLp (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ)
    (hU0 : Integrable (U p₀) μ)
    (hU1 : Integrable (fun z ↦ U p₁ (D.transport z)) μ) :
    (∫ z, inner ℝ (G z) (displacementField D p₀ p₁ z) ∂μ) +
      rho / 2 * (‖p₀ - p₁‖ ^ 2 + (eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ).toReal ^ 2) ≤
      (∫ z, U p₁ (D.transport z) ∂μ) - ∫ z, U p₀ z ∂μ := by
  have hV := displacementField_memLp D p₀ p₁ hc
  have hip := integrable_inner_memLp G _ hG2 hV
  have hsq := hc.integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)
  have htot : Integrable (fun z ↦ ‖p₀ - p₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖z - D.transport z‖ ^ 2) μ :=
    (integrable_const _).add hsq
  have hp (z : Z) :

        rho / 2 * (‖p₀ - p₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖z - D.transport z‖ ^ 2) ≤
      U p₁ (D.transport z) - U p₀ z := by
    have h := strongConvex_tangent
      (fun w : Joint (P := P) (Z := Z) ↦ U w.fst w.snd) rho hU
      (PBGSO.ProductTransport.embed p₀ z)
      (PBGSO.ProductTransport.embed p₁ (D.transport z)) _ (hG z).hasFDerivAt
    simp only [WithLp.prod_norm_sq_eq_of_L2] at h
    change U p₀ z + inner ℝ (G z) (displacementField D p₀ p₁ z) +
      rho / 2 * (‖p₀ - p₁‖ ^ 2 + ‖z - D.transport z‖ ^ 2) ≤ U p₁ (D.transport z) at h
    linarith
  have hb := integral_mono (hip.add (htot.const_mul (rho / 2))) (hU1.sub hU0) hp
  rw [integral_add' hip (htot.const_mul (rho / 2)), integral_const_mul,
    integral_add (integrable_const _) hsq, integral_sub' hU1 hU0,
    integral_const, ← secondCost_sq_eq_integral μ _ hc] at hb
  simpa using hb

    s * (∫ z, inner ℝ (G z) (displacementField D p₀ p₁ z) ∂μ) +
      rho / 2 * s ^ 2 * (‖p₀ - p₁‖ ^ 2 + (eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ).toReal ^ 2) ≤
      (∫ z, U (parameterInterpolate p₀ p₁ s) (interpolate D.transport s z) ∂μ)-

      apply WithLp.ofLp_injective 2

      rw [norm_sub_rev, hsub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs,

      (fun w : Joint (P := P) (Z := Z) ↦ U w.fst w.snd) rho hU x y _ (hG z).hasFDerivAt

    integral_sub' hUs hU0, integral_const, ← secondCost_sq_eq_integral μ _ hc] at hb

  have hv : MemLp v 2 μ := by
    convert hc.neg using 1
    funext z
    simp [v]
  have hfst := joint_fst_memLp G hG
  have hsnd := joint_snd_memLp G hG
  have hip := integrable_inner_memLp (fun z ↦ (G z).snd) v hsnd hv
  have his := integrable_inner_memLp score v hs hv
  have hpar := (hfst.integrable (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2)).inner_const
    (𝕜 := ℝ) (p₁ - p₀)
  have hparEq : (∫ z, inner ℝ (G z).fst (p₁ - p₀) ∂μ) =
      inner ℝ (∫ z, (G z).fst ∂μ) (p₁ - p₀) := by
    simpa only [real_inner_comm] using
      integral_inner (hfst.integrable (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2)) (p₁ - p₀)
  simp only [displacementField, WithLp.prod_inner_apply, PBGSO.ProductTransport.embed]
  change (∫ z, inner ℝ (G z).fst (p₁ - p₀) + inner ℝ (G z).snd (v z) ∂μ) +
    (∫ z, inner ℝ (v z) (score z) ∂μ) =
    inner ℝ (∫ z, (G z).fst ∂μ) (p₁ - p₀) + ∫ z, inner ℝ ((G z).snd + score z) (v z) ∂μ
  rw [integral_add hpar hip, hparEq]
  simp only [inner_add_left]
  rw [integral_add hip his]
  simp only [real_inner_comm (v _) (score _)]
  ring

normalized_extendedLSI_of_tangents.statement:
theorem normalized_extendedLSI_of_tangents
    {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (rho : ℝ) (hrho : 0 < rho) (dp : P)
    (gap pair b c : Fin M → ℝ) (g : Fin M → P)
    (htangent : ∀ m, gap m + inner ℝ (g m) dp + pair m +
      rho / 2 * (‖dp‖ ^ 2 + c m ^ 2) ≤ 0)
    (hpair : ∀ m, -pair m ≤ b m * c m) :
    2 * rho * ((M : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ m, gap m) ≤
      ‖(M : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ m, g m‖ ^ 2 + (M : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ m, b m ^ 2
normalized_extendedLSI_of_tangents.complete_declaration:
theorem normalized_extendedLSI_of_tangents
    {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (rho : ℝ) (hrho : 0 < rho) (dp : P)
    (gap pair b c : Fin M → ℝ) (g : Fin M → P)
    (htangent : ∀ m, gap m + inner ℝ (g m) dp + pair m +
      rho / 2 * (‖dp‖ ^ 2 + c m ^ 2) ≤ 0)
    (hpair : ∀ m, -pair m ≤ b m * c m) :
    2 * rho * ((M : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ m, gap m) ≤
      ‖(M : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ m, g m‖ ^ 2 + (M : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ m, b m ^ 2 := by
  let w : ℝ := (M : ℝ)⁻¹
  have hw : 0 ≤ w := by positivity
  have hcancel : w * (M : ℝ) = 1 := by
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hM.ne')
  have hpoint (m : Fin M) :
      2 * rho * gap m ≤ -2 * rho * inner ℝ (g m) dp - rho ^ 2 * ‖dp‖ ^ 2 + b m ^ 2 := by
    have h := htangent m
    have hp := hpair m
    have hsq := sq_nonneg (b m - rho * c m)
    nlinarith
  have hsum := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m (_ : m ∈ Finset.univ) ↦ hpoint m)) hw
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
    nsmul_eq_mul] at hsum
  simp only [← Finset.mul_sum] at hsum
  have hmean : inner ℝ (w • ∑ m, g m) dp = w * ∑ m, inner ℝ (g m) dp := by
    simp [inner_smul_left, sum_inner]
  have hquad := sq_nonneg ‖(w • ∑ m, g m) + rho • dp‖
  have hnorm : ‖rho • dp‖ ^ 2 = rho ^ 2 * ‖dp‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
  rw [norm_add_sq_real, hnorm, real_inner_smul_right] at hquad
  rw [hmean] at hquad
  have hconst : w * ((M : ℝ) * (rho ^ 2 * ‖dp‖ ^ 2)) = rho ^ 2 * ‖dp‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, hcancel, one_mul]
  change 2 * rho * (w * ∑ m, gap m) ≤ ‖w • ∑ m, g m‖ ^ 2 + w * ∑ m, b m ^ 2
  nlinarith [hconst]

negative_tangent_pairing_le.statement:
theorem negative_tangent_pairing_le
    (D : RegularDisplacement (volume : Measure Z) μ d) (p₀ p₁ : P)
    (G : Z → PBGSO.ProductTransport.Joint P Z) (hG : MemLp G 2 μ)
    (hc : MemLp (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ)
    (hs : MemLp (fun z ↦ gradient (fun z ↦ Real.log (D.density 0 z)) z) 2 μ) :
    -((∫ z, inner ℝ (G z) (displacementField D p₀ p₁ z) ∂μ) +
      ∫ z, inner ℝ (D.transport z - z) (gradient (fun z ↦ Real.log (D.density 0 z)) z) ∂μ) ≤
      Real.sqrt (fisherInformation D G) *
        Real.sqrt (‖p₀ - p₁‖ ^ 2 + (eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ).toReal ^ 2)
negative_tangent_pairing_le.complete_declaration:
theorem negative_tangent_pairing_le
    (D : RegularDisplacement (volume : Measure Z) μ d) (p₀ p₁ : P)
    (G : Z → PBGSO.ProductTransport.Joint P Z) (hG : MemLp G 2 μ)
    (hc : MemLp (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ)
    (hs : MemLp (fun z ↦ gradient (fun z ↦ Real.log (D.density 0 z)) z) 2 μ) :
    -((∫ z, inner ℝ (G z) (displacementField D p₀ p₁ z) ∂μ) +
      ∫ z, inner ℝ (D.transport z - z) (gradient (fun z ↦ Real.log (D.density 0 z)) z) ∂μ) ≤
      Real.sqrt (fisherInformation D G) *
        Real.sqrt (‖p₀ - p₁‖ ^ 2 + (eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ).toReal ^ 2) := by
  let v : Z → Z := fun z ↦ D.transport z - z
  let score : Z → Z := fun z ↦ gradient (fun z ↦ Real.log (D.density 0 z)) z
  let L : Z → Z := fun z ↦ (G z).snd + score z
  have hv : MemLp v 2 μ := by
    convert hc.neg using 1
    funext z
    simp [v]
  have hfst := joint_fst_memLp G hG
  have hsnd := joint_snd_memLp G hG
  have hL : MemLp L 2 μ := hsnd.add hs
  have hip := integrable_inner_memLp (fun z ↦ (G z).snd) v hsnd hv
  have his := integrable_inner_memLp score v hs hv
  have hpar := (hfst.integrable (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2)).inner_const
    (𝕜 := ℝ) (p₁ - p₀)
  have hparEq : (∫ z, inner ℝ (G z).fst (p₁ - p₀) ∂μ) =
      inner ℝ (∫ z, (G z).fst ∂μ) (p₁ - p₀) := by
    simpa only [real_inner_comm] using
      integral_inner (hfst.integrable (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2)) (p₁ - p₀)
  have hagg : (∫ z, inner ℝ (G z) (displacementField D p₀ p₁ z) ∂μ) +
      (∫ z, inner ℝ (v z) (score z) ∂μ) =
      inner ℝ (∫ z, (G z).fst ∂μ) (p₁ - p₀) + ∫ z, inner ℝ (L z) (v z) ∂μ := by
    simp only [displacementField, WithLp.prod_inner_apply, PBGSO.ProductTransport.embed]
    change (∫ z, inner ℝ (G z).fst (p₁ - p₀) + inner ℝ (G z).snd (v z) ∂μ) +
      (∫ z, inner ℝ (v z) (score z) ∂μ) = _
    rw [integral_add hpar hip, hparEq]
    simp only [L, inner_add_left]
    rw [integral_add hip his]
    simp only [real_inner_comm (v _) (score _)]
    ring
  have hparam : -inner ℝ (∫ z, (G z).fst ∂μ) (p₁ - p₀) ≤
      ‖∫ z, (G z).fst ∂μ‖ * ‖p₀ - p₁‖ := by
    simpa only [inner_neg_left, norm_neg, norm_sub_rev] using
      real_inner_le_norm (-(∫ z, (G z).fst ∂μ)) (p₁ - p₀)
  have hlatent : -(∫ z, inner ℝ (L z) (v z) ∂μ) ≤
      (eLpNorm L 2 μ).toReal * (eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ).toReal := by
    have h := integral_inner_le_secondCost μ (-L) v hL.neg hv
    have hvnorm : eLpNorm v 2 μ = eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ := by
      calc
        eLpNorm v 2 μ = eLpNorm (-(fun z ↦ z - D.transport z)) 2 μ := by
          congr 1
          funext z
          simp [v]
        _ = _ := eLpNorm_neg _ _ _
    simpa only [Pi.neg_apply, inner_neg_left, integral_neg, eLpNorm_neg, hvnorm] using h
  have hI : fisherInformation D G =
      ‖∫ z, (G z).fst ∂μ‖ ^ 2 + (eLpNorm L 2 μ).toReal ^ 2 := by
    rw [fisherInformation, secondCost_sq_eq_integral μ L hL]
  have hCS := sqrt_cauchy_two ‖∫ z, (G z).fst ∂μ‖ (eLpNorm L 2 μ).toReal
    ‖p₀ - p₁‖ (eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ).toReal
    (norm_nonneg _) ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  change - ((∫ z, inner ℝ (G z) (displacementField D p₀ p₁ z) ∂μ) +
    ∫ z, inner ℝ (v z) (score z) ∂μ) ≤ _
  rw [hagg, hI]
  linarith

    (D : RegularDisplacement (volume : Measure Z) μ d)
    (U : P → Z → ℝ) (p₀ p₁ : P) (rho : ℝ) (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (G : Z → PBGSO.ProductTransport.Joint P Z)
    (hU : StrongConvexOn univ rho
      (fun w : PBGSO.ProductTransport.Joint P Z ↦ U w.fst w.snd))
    (hG : ∀ z, HasGradientAt
      (fun w : PBGSO.ProductTransport.Joint P Z ↦ U w.fst w.snd)

    (hG2 : MemLp G 2 μ) (hc : MemLp (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ)
    (hs : MemLp (fun z ↦ gradient (fun z ↦ Real.log (D.density 0 z)) z) 2 μ)
    (hUmeas : ∀ p, Measurable (U p))
    (hU0 : Integrable (U p₀) μ) (hU1 : Integrable (fun z ↦ U p₁ (D.transport z)) μ)
    (hq : ContDiff ℝ 1 (D.density 0))
    (htail : RegularFlowCalculus.NoBoundaryFlux (fun z ↦ D.transport z - z) (D.density 0)) :
    2 * rho * (freeEnergy D U p₀ p₁ 0 - freeEnergy D U p₀ p₁ 1) ≤ fisherInformation D G

theorem extendedLSI
    (D : RegularDisplacement (volume : Measure Z) μ d)
    (U : P → Z → ℝ) (p₀ p₁ : P) (rho : ℝ) (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (G : Z → PBGSO.ProductTransport.Joint P Z)
    (hU : StrongConvexOn univ rho
      (fun w : PBGSO.ProductTransport.Joint P Z ↦ U w.fst w.snd))
    (hG : ∀ z, HasGradientAt
      (fun w : PBGSO.ProductTransport.Joint P Z ↦ U w.fst w.snd)
      (G z) (PBGSO.ProductTransport.embed p₀ z))
    (hG2 : MemLp G 2 μ) (hc : MemLp (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ)
    (hs : MemLp (fun z ↦ gradient (fun z ↦ Real.log (D.density 0 z)) z) 2 μ)
    (hUmeas : ∀ p, Measurable (U p))
    (hU0 : Integrable (U p₀) μ) (hU1 : Integrable (fun z ↦ U p₁ (D.transport z)) μ)
    (hq : ContDiff ℝ 1 (D.density 0))
    (htail : RegularFlowCalculus.NoBoundaryFlux (fun z ↦ D.transport z - z) (D.density 0)) :
    2 * rho * (freeEnergy D U p₀ p₁ 0 - freeEnergy D U p₀ p₁ 1) ≤ fisherInformation D G := by
  have ht := freeEnergy_tangent D U p₀ p₁ rho G hU hG hG2 hc hUmeas hU0 hU1 hq htail
  have hp := negative_tangent_pairing_le D p₀ p₁ G hG2 hc hs
  have hI : 0 ≤ fisherInformation D G := by
    exact add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (integral_nonneg fun z ↦ sq_nonneg _)
  apply LatentDiffusion.extendedLSI_of_firstOrder hrho hI
    (r := Real.sqrt (‖p₀ - p₁‖ ^ 2 + (eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - D.transport z) 2 μ).toReal ^ 2))
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
  linarith

structure DatasetRegularity (M d : ℕ) (p₀ p₁ : P) (rho : ℝ) where
  law : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z
  displacement : (m : Fin M) → RegularDisplacement volume (law m : Measure Z) d
  potential : Fin M → P → Z → ℝ

  potential_measurable : ∀ m p, Measurable (potential m p)
  potential_integrable_initial : ∀ m, Integrable (potential m p₀) (law m : Measure Z)
  potential_integrable_final : ∀ m,
    Integrable (fun z ↦ potential m p₁ ((displacement m).transport z)) (law m : Measure Z)
  potential_integrable_path : ∀ m s, s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    Integrable (fun z ↦ potential m (parameterInterpolate p₀ p₁ s)

    (fun w : PBGSO.ProductTransport.Joint P Z ↦ potential m w.fst w.snd)
    (potential_gradient m z) (PBGSO.ProductTransport.embed p₀ z)
  potential_gradient_memLp : ∀ m, MemLp (potential_gradient m) 2 (law m : Measure Z)
  displacement_memLp : ∀ m,
    MemLp (fun z ↦ z - (displacement m).transport z) 2 (law m : Measure Z)
  score_memLp : ∀ m,
    MemLp (fun z ↦ gradient (fun z ↦ Real.log ((displacement m).density 0 z)) z)
      2 (law m : Measure Z)
  density_C1 : ∀ m, ContDiff ℝ 1 ((displacement m).density 0)
  integrable_tails : ∀ m, RegularFlowCalculus.NoBoundaryFlux
    (fun z ↦ (displacement m).transport z - z) ((displacement m).density 0)

directionalPairing_le_slope.complete_declaration:
theorem directionalPairing_le_slope (hrho : 0 ≤ rho)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    R.directionalPairing ≤ slope R.freeEnergy 0 s := by
  have hpoint (m : Fin M) : s * ((∫ z, inner ℝ (R.potential_gradient m z)
      (displacementField (R.displacement m) p₀ p₁ z) ∂(R.law m : Measure Z)) +
      ∫ z, inner ℝ ((R.displacement m).transport z - z)
        (gradient (fun z ↦ Real.log ((R.displacement m).density 0 z)) z)
          ∂(R.law m : Measure Z)) ≤
      RegularTransport.freeEnergy (R.displacement m) (R.potential m) p₀ p₁ s-
        RegularTransport.freeEnergy (R.displacement m) (R.potential m) p₀ p₁ 0 := by
    have h := freeEnergy_tangent_at (R.displacement m) (R.potential m) p₀ p₁ rho
      (R.potential_gradient m) (R.potential_strong m) (R.potential_hasGradientAt m)
      (R.potential_gradient_memLp m) (R.displacement_memLp m) (R.potential_measurable m)
      (R.potential_integrable_initial m) (R.density_C1 m) (R.integrable_tails m)
      s ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2⟩ (R.potential_integrable_path m s ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2⟩)
    have hn : 0 ≤ rho / 2 * s ^ 2 * (‖p₀ - p₁‖ ^ 2+
        (eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - (R.displacement m).transport z) 2
          (R.law m : Measure Z)).toReal ^ 2) := by positivity
    linarith
  have hsum := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m (_ : m ∈ Finset.univ) ↦ hpoint m))
    (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg M))
  have hscaled : s * R.directionalPairing ≤ R.freeEnergy s - R.freeEnergy 0 := by
    unfold directionalPairing freeEnergy
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum] at hsum
    convert hsum using 1 <;> ring
  rw [slope_def_field]
  simp only [sub_zero]
  exact (le_div_iff₀ hs.1).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hscaled)

    2 * rho * (R.freeEnergy 0 - R.freeEnergy 1) ≤ R.fisherInformation
extendedLSI.complete_declaration:
theorem extendedLSI (hM : 0 < M) (hrho : 0 < rho) :
    2 * rho * (R.freeEnergy 0 - R.freeEnergy 1) ≤ R.fisherInformation := by
  let g : Fin M → P := fun m ↦
    ∫ z, (R.potential_gradient m z).fst ∂(R.law m : Measure Z)
  let pair : Fin M → ℝ := fun m ↦
    ∫ z, inner ℝ (R.latentScore m z) ((R.displacement m).transport z - z)
      ∂(R.law m : Measure Z)
  let b : Fin M → ℝ := fun m ↦
    (eLpNorm (R.latentScore m) 2 (R.law m : Measure Z)).toReal
  let c : Fin M → ℝ := fun m ↦
    (eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - (R.displacement m).transport z) 2 (R.law m : Measure Z)).toReal
  let gap : Fin M → ℝ := fun m ↦
    RegularTransport.freeEnergy (R.displacement m) (R.potential m) p₀ p₁ 0 -
      RegularTransport.freeEnergy (R.displacement m) (R.potential m) p₀ p₁ 1
  have htangent (m : Fin M) : gap m + inner ℝ (g m) (p₁ - p₀) + pair m+
      rho / 2 * (‖p₁ - p₀‖ ^ 2 + c m ^ 2) ≤ 0 := by
    let _ := (R.law m).property
    have ht := freeEnergy_tangent (R.displacement m) (R.potential m) p₀ p₁ rho
      (R.potential_gradient m) (R.potential_strong m) (R.potential_hasGradientAt m)
      (R.potential_gradient_memLp m) (R.displacement_memLp m) (R.potential_measurable m)
      (R.potential_integrable_initial m) (R.potential_integrable_final m)
      (R.density_C1 m) (R.integrable_tails m)
    have heq := tangent_pairing_eq (R.displacement m) p₀ p₁ (R.potential_gradient m)
      (R.potential_gradient_memLp m) (R.displacement_memLp m) (R.score_memLp m)
    rw [heq] at ht
    change inner ℝ (g m) (p₁ - p₀) + pair m+
      rho / 2 * (‖p₀ - p₁‖ ^ 2 + c m ^ 2) ≤ _ at ht
    rw [norm_sub_rev p₁ p₀]
    dsimp only [gap]
    linarith
  have hpair (m : Fin M) : -pair m ≤ b m * c m := by
    let _ := (R.law m).property
    let v : Z → Z := fun z ↦ (R.displacement m).transport z - z
    have hv : MemLp v 2 (R.law m : Measure Z) := by
      convert (R.displacement_memLp m).neg using 1
      funext z
      simp [v]
    have h := integral_inner_le_secondCost (R.law m : Measure Z)
      (-(R.latentScore m)) v (R.latentScore_memLp m).neg hv
    have hvnorm : eLpNorm v 2 (R.law m : Measure Z) =
        eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - (R.displacement m).transport z) 2 (R.law m : Measure Z) := by
      calc
        eLpNorm v 2 (R.law m : Measure Z) =
            eLpNorm (-(fun z ↦ z - (R.displacement m).transport z)) 2
              (R.law m : Measure Z) := by
          congr 1
          funext z
          simp [v]
        _ = _ := eLpNorm_neg _ _ _
    simpa only [Pi.neg_apply, inner_neg_left, integral_neg, hvnorm, eLpNorm_neg] using h
  have h := normalized_extendedLSI_of_tangents hM rho hrho (p₁ - p₀) gap pair b c g
    htangent hpair
  have hsq (m : Fin M) : b m ^ 2 =
      ∫ z, ‖R.latentScore m z‖ ^ 2 ∂(R.law m : Measure Z) := by
    exact secondCost_sq_eq_integral _ _ (R.latentScore_memLp m)
  simp_rw [hsq] at h
  simpa only [freeEnergy, fisherInformation, parameterForce, gap, g,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_sub] using h

distanceSq.complete_declaration:
def distanceSq : ℝ := ‖p₀ - p₁‖ ^ 2 + (M : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ m,
  ULA.wasserstein2Real (R.law m : Measure Z) ((R.displacement m).law 1) ^ 2

distanceSq_nonneg.complete_declaration:
theorem distanceSq_nonneg : 0 ≤ R.distanceSq := by
  exact add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (by positivity)
    (Finset.sum_nonneg fun m _ ↦ sq_nonneg _))

displacement_strongConvex.statement:
theorem displacement_strongConvex (hM : 0 < M) (hrho : 0 ≤ rho)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    R.freeEnergy s ≤ (1 - s) * R.freeEnergy 0 + s * R.freeEnergy 1-
      rho / 2 * s * (1 - s) * R.distanceSq
displacement_strongConvex.complete_declaration:
theorem displacement_strongConvex (hM : 0 < M) (hrho : 0 ≤ rho)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    R.freeEnergy s ≤ (1 - s) * R.freeEnergy 0 + s * R.freeEnergy 1-
      rho / 2 * s * (1 - s) * R.distanceSq := by
  have hm : (M : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hM.ne'
  have hpoint (m : Fin M) := freeEnergy_displacement_strongConvex
    (R.displacement m) (R.potential m) p₀ p₁ rho hrho (R.potential_strong m)
    (R.potential_measurable m) (R.potential_integrable_path m)
    (R.displacement_memLp m) s hs
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m (_ : m ∈ Finset.univ) ↦ hpoint m))
    (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg M))
  change R.freeEnergy s ≤ _ at h
  apply h.trans_eq
  simp only [freeEnergy, distanceSq, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  field_simp

talagrand.statement:
theorem talagrand (hM : 0 < M) (hrho : 0 ≤ rho)
    (hmin : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, R.freeEnergy 0 ≤ R.freeEnergy s) :
    rho / 2 * R.distanceSq ≤ R.freeEnergy 1 - R.freeEnergy 0
talagrand.complete_declaration:
theorem talagrand (hM : 0 < M) (hrho : 0 ≤ rho)
    (hmin : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, R.freeEnergy 0 ≤ R.freeEnergy s) :
    rho / 2 * R.distanceSq ≤ R.freeEnergy 1 - R.freeEnergy 0 := by
  have h := SourceResults.geodesic_quadratic_growth R.freeEnergy (R.freeEnergy 1)
    rho (Real.sqrt R.distanceSq) hmin
    (by simpa only [Real.sq_sqrt R.distanceSq_nonneg] using
      R.displacement_strongConvex hM hrho)
  simpa only [Real.sq_sqrt R.distanceSq_nonneg] using h

talagrand_final.statement:
theorem talagrand_final (hM : 0 < M) (hrho : 0 ≤ rho)
    (hmin : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, R.freeEnergy 1 ≤ R.freeEnergy s) :
    rho / 2 * R.distanceSq ≤ R.freeEnergy 0 - R.freeEnergy 1
talagrand_final.complete_declaration:
theorem talagrand_final (hM : 0 < M) (hrho : 0 ≤ rho)
    (hmin : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, R.freeEnergy 1 ≤ R.freeEnergy s) :
    rho / 2 * R.distanceSq ≤ R.freeEnergy 0 - R.freeEnergy 1 := by
  have hmin' : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      (fun s ↦ R.freeEnergy (1 - s)) 0 ≤ (fun s ↦ R.freeEnergy (1 - s)) s := by
    intro s hs
    simpa using hmin (1 - s) ⟨by linarith [hs.2], by linarith [hs.1]⟩
  have hconv : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      R.freeEnergy (1 - s) ≤ (1 - s) * R.freeEnergy (1 - 0) + s * R.freeEnergy 0-
        rho / 2 * s * (1 - s) * (Real.sqrt R.distanceSq) ^ 2 := by
    intro s hs
    have h := R.displacement_strongConvex hM hrho (1 - s)
      ⟨by linarith [hs.2], by linarith [hs.1]⟩
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt R.distanceSq_nonneg]
    simp only [sub_zero]
    convert h using 1
    ring
  have h := SourceResults.geodesic_quadratic_growth
    (fun s ↦ R.freeEnergy (1 - s)) (R.freeEnergy 0) rho
    (Real.sqrt R.distanceSq) hmin' hconv
  simpa only [Real.sq_sqrt R.distanceSq_nonneg, sub_zero] using h

set_option linter.style.header false

/-! # Actual regular Wasserstein geodesics

The distance is always the infimum over genuine quadratic couplings.  The
regular domain below requests finite-cost optimal Monge maps between its
positive smooth laws; it never postulates a geodesic or a distance formula.
-/

noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
open MeasureTheory Set

namespace LatentDiffusion.RegularTransport

  [CompleteSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]
  {μ ν : Measure Z}

/-- The displacement laws of an actual optimal map. -/




/-- The actual random-variable coupling of two interpolated laws bounds their
Wasserstein distance. No optimality of the intermediate coupling is assumed. -/

/-- Ordered-time formulation of constant-speed geodesicity in the genuine
Wasserstein distance. It includes both endpoints and all subintervals. -/

/-- Smooth optimal-map existence at intermediate densities is the additional
transport regularity required to glue couplings inside the regular domain. -/

/-- The classical smooth Brenier regularity certificate. The potential is
convex and its actual Fréchet gradient realizes the actual optimal map. -/

/-- Linear displacement by a regular optimal map is an actual constant-speed
Wasserstein geodesic. Constant speed follows from constructed couplings and
the proved optimal-map triangle inequality. -/

/-- Equality in the Hilbert triangle geometry forces the affine point. This
is applied to the actual L² transport displacement in the converse theorem. -/

namespace OptimalMap

/-- Gluing two optimal Monge maps across a geodesic split gives another
endpoint-optimal map. This is a construction, not an optimality assumption on

end OptimalMap

/-- On the regular optimal-map domain, every constant-speed geodesic is
exactly the displacement interpolation of the endpoint Brenier map. Endpoint
uniqueness is stated for actual optimal maps, and no intermediate affine or
geodesic representation is assumed. -/

/-- Corrected source geodesic characterization on the explicitly regular
optimal-map domain. Both implications concern the actual coupling-infimum

section Product

variable {P : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [InnerProductSpace ℝ P]
  {M : ℕ}



/-- Each component is an actual transport distance. The parameter coordinate
has weight one and each latent law has weight `sqrt(1/M)`. -/

/-- The source finite-product geodesic iff, fully proved for the actual

optimalInterpolation.statement: def optimalInterpolation (T : OptimalMap μ ν) (s : ℝ) : Measure Z
optimalInterpolation.complete_declaration:
def optimalInterpolation (T : OptimalMap μ ν) (s : ℝ) : Measure Z :=
  μ.map (interpolate T.transport s)

optimalInterpolation_zero.statement:
@[simp] theorem optimalInterpolation_zero (T : OptimalMap μ ν) :
    optimalInterpolation T 0 = μ
optimalInterpolation_zero.complete_declaration:
@[simp] theorem optimalInterpolation_zero (T : OptimalMap μ ν) :
    optimalInterpolation T 0 = μ := by simp [optimalInterpolation]

optimalInterpolation_one.statement:
@[simp] theorem optimalInterpolation_one (T : OptimalMap μ ν) :
    optimalInterpolation T 1 = ν
optimalInterpolation_one.complete_declaration:
@[simp] theorem optimalInterpolation_one (T : OptimalMap μ ν) :
    optimalInterpolation T 1 = ν := by simp [optimalInterpolation, T.pushes]

interpolation_difference.statement:
theorem interpolation_difference (T : Z → Z) (s t : ℝ) (z : Z) :
    interpolate T s z - interpolate T t z = (t - s) • (z - T z)
interpolation_difference.complete_declaration:
theorem interpolation_difference (T : Z → Z) (s t : ℝ) (z : Z) :
    interpolate T s z - interpolate T t z = (t - s) • (z - T z) := by
  unfold interpolate
  module

interpolation_distance_le.statement:
theorem interpolation_distance_le (T : OptimalMap μ ν) (s t : ℝ) :
    ULA.wasserstein2Real (optimalInterpolation T s) (optimalInterpolation T t) ≤
      |t - s| * ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν
interpolation_distance_le.complete_declaration:
theorem interpolation_distance_le (T : OptimalMap μ ν) (s t : ℝ) :
    ULA.wasserstein2Real (optimalInterpolation T s) (optimalInterpolation T t) ≤
      |t - s| * ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν := by
  have hmem : MemLp (fun z ↦ interpolate T.transport s z - interpolate T.transport t z) 2 μ := by
    convert T.finite_cost.const_smul (t - s) using 1
    funext z
    exact interpolation_difference _ _ _ _
  have h := ULA.wasserstein2_le_random_cost_real μ
    (interpolate T.transport s) (interpolate T.transport t)
    (interpolate_measurable _ T.measurable_transport s)
    (interpolate_measurable _ T.measurable_transport t) hmem
  rw [show (fun z ↦ interpolate T.transport s z - interpolate T.transport t z) =
    (t - s) • (fun z ↦ z - T.transport z) by
      funext z
      exact interpolation_difference _ _ _ _] at h
  rw [eLpNorm_const_smul, ENNReal.toReal_mul] at h
  simpa only [optimalInterpolation, ULA.wasserstein2Real, T.wasserstein_eq_cost,
    enorm_eq_nnnorm, ENNReal.coe_toReal, coe_nnnorm, Real.norm_eq_abs] using h

IsConstantSpeedGeodesic.statement: def IsConstantSpeedGeodesic (q : ℝ → Measure Z) : Prop

OptimalMapRegularity.statement: def OptimalMapRegularity (q : ℝ → Measure Z) : Prop
OptimalMapRegularity.complete_declaration:
def OptimalMapRegularity (q : ℝ → Measure Z) : Prop :=
  ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, Nonempty (OptimalMap (q s) (q t))

RegularBrenierMap.statement: structure RegularBrenierMap (μ ν : Measure Z) extends OptimalMap μ ν
RegularBrenierMap.complete_declaration:
structure RegularBrenierMap (μ ν : Measure Z) extends OptimalMap μ ν where
  potential : Z → ℝ
  potential_convex : ConvexOn ℝ univ potential
  hasGradientAt : ∀ z, HasGradientAt potential (transport z) z

optimalInterpolation_geodesic.statement:
theorem optimalInterpolation_geodesic (T : OptimalMap μ ν)
    (hregular : OptimalMapRegularity (optimalInterpolation T)) :
    IsConstantSpeedGeodesic (optimalInterpolation T)
optimalInterpolation_geodesic.complete_declaration:
theorem optimalInterpolation_geodesic (T : OptimalMap μ ν)
    (hregular : OptimalMapRegularity (optimalInterpolation T)) :
    IsConstantSpeedGeodesic (optimalInterpolation T) := by
  intro s hs t ht hst
  have hupper := interpolation_distance_le T s t
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hst)] at hupper
  simp only [optimalInterpolation_zero, optimalInterpolation_one]
  apply le_antisymm hupper
  obtain ⟨A⟩ := hregular 0 (by constructor <;> norm_num) s hs
  obtain ⟨B⟩ := hregular s hs 1 (by constructor <;> norm_num)
  obtain ⟨C⟩ := hregular s hs t ht
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := hregular t ht 1 (by constructor <;> norm_num)
  have htriangle1 := A.wassersteinReal_triangle B
  have htriangle2 := C.wassersteinReal_triangle D
  simp only [optimalInterpolation_zero, optimalInterpolation_one] at htriangle1 htriangle2
  have hleft := interpolation_distance_le T 0 s
  have hright := interpolation_distance_le T t 1
  simp only [sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hs.1, optimalInterpolation_zero,
    optimalInterpolation_one, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2)] at hleft hright
  nlinarith

affine_of_scaled_distances.statement:
theorem affine_of_scaled_distances {H : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    (a b : H) (s D : ℝ) (ha : ‖a‖ = s * D) (hb : ‖b‖ = D)
    (hba : ‖b - a‖ = (1 - s) * D) : a = s • b
affine_of_scaled_distances.complete_declaration:
theorem affine_of_scaled_distances {H : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    (a b : H) (s D : ℝ) (ha : ‖a‖ = s * D) (hb : ‖b‖ = D)
    (hba : ‖b - a‖ = (1 - s) * D) : a = s • b := by
  have hsq : ‖a - s • b‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
    have hba' := norm_sub_sq_real b a
    rw [norm_sub_sq_real, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs,
      real_inner_smul_right, ha, hb]
    rw [hba, ha, hb] at hba'
    have hi : inner ℝ a b = s * D ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith only [hba', real_inner_comm a b]
    rw [hi]
    ring
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp ((sq_eq_zero_iff).mp hsq))

compose_of_additive_distance.statement:
def compose_of_additive_distance {η : Measure Z}
    (T : OptimalMap μ ν) (A : OptimalMap μ η) (B : OptimalMap η ν)
    (hadd : ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν =
      ULA.wasserstein2Real μ η + ULA.wasserstein2Real η ν) : OptimalMap μ ν
compose_of_additive_distance.complete_declaration:
def compose_of_additive_distance {η : Measure Z}
    (T : OptimalMap μ ν) (A : OptimalMap μ η) (B : OptimalMap η ν)
    (hadd : ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν =
      ULA.wasserstein2Real μ η + ULA.wasserstein2Real η ν) : OptimalMap μ ν := by
  have hB : MemLp (fun z ↦ A.transport z - B.transport (A.transport z)) 2 μ := by
    have hbmap : MemLp (fun z ↦ z - B.transport z) 2 (μ.map A.transport) := by
      simpa only [A.pushes] using B.finite_cost
    exact hbmap.comp_of_map A.measurable_transport.aemeasurable
  have hcomp : MemLp (fun z ↦ z - B.transport (A.transport z)) 2 μ := by
    convert A.finite_cost.add hB using 1
    funext z
    simp
  have hcost : eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - B.transport (A.transport z)) 2 μ ≤
      eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - A.transport z) 2 μ+
        eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - B.transport z) 2 η := by
    calc
      _ = eLpNorm ((fun z ↦ z - A.transport z)+
          (fun z ↦ A.transport z - B.transport (A.transport z))) 2 μ := by
        congr 1
        funext z
        simp
      _ ≤ _ := eLpNorm_add_le (by norm_num)
      _ = _ := by
        congr 1
        have hm := eLpNorm_map_measure (μ := μ) (p := 2)
          (g := fun z ↦ z - B.transport z)
          (measurable_id.sub B.measurable_transport).aestronglyMeasurable
          A.measurable_transport.aemeasurable
        simpa only [A.pushes, Function.comp_def] using hm.symm
  have hreal := ENNReal.toReal_mono
    (ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨A.finite_cost.eLpNorm_ne_top, B.finite_cost.eLpNorm_ne_top⟩) hcost
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_add A.finite_cost.eLpNorm_ne_top B.finite_cost.eLpNorm_ne_top] at hreal
  have hbound : eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - B.transport (A.transport z)) 2 μ ≤
      ULA.wasserstein2 μ ν := by
    apply (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal hcomp.eLpNorm_ne_top T.wasserstein_ne_top).mp
    change (eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - B.transport (A.transport z)) 2 μ).toReal ≤
      ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν
    rw [hadd]
    simpa only [ULA.wasserstein2Real, A.wasserstein_eq_cost, B.wasserstein_eq_cost] using hreal
  exact {
    transport := B.transport ∘ A.transport
    measurable_transport := B.measurable_transport.comp A.measurable_transport
    pushes := by
      rw [← Measure.map_map B.measurable_transport A.measurable_transport,
        A.pushes, B.pushes]
    finite_cost := hcomp
    minimal := fun c ↦ hbound.trans (ULA.wasserstein2_le_couplingCost c) }

geodesic_eq_optimalInterpolation.statement:
theorem geodesic_eq_optimalInterpolation
    (q : ℝ → Measure Z) (T : OptimalMap (q 0) (q 1))
    (hunique : ∀ S : OptimalMap (q 0) (q 1), S.transport =ᵐ[q 0] T.transport)
    (hregular : OptimalMapRegularity q) (hgeodesic : IsConstantSpeedGeodesic q)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    q s = optimalInterpolation T s
geodesic_eq_optimalInterpolation.complete_declaration:
theorem geodesic_eq_optimalInterpolation
    (q : ℝ → Measure Z) (T : OptimalMap (q 0) (q 1))
    (hunique : ∀ S : OptimalMap (q 0) (q 1), S.transport =ᵐ[q 0] T.transport)
    (hregular : OptimalMapRegularity q) (hgeodesic : IsConstantSpeedGeodesic q)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    q s = optimalInterpolation T s := by
  obtain ⟨A⟩ := hregular 0 (by constructor <;> norm_num) s hs
  obtain ⟨B⟩ := hregular s hs 1 (by constructor <;> norm_num)
  let D := ULA.wasserstein2Real (q 0) (q 1)
  have hA : ULA.wasserstein2Real (q 0) (q s) = s * D := by
    simpa [D] using hgeodesic 0 (by constructor <;> norm_num) s hs hs.1
  have hB : ULA.wasserstein2Real (q s) (q 1) = (1 - s) * D :=
    hgeodesic s hs 1 (by constructor <;> norm_num) hs.2
  have hadd : ULA.wasserstein2Real (q 0) (q 1) =
      ULA.wasserstein2Real (q 0) (q s) + ULA.wasserstein2Real (q s) (q 1) := by
    rw [hA, hB]
    dsimp [D]
    ring
  let C := T.compose_of_additive_distance A B hadd
  have hC : ∀ᵐ z ∂q 0, B.transport (A.transport z) = T.transport z := hunique C
  let a := A.finite_cost.toLp (fun z ↦ z - A.transport z)
  let b := T.finite_cost.toLp (fun z ↦ z - T.transport z)
  have ha : ‖a‖ = s * D := by
    rw [Lp.norm_toLp]
    simpa only [ULA.wasserstein2Real, A.wasserstein_eq_cost] using hA
  have hb : ‖b‖ = D := by
    rw [Lp.norm_toLp]
    exact (congrArg ENNReal.toReal T.wasserstein_eq_cost).symm
  have hba : ‖b - a‖ = (1 - s) * D := by
    have heq : (fun z ↦ (b - a) z) =ᵐ[q 0]
        (fun z ↦ A.transport z - B.transport (A.transport z)) := by
      filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub b a, A.finite_cost.coeFn_toLp,
        T.finite_cost.coeFn_toLp, hC] with z hsub ha hb hc
      rw [hsub]
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
      change a z = z - A.transport z at ha
      change b z = z - T.transport z at hb
      rw [ha, hb, ← hc]
      simp
    rw [Lp.norm_def, eLpNorm_congr_ae heq]
    have hm := eLpNorm_map_measure (μ := q 0) (p := 2)
      (g := fun z ↦ z - B.transport z)
      (measurable_id.sub B.measurable_transport).aestronglyMeasurable
      A.measurable_transport.aemeasurable
    have hcost : eLpNorm (fun z ↦ A.transport z - B.transport (A.transport z)) 2 (q 0) =
        eLpNorm (fun z ↦ z - B.transport z) 2 (q s) := by
      simpa only [A.pushes, Function.comp_def] using hm.symm
    rw [hcost]
    rw [ULA.wasserstein2Real, B.wasserstein_eq_cost] at hB
    exact hB
  have hab := affine_of_scaled_distances a b s D ha hb hba
  have hmap : A.transport =ᵐ[q 0] interpolate T.transport s := by
    have hLp : (fun z ↦ a z) =ᵐ[q 0] (fun z ↦ (s • b) z) := by
      rw [hab]
    filter_upwards [hLp, A.finite_cost.coeFn_toLp, T.finite_cost.coeFn_toLp,
      Lp.coeFn_smul s b] with z hab ha hb hsmul
    rw [hsmul] at hab
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply] at hab
    change a z = z - A.transport z at ha
    change b z = z - T.transport z at hb
    rw [ha, hb] at hab
    unfold interpolate
    have hz : z - A.transport z = s • (z - T.transport z) := hab
    calc
      A.transport z = z - (z - A.transport z) := by abel
      _ = z - s • (z - T.transport z) := by rw [hz]
      _ = (1 - s) • z + s • T.transport z := by module

theorem nonnegative_vector_norm_mono {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (x y : I → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) (hy : ∀ i, 0 ≤ y i)
    (hxy : ∀ i, x i ≤ y i) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℝ I)‖ ≤ ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 y : EuclideanSpace ℝ I)‖
