theorem nonnegative_vector_norm_mono {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (x y : I → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) (hy : ∀ i, 0 ≤ y i)
    (hxy : ∀ i, x i ≤ y i) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℝ I)‖ ≤ ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 y : EuclideanSpace ℝ I)‖ := by
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ ↦ (sq_le_sq₀ (hx i) (hy i)).mpr (hxy i)

nonnegative_vector_eq_of_norm_eq.statement:
theorem nonnegative_vector_eq_of_norm_eq {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (x y : I → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) (hy : ∀ i, 0 ≤ y i)
    (hxy : ∀ i, x i ≤ y i)
    (hnorm : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℝ I)‖ =
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 y : EuclideanSpace ℝ I)‖) : x = y
nonnegative_vector_eq_of_norm_eq.complete_declaration:
theorem nonnegative_vector_eq_of_norm_eq {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (x y : I → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) (hy : ∀ i, 0 ≤ y i)
    (hxy : ∀ i, x i ≤ y i)
    (hnorm : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℝ I)‖ =
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 y : EuclideanSpace ℝ I)‖) : x = y := by
  have hs : (∑ i, (y i ^ 2 - x i ^ 2)) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun r : ℝ ↦ r ^ 2) hnorm
    rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq] at h
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr h.symm
  have hnonneg (i : I) : 0 ≤ y i ^ 2 - x i ^ 2 :=
    sub_nonneg.mpr ((sq_le_sq₀ (hx i) (hy i)).mpr (hxy i))
  funext i
  have hi := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun i _ ↦ hnonneg i)).mp hs i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (hx i) (hy i)).mp (sub_eq_zero.mp hi).symm

component_split_of_product_split.statement:
theorem component_split_of_product_split {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (d x y : I → ℝ) (hd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) (hy : ∀ i, 0 ≤ y i)
    (htri : ∀ i, d i ≤ x i + y i) (s D : ℝ)
    (hnormd : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 d : EuclideanSpace ℝ I)‖ = D)
    (hnormx : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℝ I)‖ = s * D)
    (hnormy : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 y : EuclideanSpace ℝ I)‖ = (1 - s) * D) :
    ∀ i, x i = s * d i
component_split_of_product_split.complete_declaration:
theorem component_split_of_product_split {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (d x y : I → ℝ) (hd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) (hy : ∀ i, 0 ≤ y i)
    (htri : ∀ i, d i ≤ x i + y i) (s D : ℝ)
    (hnormd : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 d : EuclideanSpace ℝ I)‖ = D)
    (hnormx : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℝ I)‖ = s * D)
    (hnormy : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 y : EuclideanSpace ℝ I)‖ = (1 - s) * D) :
    ∀ i, x i = s * d i := by
  let X : EuclideanSpace ℝ I := WithLp.toLp 2 x
  let Y : EuclideanSpace ℝ I := WithLp.toLp 2 y
  let V : EuclideanSpace ℝ I := WithLp.toLp 2 d
  have hlo : ‖V‖ ≤ ‖X + Y‖ := by
    exact nonnegative_vector_norm_mono d (fun i ↦ x i + y i) hd
      (fun i ↦ add_nonneg (hx i) (hy i)) htri
  have hhi : ‖X + Y‖ ≤ ‖V‖ := by
    have h := norm_add_le X Y
    have hx' : ‖X‖ = s * D := hnormx
    have hy' : ‖Y‖ = (1 - s) * D := hnormy
    have hd' : ‖V‖ = D := hnormd
    rw [hx', hy'] at h
    rw [hd']
    nlinarith
  have heq : V = X + Y := by
    have hfun := nonnegative_vector_eq_of_norm_eq d (fun i ↦ x i + y i) hd
      (fun i ↦ add_nonneg (hx i) (hy i)) htri (le_antisymm hlo hhi)
    exact congrArg (WithLp.toLp 2) hfun
  have hdiff : ‖V - X‖ = (1 - s) * D := by
    rw [heq, add_sub_cancel_left]
    exact hnormy
  have haff := affine_of_scaled_distances X V s D hnormx hnormd hdiff
  intro i
  exact congrArg (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ I ↦ z i) haff

distanceComponents_triangle.statement:
theorem distanceComponents_triangle
    (a : ℝ → P) (q : ℝ → Fin M → Measure Z)
    (hregular : ∀ m, OptimalMapRegularity (fun t ↦ q t m))
    (s t u : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hu : u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (i : Option (Fin M)) :
    distanceComponents a q s u i ≤ distanceComponents a q s t i + distanceComponents a q t u i
distanceComponents_triangle.complete_declaration:
theorem distanceComponents_triangle
    (a : ℝ → P) (q : ℝ → Fin M → Measure Z)
    (hregular : ∀ m, OptimalMapRegularity (fun t ↦ q t m))
    (s t u : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hu : u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (i : Option (Fin M)) :
    distanceComponents a q s u i ≤ distanceComponents a q s t i + distanceComponents a q t u i := by
  cases i with
  | none =>
    change ‖a s - a u‖ ≤ ‖a s - a t‖ + ‖a t - a u‖
    calc
      _ = ‖(a s - a t) + (a t - a u)‖ := by congr 1; abel
      _ ≤ _ := norm_add_le _ _
  | some m =>
    obtain ⟨A⟩ := hregular m s hs t ht
    obtain ⟨B⟩ := hregular m t ht u hu
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (A.wassersteinReal_triangle B)
      (Real.sqrt_nonneg (M : ℝ)⁻¹)
    simpa only [distanceComponents, mul_add] using h

product_geodesic_endpoint_scaling.statement:
theorem product_geodesic_endpoint_scaling
    (a : ℝ → P) (q : ℝ → Fin M → Measure Z)
    (hregular : ∀ m, OptimalMapRegularity (fun t ↦ q t m))
    (hg : IsProductGeodesic a q) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∀ i, distanceComponents a q 0 s i = s * distanceComponents a q 0 1 i ∧
      distanceComponents a q s 1 i = (1 - s) * distanceComponents a q 0 1 i
product_geodesic_endpoint_scaling.complete_declaration:
theorem product_geodesic_endpoint_scaling
    (a : ℝ → P) (q : ℝ → Fin M → Measure Z)
    (hregular : ∀ m, OptimalMapRegularity (fun t ↦ q t m))
    (hg : IsProductGeodesic a q) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∀ i, distanceComponents a q 0 s i = s * distanceComponents a q 0 1 i ∧
      distanceComponents a q s 1 i = (1 - s) * distanceComponents a q 0 1 i := by
  have hzero : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 1 := by constructor <;> norm_num
  have hone : (1 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 1 := by constructor <;> norm_num
  have hnx : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (distanceComponents a q 0 s) :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Option (Fin M)))‖ = s * productDistance a q 0 1 := by
    rw [distanceComponents_norm]
    simpa only [sub_zero] using hg 0 hzero s hs hs.1
  have hny : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (distanceComponents a q s 1) :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Option (Fin M)))‖ = (1 - s) * productDistance a q 0 1 := by
    rw [distanceComponents_norm]
    exact hg s hs 1 hone hs.2
  have hfirst := component_split_of_product_split
    (distanceComponents a q 0 1) (distanceComponents a q 0 s) (distanceComponents a q s 1)
    (distanceComponents_nonneg a q 0 1) (distanceComponents_nonneg a q 0 s)
    (distanceComponents_nonneg a q s 1)
    (distanceComponents_triangle a q hregular 0 s 1 hzero hs hone) s
    (productDistance a q 0 1) (distanceComponents_norm a q 0 1) hnx hny
  have hsecond := component_split_of_product_split
    (distanceComponents a q 0 1) (distanceComponents a q s 1) (distanceComponents a q 0 s)
    (distanceComponents_nonneg a q 0 1) (distanceComponents_nonneg a q s 1)
    (distanceComponents_nonneg a q 0 s)
    (fun i ↦ by simpa only [add_comm] using
      distanceComponents_triangle a q hregular 0 s 1 hzero hs hone i) (1 - s)
    (productDistance a q 0 1) (distanceComponents_norm a q 0 1) hny
    (by simpa only [sub_sub_cancel] using hnx)
  exact fun i ↦ ⟨hfirst i, hsecond i⟩

theorem product_geodesic_component_scaling
    (a : ℝ → P) (q : ℝ → Fin M → Measure Z)
    (hregular : ∀ m, OptimalMapRegularity (fun t ↦ q t m))
    (hg : IsProductGeodesic a q) (s t : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hst : s ≤ t) (i : Option (Fin M)) :
    distanceComponents a q s t i = (t - s) * distanceComponents a q 0 1 i
product_geodesic_component_scaling.complete_declaration:
theorem product_geodesic_component_scaling
    (a : ℝ → P) (q : ℝ → Fin M → Measure Z)
    (hregular : ∀ m, OptimalMapRegularity (fun t ↦ q t m))
    (hg : IsProductGeodesic a q) (s t : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hst : s ≤ t) (i : Option (Fin M)) :
    distanceComponents a q s t i = (t - s) * distanceComponents a q 0 1 i := by
  let low : Option (Fin M) → ℝ := fun i ↦ (t - s) * distanceComponents a q 0 1 i
  let high := distanceComponents a q s t
  have hlo : ∀ i, 0 ≤ low i := fun i ↦ mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hst)
    (distanceComponents_nonneg a q 0 1 i)
  have hhi : ∀ i, 0 ≤ high i := distanceComponents_nonneg a q s t
  have hpoint (i : Option (Fin M)) : low i ≤ high i := by
    have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 1 := by constructor <;> norm_num
    have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 1 := by constructor <;> norm_num
    have hleft := distanceComponents_triangle a q hregular 0 s 1 h0 hs h1 i
    have hright := distanceComponents_triangle a q hregular s t 1 hs ht h1 i
    have hxs := (product_geodesic_endpoint_scaling a q hregular hg s hs i).1
    have hyt := (product_geodesic_endpoint_scaling a q hregular hg t ht i).2
    dsimp only [low, high]
    nlinarith
  have hnorm : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 low : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Option (Fin M)))‖ =
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 high : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Option (Fin M)))‖ := by
    have hvec : (WithLp.toLp 2 low : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Option (Fin M))) =
        (t - s) • (WithLp.toLp 2 (distanceComponents a q 0 1)) := rfl
    rw [hvec, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hst),
      distanceComponents_norm]
    change (t - s) * productDistance a q 0 1 =
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (distanceComponents a q s t) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Option (Fin M)))‖
    rw [distanceComponents_norm]
    exact (hg s hs t ht hst).symm
  have heq := nonnegative_vector_eq_of_norm_eq low high hlo hhi hpoint hnorm
  exact (congrFun heq i).symm

theorem product_geodesic_components (hM : 0 < M)
    (a : ℝ → P) (q : ℝ → Fin M → Measure Z)
    (hregular : ∀ m, OptimalMapRegularity (fun t ↦ q t m))
    (hg : IsProductGeodesic a q) :
    (∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, a s = parameterInterpolate (a 0) (a 1) s) ∧
      ∀ m, IsConstantSpeedGeodesic (fun t ↦ q t m)

theorem product_geodesic_components (hM : 0 < M)
    (a : ℝ → P) (q : ℝ → Fin M → Measure Z)
    (hregular : ∀ m, OptimalMapRegularity (fun t ↦ q t m))
    (hg : IsProductGeodesic a q) :
    (∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, a s = parameterInterpolate (a 0) (a 1) s) ∧
      ∀ m, IsConstantSpeedGeodesic (fun t ↦ q t m) := by
  constructor
  · intro s hs
    have hends := product_geodesic_endpoint_scaling a q hregular hg s hs none
    change ‖a 0 - a s‖ = s * ‖a 0 - a 1‖ ∧ ‖a s - a 1‖ = (1 - s) * ‖a 0 - a 1‖ at hends
    have ha : ‖a s - a 0‖ = s * ‖a 1 - a 0‖ := by simpa only [norm_sub_rev] using hends.1
    have hb : ‖a 1 - a 0‖ = ‖a 1 - a 0‖ := rfl
    have hba : ‖(a 1 - a 0) - (a s - a 0)‖ = (1 - s) * ‖a 1 - a 0‖ := by
      have he : (a 1 - a 0) - (a s - a 0) = a 1 - a s := by abel
      rw [he]
      simpa only [norm_sub_rev] using hends.2
    have heq := affine_of_scaled_distances (a s - a 0) (a 1 - a 0) s _ ha hb hba
    calc
      a s = a 0 + (a s - a 0) := by abel
      _ = a 0 + s • (a 1 - a 0) := by rw [heq]
      _ = parameterInterpolate (a 0) (a 1) s := by unfold parameterInterpolate; module
  · intro m s hs t ht hst
    have h := product_geodesic_component_scaling a q hregular hg s t hs ht hst (some m)
    change Real.sqrt (M : ℝ)⁻¹ * ULA.wasserstein2Real (q s m) (q t m) =
      (t - s) * (Real.sqrt (M : ℝ)⁻¹ * ULA.wasserstein2Real (q 0 m) (q 1 m)) at h
    have hw : Real.sqrt (M : ℝ)⁻¹ ≠ 0 :=
      (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (inv_pos.mpr (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hM))).ne'
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hw
    convert h using 1
    ring

theorem product_geodesic_of_components
    (a : ℝ → P) (q : ℝ → Fin M → Measure Z)
    (ha : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, a s = parameterInterpolate (a 0) (a 1) s)

    (a : ℝ → P) (q : ℝ → Fin M → Measure Z)

        ULA.wasserstein2Real (q 0 m) (q 1 m) ^ 2) := by ring
  rw [hfactor, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq (sub_nonneg.mpr hst)]

      (T m) (hunique m) (hregular m)).mpr (hq m)⟩

theorem product_geodesic_iff_gradientInterpolation (hM : 0 < M)
    (a : ℝ → P) (q : ℝ → Fin M → Measure Z)
    (T : ∀ m, RegularBrenierMap (q 0 m) (q 1 m))
    (hunique : ∀ m, ∀ S : OptimalMap (q 0 m) (q 1 m),
      S.transport =ᵐ[q 0 m] (T m).transport)
    (hregular : ∀ m, OptimalMapRegularity (fun t ↦ q t m)) :
    IsProductGeodesic a q ↔
      (∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, a s = parameterInterpolate (a 0) (a 1) s) ∧

          (fun z ↦ (1 - s) • z + s • gradient (T m).potential z)

theorem product_geodesic_iff_gradientInterpolation (hM : 0 < M)

/-! # Regular density models and the literal variational problem

All posterior laws below are constructed from the given densities. Arbitrary
finite-KL trial probability laws are represented by their actual Radon–Nikodym
derivatives. The additional assumptions are positivity, measurability,
normalization and finite entropy; a KL identity is never an input.
-/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter Set
open scoped Topology ENNReal

namespace LatentDiffusion.RegularVariational

variable {A Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] {M : ℕ}

/-- A regular unnormalized density model, with its actual positive normalizer. -/

variable {ν : Measure Z}




/-- The actual Radon–Nikodym density of an arbitrary trial law. -/


/-- Finite KL supplies the complete normalized, entropy-integrable RN domain. -/

/-- The trial density relative to the original reference measure. -/

/-- The literal density integral used in the source paper. -/

/-- Every finite-KL trial law has the actual source base density and integral.
No prescribed relative density or desired normalization identity is assumed. -/


/-- Corrected source Proposition: actual finite-KL laws and the literal
density integral, with the normalized posterior uniquely identified. -/

/-- The same source equivalence on a specified law domain, in particular the
paper's finite-second-moment domain. Only posterior membership is needed; no
extension of the minimization problem to inadmissible trial laws is used. -/

/-- Lower semicontinuity follows from primitive density convergence and an
integrable entropy-energy envelope, rather than being an assumed conclusion. -/

section DensityTopology

variable {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [FirstCountableTopology X]

/-- Pointwise continuous densities and potentials, with a common local
integrable envelope for entropy and potential energy. These are ordinary
dominated-convergence hypotheses; neither continuity nor semicontinuity of
the energy integral is assumed. X may carry the source product-Wasserstein
topology on a regular, uniformly dominated class of densities. -/




/-- The corrected compactness result for the actual density energy. -/

DensityModel.statement: structure DensityModel (A Z : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Z] (M : ℕ) (ν : Measure Z)
DensityModel.complete_declaration:
structure DensityModel (A Z : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Z] (M : ℕ) (ν : Measure Z) where
  density : A → Fin M → Z → ℝ
  measurable : ∀ a i, Measurable (density a i)
  positive : ∀ a i z, 0 < density a i z
  integrable : ∀ a i, Integrable (density a i) ν
  mass_positive : ∀ a i, 0 < ∫ z, density a i z ∂ν

DensityModel.mass.statement: def DensityModel.mass (D : DensityModel A Z M ν) (a : A) (i : Fin M) : ℝ
DensityModel.mass.complete_declaration:
def DensityModel.mass (D : DensityModel A Z M ν) (a : A) (i : Fin M) : ℝ :=
  ∫ z, D.density a i z ∂ν

DensityModel.posterior.statement:
def DensityModel.posterior (D : DensityModel A Z M ν) (a : A) (i : Fin M) :
    ProbabilityMeasure Z
DensityModel.posterior.complete_declaration:
def DensityModel.posterior (D : DensityModel A Z M ν) (a : A) (i : Fin M) :
    ProbabilityMeasure Z :=
  ⟨Density.posteriorMeasure ν (D.density a i) (D.mass a i),
    Density.posteriorMeasure_isProbability ν (D.density a i) (D.mass a i)
      (fun z ↦ (D.positive a i z).le) (D.mass_positive a i) (D.integrable a i) rfl⟩

DensityModel.family.statement: def DensityModel.family (D : DensityModel A Z M ν) : PosteriorFamily A Z M
DensityModel.family.complete_declaration:
def DensityModel.family (D : DensityModel A Z M ν) : PosteriorFamily A Z M where
  logEvidence a := (M : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, Real.log (D.mass a i)
  posterior := D.posterior

relativeDensity.statement: def relativeDensity (π q : ProbabilityMeasure Z) (z : Z) : ℝ
relativeDensity.complete_declaration:
def relativeDensity (π q : ProbabilityMeasure Z) (z : Z) : ℝ :=
  ((q : Measure Z).rnDeriv (π : Measure Z) z).toReal

rn_density_realizes.statement:
theorem rn_density_realizes (π q : ProbabilityMeasure Z)
    (hfinite : InformationTheory.klDiv (q : Measure Z) (π : Measure Z) ≠ ⊤) :
    Density.densityMeasure (π : Measure Z) (relativeDensity π q) = (q : Measure Z)
rn_density_realizes.complete_declaration:
theorem rn_density_realizes (π q : ProbabilityMeasure Z)
    (hfinite : InformationTheory.klDiv (q : Measure Z) (π : Measure Z) ≠ ⊤) :
    Density.densityMeasure (π : Measure Z) (relativeDensity π q) = (q : Measure Z) := by
  obtain ⟨hac, _⟩ := InformationTheory.klDiv_ne_top_iff.mp hfinite
  rw [← Measure.withDensity_rnDeriv_eq (q : Measure Z) (π : Measure Z) hac]
  apply withDensity_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [Measure.rnDeriv_lt_top (q : Measure Z) (π : Measure Z)] with z hz
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hz.ne

rn_density_domain.statement:
theorem rn_density_domain (π q : ProbabilityMeasure Z)
    (hfinite : InformationTheory.klDiv (q : Measure Z) (π : Measure Z) ≠ ⊤) :
    Measurable (relativeDensity π q) ∧
    (∀ z, 0 ≤ relativeDensity π q z) ∧
    Integrable (relativeDensity π q) (π : Measure Z) ∧
    (∫ z, relativeDensity π q z ∂(π : Measure Z)) = 1 ∧
    Integrable (fun z ↦ relativeDensity π q z * Real.log (relativeDensity π q z))
      (π : Measure Z)
rn_density_domain.complete_declaration:
theorem rn_density_domain (π q : ProbabilityMeasure Z)
    (hfinite : InformationTheory.klDiv (q : Measure Z) (π : Measure Z) ≠ ⊤) :
    Measurable (relativeDensity π q) ∧
    (∀ z, 0 ≤ relativeDensity π q z) ∧
    Integrable (relativeDensity π q) (π : Measure Z) ∧
    (∫ z, relativeDensity π q z ∂(π : Measure Z)) = 1 ∧
    Integrable (fun z ↦ relativeDensity π q z * Real.log (relativeDensity π q z))
      (π : Measure Z) := by
  obtain ⟨hac, hint⟩ := InformationTheory.klDiv_ne_top_iff.mp hfinite
  refine ⟨(Measure.measurable_rnDeriv _ _).ennreal_toReal,
    fun _ ↦ ENNReal.toReal_nonneg, Measure.integrable_toReal_rnDeriv, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [probReal_univ, relativeDensity] using Measure.integral_toReal_rnDeriv hac
  · exact (integrable_rnDeriv_mul_log_iff hac).mpr hint

DensityModel.trialDensity.statement:
def DensityModel.trialDensity (D : DensityModel A Z M ν) (a : A)
    (q : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z) (i : Fin M) : Z → ℝ

DensityModel.literalEnergy.statement:
def DensityModel.literalEnergy (D : DensityModel A Z M ν) (a : A)
    (q : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z) : ℝ
DensityModel.literalEnergy.complete_declaration:
def DensityModel.literalEnergy (D : DensityModel A Z M ν) (a : A)
    (q : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z) : ℝ :=
  (M : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ∫ z, D.trialDensity a q i z *
    Real.log (D.trialDensity a q i z / D.density a i z) ∂ν

DensityModel.literal_integral.statement:
theorem DensityModel.literal_integral (D : DensityModel A Z M ν) (a : A)
    (q : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z) (hadm : D.family.Admissible a q) (i : Fin M) :
    Density.densityMeasure ν (D.trialDensity a q i) = (q i : Measure Z) ∧
    Integrable (fun z ↦ D.trialDensity a q i z *
      Real.log (D.trialDensity a q i z / D.density a i z)) ν ∧
    (∫ z, D.trialDensity a q i z * Real.log (D.trialDensity a q i z / D.density a i z) ∂ν) =
      (InformationTheory.klDiv (q i : Measure Z) (D.posterior a i : Measure Z)).toReal -
        Real.log (D.mass a i)
DensityModel.literal_integral.complete_declaration:
theorem DensityModel.literal_integral (D : DensityModel A Z M ν) (a : A)
    (q : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z) (hadm : D.family.Admissible a q) (i : Fin M) :
    Density.densityMeasure ν (D.trialDensity a q i) = (q i : Measure Z) ∧
    Integrable (fun z ↦ D.trialDensity a q i z *
      Real.log (D.trialDensity a q i z / D.density a i z)) ν ∧
    (∫ z, D.trialDensity a q i z * Real.log (D.trialDensity a q i z / D.density a i z) ∂ν) =
      (InformationTheory.klDiv (q i : Measure Z) (D.posterior a i : Measure Z)).toReal -
        Real.log (D.mass a i) := by
  have hfinite := hadm i
  obtain ⟨hmeas, hnonneg, hint, hmass, hent⟩ :=
    rn_density_domain (D.posterior a i) (q i) hfinite
  have hreal := rn_density_realizes (D.posterior a i) (q i) hfinite
  have htrial := Density.trialMeasure_eq_relative ν (D.density a i)
    (relativeDensity (D.posterior a i) (q i)) (D.mass a i) (D.measurable a i) hmeas
    (fun z ↦ (D.positive a i z).le) (D.mass_positive a i)
  change Density.densityMeasure ν (D.trialDensity a q i) = _ at htrial
  have heq : Density.densityMeasure ν (D.trialDensity a q i) = (q i : Measure Z) :=
    htrial.trans hreal
  have h := Density.density_weighted_freeEnergy_eq_kl ν (D.density a i)
    (relativeDensity (D.posterior a i) (q i)) (D.mass a i) (D.measurable a i) hmeas
    (D.positive a i) hnonneg (D.mass_positive a i) (D.integrable a i) rfl hint hmass hent
  dsimp only at h
  change InformationTheory.klDiv (Density.densityMeasure ν (D.trialDensity a q i))
      (D.posterior a i : Measure Z) ≠ ⊤ ∧
    Integrable (fun z ↦ D.trialDensity a q i z *
      Real.log (D.trialDensity a q i z / D.density a i z)) ν ∧
    (∫ z, D.trialDensity a q i z * Real.log (D.trialDensity a q i z / D.density a i z) ∂ν) =
      (InformationTheory.klDiv (Density.densityMeasure ν (D.trialDensity a q i))
        (D.posterior a i : Measure Z)).toReal - Real.log (D.mass a i) at h
  rw [heq] at h
  exact ⟨heq, h.2.1, h.2.2⟩

DensityModel.literalEnergy_eq.statement:
theorem DensityModel.literalEnergy_eq (D : DensityModel A Z M ν) (a : A)
    (q : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z) (hadm : D.family.Admissible a q) :
    D.literalEnergy a q = D.family.freeEnergy a q
DensityModel.literalEnergy_eq.complete_declaration:
theorem DensityModel.literalEnergy_eq (D : DensityModel A Z M ν) (a : A)
    (q : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z) (hadm : D.family.Admissible a q) :
    D.literalEnergy a q = D.family.freeEnergy a q := by
  unfold literalEnergy
  simp_rw [(D.literal_integral a q hadm _).2.2]
  simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_sub, PosteriorFamily.freeEnergy, family]
  ring

DensityModel.literal_minimizers_iff.statement:
theorem DensityModel.literal_minimizers_iff (D : DensityModel A Z M ν) (hM : 0 < M)
    (a : A) (q : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z) :
    (D.family.Admissible a q ∧ ∀ b r, D.family.Admissible b r →
      D.literalEnergy a q ≤ D.literalEnergy b r) ↔
    (∀ b, D.family.logEvidence b ≤ D.family.logEvidence a) ∧ q = D.posterior a
DensityModel.literal_minimizers_iff.complete_declaration:
theorem DensityModel.literal_minimizers_iff (D : DensityModel A Z M ν) (hM : 0 < M)
    (a : A) (q : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z) :
    (D.family.Admissible a q ∧ ∀ b r, D.family.Admissible b r →
      D.literalEnergy a q ≤ D.literalEnergy b r) ↔
    (∀ b, D.family.logEvidence b ≤ D.family.logEvidence a) ∧ q = D.posterior a := by
  have hequiv : (D.family.Admissible a q ∧ ∀ b r, D.family.Admissible b r →
      D.literalEnergy a q ≤ D.literalEnergy b r) ↔ D.family.IsGlobalMin a q := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hadm, h⟩
      refine ⟨hadm, fun b r hr ↦ ?_⟩
      simpa only [D.literalEnergy_eq a q hadm, D.literalEnergy_eq b r hr] using h b r hr
    · rintro ⟨hadm, h⟩
      refine ⟨hadm, fun b r hr ↦ ?_⟩
      simpa only [D.literalEnergy_eq a q hadm, D.literalEnergy_eq b r hr] using h b r hr
  exact hequiv.trans (D.family.global_minimizers_iff hM a q)

DensityModel.literal_minimizers_on_iff.statement:
theorem DensityModel.literal_minimizers_on_iff (D : DensityModel A Z M ν) (hM : 0 < M)
    (domain : (Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z) → Prop)
    (hposterior : ∀ a, domain (D.posterior a)) (a : A) (q : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z) :
    (D.family.Admissible a q ∧ domain q ∧ ∀ b r, D.family.Admissible b r → domain r →
      D.literalEnergy a q ≤ D.literalEnergy b r) ↔
    (∀ b, D.family.logEvidence b ≤ D.family.logEvidence a) ∧ q = D.posterior a
DensityModel.literal_minimizers_on_iff.complete_declaration:
theorem DensityModel.literal_minimizers_on_iff (D : DensityModel A Z M ν) (hM : 0 < M)
    (domain : (Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z) → Prop)
    (hposterior : ∀ a, domain (D.posterior a)) (a : A) (q : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z) :
    (D.family.Admissible a q ∧ domain q ∧ ∀ b r, D.family.Admissible b r → domain r →
      D.literalEnergy a q ≤ D.literalEnergy b r) ↔
    (∀ b, D.family.logEvidence b ≤ D.family.logEvidence a) ∧ q = D.posterior a := by
  have hpostenergy (b : A) : D.family.freeEnergy b (D.posterior b) =
      -D.family.logEvidence b := D.family.posterior_freeEnergy b
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hadm, _, hmin⟩
    have hpost := D.family.posterior_admissible a
    have he : D.family.freeEnergy a q = -D.family.logEvidence a := by
      apply le_antisymm _ (D.family.lower_bound a q)
      have h := hmin a (D.posterior a) hpost (hposterior a)
      rw [D.literalEnergy_eq a q hadm, D.literalEnergy_eq a (D.posterior a) hpost,
        hpostenergy] at h
      exact h
    refine ⟨fun b ↦ ?_, (D.family.equality_iff hM a q hadm).mp he⟩
    have h := hmin b (D.posterior b) (D.family.posterior_admissible b) (hposterior b)
    rw [D.literalEnergy_eq a q hadm,
      D.literalEnergy_eq b (D.posterior b) (D.family.posterior_admissible b),
      he, hpostenergy] at h
    linarith
  · rintro ⟨hmax, rfl⟩
    have hpost := D.family.posterior_admissible a
    refine ⟨hpost, hposterior a, fun b r hr _ ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [D.literalEnergy_eq a (D.posterior a) hpost,
      D.literalEnergy_eq b r hr, hpostenergy]
    exact (neg_le_neg (hmax b)).trans (D.family.lower_bound b r)

literalEnergy_tendsto_of_dominated.statement:
theorem literalEnergy_tendsto_of_dominated
    (ν : Measure Z) (q : ℕ → Z → ℝ) (q₀ : Z → ℝ)
    (U : ℕ → Z → ℝ) (U₀ bound : Z → ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ n, Measurable (q n)) (hU : ∀ n, Measurable (U n))
    (hbound : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ z ∂ν,
      |q n z * Real.log (q n z) + q n z * U n z| ≤ bound z)
    (hint : Integrable bound ν)
    (hqlim : ∀ᵐ z ∂ν, Tendsto (fun n ↦ q n z) atTop (𝓝 (q₀ z)))
    (hUlim : ∀ᵐ z ∂ν, Tendsto (fun n ↦ U n z) atTop (𝓝 (U₀ z))) :
    Tendsto (fun n ↦ SourceCalculus.densityFreeEnergy ν (q n) (U n)) atTop
      (𝓝 (SourceCalculus.densityFreeEnergy ν q₀ U₀))
literalEnergy_tendsto_of_dominated.complete_declaration:
theorem literalEnergy_tendsto_of_dominated
    (ν : Measure Z) (q : ℕ → Z → ℝ) (q₀ : Z → ℝ)
    (U : ℕ → Z → ℝ) (U₀ bound : Z → ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ n, Measurable (q n)) (hU : ∀ n, Measurable (U n))
    (hbound : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ z ∂ν,
      |q n z * Real.log (q n z) + q n z * U n z| ≤ bound z)
    (hint : Integrable bound ν)
    (hqlim : ∀ᵐ z ∂ν, Tendsto (fun n ↦ q n z) atTop (𝓝 (q₀ z)))
    (hUlim : ∀ᵐ z ∂ν, Tendsto (fun n ↦ U n z) atTop (𝓝 (U₀ z))) :
    Tendsto (fun n ↦ SourceCalculus.densityFreeEnergy ν (q n) (U n)) atTop
      (𝓝 (SourceCalculus.densityFreeEnergy ν q₀ U₀)) := by
  have h := tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence
    (μ := ν) (l := (atTop : Filter ℕ))
    (F := fun n z ↦ q n z * Real.log (q n z) + q n z * U n z)
    (f := fun z ↦ q₀ z * Real.log (q₀ z) + q₀ z * U₀ z) bound
    (Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦ ((hq n).mul (hq n).log |>.add ((hq n).mul (hU n))).aestronglyMeasurable)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦ by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound n) hint ?_
  · simpa only [SourceCalculus.densityFreeEnergy, mul_add] using h
  · filter_upwards [hqlim, hUlim] with z hqz hUz
    exact ((Real.continuous_mul_log.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hqz).add (hqz.mul hUz))

DominatedDensityChart.statement:
structure DominatedDensityChart (X Z : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace Z] (ν : Measure Z)
DominatedDensityChart.complete_declaration:
structure DominatedDensityChart (X Z : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace Z] (ν : Measure Z) where
  density : X → Z → ℝ
  potential : X → Z → ℝ
  density_measurable : ∀ x, Measurable (density x)
  potential_measurable : ∀ x, Measurable (potential x)
  density_continuous : ∀ z, Continuous (fun x ↦ density x z)
  potential_continuous : ∀ z, Continuous (fun x ↦ potential x z)
  envelope : ∀ x, ∃ bound : Z → ℝ, Integrable bound ν ∧
    ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∀ᵐ z ∂ν,
      |density y z * Real.log (density y z) + density y z * potential y z| ≤ bound z

DominatedDensityChart.energy.statement: def DominatedDensityChart.energy (D : DominatedDensityChart X Z ν) (x : X) : ℝ
DominatedDensityChart.energy.complete_declaration:
def DominatedDensityChart.energy (D : DominatedDensityChart X Z ν) (x : X) : ℝ :=
  SourceCalculus.densityFreeEnergy ν (D.density x) (D.potential x)

DominatedDensityChart.continuous_energy.statement:
theorem DominatedDensityChart.continuous_energy (D : DominatedDensityChart X Z ν) :
    Continuous D.energy
DominatedDensityChart.continuous_energy.complete_declaration:
theorem DominatedDensityChart.continuous_energy (D : DominatedDensityChart X Z ν) :
    Continuous D.energy := by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro x
  change Tendsto (fun y ↦ D.energy y) (𝓝 x) (𝓝 (D.energy x))
  obtain ⟨bound, hint, hbound⟩ := D.envelope x
  have h := tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence
    (μ := ν) (l := 𝓝 x)
    (F := fun y z ↦ D.density y z * Real.log (D.density y z) +
      D.density y z * D.potential y z)
    (f := fun z ↦ D.density x z * Real.log (D.density x z) +
      D.density x z * D.potential x z) bound
    (Eventually.of_forall fun y ↦
      ((D.density_measurable y).mul (D.density_measurable y).log |>.add
        ((D.density_measurable y).mul (D.potential_measurable y))).aestronglyMeasurable)
    (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound) hint
    (ae_of_all _ fun z ↦
      ((Real.continuous_mul_log.comp (D.density_continuous z)).tendsto x).add
        (((D.density_continuous z).tendsto x).mul ((D.potential_continuous z).tendsto x)))
  simpa only [energy, SourceCalculus.densityFreeEnergy, mul_add] using h

DominatedDensityChart.lowerSemicontinuou.complete_declaration:
theorem DominatedDensityChart.lowerSemicontinuous_energy
    (D : DominatedDensityChart X Z ν) : LowerSemicontinuous D.energy :=

theorem DominatedDensityChart.cauchy_minimizer
    {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X]

/-!
# Literal source regularity contracts

These are assumption translations, not existence theorems. In particular the
paper's universal solution premise includes strictly positive classical densities
at time zero even for arbitrary finite-second-moment initial laws. It is recorded
literally so that this strength is visible; it is not inferred from the other
source assumptions or used to hide an analytic bridge.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace LatentDiffusion.SourceAssumptions

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal

variable {P Z : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [NormedSpace ℝ Z]

/-- The source's normalized tilted posterior, with the normalizing constant
provided as model data. Normalization and existence of this constant are part of
the model interpretation, not proved by the regularity contract. -/

/-- The manuscript's model-regularity assumption. Parameter differentiability is
pointwise in the latent state; spatial regularity is pointwise in the parameter. -/

/-- The time-space domain in the source's C^{1,2} density assumption. -/

/-- Explicit partial derivatives and their joint continuity on the closed positive
time half-space. Time derivatives at zero are right derivatives, not derivatives
of an extension to negative time. This is the C^{1,2} meaning used here. -/

variable [MeasurableSpace Z]

/-- All data in a source classical solution. `flowEquation` is the actual gradient
flow equation chosen by the application, rather than a scalar energy estimate.
The density is required to realize the initial law as well as later laws. -/

/-- Literal universal solution-regularity premise: every parameter and every
finite-second-moment initial probability law admits the classical solution above.
This includes the source's density regularity and positivity at t=0. -/

section Potential

variable {H I : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The source's joint strong-log-concavity premise, expressed for each negative
log tilted density `U i` in the full parameter-latent pair space. -/

/-- The source's differentiable joint log-likelihood and positive global
gradient-Lipschitz constant. Negating a log density preserves this bound. -/

end Potential

end LatentDiffusion.SourceAssumptions

normalizedPosterior.statement: def normalizedPosterior (ρ : P → Z → ℝ) (A : P → ℝ) (p : P) (z : Z) : ℝ
normalizedPosterior.complete_declaration:
def normalizedPosterior (ρ : P → Z → ℝ) (A : P → ℝ) (p : P) (z : Z) : ℝ :=
  ρ p z / A p

ModelRegularity.statement: structure ModelRegularity (ρ : P → Z → ℝ) (A : P → ℝ) : Prop
ModelRegularity.complete_declaration:
structure ModelRegularity (ρ : P → Z → ℝ) (A : P → ℝ) : Prop where
  posterior_parameter_differentiable :
    ∀ z, Differentiable ℝ (fun p ↦ normalizedPosterior ρ A p z)
  evidence_differentiable : Differentiable ℝ A
  posterior_spatial_C2 : ∀ p, ContDiff ℝ 2 (normalizedPosterior ρ A p)
  tilted_positive : ∀ p z, 0 < ρ p z

timeSpaceDomain.complete_declaration: def timeSpaceDomain : Set (ℝ × Z) := Ici 0 ×ˢ univ

ClassicalDensityRegularity.statement: def ClassicalDensityRegularity {M : ℕ} (q : Fin M → ℝ → Z → ℝ) : Prop
ClassicalDensityRegularity.complete_declaration:
def ClassicalDensityRegularity {M : ℕ} (q : Fin M → ℝ → Z → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (dt : Fin M → ℝ → Z → ℝ)
    (dz : Fin M → ℝ → Z → (Z →L[ℝ] ℝ))
    (dzz : Fin M → ℝ → Z → (Z →L[ℝ] (Z →L[ℝ] ℝ))),
    ∀ m,
      ContinuousOn (fun tz : ℝ × Z ↦ q m tz.1 tz.2) timeSpaceDomain ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun tz : ℝ × Z ↦ dt m tz.1 tz.2) timeSpaceDomain ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun tz : ℝ × Z ↦ dz m tz.1 tz.2) timeSpaceDomain ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun tz : ℝ × Z ↦ dzz m tz.1 tz.2) timeSpaceDomain ∧
      (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ z, HasDerivWithinAt (fun s ↦ q m s z) (dt m t z) (Ici 0) t) ∧
      (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ z, HasFDerivAt (q m t) (dz m t z) z) ∧
      (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ z, HasFDerivAt (dz m t) (dzz m t z) z)

ClassicalSolution.statement:
structure ClassicalSolution {M : ℕ} (ν : Measure Z)
    (flowEquation : (ℝ → P) → (Fin M → ℝ → ProbabilityMeasure Z) → Prop)
    (p₀ : P) (μ₀ : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z)
ClassicalSolution.complete_declaration:
structure ClassicalSolution {M : ℕ} (ν : Measure Z)
    (flowEquation : (ℝ → P) → (Fin M → ℝ → ProbabilityMeasure Z) → Prop)
    (p₀ : P) (μ₀ : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z) where
  parameter : ℝ → P
  law : Fin M → ℝ → ProbabilityMeasure Z
  density : Fin M → ℝ → Z → ℝ
  initial_parameter : parameter 0 = p₀
  initial_law : ∀ m, law m 0 = μ₀ m
  parameter_C1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 parameter (Ici 0)
  density_C12 : ClassicalDensityRegularity density
  density_positive : ∀ m t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ z, 0 < density m t z
  density_realizes : ∀ m t, 0 ≤ t →
    (law m t : Measure Z) = ν.withDensity (fun z ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (density m t z))
  finite_second_moment : ∀ m t, 0 ≤ t → MemLp (fun z : Z ↦ z) 2 (law m t : Measure Z)
  solves : flowEquation parameter law

SolutionRegularity.statement:
def SolutionRegularity {M : ℕ} (ν : Measure Z)
    (flowEquation : (ℝ → P) → (Fin M → ℝ → ProbabilityMeasure Z) → Prop) : Prop
SolutionRegularity.complete_declaration:
def SolutionRegularity {M : ℕ} (ν : Measure Z)
    (flowEquation : (ℝ → P) → (Fin M → ℝ → ProbabilityMeasure Z) → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ (p₀ : P) (μ₀ : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z),
    (∀ m, MemLp (fun z : Z ↦ z) 2 (μ₀ m : Measure Z)) →
      Nonempty (ClassicalSolution ν flowEquation p₀ μ₀)

JointStrongLogConcavity.statement: structure JointStrongLogConcavity (U : I → H → ℝ) (m : ℝ) : Prop
JointStrongLogConcavity.complete_declaration:
structure JointStrongLogConcavity (U : I → H → ℝ) (m : ℝ) : Prop where
  positive : 0 < m
  strong : ∀ i, StrongConvexOn univ m (U i)

LipschitzGradient.statement: structure LipschitzGradient (U : I → H → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) : Prop
LipschitzGradient.complete_declaration:
structure LipschitzGradient (U : I → H → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) : Prop where
  positive : 0 < L
  differentiable : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (U i)
  lipschitz : ∀ i, LipschitzWith L (gradient (U i))

import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ParametricIntegral
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Deriv

/-!
# Dominated first variations of the actual density free-energy integral

Source: `papers/Latent_diffusion/supp_aistats.tex:188–199`,
Lemma `app:lemma_1st_var`.

The parameter result differentiates the actual integral, using pointwise
Fréchet derivatives and one integrable domination bound on a common parameter
neighborhood. The density result differentiates the actual integral along
`q + t r`, using positivity and integrable derivative domination on a common
interval. Neither result assumes the desired integral derivative.

These domination/integrability conditions are additional explicit analytic
hypotheses; the paper's A1 does not by itself establish them. The `+1` in the
ordinary entropy derivative disappears on zero-mass density perturbations.
No Wasserstein gradient, PDE integration by parts or flow construction is
claimed by this module.
-/

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped Topology

namespace LatentDiffusion.SourceCalculus

variable {Z A : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z]
  [NormedAddCommGroup A] [NormedSpace ℝ A]

/-- The actual base-density free energy with potential `U = -log ρ`. -/

/-- Parameter differentiation in source Lemma `app:lemma_1st_var`, with an
explicit weighted derivative bound that justifies differentiation under the
integral. The density is held fixed. In the source, use
`U(θ,φ,z) = L_D(θ,z) - log p_φ(x|z)` and split its derivative. -/

/-- The ordinary pointwise derivative along an affine density perturbation.
This is used below inside a dominated differentiation theorem. -/

/-- Genuine density-direction differentiation of the source free-energy
integral. Positivity and the domination bound hold on one common neighborhood
of zero, rather than point-dependent neighborhoods. -/

/-- On probability-density tangent directions the constant `+1` vanishes.
The conclusion is the source's density first variation, now for an actual
integral with all dominated-differentiation hypotheses exposed. -/

end LatentDiffusion.SourceCalculus

densityFreeEnergy.statement: def densityFreeEnergy (ν : Measure Z) (q U : Z → ℝ) : ℝ
densityFreeEnergy.complete_declaration:
def densityFreeEnergy (ν : Measure Z) (q U : Z → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ z, q z * (Real.log (q z) + U z) ∂ν

parameter_freeEnergy_hasFDerivAt.statement:
theorem parameter_freeEnergy_hasFDerivAt
    (ν : Measure Z) (q : Z → ℝ) (U : A → Z → ℝ)
    (DU : A → Z → A →L[ℝ] ℝ) (a₀ : A) (s : Set A) (bound : Z → ℝ)
    (hs : s ∈ 𝓝 a₀) (hq : Measurable q)
    (hU : ∀ᶠ a in 𝓝 a₀, Measurable (U a))
    (hbase : Integrable (fun z ↦ q z * (Real.log (q z) + U a₀ z)) ν)
    (hDU : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z ↦ q z • DU a₀ z) ν)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ z ∂ν, ∀ a ∈ s, |q z| * ‖DU a z‖ ≤ bound z)
    (hbound_int : Integrable bound ν)
    (hdiff : ∀ᵐ z ∂ν, ∀ a ∈ s, HasFDerivAt (fun b ↦ U b z) (DU a z) a) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun a ↦ densityFreeEnergy ν q (U a))
      (∫ z, q z • DU a₀ z ∂ν) a₀
parameter_freeEnergy_hasFDerivAt.complete_declaration:
theorem parameter_freeEnergy_hasFDerivAt
    (ν : Measure Z) (q : Z → ℝ) (U : A → Z → ℝ)
    (DU : A → Z → A →L[ℝ] ℝ) (a₀ : A) (s : Set A) (bound : Z → ℝ)
    (hs : s ∈ 𝓝 a₀) (hq : Measurable q)
    (hU : ∀ᶠ a in 𝓝 a₀, Measurable (U a))
    (hbase : Integrable (fun z ↦ q z * (Real.log (q z) + U a₀ z)) ν)
    (hDU : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z ↦ q z • DU a₀ z) ν)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ z ∂ν, ∀ a ∈ s, |q z| * ‖DU a z‖ ≤ bound z)
    (hbound_int : Integrable bound ν)
    (hdiff : ∀ᵐ z ∂ν, ∀ a ∈ s, HasFDerivAt (fun b ↦ U b z) (DU a z) a) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun a ↦ densityFreeEnergy ν q (U a))
      (∫ z, q z • DU a₀ z ∂ν) a₀ := by
  apply hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
    (F := fun a z ↦ q z * (Real.log (q z) + U a z))
    (F' := fun a z ↦ q z • DU a z) hs
  · filter_upwards [hU] with a ha
    exact (hq.mul (hq.log.add ha)).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact hbase
  · exact hDU
  · filter_upwards [hbound] with z hz a ha
    simpa only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs] using hz a ha
  · exact hbound_int
  · filter_upwards [hdiff] with z hz a ha
    exact ((hz a ha).const_add (Real.log (q z))).const_mul (q z)

density_integrand_hasDerivAt.statement:
theorem density_integrand_hasDerivAt (q r U t : ℝ) (hpositive : 0 < q + t * r) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ (q + s * r) * (Real.log (q + s * r) + U))
      (r * (Real.log (q + t * r) + U + 1)) t
density_integrand_hasDerivAt.complete_declaration:
theorem density_integrand_hasDerivAt (q r U t : ℝ) (hpositive : 0 < q + t * r) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ (q + s * r) * (Real.log (q + s * r) + U))
      (r * (Real.log (q + t * r) + U + 1)) t := by
  have hq : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ ↦ q + s * r) r t := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).mul_const r).const_add q
  have hlog := (hq.log (ne_of_gt hpositive)).add_const U
  have hcancel : (q + t * r) * (r / (q + t * r)) = r := by
    rw [mul_comm, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hpositive)]
  convert hq.mul hlog using 1
  rw [hcancel]
  ring

density_freeEnergy_hasDerivAt.statement:
theorem density_freeEnergy_hasDerivAt
    (ν : Measure Z) (q r U : Z → ℝ) (s : Set ℝ) (bound : Z → ℝ)
    (hs : s ∈ 𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) (hq : Measurable q) (hr : Measurable r)
    (hU : Measurable U)
    (hbase : Integrable (fun z ↦ q z * (Real.log (q z) + U z)) ν)
    (hpositive : ∀ᵐ z ∂ν, ∀ t ∈ s, 0 < q z + t * r z)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ z ∂ν, ∀ t ∈ s,
      |r z * (Real.log (q z + t * r z) + U z + 1)| ≤ bound z)
    (hbound_int : Integrable bound ν) :
    Integrable (fun z ↦ r z * (Real.log (q z) + U z + 1)) ν ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ densityFreeEnergy ν (fun z ↦ q z + t * r z) U)
        (∫ z, r z * (Real.log (q z) + U z + 1) ∂ν) 0
density_freeEnergy_hasDerivAt.complete_declaration:
theorem density_freeEnergy_hasDerivAt
    (ν : Measure Z) (q r U : Z → ℝ) (s : Set ℝ) (bound : Z → ℝ)
    (hs : s ∈ 𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) (hq : Measurable q) (hr : Measurable r)
    (hU : Measurable U)
    (hbase : Integrable (fun z ↦ q z * (Real.log (q z) + U z)) ν)
    (hpositive : ∀ᵐ z ∂ν, ∀ t ∈ s, 0 < q z + t * r z)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ z ∂ν, ∀ t ∈ s,
      |r z * (Real.log (q z + t * r z) + U z + 1)| ≤ bound z)
    (hbound_int : Integrable bound ν) :
    Integrable (fun z ↦ r z * (Real.log (q z) + U z + 1)) ν ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ densityFreeEnergy ν (fun z ↦ q z + t * r z) U)
        (∫ z, r z * (Real.log (q z) + U z + 1) ∂ν) 0 := by
  have hmeas : ∀ t : ℝ,
      Measurable (fun z ↦ (q z + t * r z) * (Real.log (q z + t * r z) + U z)) :=
    fun t ↦ (hq.add (hr.const_mul t)).mul ((hq.add (hr.const_mul t)).log.add hU)
  have hdmeas : Measurable (fun z ↦ r z * (Real.log (q z) + U z + 1)) :=
    hr.mul ((hq.log.add hU).add_const 1)
  have h := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
    (F := fun t z ↦ (q z + t * r z) * (Real.log (q z + t * r z) + U z))
    (F' := fun t z ↦ r z * (Real.log (q z + t * r z) + U z + 1)) hs
    (Eventually.of_forall fun t ↦ (hmeas t).aestronglyMeasurable)
    (by simpa using hbase)
    (by simpa using hdmeas.aestronglyMeasurable (μ := ν))
    (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound) hbound_int
    (by
      filter_upwards [hpositive] with z hz t ht
      exact density_integrand_hasDerivAt (q z) (r z) (U z) t (hz t ht))
  simpa only [zero_mul, add_zero, densityFreeEnergy] using h

density_firstVariation_of_zero_mass.statement:
theorem density_firstVariation_of_zero_mass
    (ν : Measure Z) (q r U : Z → ℝ) (s : Set ℝ) (bound : Z → ℝ)
    (hs : s ∈ 𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) (hq : Measurable q) (hr : Measurable r)
    (hU : Measurable U)
    (hbase : Integrable (fun z ↦ q z * (Real.log (q z) + U z)) ν)
    (hpositive : ∀ᵐ z ∂ν, ∀ t ∈ s, 0 < q z + t * r z)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ z ∂ν, ∀ t ∈ s,
      |r z * (Real.log (q z + t * r z) + U z + 1)| ≤ bound z)
    (hbound_int : Integrable bound ν)
    (hr_int : Integrable r ν) (hmass : (∫ z, r z ∂ν) = 0) :
    Integrable (fun z ↦ r z * (Real.log (q z) + U z)) ν ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ densityFreeEnergy ν (fun z ↦ q z + t * r z) U)
        (∫ z, r z * (Real.log (q z) + U z) ∂ν) 0
density_firstVariation_of_zero_mass.complete_declaration:
theorem density_firstVariation_of_zero_mass
    (ν : Measure Z) (q r U : Z → ℝ) (s : Set ℝ) (bound : Z → ℝ)
    (hs : s ∈ 𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) (hq : Measurable q) (hr : Measurable r)
    (hU : Measurable U)
    (hbase : Integrable (fun z ↦ q z * (Real.log (q z) + U z)) ν)
    (hpositive : ∀ᵐ z ∂ν, ∀ t ∈ s, 0 < q z + t * r z)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ z ∂ν, ∀ t ∈ s,
      |r z * (Real.log (q z + t * r z) + U z + 1)| ≤ bound z)
    (hbound_int : Integrable bound ν)
    (hr_int : Integrable r ν) (hmass : (∫ z, r z ∂ν) = 0) :
    Integrable (fun z ↦ r z * (Real.log (q z) + U z)) ν ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ densityFreeEnergy ν (fun z ↦ q z + t * r z) U)
        (∫ z, r z * (Real.log (q z) + U z) ∂ν) 0 := by
  obtain ⟨hint, hderiv⟩ := density_freeEnergy_hasDerivAt ν q r U s bound hs hq hr hU
    hbase hpositive hbound hbound_int
  have hweighted : Integrable (fun z ↦ r z * (Real.log (q z) + U z)) ν := by
    convert hint.sub hr_int using 1
    ext z
    change r z * (Real.log (q z) + U z) =
      r z * (Real.log (q z) + U z + 1) - r z
    ring
  refine ⟨hweighted, ?_⟩
  have heq : (∫ z, r z * (Real.log (q z) + U z + 1) ∂ν) =
      ∫ z, r z * (Real.log (q z) + U z) ∂ν := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ z, r z * (Real.log (q z) + U z) + r z ∂ν := by
        congr 1
        ext z
        ring
      _ = _ := by rw [integral_add hweighted hr_int, hmass, add_zero]
  rwa [heq] at hderiv

import LatentDiffusion.SourceAssumptions
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.WithDensity
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.LpSeminorm.Basic

/-!
# The literal time-zero solution assumption has an obstruction

An arbitrary finite-second-moment initial law includes a Dirac measure. Such a
law cannot have a density relative to a reference measure that assigns zero mass
to the corresponding singleton. This argument needs no PDE or positivity
assumption. In particular it applies to Lebesgue measure in positive dimension.
-/

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set

namespace LatentDiffusion.SourceObstruction

variable {P Z : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [NormedSpace ℝ Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSingletonClass Z]

/-- The source's universal solution regularity is impossible whenever the
reference measure has even one null singleton. The initial law is an actual
finite-second-moment Dirac probability measure. -/

/-- Atomless reference measures, including positive-dimensional Lebesgue
measures, therefore rule out the literal source premise. -/

end LatentDiffusion.SourceObstruction

not_solutionRegularity_of_null_singleton.statement:
theorem not_solutionRegularity_of_null_singleton {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (ν : Measure Z) (z₀ : Z) (hν : ν {z₀} = 0) (p₀ : P)
    (flowEquation : (ℝ → P) → (Fin M → ℝ → ProbabilityMeasure Z) → Prop) :
    ¬ SourceAssumptions.SolutionRegularity ν flowEquation
not_solutionRegularity_of_null_singleton.complete_declaration:
theorem not_solutionRegularity_of_null_singleton {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (ν : Measure Z) (z₀ : Z) (hν : ν {z₀} = 0) (p₀ : P)
    (flowEquation : (ℝ → P) → (Fin M → ℝ → ProbabilityMeasure Z) → Prop) :
    ¬ SourceAssumptions.SolutionRegularity ν flowEquation := by
  intro h
  let μ₀ : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z := fun _ ↦ (Measure.dirac z₀).toProbabilityMeasure
  have hmem : ∀ i, MemLp (fun z : Z ↦ z) 2 (μ₀ i : Measure Z) := by
    intro i
    change MemLp (fun z : Z ↦ z) 2 (Measure.dirac z₀)
    exact (memLp_congr_ae (ae_eq_dirac (fun z : Z ↦ z))).mpr
      (memLp_const (μ := Measure.dirac z₀) (p := 2) z₀)
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := h p₀ μ₀ hmem
  let i : Fin M := ⟨0, hM⟩
  have hinit : (S.law i 0 : Measure Z) = Measure.dirac z₀ := by
    rw [S.initial_law i]
    rfl
  have hd : Measure.dirac z₀ =
      ν.withDensity (fun z ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (S.density i 0 z)) := by
    rw [← hinit]
    exact S.density_realizes i 0 le_rfl
  have hac : Measure.dirac z₀ ≪ ν := by
    rw [hd]
    exact withDensity_absolutelyContinuous _ _
  have hz := hac hν
  simp at hz

not_solutionRegularity_of_noAtoms.statement:
theorem not_solutionRegularity_of_noAtoms {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (ν : Measure Z) [NullSingletonClass ν] (p₀ : P)
    (flowEquation : (ℝ → P) → (Fin M → ℝ → ProbabilityMeasure Z) → Prop) :
    ¬ SourceAssumptions.SolutionRegularity ν flowEquation
not_solutionRegularity_of_noAtoms.complete_declaration:
theorem not_solutionRegularity_of_noAtoms {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (ν : Measure Z) [NullSingletonClass ν] (p₀ : P)
    (flowEquation : (ℝ → P) → (Fin M → ℝ → ProbabilityMeasure Z) → Prop) :
    ¬ SourceAssumptions.SolutionRegularity ν flowEquation :=
  not_solutionRegularity_of_null_singleton hM ν 0 (measure_singleton 0) p₀ flowEquation

import LatentDiffusion.Density
import LatentDiffusion.Flow
import Mathlib.Topology.Semicontinuity.Basic
import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.Cauchy
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Deriv

set_option linter.style.header false

/-!
# Additional source results, on their explicit mathematical domains

These theorems reconstruct elementary steps used in the supplied manuscript.
They do not construct optimal transport plans, identify a Wasserstein metric
derivative, or justify differentiation or integration by parts on an unbounded
domain. Those continuum application steps remain separate obligations.

`cauchy_minimizing_sequence` corrects Supplement `lem:cauchy`: a Cauchy
sequence must also be a minimizing sequence. A complete ambient metric space
and lower semicontinuity then give an actual minimizer.
-/

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped Topology

namespace LatentDiffusion.SourceResults

/-- Corrected Supplement `lem:cauchy`: completeness and lower semicontinuity
identify the limit of a Cauchy *minimizing* sequence as a minimizer.
No unrelated Cauchy sequence supplies this conclusion. -/

/-- The scalar derivative used in Supplement `app:lemma_1st_var` includes
the additive constant one. It disappears only on zero-total-mass directions. -/

/-- Constants represent the same first variation on probability tangent
directions. This proves the precise reason the source may omit `+1`. -/

/-- The source's normalized product metric cancels the `1/M` from the
distributional first variation with the inverse metric's `M`.
The positivity of the data count is essential. -/

/-- The first-order scalar consequence of the source's geodesic-convexity
inequality. This step is proved by taking the right derivative; the existence
and calculus of an actual Wasserstein geodesic is not a premise hidden here. -/

/-- The source's Talagrand-type quadratic growth follows directly from strong
geodesic convexity at a minimizer. This proof needs no entropy dissipation.
The application must still establish the displayed convexity inequality for

theorem cauchy_minimizing_sequence
    {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X]
    (F : X → ℝ) (Fstar : ℝ) (hF : LowerSemicontinuous F)
    (hstar : ∀ x, Fstar ≤ F x) (u : ℕ → X)
    (hu : CauchySeq u) (hvalue : Tendsto (fun n ↦ F (u n)) atTop (𝓝 Fstar)) :
    ∃ xstar, Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 xstar) ∧ F xstar = Fstar ∧
      ∀ x, F xstar ≤ F x
cauchy_minimizing_sequence.complete_declaration:
theorem cauchy_minimizing_sequence
    {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X]
    (F : X → ℝ) (Fstar : ℝ) (hF : LowerSemicontinuous F)
    (hstar : ∀ x, Fstar ≤ F x) (u : ℕ → X)
    (hu : CauchySeq u) (hvalue : Tendsto (fun n ↦ F (u n)) atTop (𝓝 Fstar)) :
    ∃ xstar, Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 xstar) ∧ F xstar = Fstar ∧
      ∀ x, F xstar ≤ F x := by
  obtain ⟨xstar, hx⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete hu
  have hlim : F xstar ≤ Fstar := by
    apply le_of_forall_lt_imp_le_of_dense
    intro c hc
    exact ge_of_tendsto hvalue ((hx.eventually (hF xstar c hc)).mono fun _ h ↦ h.le)
  have heq := le_antisymm hlim (hstar xstar)
  refine ⟨xstar, hx, heq, ?_⟩
  intro x
  rw [heq]
  exact hstar x

theorem geodesic_convexity_first_order
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (fend derivative rho distance : ℝ)
    (hderiv : HasDerivWithinAt f derivative (Ici 0) 0)
    (hconv : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      f s ≤ (1 - s) * f 0 + s * fend - rho / 2 * s * (1 - s) * distance ^ 2) :
    derivative ≤ fend - f 0 - rho / 2 * distance ^ 2
geodesic_convexity_first_order.complete_declaration:
theorem geodesic_convexity_first_order
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (fend derivative rho distance : ℝ)
    (hderiv : HasDerivWithinAt f derivative (Ici 0) 0)
    (hconv : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      f s ≤ (1 - s) * f 0 + s * fend - rho / 2 * s * (1 - s) * distance ^ 2) :
    derivative ≤ fend - f 0 - rho / 2 * distance ^ 2 := by
  have hright : Tendsto (slope f 0) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 derivative) :=
    (hasDerivWithinAt_iff_tendsto_slope' (by simp : (0 : ℝ) ∉ Ioi 0)).mp
      (hderiv.mono Ioi_subset_Ici_self)
  have hbound : ∀ᶠ s : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0,
      slope f 0 s ≤ fend - f 0 - rho / 2 * (1 - s) * distance ^ 2 := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin,
      (eventually_lt_nhds (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds]
      with s hs hs1
    have hh := hconv s ⟨hs.le, hs1.le⟩
    rw [slope_def_field]
    simp only [sub_zero]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hs).mpr
    calc
      f s - f 0 ≤ (1 - s) * f 0 + s * fend -
          rho / 2 * s * (1 - s) * distance ^ 2 - f 0 := sub_le_sub_right hh _
      _ = (fend - f 0 - rho / 2 * (1 - s) * distance ^ 2) * s := by ring
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ ↦ fend - f 0 - rho / 2 * (1 - s) * distance ^ 2)
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (fend - f 0 - rho / 2 * distance ^ 2)) := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun s : ℝ ↦ fend - f 0 - rho / 2 * (1 - s) * distance ^ 2) := by
      fun_prop
    simpa using (hc.tendsto 0).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto hright hlim hbound

theorem geodesic_quadratic_growth
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (fend rho distance : ℝ)
    (hmin : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, f 0 ≤ f s)
    (hconv : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      f s ≤ (1 - s) * f 0 + s * fend - rho / 2 * s * (1 - s) * distance ^ 2) :
    rho / 2 * distance ^ 2 ≤ fend - f 0 := by
  have hbound : ∀ᶠ s : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0,

    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin,

    have hm := hmin s ⟨hs.le, hs1.le⟩

tilted_log_integrand.statement:
theorem tilted_log_integrand {Z : Type*} (q ρ R : Z → ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ z, 0 ≤ q z) (hρ : ∀ z, 0 < ρ z) (z : Z) :
    q z * Real.log (q z / tiltedDensity ρ R z) =
      q z * Real.log (q z / ρ z) + q z * R z

theorem tilted_log_integrand {Z : Type*} (q ρ R : Z → ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ z, 0 ≤ q z) (hρ : ∀ z, 0 < ρ z) (z : Z) :
    q z * Real.log (q z / tiltedDensity ρ R z) =
      q z * Real.log (q z / ρ z) + q z * R z := by
  by_cases hz : q z = 0
  · simp [hz]
  · have hqz : 0 < q z := lt_of_le_of_ne (hq z) (Ne.symm hz)
    rw [tiltedDensity, Real.log_div hz (mul_ne_zero (hρ z).ne' (Real.exp_ne_zero _)),
      Real.log_mul (hρ z).ne' (Real.exp_ne_zero _), Real.log_exp,
      Real.log_div hz (hρ z).ne']
    ring

theorem tilted_freeEnergy_decomposition
    {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (ν : Measure Z) (q ρ R : Z → ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ z, 0 ≤ q z) (hρ : ∀ z, 0 < ρ z)
    (hfree : Integrable (fun z ↦ q z * Real.log (q z / ρ z)) ν)
    (hpenalty : Integrable (fun z ↦ q z * R z) ν) :
    Integrable (fun z ↦ q z * Real.log (q z / tiltedDensity ρ R z)) ν ∧
      densityFreeEnergy ν q (tiltedDensity ρ R) =
        densityFreeEnergy ν q ρ + ∫ z, q z * R z ∂ν

theorem tilted_freeEnergy_decomposition
    {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (ν : Measure Z) (q ρ R : Z → ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ z, 0 ≤ q z) (hρ : ∀ z, 0 < ρ z)
    (hfree : Integrable (fun z ↦ q z * Real.log (q z / ρ z)) ν)
    (hpenalty : Integrable (fun z ↦ q z * R z) ν) :
    Integrable (fun z ↦ q z * Real.log (q z / tiltedDensity ρ R z)) ν ∧
      densityFreeEnergy ν q (tiltedDensity ρ R) =
        densityFreeEnergy ν q ρ + ∫ z, q z * R z ∂ν := by
  unfold densityFreeEnergy
  simp_rw [tilted_log_integrand q ρ R hq hρ]
  exact ⟨hfree.add hpenalty, integral_add hfree hpenalty⟩

tilted_freeEnergy_le.statement:
theorem tilted_freeEnergy_le
    {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (ν : Measure Z) (q ρ R : Z → ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ z, 0 ≤ q z) (hρ : ∀ z, 0 < ρ z) (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hfree : Integrable (fun z ↦ q z * Real.log (q z / ρ z)) ν)
    (hpenalty : Integrable (fun z ↦ q z * R z) ν) :
    densityFreeEnergy ν q ρ ≤ densityFreeEnergy ν q (tiltedDensity ρ R)
tilted_freeEnergy_le.complete_declaration:
theorem tilted_freeEnergy_le
    {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (ν : Measure Z) (q ρ R : Z → ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ z, 0 ≤ q z) (hρ : ∀ z, 0 < ρ z) (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hfree : Integrable (fun z ↦ q z * Real.log (q z / ρ z)) ν)
    (hpenalty : Integrable (fun z ↦ q z * R z) ν) :
    densityFreeEnergy ν q ρ ≤ densityFreeEnergy ν q (tiltedDensity ρ R) := by
  rw [(tilted_freeEnergy_decomposition ν q ρ R hq hρ hfree hpenalty).2]

tilted_evidence_le.statement:
theorem tilted_evidence_le
    {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (ν : Measure Z) (ρ R : Z → ℝ)
    (hρmeas : Measurable ρ) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hρ : ∀ z, 0 ≤ ρ z) (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z) (hint : Integrable ρ ν) :
    Integrable (tiltedDensity ρ R) ν ∧
      (∫ z, tiltedDensity ρ R z ∂ν) ≤ ∫ z, ρ z ∂ν
tilted_evidence_le.complete_declaration:
theorem tilted_evidence_le
    {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] (ν : Measure Z) (ρ R : Z → ℝ)
    (hρmeas : Measurable ρ) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hρ : ∀ z, 0 ≤ ρ z) (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z) (hint : Integrable ρ ν) :
    Integrable (tiltedDensity ρ R) ν ∧
      (∫ z, tiltedDensity ρ R z ∂ν) ≤ ∫ z, ρ z ∂ν := by
  have hnonneg (z : Z) : 0 ≤ tiltedDensity ρ R z :=
    mul_nonneg (hρ z) (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hle (z : Z) : tiltedDensity ρ R z ≤ ρ z := by
    apply mul_le_of_le_one_right (hρ z)
    exact Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (neg_nonpos.mpr (hR z))
  have hmeas : Measurable (tiltedDensity ρ R) := hρmeas.mul (hRmeas.neg.exp)
  have htilt : Integrable (tiltedDensity ρ R) ν := by
    apply hint.mono' hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
    exact ae_of_all _ fun z ↦ by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hnonneg z)] using hle z
  exact ⟨htilt, integral_mono htilt hint hle⟩

import Mathlib.InformationTheory.KullbackLeibler.Basic
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.ProbabilityMeasure
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-! # The normalized variational problem

The free energy is defined by its canonical normalized form, minus log evidence
plus average actual KL divergence. Admissibility retains finite KL before any
`toReal` conversion. Identifying this definition with a density integral needs
the usual log-integrability and normalization identities; those are not inferred
from pointwise smoothness. The theorem is valid for arbitrary measurable latent
spaces and arbitrary parameter sets, so in particular for tilted latent models.
-/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal
namespace LatentDiffusion

variable {A Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] {M : ℕ}

/-- The tilted log evidence and its normalized posterior at each datum. -/

namespace PosteriorFamily
variable (P : PosteriorFamily A Z M)

/-- Excludes infinite entropy from real arithmetic. -/

/-- The normalized free energy, equal to the log-density definition on its
finite integrability domain. -/





/-- Equality in the variational bound identifies every posterior, using
Gibbs' equality theorem for actual finite measures. -/

/-- Proposition 1, including the unique optimal variational distribution.
No existence of a log-evidence maximizer is assumed or concluded. -/

end PosteriorFamily

/-- The valid zero-tilt comparison requires a true optimum attaining zero
gap. Zero gap only at a tilted optimum is insufficient. -/

/-- A zero-penalty tilted maximizer can fail to maximize the true likelihood.
Both likelihoods and gaps here are exact real numbers on a two-point model. -/

end LatentDiffusion

PosteriorFamily.statement: structure PosteriorFamily (A Z : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Z] (M : ℕ)
PosteriorFamily.complete_declaration:
structure PosteriorFamily (A Z : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Z] (M : ℕ) where
  logEvidence : A → ℝ
  posterior : A → Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z

Admissible.statement: def Admissible (a : A) (q : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z) : Prop
Admissible.complete_declaration:
def Admissible (a : A) (q : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z) : Prop :=

def IsGlobalMin (a : A) (q : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z) : Prop :=

posterior_admissible.statement: theorem posterior_admissible (a : A) : P.Admissible a (P.posterior a)

theorem posterior_admissible (a : A) : P.Admissible a (P.posterior a) := by

  simp

posterior_freeEnergy.statement: theorem posterior_freeEnergy (a : A) : P.freeEnergy a (P.posterior a) = -P.logEvidence a

theorem posterior_freeEnergy (a : A) : P.freeEnergy a (P.posterior a) = -P.logEvidence a := by

theorem lower_bound (a : A) (q : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z) :
    -P.logEvidence a ≤ P.freeEnergy a q
lower_bound.complete_declaration:
theorem lower_bound (a : A) (q : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z) :
    -P.logEvidence a ≤ P.freeEnergy a q := by
  unfold freeEnergy
  have h : 0 ≤ (M : ℝ)⁻¹ *
      ∑ m, (InformationTheory.klDiv (q m : Measure Z) (P.posterior a m : Measure Z)).toReal :=
    mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
      (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg))
  linarith

equality_iff.statement:
theorem equality_iff (hM : 0 < M) (a : A) (q : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z)
    (hq : P.Admissible a q) :
    P.freeEnergy a q = -P.logEvidence a ↔ q = P.posterior a
equality_iff.complete_declaration:
theorem equality_iff (hM : 0 < M) (a : A) (q : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z)
    (hq : P.Admissible a q) :
    P.freeEnergy a q = -P.logEvidence a ↔ q = P.posterior a := by
  constructor
  · intro he
    have hsum : (∑ m, (InformationTheory.klDiv (q m : Measure Z)
        (P.posterior a m : Measure Z)).toReal) = 0 := by
      have hm : (M : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hM)
      have hh : (M : ℝ)⁻¹ * (∑ m, (InformationTheory.klDiv (q m : Measure Z)
          (P.posterior a m : Measure Z)).toReal) = 0 := by
        unfold freeEnergy at he
        linarith
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hh).resolve_left (inv_ne_zero hm)
    funext m
    have hm : (InformationTheory.klDiv (q m : Measure Z)
        (P.posterior a m : Measure Z)).toReal = 0 := by
      exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun _ _ => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg)).mp hsum
        m (Finset.mem_univ m)
    have hz : InformationTheory.klDiv (q m : Measure Z) (P.posterior a m : Measure Z) = 0 :=
      (ENNReal.toReal_eq_zero_iff _).mp hm |>.resolve_right (hq m)
    letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (q m : Measure Z) := (q m).property
    letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (P.posterior a m : Measure Z) := (P.posterior a m).property
    have hm := InformationTheory.klDiv_eq_zero_iff.mp hz
    exact Subtype.ext hm
  · intro he
    subst q
    exact P.posterior_freeEnergy a

global_minimizers_iff.statement:
theorem global_minimizers_iff (hM : 0 < M) (a : A)
    (q : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z) :
    P.IsGlobalMin a q ↔
      (∀ b, P.logEvidence b ≤ P.logEvidence a) ∧ q = P.posterior a
global_minimizers_iff.complete_declaration:
theorem global_minimizers_iff (hM : 0 < M) (a : A)
    (q : Fin M → ProbabilityMeasure Z) :
    P.IsGlobalMin a q ↔
      (∀ b, P.logEvidence b ≤ P.logEvidence a) ∧ q = P.posterior a := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hq, hmin⟩
    have he : P.freeEnergy a q = -P.logEvidence a := le_antisymm
      (by simpa only [P.posterior_freeEnergy] using
        hmin a (P.posterior a) (P.posterior_admissible a)) (P.lower_bound a q)
    refine ⟨fun b => ?_, (P.equality_iff hM a q hq).mp he⟩
    have hb := hmin b (P.posterior b) (P.posterior_admissible b)
    rw [he, P.posterior_freeEnergy] at hb
    linarith
  · rintro ⟨hmax, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨P.posterior_admissible a, fun b r _ => ?_⟩
    rw [P.posterior_freeEnergy]
    exact (neg_le_neg (hmax b)).trans (P.lower_bound b r)

maximizer_iff_exists_minimizer.statement:
theorem maximizer_iff_exists_minimizer (hM : 0 < M) (a : A) :
    (∀ b, P.logEvidence b ≤ P.logEvidence a) ↔ ∃ q, P.IsGlobalMin a q
maximizer_iff_exists_minimizer.complete_declaration:
theorem maximizer_iff_exists_minimizer (hM : 0 < M) (a : A) :
    (∀ b, P.logEvidence b ≤ P.logEvidence a) ↔ ∃ q, P.IsGlobalMin a q := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨P.posterior a, (P.global_minimizers_iff hM a _).mpr ⟨h, rfl⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
    exact ((P.global_minimizers_iff hM a q).mp hq).1

zero_gap_comparator.statement:
theorem zero_gap_comparator {ell tilted : A → ℝ} (a b : A)
    (hupper : ∀ x, tilted x ≤ ell x)
    (htrue : ∀ x, ell x ≤ ell b) (hzero : tilted b = ell b)
    (hmax : ∀ x, tilted x ≤ tilted a) :
    ell a = ell b
zero_gap_comparator.complete_declaration:
theorem zero_gap_comparator {ell tilted : A → ℝ} (a b : A)
    (hupper : ∀ x, tilted x ≤ ell x)
    (htrue : ∀ x, ell x ≤ ell b) (hzero : tilted b = ell b)
    (hmax : ∀ x, tilted x ≤ tilted a) :
    ell a = ell b := by
  have h := hmax b
  rw [hzero] at h
  exact le_antisymm (htrue a) (h.trans (hupper a))

zero_gap_at_tilted_max_not_sufficient.statement:
theorem zero_gap_at_tilted_max_not_sufficient :
    let ell : Bool → ℝ := fun b => if b then 1 else 0
    let gap : Bool → ℝ := fun b => if b then 2 else 0
    (∀ b, 0 ≤ gap b) ∧ gap false = 0 ∧
      (∀ b, ell b - gap b ≤ ell false - gap false) ∧ ell false < ell true
